Dude, I was just trying to park, right? Like, this spot was kinda tight, but I thought I could make it. And then, I just misjudged it, you know? My front bumper just grazed the pole, and now there's, like, a really ugly scratch, and a small dent underneath. My dad is gonna kill me, this car is new, pá. I'm so bummed about this.

I was just leaving the supermarket, you see, with my groceries, and the sun was quite strong, a lovely day for it, and I saw this young man, he was trying to park his car, a small grey one it was, and he just seemed to misjudge the distance to the pillar, and I heard a scraping sound, and then he looked very distressed, poor thing, there was a scratch and a small dent on the front of his car, it wasn't anyone else's fault, just a little miscalculation.

I was driving along EN125, going to visit my sister in Tavira, as I do every Tuesday, and it happened to be a bit foggy, not too bad but enough to obscure things a little, and I just drifted a tiny bit off the road, not much, but enough to hit a small concrete barrier, a little kerb really, and it really rattled me, and now my front bumper is all dented and there's a big crack in the plastic and one of the headlights is broken, it's just a genuine accident, I never thought anything like this would happen to me, my eyesight isn't what it used to be but I still drive very carefully.

I was not directly involved in the incident. I observed a Citroën C3, traveling westbound on EN125, veer slightly off the carriageway. The vehicle made contact with a low concrete road barrier on the shoulder. Post-impact, the front-left section of the vehicle displayed significant cosmetic damage, specifically a large dent, a visible crack, and the left headlamp assembly appeared to be non-functional.

I was approaching the Rotunda do Relógio. Due to unexpected glare from the morning sun and the concurrent distraction of a pedestrian stepping onto the zebra crossing, I misjudged the distance to the oncoming vehicle. My speed was approximately 10 km/h. There was a minor frontal impact. The front bumper of my vehicle now has a dent, visible scratching, and the left fog lamp is broken. The second vehicle's statement should corroborate the low velocity of the event.

Oh goodness, I was just entering the roundabout, very slowly mind you, because it was rush hour and lots of traffic, and then this very fancy Mercedes just sort of, eased into my path, I think the driver didn't see me, and we just bumped, not hard at all, but my little Peugeot, it's got a impact depression on the front, and a scratch, and the right indicator light is cracked, I was so shaken up, you know, my heart was pounding, but thankfully nobody was hurt.

Alright, so I was in the roundabout, right? Like, the one near the bridge, you know? And I was in the inner lane, indicating to exit, and this other car, a white van, just came into my lane from the outer lane without looking. I did my best to brake, pá, but it was too late. My front right side hit his back left side. Now I've got a big dent and scratch on my front fender, and my headlight is, like, totally busted. I'm so annoyed, man.

My vehicle was operating within the outer lane of the roundabout on Avenida 25 de Abril. I was preparing to take the second exit. The insured vehicle, a Nissan Qashqai, which was positioned in the inner lane, initiated a maneuver to exit, thereby conflicting with my trajectory. The point of impact was the front-right quarter panel of the Nissan and the rear-left quarter of my van. Damage assessment shows a dent, superficial scratching, and a fractured taillight assembly on my vehicle.

I was waiting at the pedestrian crossing, just watching the cars go round and round, it's always so busy there, and the weather was quite pleasant for a change, and I saw the grey car, the Qashqai, trying to exit the roundabout, and the white van, it just didn't seem to give way, or maybe the driver didn't see, these things happen so quickly, and they bumped, not a huge crash, but enough to make a noise, and I saw a lamp on the van was broken, and the grey car had a dent, a genuine accident really, poor people.

I was attempting to reverse out of a parking spot on Rua do Carmo. The visibility was somewhat limited due to an adjacent larger vehicle. Despite checking my mirrors, I failed to observe the approaching vehicle (Fiat 500) and inadvertently made contact. My rear bumper sustained a dent and a series of scratches. The accident was purely an error in judgment on my part during the reversing maneuver.

Oh, my sweet little Fiat, I was just driving past, going at like, 15 km/h, really slow, you know? And this car, a Hyundai, just started reversing out, like, really suddenly! I honked, but it just kept coming. Now my front fender has, like, a dent, and there's a huge scratch right there. It's so unfair, pá, I was just driving normally.

I was driving through Serra da Estrela, it was late evening, just before sunset, beautiful scenery really, and I was going a steady 60 km/h, no faster, when suddenly, a wild boar just ran out onto the road, from the brush you see, it was so unexpected, I had no time to brake properly, and I hit it, poor animal, and now my car, the front bumper is really dented, and there's a crack in the grille, and the right fog lamp is shattered, a genuine accident, what can one do against nature.

I was heading behind the Dacia Duster on the mountain road. The driver was maintaining a consistent and safe speed. Suddenly, a large wild boar emerged from the roadside vegetation. The Duster's driver applied brakes, but impact with the animal was unavoidable. The vehicle sustained damage to its front fascia, specifically a notable dent, a crack in the lower grille, and the right-side auxiliary lamp was observed to be broken. This was clearly an unforeseeable event.

Man, it was raining so hard on the A2, you know? Like, super heavy. I was going about 100 km/h, well below the limit, but suddenly, like, the car just lost grip, totally hydroplaned. I tried to correct it, but I just slid into the guardrail, pá. The whole left side of my car is messed up. There's a huge dent and scratches all along the side, the rear-view mirror is cracked, and the left tail light is broken. It was just an accident, I swear, the rain was insane.

I was traveling on the A2, south of Évora, during a period of extremely heavy rainfall. The road conditions were severely compromised by standing water. I observed an Audi A4, approximately 100 meters ahead of my position, suddenly lose traction. The vehicle veered to the left, impacting the median guardrail. Post-impact, the driver's side of the vehicle showed substantial damage, including extensive denting, scraping along the entire left flank, a cracked side mirror, and a shattered rear lamp. The incident appeared to be a direct consequence of hydroplaning.

Dude, it was like, totally not my fault, you know? I was just driving my Renault Clio down Rua Augusta, like, super slow, maybe 20 km/h, and this guy in front just, like, slammed on his brakes out of nowhere near the Arco da Rua Augusta. I tried to stop, man, I really did, but it was too late. I just kinda nudged him, you know? My front bumper has a dent and a scratch, and I’m so worried about the repair costs, pá. This is all so confusing.

At approximately 14:30 on October 15th, I was operating my Audi A4 on the A20, proceeding towards the Campanhã exit in Porto. While initiating the merge into the exit lane, a white commercial van, registration number not fully observed, attempted to enter the same lane from the left with insufficient clearance. The lateral contact resulted in a significant scratch along the passenger side, a minor dent near the rear door, and the breakage of the passenger-side rear lamp assembly. My speed was approximately 60 km/h, consistent with the posted limits for the deceleration lane.

location: Continente Car Park, Estrada de São Brás, Faro

statements.text: Oh dear, it was just terrible. I was at the Continente in Faro, you know, on the Estrada de São Brás, I had just bought some lovely fresh fish for my grandchildren who were visiting from Évora. The sun was quite bright, and I was reversing my little Dacia Sandero very, very slowly, maybe 5 km/h, just trying to get out of the parking space when *bang*! I bumped into one of those concrete pillars they have. My poor front bumper has a horrible dent and a bit of a crack. My husband, Manuel, always tells me to be careful, bless his heart. It really gave me a fright, I nearly dropped my shopping bag.

Man, it was a total mess, you know? I was cruising my VW Polo through Praça da República in Coimbra, at like, 30 km/h, the light was green for me, for sure! And then this other car just, like, came out of nowhere from the side street, didn't even stop! I swerved but couldn't avoid it. My passenger door is all dented and scratched, and the window, like, totally shattered. It was so unexpected, pá, I still can’t believe it.

My vehicle, a Mercedes A-Class, was proceeding eastbound on Rua da Sofia, approaching Praça da República in Coimbra. I maintain that the traffic signal indicated a yellow light transitioning to red. I was decelerating, anticipating the stop, however, the Volkswagen Polo failed to yield as per standard intersection protocols and collided with my vehicle's front passenger side. The impact caused a superficial scratch on my front fender, but no significant structural damage to my vehicle. I estimate my speed at impact to be less than 15 km/h.

At approximately 11:00, while operating my Ford Focus at a reduced speed of approximately 10 km/h on Avenida do Infante in Funchal, near the Reid's Palace Hotel, an individual stepped suddenly off the pavement into the street without observing oncoming traffic. Despite immediate braking, the pedestrian made contact with the passenger-side front fender of my vehicle. The impact was minor, resulting in a small dent and associated scratch on the fender. The pedestrian sustained no visible injuries and declined medical assistance, proceeding on foot after the incident was documented.

I was enjoying a lovely walk along the Avenida do Infante, the weather was just delightful, a gentle breeze from the ocean, very pleasant. I saw the car, a nice blue Ford, driving along quite slowly, minding its own business, perhaps 10 or 15 kilometers an hour, no more. And then, well, this young person, probably distracted by their phone, just walked right into the side of it, near the front wheel. The car stopped immediately, I must say. There was a little dent, and a scratch, you could see it. The young person seemed perfectly fine, just a bit shaken, like. My grandson, Tiago, he’s always on his phone, I tell him it's dangerous, but they never listen, do they?

Oh, it was such a bother, you see, I was trying to park my little Fiat Punto in Largo da Misericórdia in Setúbal, which can be quite tricky with all the narrow streets, you know. I was going very, very slow, probably 5 km/h, just easing into the spot, and the sun was in my eyes, really bright that morning, and I just misjudged it a little bit. And *thump*! I hit that old lamppost right there. My front lamp, the left one, it's completely broken, and there's a nasty dent and a crack on the bumper. My eyes aren't what they used to be, you know, my optician, Dr. Silva, says I need new glasses, I keep forgetting to order them. It's a real nuisance.

location: Braga Parque Shopping Centre Car Park, Braga

statements.text: Like, okay, so I was at Braga Parque, you know, heading out after grabbing some new sneakers, and I was backing my Opel Corsa out of the parking spot. It was kinda tight, and this other car, a silver SUV, started backing out at the same time, from the spot opposite. I could not spot him, pá, I swear! Or maybe he didn't see me, who knows? We just, like, lightly bumped. My rear bumper got a dent and a scratch, and I’m so annoyed, man, because now I have to deal with all this insurance stuff. It's so confusing.

On October 18th, at approximately 09:15, I was navigating my Peugeot 308 down Rua dos Pescadores in Aveiro, proceeding towards the city center. The street is rather narrow, and at one point, I misjudged the clearance while passing a legally parked vehicle, a red Fiat Punto. My vehicle's front passenger side made contact with the rear driver's side of the parked car. The incident resulted in a dent and significant scratches on my front bumper, and the right-hand front lamp of my vehicle is now broken. My speed was minimal, estimated at 5 km/h, due to the constrained environment.

Oh, it was dreadful, truly. I was in the Rotunda de Guimarães, you know, the big one near the stadium. I was going round, like I always do, being very careful, maybe 25 kilometers an hour, and this other car, a black BMW, just came speeding in, it didn't seem to indicate! I attempted to avoid it, poor me, but it clipped my side. My little Skoda Fabia now has a big damage to the rear door, and a long scratch, and there’s a crack near the wheel arch. My blood pressure went right up, I had to stop and take my tablets, you know. It’s always something, isn’t it? The traffic here is just not what it used to be.

At approximately 16:00, I was operating my BMW 3 Series, entering the Rotunda de Guimarães from the south approach. I was indicating right, intending to exit at the second turn-off. The Skoda Fabia, which was already circulating within the roundabout, deviated from its lane without proper indication and made contact with the front passenger side of my vehicle. The collision caused minor damage to the Skoda; my vehicle sustained no discernible damage. My entry speed was approximately 30 km/h.

Okay, so I was driving my Hyundai i20 down Rua Miguel Bombarda in Leiria, you know, that really narrow street downtown? I was going, like, super slow, maybe 15 km/h, because there are always people walking around. And then this bus just, like, came towards me, taking up the whole road, and I had to swerve a bit to the right, and *bam*! I totally hit one of those stupid bollards they have on the pavement. My front bumper has a pretty gnarly dent and some scratches now. It’s so annoying, pá, like, why are those bollards even there, man?

I was just sitting outside the café on Rua Miguel Bombarda, enjoying my coffee, a lovely sunny day it was, you know. I saw a young man driving a small blue car, a Hyundai I think, going along. He wasn't going fast, no, probably about 10 or 15 kilometers an hour. Then a big bus came from the other direction, and the young man, bless his heart, he moved to the side a bit too much and bumped right into one of those metal poles they put on the pavement. Poor fellow, it made a terrible sound. You could see a dent and some scratches on the car. My late husband, Joaquim, always used to say those streets were too narrow for modern traffic, bless his soul.

Oh man, it was like, totally my fault, you know? I was looking at the GPS, just for a sec, and the car in front just stopped suddenly. I swear I was going like, maybe 40 km/h, but I couldn't brake in time. My front bumper is all dented and there are some deep scratches. And like, the left headlight is definitely broken, dude. I'm so anxious about the cost, pá.

I was stationary at the traffic light on Avenida da República. My vehicle, a Volkswagen Passat, was struck from the rear by a Renault Clio. The impact caused a significant dent to my rear bumper and the left rear lamp assembly is broken. My speed was 0 km/h at the time of impact. The driver of the Clio admitted fault. No personal injuries reported.

I was travelling in the middle lane of the VCI near the Freixo bridge, maintaining a constant speed of approximately 90 km/h. A vehicle, a white van, attempted to merge from the right lane without adequate clearance. Despite my evasive maneuver, the van's left side made contact with my vehicle's right side, resulting in extensive scratches and a minor dent along the passenger doors. The van did not stop.

I was behind the Mercedes-Benz, doing about 85 km/h. A white delivery van, I think it was a Peugeot Partner, just cut across from the right lane. It looked like he didn't even see the Mercedes. There was a loud scraping sound, and I saw the van hit the side of the car. The Mercedes swerved a bit but the van just kept going towards Matosinhos. It happened quite fast, near the exit for Campanhã, around 10:30 AM.

Well I was just coming from visiting my sister, bless her heart, over by the market, and I was going to turn onto Rua de Aveiro. The light, it was green for me, I'm sure of it. I had my grandchildren's drawings on the passenger seat you see, so I was driving very carefully. This young man in a black car, he just came speeding through, probably doing 60 km/h at least. He hit my front end, made a terrible noise. My bumper is all dented and cracked, and the right headlight is absolutely smashed. Such a shame, this car has been so good to me.

Okay, so like, I was just driving super slow, you know, around 20 km/h, because it's a busy street in Faro, pá. And then suddenly, this lady just kinda walked right out from between two parked cars. I slammed on the brakes, but like, I just kinda clipped her with the side of my bumper. She seemed okay, just a bit shaken, thankfully. My front bumper has a dent now, and there's a small crack near the fog light. I feel so bad, man.

location: Parking lot, near Templo Romano, Évora

statements.text: It happened to be a lovely sunny day in Évora, I had just finished my usual walk by the Roman Temple and was heading back to the car. I was reversing out of my parking spot, very slowly mind you, probably less than 5 km/h. I checked my mirrors, twice! But the car next to me, a black SUV, it was quite big, I just didn't see it for a moment. Just a small tap, but it left a dent and some scratches on my rear bumper. Oh dear, it’s always something, isn't it? My husband always says I should leave the parking to him, bless his soul.

My vehicle was correctly parked in a designated space within the Évora city center parking facility. I was not present at the time of the incident. Upon returning, I observed a noticeable scratch on the front passenger side fender. An elderly lady in a Dacia Sandero approached me and stated she had reversed into my parked vehicle. She confirmed she caused the damage. The damage consists of a distinct scratch approximately 15 cm in length.

I was navigating a tight turn on Avenida Luísa Todi, close to the port area. Due to poor lighting conditions and a momentary lapse in concentration, I misjudged the distance to a concrete street barrier. My front passenger side made contact with the barrier. The impact resulted in a significant dent to the front right fender, severe scratches along the side panel, and the complete breakage of the right front fog lamp. My speed was approximately 15 km/h at the time of collision.

It was just a quick lane change, you know, on the Marginal near Estoril. I checked my mirror, like, I thought it was clear. But then this other car, a silver Skoda, just appeared really fast, pá. I guess I missed seeing him in my blind spot. We just kinda brushed against each other. My rear passenger door has a long scratch and a small dent. It was a stupid mistake, man. I was probably going like 70 km/h.

I was proceeding in the left lane on Avenida Marginal, travelling at approximately 80 km/h. A Ford Focus in the adjacent right lane attempted to change lanes into my path without signaling. Despite applying brakes, a minor side-swipe occurred. The Ford's rear passenger side contacted my front right fender. My vehicle sustained superficial scratches to the front right wing. No other damages or injuries were observed.

I was trying to reverse into a parking space on Rua do Souto, quite a narrow street in Braga, it was just after lunch and I was a bit tired you see. I looked in my mirrors, but that old stone wall, it just suddenly seemed closer than I thought. I heard a loud crunch. My rear bumper is quite badly dented and scratched now, and the left tail light is definitely broken. Such a nuisance, and my back has been bothering me lately, not from the accident, just from old age, you know. But the car, oh dear.

I was proceeding through the intersection at Rossio, having a confirmed green light for my direction of travel. My speed was approximately 35 km/h. A Honda Civic then entered the intersection from the perpendicular street, failing to yield. Impact occurred to my front left quarter panel. The vehicle sustained a substantial dent, a crack in the bumper, and the left headlamp assembly is broken. The individual driving the other car appeared to be distracted.

I was heading towards the train station, you know, on Rossio in Aveiro. The traffic light, like, I thought it was still yellow, man, so I just went for it. But then this BMW, it just came out of nowhere. I totally misjudged it, pá. We crashed right in the middle. My front right fender is all dented and scratched up. I'm so bummed about my car.

location: N125 near Praia da Rocha, Portimão

statements.text: Dude, I was heading on the N125, you know, heading towards Praia da Rocha, probably doing like 80 km/h. And this dog, it just ran out onto the road, suddenly! I swerved super hard to avoid it, like, instinct, pá. I managed not to hit the dog, thank God, but I kinda scraped the guardrail on the side of the road. My whole passenger side, like, from the front fender all the way to the back, has these deep scratches, and there's a dent on the rear door too. My heart was pounding, man.

Like, I was totally just chilling, you know, waiting for the light to change on Rua Augusta, and then BAM, this guy just, like, totally hit me from behind. My rear bumper is, like, all dented and scratched, and the taillight is totally busted, man. I'm so freaked out about the cost, pá. This is so annoying.

Incident occurred at approximately 14:35 on Avenida da Boavista, near Casa da Música. My vehicle, a Mercedes C-Class, was sideswiped by a Fiat Punto during a lane change maneuver initiated by the third party. Impact resulted in a lateral scrape, specifically a substantial scratch along the passenger door and a minor dent near the rear wheel arch. Driver exchanged details cooperatively. Documentation attached.

Oh dear it was a lovely sunny day you know I was just going to the market to get some fresh fish for my dinner my grandson Tiago loves my bacalhau and I was just crossing the Praça da República when this young man he just came out of nowhere no he didn't even look I tell you and he hit my front fender and now there's this big dent and the windshield it completely shattered you know and the headlight it's completely smashed poor little car and my daughter Ana is going to be so cross with me about it all.

Dude, I was, like, backing out of my spot, super carefully, you know, in the Colombo parking lot? And this other car just, like, came speeding around the corner and totally scraped my side. Now there's this gnarly dent on the passenger door and, like, a bunch of scratches. My dad is gonna kill me, pá. This is so annoying.

While stationary at a traffic light on EN125, my vehicle was struck from the rear by a VW Golf. The impact was low velocity, estimated at less than 10 km/h. Visual inspection confirms a superficial scratch approximately 20 cm in length across the lower section of the rear bumper. No other damage detected on my vehicle. Parties exchanged details efficiently.

Well I was just trying to park my little car near the old Roman Temple you know on Rua do Cicioso it's always so difficult to find a spot there and I thought I had plenty of space but then I just heard this bump and it was that stone pillar that's always there and now there's a damage to the back of my car and some scratches too I'm getting too old for this driving I think my husband João used to do all the reversing he was so good at it.

Man, I was just driving down Avenida da Liberdade, you know, minding my own business, and then BAM! This massive pothole just appeared out of nowhere. I couldn't swerve, pá. It totally, like, jolted the car. Now I see there's a crack in the lower front bumper and one of my fog lights is, like, totally busted. This sucks so much, you know?

During a parallel parking attempt in Largo da Misericórdia, my vehicle made low-velocity contact with a stationary Ford Focus. The incident occurred at approximately 10:10. The front passenger-side bumper of my vehicle contacted the rear passenger-side bumper of the Ford. The result was a superficial scratch approximately 15 cm in length on my vehicle's front bumper. No other vehicular damage reported by either party. No injuries.

Oh dear it was just after sunset and I was travelling home from my cousin Maria's house near the Douro River on the N221 it was getting dark and I wasn't going very fast I promise and suddenly this big wild boar just ran out into the road from the trees I tried to brake but it was too late and I hit it poor thing it just ran off after but now my car has a big dent and a crack in the front and my headlight is all broken I hope the poor boar is alright I really do.

Dude, Rua Direita is, like, so narrow, you know? I was just trying to get past this parked van, super slowly, like at 5 km/h, and then, like, the mirror on the van totally just scraped my passenger door. Now there's this long scratch and a small dent. It's, like, barely noticeable but my mom will definitely see it, pá. This is such a hassle.

Man, I was just stopped at the red light, you know, completely still, minding my own business. And then, like, BAM! This guy just rear-ended me. My car, pá, it's got a pretty big dent in the bumper, and some serious scratches right below the tail light. I swear I felt my neck snap back. I'm so anxious about the cost of fixing this, like, it's not fair, dude. I don't even know where to begin with this insurance stuff.

Vehicle 1 was stationary at a red light. I misjudged the stopping distance and initiated a low-speed impact with the rear of Vehicle 1. My front bumper sustained a minor dent and some superficial scratches. I accept full responsibility for the incident.

At approximately 14:35, while proceeding southbound on Rua de Santa Catarina, I initiated a lane change from the right lane to the left lane. My turn signal was activated. During the maneuver, my vehicle made contact with the adjacent vehicle in the left lane. The impact resulted in a prominent scratch along my front passenger door and a minor dent near the rear wheel arch. Driver of the other vehicle confirmed similar lateral damages.

I was travelling in the left lane. The vehicle next to me started to merge into my lane without sufficient space. There was a side-swipe. My driver-side rear panel has a significant scratch and a small dent from the impact.

Oh dear, it was such a lovely day, I was just going to pick up some codfish for dinner, my grandson loves it you see, and I was backing out of my spot, slowly, slowly, like my Manuel always told me to, may he rest in peace. And I heard this terrible crunch. My goodness, I must have misjudged the distance, I just saw a lamppost, you know the old ones? Well, I think my left tail light is completely broken, and there's a horrible dent right on the corner of the bumper. My eyes aren't what they used to be, bless them. I feel so silly, just a moment of distraction, thinking about my grandson.

Dude, I was just trying to get out of the roundabout, you know? Like, I thought I had the right of way 'cause I was already in it. But this car just came out of nowhere, pá, from the other entrance. We totally collided. My front right side is messed up, like, a huge dent, and a bunch of scratches. And the worst part, man, the passenger side window is completely shattered. It's so confusing, I'm pretty sure I was doing it right, but now I'm super stressed about this whole thing.

I entered the roundabout correctly, yielding to traffic already present. The insured vehicle, however, entered directly in front of me without proper yielding, causing a collision with my front-left side. My bumper has a dent and a scratch, but their window on the passenger side is definitely shattered.

During slow-moving traffic conditions at approximately 10:10 AM, my vehicle made incidental contact with the rear bumper of the preceding vehicle. My speed at the point of impact was estimated at 5 km/h. Visual inspection revealed only a superficial scratch to my front bumper. No other damage or injury was noted by either party. The incident was entirely cosmetic in nature.
We were in stop-and-go traffic. I felt a slight nudge. Upon inspection, there was a very minor scratch on my rear bumper. Nothing significant, just a surface mark.

I was on my way home from visiting my sister, bless her heart, she made the most wonderful 'arroz de pato', just like my mother used to. It was getting dark, around 7 in the evening, and I was going a steady 90 km/h, well within the speed limit, you know. Suddenly, a wild boar, or maybe it was a very large dog, just ran out of the bushes, right in front of me! I couldn't stop in time. There's a big crack in my front bumper, and a nasty dent right near the grill. Poor thing, I hope it wasn't too badly hurt. I just thank goodness it wasn't one of those big ones, or I wouldn't be here to tell the tale, would I?

At approximately 16:20, while attempting to reverse into a parking space on Praça da Batalha, I misjudged the distance to a concrete pillar. My rear passenger-side quarter panel made contact with the pillar. The impact caused a noticeable dent and a series of scratches in the paintwork. No other vehicles or individuals were involved.

Like, I was turning right, you know, on Rua do Ouro, and I totally thought the light was green for me, pá. But then, this van, like, just came straight through! We barely touched, honestly, but my front bumper has this really annoying dent now, and the headlight, dude, the lamp is completely broken. It's so frustrating 'cause I swear I checked the light, but maybe I was just, like, distracted or something. This is going to be such a hassle.

I was proceeding straight through the intersection on a green light. The insured driver initiated a right turn directly into my path. The impact was minimal, occurring at low speed. My front left corner sustained a minor dent. Their front right bumper shows a dent, and the headlight is broken.

I was attempting to merge onto Avenida da Boavista from a slip road. The traffic flow was heavy. I executed the merge with caution, indicating well in advance. However, the vehicle in the adjacent lane did not yield sufficient space, resulting in a minor scraping contact between our vehicles. My rear passenger door has a superficial scratch, approximately 20 centimeters in length. No structural damage was observed.

Oh, the traffic was absolutely dreadful, you know, just bumper to bumper. I was in the middle lane, just minding my own business, when this little car tried to squeeze in from the right. Didn't see me, I suppose. Just a little 'ssshhh' sound, not a crash really. I got out, and yes, there's a small scratch on my front fender, a tiny one, barely noticeable really. My husband will never forgive me if he sees it, he's so particular about the car, bless his heart.

incident_type: Parking lot reversing into parked vehicle

statements.text: Goodness me, I was just trying to park near the shopping centre, you know, to pick up some new shoes for my granddaughter's birthday, she's turning ten next month, such a sweet girl. I thought I had plenty of space to reverse into the spot. But I simply misjudged it, my dear, and heard a soft thud. I got out straight away, and yes, I've put a dent in the rear bumper of a parked car, and it has some ugly scratches too. My own car also has a damage to the back and some scratches, just a little less. I feel absolutely terrible, you know, my eyes aren't as good as they once were for judging distances, but I made sure to leave my details on their windscreen.

I returned to my parked vehicle to find a note. The insured party had reversed into my car. There's a noticeable dent on my front-right fender and some deep scratches. The insured party was present and very apologetic, confirmed it was an accident.

Oh man, like, I was just driving, you know, near Campo Pequeno, and traffic suddenly stopped. And I totally hit the car in front of me. Like, I did my best to brake, but it was too late, pá. My front bumper's got a huge dent and a scratch, and I think the headlight is, like, totally broken. I'm so worried about the costs, dude, this is a nightmare.

At approximately 14:30 on November 12th, 2026, while proceeding eastbound on Rua da Boavista near the Trindade intersection, a white Mercedes-Benz C-Class initiated a lane change from the adjacent right lane without adequate clearance. My vehicle sustained impact to the front-left fender. Specific damage includes a significant scratch and a minor dent to the panel, as documented by photographs. My speed was approximately 40 km/h.

Well, I was just going to the market, you see, to get some fresh fish for dinner, it happened to be a lovely sunny day too, not a cloud in the sky. And I was crossing Largo da Portagem, I always do, and suddenly this young man, he just came out of nowhere from the side road, I think he didn't even see the stop sign, can you imagine? My poor little Clio, the front of it, it's got a big dent, and the windshield, it just, shattered, and the right headlight is broken. My grandson, Tiago, he usually cleans the car for me, he's going to be so upset. Such a shame.

Oh my god, like, I was backing out of my parking spot, you know, super slowly, in the Forum Algarve car park. And this older lady, she just like, came around the corner too fast, and like, totally scraped the side of my car. Now there’s this big dent and a bunch of scratches on the rear-left door. It's so frustrating, pá, what am I even supposed to do? This is so annoying.

location: A2 motorway, near Palmela exit, Setúbal

statements.text: I was operating my vehicle, an Audi A4, in the left lane of the A2 southbound, approximately 5 km north of the Palmela exit. The insured vehicle, a grey Dacia Sandero, attempted to merge from the right lane into my lane without sufficient space or signaling. Despite my evasive braking, a side-swipe impact occurred. My vehicle sustained superficial scratching and a minor dent along the passenger side front door panel due to this maneuver.

Oh, it was terrible, just awful. I was sitting on a bench, minding my own business, enjoying the nice weather, it was about three in the afternoon, my usual time for a little rest after visiting my sister at the hospital, bless her heart. And this young man, he just stepped right into the road, I think he was looking at his phone, so typical these days. And the car, it was a lovely blue one, not going fast at all, maybe 20 km/h, but it clipped him, you see, not seriously, thankfully, but the car got a damage to the front bumper and a long scrape along the side. My goodness, what a fright for everyone involved.

location: N247, near Praia do Guincho, Cascais

statements.text: Dude, I was just cruising along the N247, you know, heading towards Guincho beach, enjoying the view. And suddenly, like, out of nowhere, this piece of, like, debris or something flew off a truck in front of me. It hit my windshield, and now there’s a big crack right across it, and a mark on the bonnet too. So annoying, man, I didn't even have time to react, it just happened so fast, pá. My car is, like, pretty new!

While reversing into a designated parking space adjacent to Canal Central, my vehicle's rear sensor system failed to detect a bollard positioned behind the vehicle. The rear bumper made contact with the obstruction. The impact resulted in a localized dent to the right-rear bumper and a functional breakage of the right-rear tail lamp unit. Speed at impact was estimated at under 5 km/h.

location: Rural road M506, near Évora, Alentejo

statements.text: Oh, it was just terrible, my heart nearly stopped. I was navigating home, it was getting dark already, around seven o'clock, after visiting my cousins in Reguengos, they make the most wonderful wine, you know, but anyway. I was on that quiet road, the M506, not going fast, maybe 60 km/h, being very careful, my eyesight isn't what it used to be. And then, from the bushes, a wild boar! A huge one, I tell you! It just ran right out. I swerved, but it was too late. It hit the front of my poor Duster, there's a big dent, and the left headlight is completely broken, and a long scratch down the side. I'm still shaking, it was so frightening, truly a shock.

location: Ponte D. Luís I approach, Vila Nova de Gaia

statements.text: Ugh, like, traffic was insane, you know, heading onto the bridge from Gaia side. We were barely moving, like 5 km/h, literally inching forward. And the guy in front of me, he like, braked super hard for no reason, and I just, you know, bumped his bumper. It wasn't hard at all, but now my front bumper has this noticeable scratch and a small dent. It's so annoying, pá, I just started this new job, and now this expensive mess.

Man, I was just like, driving, you know? And then this guy just stopped suddenly in front of me on Rua da Madalena. I attempted to brake, but like, boom! Just a little bump, but now my front bumper is all, like, messed up with a dent and a scratch. Ugh, this is so annoying, dude.

Vehicle 1, a Renault Clio, failed to maintain a safe following distance. My BMW 3 Series was stationary at the traffic light on Rua da Madalena. Impact occurred at approximately 15:30. Minor damage to my rear bumper, specifically a shallow dent and associated paint scratches.

While executing a lane change maneuver on Avenida da Boavista, Vehicle B, a Ford Focus, encroached into my lane without adequate clearance. This resulted in a side-swipe contact with my Volkswagen Passat's passenger side door, exhibiting a prominent scratch and minor dent.

Oh, it was a terrible day, raining a bit, you see. I was just heading to the pharmacy for my husband's medicine, poor dear, he has a cough. I saw the silver car, the Volkswagen, trying to move over, and then the little blue car just came too close, like it didn't even see it. Just a big scraping noise! No one hurt thank goodness, but the silver car has a nasty scratch and a little dent on its side, I saw it, clear as day.

I was going to the market, early morning, the sun was just coming up. I always take this road, through Largo da Sé, it's quieter. I stopped at the stop sign, I always do, my husband always tells me to be careful. Then I started to go, and this young man, he just came out of nowhere! Bang! Right into my front. My lovely little car has a big dent and the light is all broken, and a scratch too. Such a shame, such a shame.

Dude, I swear the light was green for me! Like, I was just cruising, going maybe 40 km/h, and this old lady, she just, like, pulled out from the side street. I slammed the brakes, but couldn't avoid her. My front bumper is a bit dented now, and the headlight is totally smashed, and there's a huge scratch on the side of my Ford Fiesta. This is so gonna cost me.

Okay, so I was trying to park, right? Like, it's a super tight spot, and this dude in a huge SUV just parked way over the line. I was reversing really slowly, like, 5 km/h, and I just, like, scraped the pillar. My bad, I guess. Now there's a really ugly scratch and a small dent on my rear bumper, man. So annoying.

At approximately 10:15, I observed a Nissan Juke, Vehicle A, attempting to reverse into parking bay P12 in the Cascais Shopping Centre lot. The driver misjudged the distance to a concrete support pillar. Contact occurred, resulting in visible cosmetic damage to the vehicle's rear-left bumper, specifically a substantial scratch and a superficial dent.

While operating my vehicle, an Audi A4, at a reduced speed of 20 km/h on Rua Ferreira Borges, an individual discarded a glass bottle from a second-story window. The object impacted my windshield, causing localized glass shatter and a minor dent to the hood. Pedestrian was unharmed as the object missed them.

Dude, I was just walking by, you know? And then, like, this bottle just came flying down from an apartment window. It hit that black Audi, like, right on the front. I saw the windshield just *shatter* in one spot, and, like, a dent on the hood. Crazy, man. The guy in the Audi looked super annoyed.

It was a beautiful sunny day, I was just leaving my daughter's house in Estoril, after visiting the grandchildren. Lovely children, they are. I was backing out of the driveway, very slowly, very carefully, I always am. And then, I just heard a little bump! Oh dear, I must have touched the car parked across the street. My husband says my eyesight isn't what it used to be. My rear bumper has a dent and a scratch now. The other car had just a tiny scratch, thankfully.

At approximately 14:00, Vehicle A, a Dacia Sandero, was observed reversing from a residential driveway. The driver misjudged the rearward distance to a stationary Renault Megane. A low-speed impact occurred. Vehicle A sustained a visible dent and scratch on the rear bumper. No significant damage observed on Vehicle B.

I was on the A1, you know, just trying to get into the fast lane to pass this slow truck. I checked my mirrors, like, three times, dude! And then, out of nowhere, this old lady in a Fiat Punto just sped up and hit me! She totally scraped the side of my car, and my rear lamp is, like, busted. So not cool.

Oh, the motorways are so fast these days, too many young people driving too quickly, you see. I was in the right lane, just going my own speed, not too fast, not too slow. And then this young man, he just came over from the middle lane without looking! Right into my side! My beautiful Fiat Punto, now it has a long scratch along the side and the front lamp is completely broken. I told him to be more careful, but he just mumbled something, the youth today, no respect.

While operating my vehicle, a Skoda Octavia, on the IP4 at approximately 90 km/h, an unsecured piece of cargo, presumed to be from a preceding truck, became dislodged. The object, a metal pipe, impacted the lower front section of my vehicle. This resulted in a visible crack in the bumper and a significant dent on the front grille. Evasive action was not feasible.

Man, I was driving behind this guy, you know, on the IP4, and this, like, metal thing just flew off a truck! It totally bounced off the road and smacked the front of the car in front of me, the silver one. There was a loud crack, and I could see the bumper cracked and a big damage to the grille. That sucks, dude.

I was at the Continente in Setúbal, buying some groceries, just the essentials, you know, for dinner tonight. I parked my little Citroën C3, but then I realized I needed to back up a little to straighten it. I looked, I promise I looked! But then, boom! Just a little bump, but the car behind me was closer than I thought. My rear bumper has a dent and a scratch, and their front lamp is broken. Oh dear, I felt so bad.

My vehicle, a Seat Leon, was stationary and correctly parked in the Continente parking facility in Setúbal. Vehicle A, a Citroën C3, initiated a reverse maneuver from an adjacent parking bay without due care, colliding with my front bumper. Impact resulted in a pronounced dent, abrasive scratches, and the complete fracture of the left-side front lamp assembly.

Dude, this road near Évora is, like, so bad! I was just driving, maybe 60 km/h, and then there was this massive pothole, totally invisible until I was on it. I couldn't swerve, man. My front wheel just slammed into it. Now my alloy wheel has a crack, and there's a impact depression on the side panel above it. This is, like, gonna be expensive.

Oh, those roads out near Évora are dreadful, absolutely dreadful! My grandson, he lives there, says they never fix them. I was navigating behind that young man, in the little black car, and he just hit a huge hole in the road, poor thing. Made a terrible thud! I saw his wheel, it looked like it had a crack, and I think the side of the car, near the wheel, looked a bit dented too. You have to be so careful these days.

I was, like, stopped at the traffic light, you know, on Avenida da Liberdade, totally still. And then BAM! This dude just, like, drove right into my rear bumper. My whole car jolted forward. I looked back, and man, the rear window just, like, spiderwebbed, and the bumper's all pushed in. It's gonna cost a fortune, pá, I'm so worried.

I was operating my vehicle, a BMW 320d, in the second lane on Avenida da Liberdade, proceeding at approximately 30 km/h. Due to momentary lapse in attention, I failed to observe the stationary vehicle in front of me, a Fiat Punto, in time to initiate effective braking. Impact occurred at low speed. Damages observed include a significant dent and paint abrasion on the rear bumper of the Fiat, and its rear windshield sustained a visible shatter pattern. My vehicle sustained minor frontal scratches.

On the 15th of March, at approximately 14:10, I was maneuvering my Audi A4 along Rua das Flores in Porto. The street's narrow, requiring precise vehicle positioning. A Peugeot 208, driven by the third party, attempted to overtake from the right despite insufficient clearance. This action resulted in a side-swipe contact. My vehicle's passenger-side front fender and door sustained significant scratching and a shallow dent.

Oh dear, it happened to be a sunny afternoon, I was just trying to get to the grocery store on Rua de Santa Catarina, you know, for some fresh pão and queijo. My grandson, Tiago, told me to take Rua das Flores, it’s a shortcut, he said. Well, I was in my little Peugeot, it’s a lovely car, and this big, fancy Audi was going so slowly. I thought there was enough space to pass, my eyesight isn't what it used to be, but I swear, he just swerved a bit. Anyway, my car scraped along his. There’s a long mark and a bit of a push-in on his side. My car is fine, thankfully, just a bit of paint transfer.

It was Tuesday, I remember because my niece, Sofia, called me that morning to remind me about the market. I was travelling my old Opel Corsa through Rotunda do Papa in Coimbra, going towards the university, just after lunch, around 1:30 PM. I had the right of way, I always check very carefully! But this young man, oh bless his heart, he just came speeding from my left, didn't even slow down, and hit my front passenger side. My headlight completely shattered, and there’s a big dent in the wing. There's also a big crack spreading from the impact point. It gave me such a fright, I nearly dropped my shopping bag!

Dude, like, I was rushing to class, you know, at the university. I thought the light was gonna change, but then, like, I totally misjudged it at Rotunda do Papa. This old lady, man, she was already in the roundabout, and I just kinda, like, T-boned her car. My bad, seriously. Her front right lamp is, like, smashed, and there’s a huge dent and a crack on the fender. I'm so sorry, pá, hope she's okay.

Okay, so I was trying to back out of this parking spot at Forum Algarve, you know? It was really tight. And, like, I guess I could not spot the car behind me, a grey VW Golf, until it was too late. I just heard a thud, and my rear bumper, dude, it's got this noticeable dent and some scratches. It was a really slow impact, but still, like, annoying, you know?

At approximately 17:45, within the Forum Algarve parking facility, I observed a Nissan Juke attempting to reverse from an adjacent parking bay. Despite my stationary position in a Volvo V40 and a clear visual signal (reversing lights), the Nissan continued its maneuver. This resulted in a low-velocity impact with the front passenger side of my vehicle. The Nissan's rear bumper is noted to have a dent and associated paint scratches.

While operating my Ford Focus on the N18 approximately 15 km south of Évora, at 09:30, a wild boar suddenly entered the roadway from the right shoulder. To prevent a direct impact with the animal, I initiated an evasive steering maneuver to the left. This caused my vehicle to depart the asphalt and collide with a roadside utility pole. The frontal impact resulted in a significant dent to the bonnet, extensive scratching along the passenger side, the right headlight unit is completely broken, and the windshield sustained a large shatter pattern.

I was navigating my trusty old Mercedes, you know, the one my husband bought me before he passed, God rest his soul. It was just after noon, around 12:45, on the A1 motorway, trying to take the exit for Aveiro. The traffic was quite heavy, like always. I was slowly moving into the exit lane, very carefully, I always use my blinker, you know. But this young man in a little Corsa, he just zipped right into my side! My beautiful car has a terrible long scratch along the rear passenger door and a dent near the wheel arch. It upset my whole day, I had to stop and get a calming tea.

Man, like, I was just trying to merge onto the exit, you know? This old lady, like, she wasn't really checking her mirrors, I guess. I was in my Opel Corsa, trying to get past her Mercedes, and she just, like, started to come over into my lane. There was, like, a scrape sound and then a bit of a bump. Her rear side door has a pretty big scratch and a small dent from my front fender. It wasn't my fault, pá, I swear!

Dude, okay, so I was in Funchal, driving my Seat Ibiza, navigating the Rotunda do Infante, you know, it's a bit confusing with all the exits. I was trying to get to the marina, following the GPS, and this other car, a silver Skoda Octavia, just, like, came out of nowhere from my right. He totally hit my passenger side door. There's a big dent there and, like, deep scratches. And my rear right taillight? Totally smashed, pá. I don't even know what to do.

On the 22nd of April, at approximately 11:15, I was operating a Skoda Octavia within the Rotunda do Infante in Funchal, maintaining a speed of approximately 20 km/h. The insured vehicle, a Seat Ibiza, entered the roundabout from an incorrect lane, failing to yield to traffic already circulating. This resulted in a side-impact collision. My vehicle made contact with the passenger side of the Seat. Visible damage to the Seat includes a significant dent and associated paint scratching on the front passenger door, and the rear right lamp housing is broken.

While operating a Mercedes C-Class on a residential street near Praia da Rainha in Cascais, at 16:30, a pedestrian, an elderly male, unexpectedly stepped into the roadway from between two parked vehicles. My speed was approximately 15 km/h. Despite immediate braking and an evasive turn, contact was unavoidable. The pedestrian impacted the front right side of my vehicle. The incident resulted in a shallow dent on the front fender, a long scratch along the side, and a crack on the plastic housing of the passenger-side mirror. The pedestrian appeared to sustain minor injuries but refused immediate medical assistance at the scene, stating he was 'fine'.

Oh, it was a lovely sunny day near the beach in Cascais, I was walking my little dog, Max, you know, he loves the sea air. Around 4:30 in the afternoon, I saw this poor old gentleman, he looked a bit confused, just step right off the pavement into the road. A nice silver Mercedes, going quite slowly, tried to stop, but it bumped him. The car’s mirror housing looked cracked after, and there was a mark on the front where he hit. The driver was very kind, you know, immediately got out to help. The old man seemed okay, just a bit shaken.

I was trying to park my little Renault Clio in Bairro Alto, you know, it's so difficult to find a space there, especially on a Friday evening. My granddaughter, Ana, was waiting for me at the restaurant, so I was a bit flustered. I was reversing into a spot, it was a very tight squeeze, and I thought I had cleared the wall behind me. But then, *thump*! My rear bumper hit the stone wall. The right taillight completely broke, and there's a horrible dent and long scrape along the bumper. It’s such a nuisance, and my back started aching from the stress!

Dude, I was driving my Honda Civic on the Vasco da Gama Bridge, heading towards Montijo, you know, on my way to visit my cousin. And suddenly, like, a huge piece of debris, looked like a bit of a tire or something, just appeared in my lane! I swerved to avoid it, like, instinctively, and ended up grazing the concrete barrier on the right side. My front right side, man, it's all messed up. The headlight is broken, there's a big crush on the fender, and like, scratches all along the side, and a huge crack on the bumper plastic. My heart was pounding, pá!

Dude, I was just chilling, you know, driving along Avenida da Boavista, and like, the car in front just slammed on its brakes, pá! I made an effort to stop, but my car, like, just nudged it. I'm so worried about the costs, man. There's definitely a dent on my front bumper and some scratches, too. It's totally not my fault, you know?

I was operating my vehicle at approximately 45 km/h on Avenida da Boavista when the traffic ahead experienced an abrupt deceleration. I initiated braking maneuvers. The vehicle behind me, a Seat Ibiza, failed to maintain an adequate safety distance, resulting in a low-speed impact. My rear bumper exhibits minor cosmetic damage, specifically a slight dent and superficial scratches consistent with the impact.

Oh dear, I just went to the market, like I always do on Tuesdays, to get some fresh fish for my grandson, Tiago, he loves my bacalhau à brás. It happened to be a lovely sunny day, not a cloud in the sky. When I was reversing out of my parking spot, I was being ever so careful, you know how it is when you're older and your eyesight isn't what it used to be. I just felt a little bump and then I saw, to my horror, I had scraped against a concrete pillar! My beautiful Mercedes, it has a horrible scratch and a dent, and the left rear lamp is completely broken. Such a shame, such a shame. I don't know what my husband, in heaven bless his soul, would say.

While proceeding northbound on Estrada Nacional 10, I maintained a velocity of 80 km/h. A vehicle, a Kia Picanto, unexpectedly deviated from its lane without signaling, encroaching into my designated path. This abrupt maneuver resulted in a side-swipe incident. My vehicle sustained lateral damage, specifically longitudinal scratches and a shallow dent along the passenger side door and fender.

Oh man, I swear I checked my mirror, you know? Like, I totally thought the lane was clear. I was trying to merge, because, like, my exit was coming up super fast, and then, boom, this Golf just appeared! I feel so bad, dude. My car's got, like, a nasty scratch on the driver's side and, you know, a bit of a dent from where we touched. This is so stressful, pá.

Okay, so, like, I was trying to park on Rua dos Clérigos, and it's super tight there, you know? I was reversing, trying to be careful, but I totally misjudged the distance, man. And then, wham, I hit that old stone pillar, you know the one near the café? My rear bumper is, like, all dented and scratched up, and the right taillight is definitely broken. This is going to cost a fortune, pá, my dad is going to kill me.

It was just after lunch, around one-thirty, and I was navigating my grandchildren, little Mariana and Pedro, to the beach at Praia da Rocha. The sun was shining, a bit bright actually, and I approached the intersection on N125 near Aqua Portimão, you know, the big shopping center? The light was green for me, I swear it was. But then, all of a sudden, this black Mercedes came right through from the other direction, straight into my side! My door is all dented and scratched, and the window, oh my, the window is completely shattered. The children were so scared, bless their little hearts. I am still shaking.

At approximately 13:35, while executing a left turn at the intersection of N125 and the Aqua Portimão access road, I proceeded cautiously upon observing the green signal for my direction of travel. Simultaneously, an Opel Corsa entered the intersection from the opposing direction. A collision ensued. My front bumper exhibits a significant dent and associated scratches. The impact caused the passenger-side headlight casing to crack, though not shatter.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio, intending to take the third exit. As I signaled and began to transition lanes, another vehicle, a Citroën C3, which was already in the inner lane, attempted to exit without proper indication, cutting across my path. Despite evasive steering, a minor contact occurred. My front right fender and bumper area have visible scratches and a shallow dent.

Oh my god, like, this is so awful, you know? I was driving super slow, maybe like 15 km/h, on Avenida dos Aliados, because there were so many people. And then, suddenly, this dude just like, stepped right in front of my car from between two parked cars! I totally slammed on the brakes, pá, but I still, like, gently touched him. He fell, but he got up okay, just a bit shaken. My front bumper has a small dent and some scratches now from the impact. I hope he's really okay, man. I'm so freaked out.

I was walking near the Majestic Café and observed the incident. A young man unexpectedly stepped into the street, and the small Peugeot hatchback, which was moving at a very slow speed, could not stop completely. There was a slight impact. The pedestrian fell but quickly rose, appearing unharmed though surprised. The car's front bumper showed a minor dent and some scraping marks after the event.

Well, it was a busy afternoon, just like usual in Praça do Comércio, I was trying to find a spot to drop off my wife, Maria, before going to the doctor for my knee, it's been acting up something terrible these cold mornings. I was pulling into a space and thought I was clear, but the car in front, a little smart car, had stopped a bit further back than I thought. I just nudged its bumper ever so slightly. It's not much, but my front bumper has a little crack, and some scratches near the corner. Oh, these new cars are so delicate, not like the old ones!

During peak hour traffic on Via Norte, approximately 2 km before the intersection with A4, a sudden chain reaction braking event occurred. The vehicle directly in front of me initiated emergency braking. I successfully applied maximum braking force, avoiding a collision. However, the vehicle behind me, a older Renault Kangoo, failed to react adequately, resulting in a rear-end impact with my vehicle. My rear bumper sustained a significant dent, the rear windshield is completely shattered, and the right rear lamp assembly is broken.

Oh, it was terrible, just awful! I was coming from the market in Matosinhos, with my weekly groceries, the traffic was so heavy, like always on Via Norte, you know. Then the cars in front of me just stopped, suddenly, no warning at all! I tried my best, I really did, but my old Kangoo just couldn't stop in time. I hit the car in front, a big Audi. My front has a big dent, and the headlight, the left one, is broken. It's a miracle no one was seriously hurt, thank heavens!

So, like, I was trying to get into this parking spot on Rua Augusta, it was really tight, you know? And this old lady, driving a Seat Arona, was like, also trying to get in, but she was coming from the other direction, totally wrong, pá! We both kinda went for it at the same time, and our side mirrors, like, just scraped. My mirror casing has a nasty scratch now. It's so annoying, man, why can't people just wait their turn?

I was on my way very carefully down Rua Augusta, it's always so busy there with all the tourists and shops. I saw a parking space opening up, a small one, perfect for my little Arona. I was going to turn in, when this young lady in a Mini Cooper, she just came out of nowhere, going too fast, trying to rush into the same spot! We just touched, only a little bit. My side mirror has a scratch, that's all. These young people, always in such a hurry, no patience at all, I tell you!

Dude, I was just like, cruising down Rua da Misericórdia, you know, heading to my friend's place in Chiado. This guy in front just slammed on his brakes, like, for no reason. I did my best to stop, obviously, but I couldn't, you know? My front bumper like, totally got a dent and some nasty scratches. And I think my right headlight is broken, man. This is gonna cost a fortune, pá, I'm so stressed!

At approximately 14:15, I was operating my vehicle, a Volkswagen Golf, northbound on Rua da Misericórdia. Ahead of me, a pedestrian abruptly entered the crosswalk without warning. I initiated an emergency braking maneuver. The vehicle behind me, a Fiat Punto, subsequently impacted my rear bumper. The damage to my vehicle appears to be a minor dent and some surface scratches on the rear.

location: Cruzamento da Avenida da Boavista com a Rua Guerra Junqueiro, Porto

statements.text: At 09:30 AM, while proceeding eastbound through the intersection of Avenida da Boavista and Rua Guerra Junqueiro, I observed the traffic signal indicating a green light for my direction of travel. A grey Opel Corsa, southbound on Rua Guerra Junqueiro, failed to yield to the right-of-way, initiating a broadside impact with my vehicle's front passenger side. The primary impact resulted in a significant dent to the front fender and the rupture of the passenger-side headlamp assembly.

Man, I swear I thought the light was yellow, like, going to turn red, you know? I was just trying to get through the intersection, pá, I was already in the middle, and then this Audi just, like, came out of nowhere. I didn't even see him, honestly. My front bumper is all dented and my left headlight is totally smashed. This is so bad!

Oh dear, it was just awful. I was on my way to see my sister in Olhão, you know, she makes the most wonderful almond cakes, and the weather was so lovely, a bit windy actually, but the sun was shining bright, made me happy. And then this big lorry, a very fast one it was, tried to pass me on the EN125, it was quite narrow there, I think near that big roundabout. And it came too close, oh yes, it scraped along my beautiful car, a nasty scratch it left on the side, a very long one, and I think there's a small dent near the rear wheel arch. My poor little Renault Clio, only had it for five years. I was so shaken, had to pull over and have a cup of tea.

At approximately 11:00 AM, my commercial vehicle, a Volvo FH16 truck, was operating on Estrada Nacional 125, southbound. I was in the process of overtaking a slower-moving Renault Clio. During the maneuver, the Clio appeared to drift slightly into my lane, resulting in a minor side-swipe contact. Post-impact inspection revealed superficial scratches along the trailer's left side and a minor dent to the front passenger door of the Renault Clio.

location: Parque de Estacionamento do Centro Comercial Colombo, Lisboa

statements.text: Okay, so, like, I was backing out of my parking spot at Colombo, you know, the usual spot on floor -1. And this van, like, this huge white van, was just driving by too fast, pá. I checked my mirrors, I swear, but it just came out of nowhere. We like, just scraped each other, you know? Now my rear passenger door has this massive scratch and a dent, like, right in the middle. My parents are gonna kill me, man, this is so annoying.

Oh yes, I saw it all happen. I was just trying to remember where I left my car, you see, they all look the same in that Colombo car park, it's a real maze, not like the old days. But yes, the young man in the small Seat was reversing slowly, and that white van, he was going a bit too fast for a car park, I thought, and he caught the corner of the Seat. There was a loud scraping sound and I saw a big scratch appear on the side of the little car, and I think a dent too, right there near the back door. Poor boy looked quite upset.

At approximately 10:45 AM, I was driving my vehicle, a BMW 3 Series, at a speed of approximately 15 km/h on Rua Augusta, approaching a designated pedestrian crossing. A pedestrian, distracted by their mobile device, suddenly stepped into the roadway without observing oncoming traffic. Despite immediate application of brakes, a minor impact occurred with the pedestrian's leg, causing them to stumble but not fall. The pedestrian reported no injuries. My vehicle sustained a small dent and some superficial scratches on the front passenger-side bumper. No visible damage to the pedestrian's clothing or person.

Man, I was just like, walking down Rua Augusta, you know, enjoying the sun. And this guy, like, totally glued to his phone, just walked right into the street without looking, pá. This BMW was driving super slow, honestly, the driver totally slammed on the brakes, but like, it was too late. He just bumped the guy's leg. The pedestrian seemed fine, just a bit shocked. The BMW's bumper got a small dent and some scratches from the impact, I think.

Oh, what a fright! I was just coming down Caminho dos Pretos, it's such a winding road, you know, very steep, and my daughter always tells me to be careful, bless her. I was going very slowly, about 10 km/h, because I was admiring the view, the sea looked so blue. And then suddenly, this small van came around the bend, also quite slow, but it was just a bit too wide for the road, I think. We just sort of nudged each other, really, barely a bump. My front left headlight, though, it's definitely broken, and there's a crack on the bumper right underneath it. I was so relieved no one was hurt, but my heart was pounding, dear me.

At approximately 13:00, my commercial van, a Renault Kangoo, was ascending Caminho dos Pretos, adhering to the speed limit. Approaching a blind curve, a Dacia Sandero, descending the same route, slightly encroached into my lane. A minor low-speed head-on impact occurred. The Dacia Sandero sustained a broken front-left headlamp and a discernible crack on its front bumper. My vehicle incurred minimal, non-structural cosmetic damage not relevant to the detected damages list.

Okay, so I was just, like, trying to back my car out of this really tight spot on Rua do Carmo, you know? It's always a nightmare parking there. I thought I had enough space, honestly, but then I heard this, like, awful crunch. I totally misjudged the distance, man, and hit the wall behind me. Now my rear bumper has a huge dent, and the left taillight is completely shattered, pá. This is gonna be so expensive to fix, I'm freaking out.

At approximately 16:20, I observed a Peugeot 208 attempting to exit a parallel parking space on Rua do Carmo. The driver executed a rearward maneuver, failing to maintain adequate clearance from the adjacent masonry wall. The vehicle's rear bumper made contact with the wall, resulting in a distinct dent to the rear bumper and a complete shatter of the left taillight assembly. The incident appeared to be a driver error, with no third-party involvement.

At 21:00, while operating my vehicle, a Toyota Corolla, at approximately 70 km/h on a rural road within Serra da Estrela, near the Manteigas exit, a wild boar suddenly emerged from the dense vegetation on the right side of the road. Despite immediate evasive action and braking, impact was unavoidable. The animal, estimated at 50 kg, collided with the front-right quarter panel of my vehicle. The collision resulted in a significant dent, extensive scratches, and the incapacitation of the front-right fog lamp.

Oh, the situation involved a dark night, very dark, and I was just coming back from visiting my cousin in Gouveia, she has such lovely sheep, you know. I was behind this very respectable-looking Toyota, going along that twisty road in Serra da Estrela, a bit cold it was too. And then suddenly, out from the bushes, a big wild pig! It just ran right out, poor thing. The Toyota driver tried to swerve, but it was too late. There was a thud, and I saw a big impact depression on the front of the car, and some nasty scratches, and I think one of the lights, the smaller one, was broken. The driver pulled over right away, seemed very shaken.

Well, I was just trying to get into the correct lane, you see, I was heading over the 25 de Abril Bridge towards Almada, because I was going to visit my grandson, he loves to see the Cristo Rei. And it's always so busy on that bridge, all those cars going so fast, you know? I put my indicator on, oh yes, very clearly, and started to move over, but then this red car, a very speedy one it was, just appeared from nowhere in the next lane. We bumped! It made a rather terrible scraping sound. Now my rear-left fender has a big scratch, and there's a shallow dent too. I nearly missed my exit, dear me.

Man, I was just like, driving in my lane, you know, on the 25 de Abril Bridge, heading to Costa da Caparica. This old lady in a Ford Focus, like, just veered into my lane without even looking, pá! I honked, I swear, but she just kept coming. We totally scraped. Now my front passenger door is all scratched up and has a small dent. This is so annoying, I was just trying to get to the beach!

Ugh, man, it was raining, like, super hard, you know? I was heading on Estrada da Costa near Guincho, heading back to Cascais, going like, 60 km/h, which is totally within the limit, pá. But then, I hit this huge puddle, and my car just, like, started to aquaplane. I tried to correct it, but I just lost control for a second and grazed the roadside barrier. My front bumper has a massive dent, some ugly scratches, and there's definitely a crack on the lower part, like, near the fog light. This is just my luck, man.

At approximately 19:10, during heavy rainfall conditions, I observed a Volkswagen Polo traveling westbound on Estrada da Costa (N247) near Guincho. The vehicle, operating at an approximate speed of 60 km/h, encountered a significant accumulation of water on the roadway, initiating hydroplaning. The driver subsequently lost momentary control, veering slightly off the carriageway and impacting the roadside safety barrier. Visual inspection confirmed a substantial dent to the front bumper, significant surface scratches, and a structural crack in the lower front fascia.

Dude, it was like, totally not my fault, pá! I was stopped at the red light on Rua de São Bento, you know, just chilling, and then BAM! This other car just, like, drove right into me from behind. My bumper is all, like, pushed in and scratched up. I'm so worried about the costs, man, my parents are going to kill me.

On 2026-03-15 at approximately 14:30, while operating my vehicle, an Audi A4, on Avenida da Boavista in Porto, I initiated a lane change from the right lane to the central lane. All signals were engaged. Concurrently, a vehicle, a black Opel Corsa, also attempted to merge from the left lane into the central lane, resulting in a side-swipe impact. The collision occurred at an estimated speed of 30 km/h. My passenger-side rear door and fender sustained significant scratching and a noticeable dent.

Oh dear it was just dreadful yesterday. I was at the Mercado Municipal in Faro you see, just trying to get some fresh fish for my grandchildren’s dinner, they love my bacalhau à brás you know. And I was backing out of the parking space, very slowly mind you, I always am careful. And then there was this little bump! I simply didn't see that small grey car parked behind me. My rear bumper got a bit of a crack and there’s a dent right there too. I feel terrible for the second vehicle. I hope they weren't too upset.

Man, it was so confusing, pá! I was driving through Praça da República, like, the light was green for me, for sure! But then this other car, a big black Mercedes, just came out of nowhere from the side street, you know? It just hit my front left side, like, right into the headlight and fender. My headlight is totally broken, and the window on the driver's side just shattered everywhere! And there's a huge dent in the door. I think the traffic lights were malfunctioning, honestly.

At approximately 10:15 on 2026-04-01, while traveling southbound on the A2 highway at kilometer marker 95, in the vicinity of Grândola, my vehicle, a Mercedes-Benz C-Class, encountered unexpected road debris. The object, appearing to be a discarded truck tire remnant, was unavoidable at the posted speed limit of 120 km/h. Impact occurred with the lower front fascia and windshield. Inspection revealed a significant crack in the lower passenger-side windshield and extensive scratching on the front bumper. The incident was documented by dashcam footage.

Oh, it was terrible, a real fright, just yesterday on Rua Fernandes Tomás in Cascais. I was driving so carefully, at about 15 kilometres an hour, honestly. And then this young lady, she just stepped out from between two parked cars, she wasn't looking at all! I slammed on the brakes, but I just clipped her. She seemed okay, thank goodness, just a bit shaken. My bonnet, it has a dent right where it hit and a long scratch too. I hope she's alright, I offered her my help, you know.

I saw it happen. The old lady was driving slowly, but the pedestrian, a young woman, just walked into the street without looking up from her phone. The car definitely hit her, but it wasn't a hard impact. She got up immediately. There's a small dent on the car's hood, and it looked like a scratch too. The driver stopped right away and seemed very concerned.

Ugh, this is so embarrassing, man. I was trying to park in the Forum Braga garage, you know, it's always so tight in there, pá. I was reversing into a spot, and like, I just totally misjudged it and backed right into one of those concrete pillars. So stupid, honestly. Now my rear lamp is completely broken, and there's a huge dent in the tailgate, with a bunch of scratches around it. My dad is gonna be so mad, like, seriously.

On the evening of 2026-05-22, at approximately 21:00, I was operating my Skoda Octavia on the N18 road, southbound, at kilometer 30, outside Évora. Visibility was low due to darkness and lack of street lighting. A wild boar suddenly entered the roadway from the dense vegetation on the right side. Despite immediate braking, impact was unavoidable. The animal was struck by the front right quarter of the vehicle. The resulting damage includes a severe dent to the front passenger-side fender, a crack in the front bumper, and the headlamp on that side is completely broken. The animal unfortunately did not survive.

location: Estrada de Santa Luzia, Viana do Castelo

statements.text: Well, it happened just this morning, on my way up to Santa Luzia, a lovely view up there always, you know. I was merging onto the main road, the Estrada de Santa Luzia, from a smaller street, signalling clear as day I was. But this young fella in a dark coloured car, I think it was a Ford, came flying past me, he didn't even slow down! And he just scraped the side of my car. It's just a long scratch on the passenger side door, thankfully, but it really gave me a fright, the way he was driving, honestly, these young people.

location: Road M543, Serra da Estrela, near Manteigas

statements.text: Oh my god, pá, I was so scared! It was like, raining really heavily up in Serra da Estrela, near Manteigas, you know, that twisty road, M543. And I was driving really carefully, I swear, maybe like 40 km/h. But then, my car just, like, totally lost grip, you know? It just skidded! And I couldn't stop it, so I, like, hit the guardrail on the side of the road. My front fender is all dented and there are huge scratches on the side. I just hope the car is okay, man.

Man, like, I was just stopped at the traffic light, you know? And then, BAM! This guy just hits me from behind. My bumper is, like, totally pushed in, and the taillight, it's just shattered. And there's a big scratch too, from the impact. I'm so worried about the costs, dude.

Vehicle 78-XY-12 (Renault Clio) was stationary. I, in vehicle 55-ZX-33, failed to maintain adequate braking distance due to momentary distraction. Impact occurred at approximately 15 km/h. Observed damage on the insured's vehicle includes significant rear bumper deformation and fracture of the left rear lamp assembly.

Oh dear, it was such a lovely Tuesday, I was just driving to pick up some bacalhau for my grandchildren, you know, from that nice fishmonger near Bolhão market. The weather was a bit cloudy, but no rain! And then this young fellow, he just came too close while I was trying to park, poor me. My beautiful car, it has a long scratch now all along the side, and a little dent too, right near the door handle. It's truly upsetting. My late husband, God rest his soul, he always kept the car so pristine.

At 14:30, I was proceeding northbound through the intersection of Praça da República, adhering to the green light signal. Vehicle 45-CD-67 (Ford Focus) entered the intersection from the eastbound direction, failing to yield. Impact occurred to the front-right quarter of my vehicle. Damages observed include a significant dent to the fender, a crack in the headlight casing, and the indicator lamp is no longer functional.

Ugh, man, I was just like, heading to class, right? I swear the light was yellow, like, just turning red, you know? And this car just came out of nowhere. We totally crashed. I'm so confused, man, I didn't mean for this to happen. I think his headlight is all busted.

Oh man, this is so annoying. I was just trying to back out of my parking spot, right? And this pillar, like, just appeared out of nowhere. My rear bumper has a pretty bad dent now, and there's a huge scratch along the side too. It's gonna cost a fortune, I bet, dude.

Goodness me, it was just past lunchtime, I was travelling very slowly, minding my own business, you know, heading towards the Bom Jesus do Monte to visit my niece. The sun was in my eyes a bit, and this young person just, like, ran out from between two parked cars! I braked instantly, thank the Lord, but there was a tiny bump. They were fine, just startled, thankfully. But my car, it has a scratch on the front bumper now, from where their bag maybe brushed against it. It's not much, but still, a scratch on my lovely car.

I observed the incident at approximately 13:15. Vehicle 33-GH-55 (Skoda Octavia) was proceeding at low speed (estimated 10 km/h). A pedestrian unexpectedly entered the roadway. The vehicle executed an immediate stop, resulting in a minor, glancing contact. The pedestrian remained upright and appeared uninjured. I noted a superficial scratch on the front-right bumper of the vehicle.

At 08:00, while reversing from my residential driveway, I misjudged the distance to the retaining wall. Impact occurred at low speed, approximately 5 km/h. The rear-left quarter panel sustained a significant dent, and a structural crack propagated from the impact point. No other parties or property were involved.

Ugh, man, this is so bad. I was trying to parallel park, right? And I totally, like, misjudged the space and bumped into the parked car behind me. My front bumper is all pushed in, and there's this nasty scratch from the impact. And the fog lamp, it's totally busted, dude. I left a note for the other driver, I hope they're not too mad.
