I tried to brake, but my foot slipped slightly on the pedal, and I gently bumped into the car in front of me. I felt terrible immediately. When I got out to check, I saw a noticeable dent on their rear bumper. I am so worried about my insurance premiums going up, but I really just want to make sure everything is handled correctly and fairly.

I was at a complete stop in the lane waiting for the light to change. Out of nowhere, I felt a solid impact from behind. My car pushed forward a few meters. When I stepped out, I saw that my bumper had a clear dent from the other driver's plate area.

It was pouring rain this morning near the Saldanha square. I was trying to merge into the right lane to turn, but the visibility was just awful. I checked my mirror, but I must have misjudged the distance of the car already in that lane. We made side-to-side contact while moving at slow speeds. It was a really stressful moment for me, being a new driver. I pulled over immediately to talk to the other driver. I could see a long scratch along the side panel of their vehicle, but thankfully nobody was hurt.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio during the morning rush. I was in the middle lane and intended to exit towards the airport, but I think I didn't signal early enough or perhaps the other driver didn't see me. As I moved to exit, the side of my car hit the front of a van that was also exiting. I was honestly so confused because everything happened in a split second. The impact broke my side indicator lamp. I am just really rattled by the whole ordeal and hope the repair process isn't too complicated.

The Fiat suddenly cut across my lane while we were both navigating the roundabout. I had no time to react and swerved, but we still collided. My front bumper made contact with their side, shattering their lamp. It was quite chaotic.

I was parking near the river in Coimbra. I thought I had plenty of space to back into the spot, but I miscalculated the distance to the concrete pillar behind me. It was a very low-speed mistake, but I heard a sickening scraping noise. When I inspected the damage, there was a visible scratch and a small crush on the rear quarter panel. I feel very embarrassed as I have been driving for years and rarely have these kinds of mishaps. I just want to get it fixed through my policy as soon as possible.

I was heading down the Estrada Monumental on my way to visit my daughter. The sun was quite low, and it was shining right into my eyes as I approached the green light. A car coming from the cross-street entered the intersection. I braked hard, but we still clipped each other. My side window was shattered from the impact and the flying debris. I am seventy-two, so this really shook me up. I sat in my car for a while until the police arrived to help us fill out the paperwork.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus. The driver of the BMW definitely seemed to be struggling with the sun glare. They both entered the intersection at the same time and hit the side of each other. I saw the BMW's glass shatter across the road.

I was driving along the riverfront, trying to keep up with the flow of traffic. I checked my blind spot before moving into the left lane, but I failed to notice the motorcycle coming up quickly. We didn't hit hard, just a light graze while both vehicles were in motion. It caused a long, ugly scratch on my passenger door. I felt horrible for the motorcyclist, even though they were fine. It's just one of those things that happens in city traffic when everyone is in a hurry, I suppose.

The streets in Porto are so narrow and tight, aren't they? I was trying to pull into a tight space and I must have been distracted by my kids shouting in the back. I reversed too far and hit a parked delivery van. The situation involved a stupid mistake, really. I hit the corner of the van with my rear bumper, which caused a dent and broke my tail lamp. I am just really stressed about the cost of the repairs and the paperwork involved. I should have been much more careful in such a narrow street.

I was driving down Avenida da Liberdade around 3:00 PM. Traffic was moving steadily, but then the car in front of me braked very abruptly for a pedestrian. I applied the brakes as fast as I could, but the road was a bit slick, and I ended up bumping into them. It was a low-speed impact, but it left a clear damage to the center of their trunk. It was a really unfortunate situation. I've been driving for twenty years and rarely get into accidents, so this is quite distressing for me.

I had to stop suddenly because someone walked into the road without looking. The car behind me didn't stop in time and hit my rear bumper. I got out to check and there is a definite dent on the metal surface. Thankfully, it's just cosmetic.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was heading towards the city center, and it was quite busy. I was changing lanes to prepare for a turn and caught the edge of a taxi that was driving in my blind spot. I immediately heard a grinding sound as our panels rubbed together. It left a series of nasty scratches on the passenger side door. I am a professional driver myself, so I am very annoyed with my own lapse in concentration. The taxi driver was calm, which helped me stay composed while we exchanged our insurance details.

I was at the supermarket parking lot near the bridge. When I was pulling out of my parking bay, I didn't see the bollard behind me clearly because of the low light. I reversed slowly, but I ended up hitting the plastic covering on the bollard. It caused a significant crack in my rear bumper cover. I felt so silly! It's not a major accident, but it's annoying and I want to get it taken care of so it doesn't get worse. I hope this process is quick.

I was walking to my car in the same row. I saw the driver reverse into the yellow bollard at the end of the space. It was a simple accident, happened quite slowly. I saw the bumper crack when it hit the concrete pillar.

I was driving home from work in the afternoon traffic on Avenida da Boavista. The car ahead of me stopped very suddenly because of a pedestrian crossing the road. I tried to brake, but I wasn't fast enough on the pedal and I ended up bumping into the back of his vehicle. I feel terrible about it because I was distracted for just a second. It resulted in a noticeable dent on my front bumper and a long scratch along the paint where the plastic caught the other car's metallic frame.

I had to stop abruptly at the crosswalk to let a student pass safely. I was already at a full stop when I felt a significant impact from behind. The driver behind me apologized immediately and was very cooperative. My car has a dent on the rear bumper and some scratch marks from the impact.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal and attempting to change into the outer lane to exit toward Avenida da Liberdade. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the white van clearly enough in my blind spot. I steered right and we made side-to-side contact. It was really stressful, like, I was just trying to follow the signs but the traffic was moving so fast. There is just a thin, deep scratch running along my driver-side door panel now.

It was such a rainy Tuesday morning and I was just trying to park near the city center to grab a coffee. I misjudged the distance between my car and the bollard on the curb while reversing into the parking space. I was going very slowly, maybe 5 km/h, but the angle was wrong and I hit the metal post. It left a clear dent on my rear quarter panel. I am so upset with myself for being so clumsy today, but I wanted to report it right away.

I was cruising along Avenida dos Aliados when the vehicle in the adjacent lane began to merge into my path without signaling. I attempted to veer to the left to avoid him, but we still made contact. It was all very sudden. My front indicator lamp is broken and it resulted in a significant mark on the side wing. I'm just relieved nobody was hurt, but I'm quite worried about the repair costs since this is a relatively new car for me.

I apologize, as I genuinely did not see the other car in my peripheral vision when I moved lanes. I feel responsible for the mishap. The impact caused a scratch on their fender and their turn signal lamp is broken. We exchanged insurance details on the side of the road immediately.

My wife and I were driving out to Loulé for a doctor's appointment. The sun was quite bright and reflected off the asphalt at the intersection. I didn't see the red light in time and entered the junction, colliding with a car crossing from the right. It was a terrifying moment. My headlight glass shatter is everywhere, and there is a massive crush on the passenger side door. I am truly sorry for the trouble this has caused everyone involved in this unfortunate accident.

I was waiting at the traffic light on the cross street and saw the whole thing. The light turned red for the Yaris driver, but he didn't seem to notice until it was too late. The impact was quite loud, shattering the glass of the headlights and causing a visible damage to the door.

I was queuing in the heavy traffic near the river. The car ahead of me rolled back slightly while trying to park, and because I was already quite close, I wasn't able to react in time to put my car in reverse. We tapped each other. It was barely moving, but it caused a crack in my front bumper trim. I really hope this doesn't take too long to fix, as I need my car to get to my family home in Cascais every weekend.

It was rush hour and I was trying to merge into the lane for the A1 exit. I was moving at about 20 km/h. I looked over my shoulder and signaled, but the driver behind me accelerated as I was already half-way in. We made contact along the side of the cars. It resulted in a deep scratch and a noticeable dent on my passenger door now. It is quite frustrating, but I suppose these things happen in busy Lisbon traffic all the time.

I was moving straight in my lane when the Audi merged into me suddenly. I hit the brakes, but couldn't avoid the collision. It resulted in a scratch on their door and a small dent. We are both safe, which is the most important thing.

I was entering the roundabout near the stadium. A motorbike rider came up too fast on the inside lane and clipped my bumper while I was exiting. It caused a significant scratch and a crack in the plastic molding. I stopped immediately, but the rider also stopped. It was a very tense situation, you know, because I didn't want the rider to be hurt. Luckily everyone is okay, but my car definitely needs some repair work after this incident.

I was riding my bike and moving through the roundabout. I attempted to squeeze past the SUV but miscalculated the driver's exit path. I brushed against the bumper, causing a scratch and a crack to the car's trim. I admit I was riding a bit too aggressively for the conditions.

I was driving home after work around 6:00 PM when traffic on Avenida da Boavista suddenly halted. I applied my brakes, but the car behind me didn't stop in time. It was honestly such a shock because everything was moving so slowly, maybe 20 km/h. I felt a solid jolt from behind, and when I got out to check, I saw a clear dent on my rear bumper. I am really worried about the repair costs, to be honest. The second vehicle was very apologetic and admitted he was looking at his GPS for a second.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música when another driver attempted to exit from the inner lane while I was clearly in the outer lane. It all happened in a split second, man. I attempted to steer away but I couldn't avoid the side-swipe. It resulted in a long scratch running along my passenger side door. I was just trying to head toward the bridge, you know, and now I'm stuck dealing with all this paperwork. It's super stressful because I have an exam tomorrow and I really didn't need this right now.

I was in the middle of navigating the busy traffic at the roundabout. I signaled to exit, but I clearly misjudged the proximity of the Seat Ibiza in the outer lane. I take full responsibility for the miscalculation during the merge. The contact was light, leaving just a surface scrape along the other driver's side panel.

It happened to be a busy afternoon, and I was trying to parallel park near the main square. I was moving at maybe 5 km/h, very slowly. I misjudged the distance to the stone pillar behind me. I heard a scraping sound and immediately knew I had hit something. Upon inspection, there is a visible dent and a deep scratch on the rear corner of the bumper. I feel quite embarrassed as I have been driving for years without incident, but the visibility here is tricky with all the pedestrians crossing the street simultaneously.

I was cruising along the Marginal toward Estoril, keeping to the speed limit of 50 km/h. It was a beautiful day, actually, but then this van tried to squeeze into my lane without checking his blind spot. He clipped my front left corner. The impact caused a scratch on the wheel arch and my headlight assembly is completely broken. I am absolutely livid because I take such good care of this car. It really ruins the whole weekend plans, having to deal with this insurance nonsense on a Saturday morning.

The sun was quite blinding as I approached the junction. I intended to change lanes to make my upcoming turn. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the BMW was caught in my blind spot. I hit the brakes, but it was too late to avoid contact. I have already agreed to cover the damages to his lamp and paint.

I was waiting at the traffic light on Avenida da República. When the light turned green, I proceeded cautiously, but a motorcyclist coming from the cross-street tried to beat the red light. He couldn't stop in time and collided with my driver-side mirror, causing the glass to shatter. It was terrifying, honestly. I was just heading home to my family. Thankfully, no one was hurt, but I'm just so shaken up by how quickly things can go wrong when you're just following the rules of the road.

I was walking my dog near the intersection. I clearly saw the Toyota driver move forward when the light turned green for them. The motorcyclist entered the junction way too fast, clearly ignoring the red light signal. The collision was inevitable at that point, resulting in the Toyota's side mirror glass shattering instantly.

I was pulling out of a parking spot on this very narrow street in Porto. I could not spot a car coming because of the delivery trucks blocking the view. We were both going very slow, probably 10 km/h, but the contact was enough to leave a nasty dent on my front fender and break the side indicator lamp. I feel terrible about the accident. I've been driving for forty years and I rarely have issues, but these city streets are getting impossible to navigate with all these obstacles.

I was travelling along the avenue, keeping a steady pace of 40 km/h. The road was quite wet from the light rain earlier. The car next to me suddenly swerved to avoid a puddle and clipped my left side. It’s just a superficial scratch, but it's annoying because the car is relatively new. I'm worried about whether this will affect my insurance premium next year. The other driver stopped immediately, which I suppose is a good thing, though the whole situation is just incredibly frustrating and time-consuming.

The road conditions were slippery after the brief shower. I noticed a large puddle in my lane and instinctively swerved to the left to avoid hydroplaning. I failed to check my side mirror carefully enough, resulting in contact with the Renault. I fully accept the fault for the scratch caused to the other vehicle.

I had just finished shopping at a bookstore and was stopped in traffic on Rua Garrett. The car behind me, a young man who looked very nervous, just rolled into me. It wasn't a hard hit, but my bumper has a dent and the right tail lamp is broken. I'm just so tired; I had a long day at the office. I just want this sorted out quickly. He was very polite and gave me all his information without any fuss, which I appreciate.

I was cruising near the docks when a delivery scooter cut between lanes way too fast. I swerved slightly to avoid him, but then I scraped against the side railing of a parked truck. It left a long, ugly scratch down my rear door. Honestly, the scooter driver just sped off. It’s not fair, but I have to report this as my own accident since there's no one else to blame. I'm really anxious about how much this will cost, honestly, money is tight right now.

I was entering the roundabout when a vehicle coming from the internal lane cut across my path to exit. I slammed on my brakes, but the angle was impossible. We collided, and there's a significant dent on my passenger door and the mirror glass is shattered from the impact. I was on my way to visit my granddaughter, and this has really ruined my afternoon. It's a shame, but these things happen. I just hope the repairs can be done by next week as I have a trip planned.

I misjudged the roundabout lanes, I admit that. I was in the wrong lane to exit and tried to correct it, which caused me to drift into the Volvo's path. I am deeply sorry for the damage to his door and mirror. I will cooperate fully with the insurance process to ensure he gets his repairs sorted.

I was navigating down Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM heading towards the Foz area. The traffic was quite heavy as usual, and the car in front of me stopped suddenly because of the traffic light turning red. I did my best to brake, but I didn't leave enough distance and ended up tapping his rear bumper at a very low speed. My front bumper has a noticeable dent and some scratches on the plastic finish. It was completely my fault, and I feel terrible about the inconvenience caused to the second vehicle.

I was waiting at the red light near the park when I felt a sudden bump from behind. It wasn't a violent crash, but enough to move my car slightly forward. Upon checking, there is a clear dent on my bumper and a few scratches where the other vehicle made contact. The gentleman behind me was very apologetic and admitted he misjudged the stopping distance.

It was raining this morning and visibility was not great near Martim Moniz. I was trying to merge into the right lane, checking my mirrors, but I honestly didn't see the van in my blind spot until it was too late. I heard a scraping sound as our side panels made contact. I pulled over immediately to check the damage. There are long scratches along my passenger door and the rear quarter panel. I am just really stressed out, man, this is my first accident and I'm super worried about the repair costs.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música to take the second exit. A car to my left was also exiting, and we both drifted slightly toward the center line. I tried to correct, but we made contact. My front corner hit his side. Now I have a broken headlight lamp and a dent in my fender. I've been driving for forty years, you know, and this is the first time something like this happens in this busy roundabout. It's just very upsetting for everyone involved.

We were both circling the roundabout when the individual driving the other car seemed to lose his lane position. He drifted into my side, causing damage to his own headlamp. I have a dent on my door as well. We pulled over just past the roundabout to exchange insurance details. The driver was very polite and cooperative throughout the process.

I was reversing out of a tight parking spot at the shopping center. I was looking behind me, but I miscalculated the angle of the pillar behind me and ended up grazing the side of a parked car. I feel awful because the car was parked perfectly. There are just some ugly scratches on my rear bumper now. I am worried about how my insurance premium will be affected, but I know I must report this properly. It was just a silly, careless mistake on my part.

I was proceeding through the intersection at green, but I think the second vehicle might have jumped the yellow. We collided right in the middle. The impact shattered my side mirror glass and caused a deep dent in my passenger door. I was quite shaken up, but luckily no one was hurt. My memory is a bit of a blur because it happened so fast, like in a split second, you know? I'm just grateful that my seatbelt held me in place and prevented any real physical injury.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus. I saw the Ford entering the intersection when the other car came from the side street. It looked like the second car tried to beat the light. The impact was quite loud, and I saw glass shattering onto the asphalt. Both drivers stepped out of their vehicles and were checking for injuries immediately after.

I was traveling along the EN125 when traffic came to a sudden halt near the construction works. I pressed the brakes, but my car slid slightly on some loose gravel on the road surface, causing me to hit the car in front. The impact was enough to break my front lamp and leave a dent in the bumper. I am quite worried about the repair time, as I need this vehicle for my daily commute to work. It was a very unfortunate situation for everyone.

I was driving straight in the middle lane when a taxi suddenly swerved to avoid a cyclist. I had nowhere to go and ended up catching the back of the taxi with my side. It left a long scratch running along my driver's side door and a small dent near the handle. It all happened so fast, I didn't really have time to react. I'm just glad nobody got hit, especially the cyclist, though the situation involved a very stressful moment for all of us involved in the traffic.

I was forced to shift quickly to avoid a cyclist who crossed into the lane without looking. I felt a scrape and heard a bang. The Nissan driver caught my rear bumper. There is a dent and several scratches on the side of my car. I stopped as soon as it was safe to do so to exchange details with the insured driver.

I was stopped at the red light on Avenida da Liberdade. The car behind me didn't stop in time and pushed me into the car ahead. The impact wasn't huge, but there is a clear dent on my rear trunk lid and some scratches from the license plate frame of the car behind. I'm very concerned because this is a newer car and I want it to be perfect. The other driver apologized immediately, he was very distressed about the whole incident.

I was distracted for a split second by the GPS, and by the time I looked up, the traffic had stopped. I couldn't stop in time and tapped the car in front. I feel terrible about it. I have some scratches on my front bumper, and I know I caused damage to the BMW in front of me. I am fully taking responsibility for the incident.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving up the avenue and started signaling to change lanes. I looked in my mirror, but there was a blind spot, and I missed seeing the motorcycle passing on my right. We just brushed against each other. It happened to be a light impact, but it left a few visible scratches on my side door. I stopped immediately to make sure the rider was okay. Thankfully, he stayed upright and wasn't hurt, which is the most important thing. I am definitely more aware of blind spots now.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was extremely heavy as usual. I slowed down because the car in front of me braked suddenly for a pedestrian. I managed to stop safely, but the driver behind me clearly didn't react in time. I felt a firm jolt from the back, and when I got out to check, I saw a clear dent on my rear bumper. I am honestly quite shaken by the whole incident and just hope the repair process doesn't take too long.

It was my fault completely. I got distracted for a split second by a notification on my phone and failed to notice the traffic had come to a standstill. I hit the back of the gentleman's car at a very low speed, maybe 10 km/h. I am very sorry for the trouble caused.

I was parking my car in a tight spot near Rua Augusta this morning around 10:00 AM. I thought I had cleared the concrete pillar, but I miscalculated the angle while reversing at a very low speed. I heard a scraping noise and immediately stopped. Upon inspection, there is a visible scratch along the rear passenger side panel. I feel really embarrassed about this, it was just a silly mistake on my part while trying to get into the space. I have taken photos of the area and the scratch for your review.

Oh man, I am so stressed out right now. I was navigating the Rotunda da Boavista, you know how crazy that place gets. I was in the middle lane, and suddenly this delivery van decided to switch lanes without checking his blind spot. He clipped my front wing. I am pretty sure he didn't even see me there. Now I have this big dent and a long scrape along the side of my car. I really need this fixed quickly as I use this car for my university commute every single day, dude.

I was walking near the roundabout waiting to cross the street when I saw the silver van change lanes abruptly. The smaller Toyota driver did not have time to react, and the van hit the passenger side of the car. It was clearly a misjudgment by the van driver.

I was traveling along Avenida 24 de Julho heading toward Cais do Sodré. The weather was a bit rainy, and the road was slick. A vehicle in the left lane lost traction slightly and slid into my lane, swiping the side of my vehicle. The impact was enough to break my indicator lamp and leave a deep scratch across the driver's side door. It happened so fast that I couldn't avoid it. I've been driving for years and have never had to file a claim like this, so I am just following the protocol.

I was driving down the N125 near Faro when a dog ran across the road. I stepped on the brakes to avoid hitting it, and the person behind me just plowed straight into my rear. It was quite a loud impact, and it caused the glass in my rear light cluster to shatter and left a very large dent in the boot lid. I am just relieved nobody was hurt, but I am quite concerned about the extent of the bodywork damage. My back is feeling a bit sore, but I suspect it is just nerves.

I admit I was following too closely for the conditions. When the Mercedes stopped, I didn't have enough distance to come to a halt in time. I hit them with enough force that my own bumper is also damaged. I apologize for the inconvenience.

Back when I was a young man, traffic wasn't this chaotic, but today in Porto, it is quite something. I was entering the intersection carefully, adhering to the lights, but a driver coming from the side didn't respect the stop sign. They hit the corner of my car, which resulted in a broken front lamp and a significant dent in the fender. I am just glad my wife was not with me today, as it might have frightened her. I am reporting this as required by the insurance policy I have held for forty years.

I was heading northbound on Avenida da República during the lunch hour rush. I was maintaining a steady speed in the middle lane when an SUV attempted to merge into my lane without noticing I was already alongside him. His vehicle scraped against my passenger side, leaving a long, deep scratch. We both pulled over immediately to exchange details. He was quite apologetic and admitted he didn't check his side mirror properly before moving over. It is a frustrating situation, but thankfully it was just superficial cosmetic damage to the paintwork.

I was pulling out of a parking garage on Rua do Alecrim when a delivery rider clipped my front corner. The situation involved a very low-speed event, but because my car is quite compact, it seems to have taken the brunt of the impact. I have a damage to the bumper and the side turn signal lamp is broken. I am worried about how much this is going to cost to repair, dude, especially since I am just trying to get through the semester. I hope the insurance covers the repairs properly.

I was stationary at a red light at Praça Marquês de Pombal. The light turned green, but the car in front of me didn't move immediately because of a cyclist. I stopped, but the driver behind me failed to stop. My rear trunk has a substantial dent, and the rear light assembly glass has shattered. I am very frustrated as this is a new vehicle and I have always been a very careful driver. I am currently awaiting the police report to finalize the documentation for this claim.

I misjudged the distance between us while we were starting to move. I thought the Volvo was going to accelerate faster than they did. I accept full responsibility for the collision. I have provided my insurance details to the other driver.

I was driving on Avenida da Liberdade, enjoying the sunny weather, when traffic suddenly started merging to the left due to road construction ahead. A truck tried to push into my lane before I could clear the space. The metal side of the truck trailer swiped my passenger side door, resulting in a series of deep scratches along the paint. It happened quite slowly, but the damage is certainly noticeable. I have contacted the company that owns the truck, and we have agreed to coordinate with our respective insurers to get this resolved professionally.

I was navigating home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was moving at about 20 km/h when the traffic light ahead turned amber, and the car in front of me braked suddenly. I made an effort to react quickly, but I didn't stop in time and tapped his rear bumper. It was such a silly, low-speed mistake, man, I'm honestly so stressed about the repair costs because my bumper has a visible dent now. I really hope this doesn't make my premiums skyrocket.

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The driver behind me didn't brake early enough in the stop-and-go traffic. My rear bumper sustained a dent from the impact. We exchanged details calmly.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, you know the one, the Rotunda do Relógio. It was quite chaotic with all the tourists and airport traffic. I was in the outer lane trying to exit toward the highway when another vehicle drifted into my path. I swerved to avoid a bigger hit but ended up brushing against their side. It left a long, ugly scratch along my passenger-side door. I feel so bad about it, I should have been more careful with all the lane changes around that busy intersection.

I was trying to park in a very tight spot on Rua da Prata this morning. It was raining slightly, and the streets were slick with those old cobblestones. I miscalculated the distance to the concrete bollard on the corner while reversing. I heard a sickening scraping sound and felt the car stop abruptly. Upon checking, I noticed a deep scratch and a noticeable dent on my rear fender. It's my first incident in years, and I'm just so frustrated with myself for being so clumsy today.

I was on my way down Avenida dos Aliados when I attempted to make a right turn. Another driver was pulling out of a side street, and we both misread the timing of the intersection. We hit at a very low speed, maybe 10 km/h. My front right lamp is broken, which is quite annoying as it's a new vehicle. I'm worried about the paperwork, but the individual driving the other car was very understanding throughout the whole exchange of information.

I was exiting the side street slowly when the insured driver made a turn into my front quarter panel. I had stopped but perhaps not far enough back. The impact broke their lamp. The situation involved a simple accident caused by poor visibility at the corner.

I was cruising along the Marginal road in Cascais, enjoying the view of the Atlantic, which might have been a mistake because I wasn't fully focused on the lane marking. A van was passing me, and I drifted a bit to the left. We made contact, just a glancing blow, but it left a significant white scratch across my driver's side door panel. I am quite embarrassed to admit this, but the sun was reflecting off the water right into my eyes. I will definitely be more attentive next time.

Oh, what a morning. I was picking up some bread on Rua de Santa Catarina, which is always so busy with pedestrians and delivery vans. As I was pulling out of the narrow space, I didn't see the post behind me. I backed right into it. The sound was terrible, and the glass of my rear tail light is completely shattered now. I feel just awful, my husband told me to be careful in these narrow Porto streets, and here I am, having to report this to you.

I was walking by the bakery and saw the small Fiat backing into the concrete post. The driver was clearly trying to be careful, but the space was just too narrow. The rear light glass shattered instantly upon impact with the corner of the post.

I was waiting in traffic on Avenida da República during the afternoon rush. The vehicle ahead of me began to move, and I released my brake, but then they slammed on theirs again because of a pedestrian crossing. I bumped into them at very low speed. It resulted in a small dent on my hood. This is a very stressful situation for me, and I apologize for the inconvenience to the other driver. I am currently awaiting the repair quote for the insurance adjustment process.

I was travelling toward Cais do Sodré and needed to merge into the right lane to exit. I checked my mirror, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. As I started to move over, I heard a loud screeching sound. We both stopped immediately. It caused a long scratch along the side of my car. I feel terrible, dude, I've been driving for five years and never hit anyone before. I just hope the other person is okay and not too angry about the paint damage.

I was traveling in the right lane near the train station when the driver in the middle lane moved over without seeing me. I honked, but it was too late. My front fender and their side panel both have scratches from the contact.

I was attempting to navigate a delivery zone near Rua Augusta. It was mid-morning, and there were many tourists walking around. I was distracted by a delivery truck that was blocking half the lane. While trying to bypass it, I clipped a decorative stone planter on the curb. The force was enough to cause a visible crack in my front bumper cover. I am so embarrassed by this event; I was just trying to get to my appointment on time and made a very poor judgment call.

Back in my day, drivers were more patient, but today at Praça da Batalha, it was absolute chaos with the construction. I was braking for a taxi, and the young man behind me simply didn't stop in time. He hit my rear end quite hard. My rear lamp is broken and there is a significant dent in the metal boot lid. I've lived in Porto for forty years, and I've never seen such reckless driving as I do these days. I'm just lucky nobody was walking behind the car at that moment.

I was behind the Dacia and misjudged the distance when traffic suddenly slowed down due to the construction work in the square. I hit the rear of their vehicle, causing damage to their lamp and bumper. I accept full responsibility for the accident.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM when the traffic suddenly came to a complete halt near the park. I made an effort to brake, but I didn't stop in time and tapped the car in front of me. I'm honestly so worried about my insurance premiums going up, you know? It was just a stupid lapse in concentration for a second. When I got out, I could clearly see a nasty dent on my bumper and some deep scratches along the paintwork. I feel terrible about the whole situation, man, it's just a total nightmare for me.

It was raining quite hard this morning as I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio. I was in the outer lane and another driver tried to exit from the inner lane without checking their blind spot. We made contact just as I was passing. My front left lamp is broken and there is a long, ugly scratch across the passenger door. I am really stressed out because I rely on this car for work every single day, and the insurance process feels so incredibly daunting to me right now.

I was attempting to exit the roundabout to head toward the airport. I admit I might have misjudged the distance of the car in the outer lane due to the heavy rain. We collided as I veered to the exit. I noticed my rear light was broken during the incident. I am ready to cooperate fully with the insurance company regarding the damage.

I was parking my car on Rua de Santa Catarina around 10:00 AM. I thought I had enough clearance while reversing into the tight space between two parked vans, but I miscalculated the distance to the concrete pillar on the sidewalk. There is a visible scratch on the rear right panel now. I have been driving for years and I feel so foolish for making such a basic mistake. I really hope this repair doesn't cost me an arm and a leg, I'm just so anxious about the whole claim.

I was on my way home along Avenida Luísa Todi in the evening. The traffic was dense and a truck in the lane to my right started merging into my lane without signaling properly. I did my best to steer left, but there wasn't enough room, so he side-swiped my door. There is a very clear dent in the center of the door and multiple scratches along the frame. It all happened so fast, and I am still shaking from the impact. I am just hoping the repairs are straightforward.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the truck drift into the lane of the Toyota. It appeared to be a simple error by the truck driver who likely didn't see the smaller car. The contact resulted in visible damage to the side of the Toyota, specifically a dent and some scratches. It was an unfortunate accident, definitely no malice involved.

Back in my day, we were taught to keep a safe distance, but clearly, the driver behind me forgot that lesson today on the Estrada da Circunvalação. I was slowing down for a yellow light when I felt a massive jolt from behind. When I checked the back, I saw that my rear glass had shattered completely and the brake lamp was broken into pieces. It was quite a shock, and my poor car looks like a real mess, goodness me.

I am terribly sorry for the incident. I was looking at my GPS for a split second and didn't notice the car ahead had braked for the lights. I hit the rear of the Fiesta, causing damage to their rear light and the glass. I take full responsibility for my lack of attention on the road.

I was approaching the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal in the right lane. Another vehicle, which was positioned to my left, suddenly decided to merge into my lane right as I was accelerating. We collided side-on. It left a long scratch along my entire front fender. This is incredibly frustrating because I maintain my car perfectly. I am waiting for the insurance company to guide me through the next steps, but I am quite worried about how long the car will be in the repair shop.

It was just a small urban accident, really. I was maneuvering slowly through the traffic near Avenida dos Aliados when a delivery scooter bumped into my corner. I heard a loud pop and realized my front lamp was broken and there was a impact depression on the plastic bumper cover. I am a very careful driver, but this was simply unavoidable in such crowded city streets. I really hope the insurance handles this efficiently because I need my vehicle for my daily commute.

I was weaving through the traffic and misjudged the gap between the Smart car and the bus. I accidentally hit the front of the car, which caused a dent and broke the light. I apologize for the inconvenience caused, it was a momentary lapse in judgment while trying to navigate the city center traffic.

I was pulling into a parking spot on Rua Augusta. As I was turning the wheel, I failed to notice a concrete bollard that was slightly obscured by a delivery sign. I hit it at a very low speed, but it left a dent and a large scratch on my front bumper. I feel so embarrassed reporting this, but I know it's the correct thing to do. Everything is so busy here, and I suppose I just wasn't paying enough attention for a second.

I was stuck in the usual morning congestion crossing the 25 de Abril bridge towards Lisbon. The traffic flow was very stop-and-go. The driver behind me didn't stop in time when the car ahead of me braked suddenly. The impact pushed me forward into the vehicle in front, which caused the glass of my rear window to shatter and a major dent in the rear hatch. I was honestly quite shaken by the loud noise of the glass breaking and the force of the collision.

I was in the vehicle directly behind the one that caused the collision. It was clear that the driver was not maintaining a sufficient gap. When traffic slowed down, he didn't brake in time and hit the Volkswagen, creating a chain reaction. I saw the rear glass shatter immediately upon impact. It was definitely a rear-end collision caused by lack of distance.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving in the center lane of Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo when a taxi merged without warning. The front of his vehicle hit my side, resulting in a deep scratch and a broken indicator lamp. My car is relatively new and I am quite upset about this damage. The taxi driver seemed in a hurry, but he stayed to exchange details. I am documenting everything now to ensure the claim proceeds as smoothly as possible, as I am quite worried about repair times.

I was travelling home after a long shift at the office, heading down Avenida da Boavista around 6:30 PM. The traffic was quite heavy as usual, and suddenly the car ahead of me braked hard for a yellow light. I did my best to press the brake, but I just couldn't stop in time on the damp road surface. My front bumper hit their rear bumper directly. I feel terrible about it, honestly, and I’m so worried about the repair costs since it’s my main car. It left a noticeable dent on the hood now.

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the second vehicle had hit me. I got out to check and noticed a clear dent on my rear bumper. We exchanged details calmly.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio during the morning rush. I was in the outer lane trying to take the second exit, and I suppose I didn't check my blind spot well enough before moving. The car in the inner lane was faster than I anticipated, and we made side contact. It was completely my fault, man, I'm just so stressed because this is a rental and I don't know how the insurance works. I can see a long scratch along the passenger side door.

I was parking near the University area this afternoon, trying to squeeze into a tight space on the side of the road. I misjudged the distance to the bollard near the curb, and as I turned the wheel to straighten out, I scraped the rear quarter panel. I am so embarrassed about it, it was such a silly mistake to make while I was rushing to meet my professor. There is a deep scratch and a small dent in the metal panel right above the rear wheel.

I was sitting at the cafe terrace nearby when I saw the driver trying to park. It was a very narrow spot and the driver miscalculated the turn, hitting the side of the vehicle against the metal bollard on the sidewalk. I saw the scratch and dent immediately.

I was driving down from the Town Hall when the traffic lights turned yellow. I was distracted for a split second by a pedestrian on the crosswalk and didn't notice the car ahead had stopped abruptly. I slammed on the brakes at about 20 km/h, but I still slid forward into them. The impact caused a hairline crack in my headlight lens. I am just really shaken up, I’ve been driving for years and this is the first time I've ever hit someone like this.

The situation involved a beautiful sunny afternoon and I was enjoying the view along the coast. I was cruising at about 40 km/h when the vehicle in front of me slowed down to turn into a beach parking lot. I didn't notice their turn signal until it was too late. I applied the brakes, but I still made contact. You can see a distinct dent on the center of my front bumper. I feel so foolish for being distracted by the ocean view instead of paying attention to the road.

I was slowing down to enter the parking lot near the beach. I used my blinker well in advance, but the driver behind me didn't seem to notice. They bumped into my rear at low speed. We pulled over and verified the dent on their bumper.

I was heading toward Almada, and the traffic was moving at a slow pace. I tried to change into the right lane to exit the bridge, but there was a blind spot issue. My side mirror clipped the side mirror of a truck that was moving alongside me. It was a very loud noise, like glass shattering, and sure enough, my side mirror glass is completely shattered. I am quite worried about the repair costs because the part is electronic and probably expensive to replace.

I was maintaining my lane on the bridge when the car next to me suddenly moved over. They hit my mirror, which caused their mirror glass to shatter on impact. We stopped at the first available safety bay to check the damage.

It was early morning and I was on my way to drop the kids at school. I was pulling out of a side street onto Rua da Constituição and failed to yield to the car coming from my left. I misjudged their speed, which was probably higher than I thought. I scraped the side of their front bumper. I feel terrible for the delay this caused everyone, and I’m really anxious about the insurance premium going up because of this minor incident.

I was driving down the main street when the Dacia pulled out from a side road without stopping. I tried to brake, but we still touched, leaving a long scratch on my front bumper. The other driver apologized immediately.

I was driving home after a long shift, probably around 6 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I attempted to press the brake pedal, but I was just a bit too late given the wet road conditions and the distance. My front bumper hit their rear bumper, causing a small dent. I feel terrible about it, honestly, and I'm just worried about how much this will affect my insurance premiums moving forward.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música to head towards Matosinhos. I was in the outer lane when a van suddenly cut across me to exit. I didn't have enough time to react, so our sides clipped. It resulted in a scratch and a dent on my passenger door. I am just so anxious about the repair costs, man, I really hope the insurance covers this without too much hassle, you know? It happened so fast that I barely had time to process it.

I was merging into the exit lane of the roundabout. I checked my mirrors, but I believe the oncoming driver was in my blind spot. We made contact, causing some damage to his side panel. I take responsibility for misjudging the lane change.

I was attempting to parallel park on Rua Augusta. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I miscalculated the distance to the vehicle parked behind me. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had grazed the rear bumper of the car. It left a noticeable scratch on their bumper. I am quite embarrassed by the incident, as I have been driving for many years and rarely have these kinds of mishaps. I have already left my contact details for the owner of the other car.

It was raining quite heavily this morning near the Cais do Sodré station. Traffic was crawling at about 20 km/h. I attempted to change lanes to avoid a stationary bus, but I didn't see the car in the lane next to me quickly enough. We made contact, and my front corner dented his panel and hit his light, causing the lamp to be broken. I am really stressed about this because the car is relatively new and I have never filed a claim before.

I was driving normally in the middle lane when the driver in the left lane veered into me. It seems like the rain affected his visibility. The impact caused a dent on my wheel arch and shattered my indicator lamp.

Traffic on the bridge was stop-and-go as it usually is on a Tuesday morning. I was looking for a playlist on my phone for a split second, and in that moment, the car ahead stopped completely. I slammed on my brakes, but I still rolled into his bumper at low speed, leaving a small dent. It was entirely my fault for being distracted, and I accept full responsibility for the accident. I am just thankful that nobody was hurt, as the speed was quite low.

I was driving down the Estrada Monumental, and as I reached the intersection, the traffic lights turned yellow. The car in front of me decided to stop, but I thought I could make it through, so I braked late. I tapped his bumper, which resulted in a dent, and unfortunately, my headlight hit his bumper in a way that caused my glass to shatter. I feel so bad about this, the road was slippery from the earlier drizzle and I just couldn't stop in time.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus. I saw the Fiat accelerate when the light was changing. The driver behind him couldn't stop in time on the slick road and bumped into him. It was definitely a low-speed impact.

I was driving along Avenida da República, planning to turn right at the next junction. I checked my mirrors, or so I thought, and started to merge into the right lane. I failed to notice the taxi already occupying that lane. We made contact, resulting in a long scratch along the side of my vehicle. I am really annoyed with myself for not being more careful. My work schedule has been so intense lately that I think I just lost focus for a few seconds.

I was cruising in the right lane when the Tesla suddenly moved over. I tried to honk, but there wasn't enough time to evade. He scraped the entire side of my passenger door. It's a professional vehicle, so this is quite an inconvenience.

I was trying to park in one of the tight spots near the Praça do Comércio. I turned the wheel too sharply while reversing. I ended up hitting a concrete pillar. It caused a dent in my rear quarter panel and the impact also resulted in my tail lamp being broken. I am quite shaken up because I am not used to driving in such tight urban spaces. I'll need to get the car fixed soon as I rely on it for my daily commute to the office.

statements.text: My grandson was in the back seat, and we were chatting about his school day, so I suppose I wasn't paying full attention to the traffic ahead of me. The light turned red at the junction, and the car in front stopped suddenly. I hit them from behind, which left a dent and a scratch on both our bumpers. It was a very quiet afternoon, and the sun was quite low, which made it hard to see clearly. I've been driving for forty years and I'm very sorry for this mistake.

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me clearly didn't see me stop. It caused some minor damage to my bumper, just a dent and some paint damage. I am mostly concerned about the delay.

I was driving slowly on Rua de Santa Catarina, looking for a parking space. I turned my head to look at a shop window and didn't notice the bollard near the curb. I clipped it at a very low speed. I feel like such an amateur, dude, I was just distracted by the scenery and totally lost track of where the curb was. I hope this is a quick fix, man.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. The traffic was stop-and-go. I was distracted for a split second by the GPS, and when I looked up, the Golf in front of me had already braked. I hit the brakes, but I still slid forward and bumped into his rear end. It left a noticeable dent on his bumper.

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, keeping to the outer lane. I hope the insurance covers the bodywork properly without me having to pay a fortune out of pocket.

I was parking my car on Rua da Prata this morning to grab a coffee. It was raining slightly, and the cobbles were quite slippery. There is a visible dent and a long scratch on the rear panel. I’ve been driving for years and this is the first time I've done something like this. It is just such a frustrating start to my Tuesday.

I was heading down Avenida 24 de Julho at about 40 km/h when a delivery van to my left started drifting into my lane. I did my best to swerve, but he still caught my front quarter panel. This is an unnecessary inconvenience for my schedule, but it is a simple matter of liability. The van driver apologized immediately, acknowledging that he had drifted while checking his manifest. We exchanged details and left the scene quickly to avoid blocking the transit.

I was distracted checking an address for a delivery on Avenida 24 de Julho. I didn't realize I was moving out of my lane until I heard the contact. It resulted in a scratch on the side of the BMW. I take full responsibility for the error in judgment.

I was stopped at a red light on the Circunvalação when, suddenly, I felt a massive jolt from behind. The impact was strong enough to shatter my rear windshield and break my right tail lamp. I’m just thankful that no one was walking nearby, as the glass shards scattered quite far across the asphalt. It really is a terrible mess.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the pedestrian crossing to clear. The Toyota was waiting at the lights, and the car behind just failed to stop. The situation involved a loud impact, and I saw the glass shatter from the rear window and the lamp housing break into pieces on the road.

It was during the morning rush hour near the metro station. Traffic was crawling, maybe 15 km/h. I was maintaining my lane, but the vehicle next to me, a black SUV, tried to force a gap that didn't exist. He ended up scraping along my driver's side door. I was quite anxious because I was already late for an important meeting, and the whole situation was just stressful. The scratch is right down the middle of the door panel. I’ve already taken photos as instructed by the insurance guidelines, so hopefully, the repair process is straightforward.

The traffic heading south over the bridge was heavy and moving very slowly. The car in front slowed down, so I slowed down too, but the vehicle behind me didn't stop in time. He hit me quite hard. It caused a significant dent in the bumper and the left tail lamp is broken. I feel quite worried about the damage, man, because I need this car for my daily commute. I'm hoping it's just a simple repair and not something that will keep me waiting for weeks. The whole thing was just a bad luck situation.

I misjudged the braking distance on the bridge. When the traffic slowed to a crawl, I wasn't quick enough to stop and tapped the back of the Nissan. My front bumper hit his tail lamp and caused a dent. I’ve accepted my fault for this.

I was attempting to park in a very narrow street in downtown Porto. The car behind me was getting impatient, which made me feel quite rushed and nervous, you know? While trying to pull in, I scraped against the corner of a parked delivery vehicle. It’s just a long surface scratch on my front bumper, but it looks really obvious on the white paint. I am so worried about how much this is going to affect my insurance premiums, dude. I should have just waited for them to pass before trying to maneuver into that tight spot.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was moving from the middle to the left lane. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I failed to notice the car approaching in my blind spot. We made contact, and it caused a dent in my wheel arch and a crack in the plastic trim. It’s quite embarrassing, to be honest. I pride myself on being a careful driver, but this shows how easily a simple oversight can cause damage. The other driver was very understanding, which helped keep my nerves down, but I am still anxious about the repair timeline and the cost of the parts.

I was driving in the left lane when the Audi started moving over. I sounded my horn, but he kept coming. We collided at the wheel arch. I have a dent and the trim is cracked. The situation involved a low-speed impact, but the damage is clear to see.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: I was circulating around the Rotunda da Boavista, intending to take the exit toward Avenida da França. As I was exiting, a taxi tried to cut across my path from the inner lane. He swiped the front of my car, causing a scratch and breaking my front left lamp. I am an older driver, and these modern roundabouts with so many lanes can be quite confusing at times. I remember the weather was perfectly clear, but the taxi driver seemed to be in a great rush. I stopped immediately to ensure he also pulled over to discuss the incident.

I saw the Volvo in the outer lane of the roundabout. The taxi driver took the exit from the middle lane and didn't check his blind spot. The taxi's rear side hit the Volvo's front. It broke the lamp and left a large scratch on the bumper.

I was heading down Avenida da Boavista around 8:30 AM when the traffic suddenly stopped for the light. I pressed my brakes, but I guess I didn't leave enough distance because I nudged the back of the car in front of me at maybe 10 km/h. It was really raining hard and the road was quite slippery, which made stopping much more difficult than usual. I feel terrible about it, honestly, as I was distracted by the heavy traffic. My car has a visible dent on the bumper where it hit their tow bar.

I was trying to park in that tight space near the Rossio station. It was my first time visiting this area and the cobblestone streets are honestly so confusing. I misjudged the distance while reversing into the spot and clipped the side of the car parked next to me. I heard a scraping noise and immediately stopped. I am so worried about the repair costs, you know? I checked the damage and there is definitely a scratch along the passenger door panel. I am just a student and this is my first car, man.

I was sitting in my car when I felt a sudden bump from the side. I looked out and saw the driver of the Peugeot getting out, clearly upset and apologizing profusely. It was clearly a mistake while parking. There is a long scratch on my rear door panel, right above the wheel arch. I have the insurance details of the oncoming driver now.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música at noon today. As I was exiting the circle, the driver in the adjacent lane tried to squeeze in without signaling properly. I couldn't move over because of the traffic divider, so we ended up sideswiping each other at low speed. It happened so fast, honestly. I think my headlight housing got caught and now the lamp is broken. I am just really stressed about the whole claims process because I need my vehicle for my job as a courier.

I was maintaining a steady speed in the middle lane when the vehicle to my left suddenly swerved to avoid a taxi that had pulled over abruptly. We collided along the side panels. It was completely unexpected and I didn't have enough time to react or move out of the way. Both my doors have a deep dent and a nasty scratch where we made contact during the swerve. It was an extremely stressful experience for me.

I panicked when the taxi in front of me slammed its brakes. I swerved to the right to avoid hitting it, and unfortunately, I clipped the small car driving alongside me. I accept full responsibility for the incident. I stopped immediately and we exchanged information. I feel very bad for the damage caused to the individual driving the other car's car doors.

Well, my grandson had told me to be careful, as the streets in downtown Porto are quite narrow on a Saturday morning with all the tourists walking about. I was pulling out of a small delivery bay near the church, and it slipped my attention the cyclist coming from behind me. I heard a bang and saw the cyclist stumble. My side window glass shatter happened when their handle bar swung into the door frame. I am quite shaken up by this, as I have been driving for forty-five years without any issues.

I was standing on the corner waiting for my friend to finish shopping. I saw the Mini pulling out very slowly, but the cyclist was coming quite fast through the blind spot. The collision was minor, but the cyclist's handlebar hit the driver's window directly, causing the glass to shatter immediately. Neither party was going fast, it was just a very unfortunate coincidence of timing and positioning.

I was commuting during the heavy morning rush hour on Avenida da República. I signaled to change into the right lane to prepare for my turn. I checked my mirrors, but there was a significant blind spot, and as I moved, I made contact with a van that was also accelerating. We were both moving at about 30 km/h. It was a stupid mistake and I feel quite embarrassed. There is a long scratch running along the rear quarter panel of my vehicle. The other driver was very polite about it.

I was heading toward the hotel zone when traffic slowed down. The driver behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a significant jolt as they hit my bumper. I was distracted for a split second by the GPS, and when I looked up, the car in front had stopped. I slammed on the brakes, but I still slid into them. I apologize to the second vehicle. I clearly caused the dent and broke their tail lamp. I am ready to cooperate with the insurance company to resolve this as quickly as possible.

I was searching for a parking spot near the river and found a space that looked sufficient. While maneuvering into the narrow gap, I accidentally cut the turn too sharply. I hit a concrete pillar that wasn't properly marked with reflective tape. It caused a dent in the side panel and a significant scratch along the passenger door. I am feeling very frustrated because I have been very careful with this car since I bought it last year. It’s just one of those bad days, I suppose.

I was crossing the intersection when another car entered from a side street without observing the stop sign. I attempted to swerve, but we still collided at the front corner. I honestly thought I had enough time to pull out, but I miscalculated the speed of the approaching Renault. I take full responsibility for the collision at the intersection. I did my best to react quickly, but I was not fast enough and hit their bumper at a very low speed. My front bumper has a noticeable dent now. I am really worried about how this will affect my insurance premium as I have never had an accident before.

I was stopped at the signal when the car behind me failed to brake in time. It was a low-speed impact, but it was enough to cause a dent on my rear bumper. The individual driving the other car was apologetic and we exchanged insurance details immediately after the incident.

It was raining quite heavily this morning near the airport roundabout. I was in the outer lane of the roundabout trying to take the exit towards the highway. I suppose I misjudged the distance of the vehicle in the inner lane, and as I turned, the side of my car grazed their side panel. It was just a minor scratch on the passenger side door. I feel terrible about it because I was rushing to get to an important meeting at the office and was clearly distracted.

I was attempting to parallel park in a very tight spot near the university. I thought I had enough clearance, but I underestimated the angle of my rear wheel as I reversed. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had hit the car parked behind me. There is a small dent and a scratch on my rear quarter panel. I immediately left a note with my contact information on the other driver's windshield because I know how frustrating it is to return to a damaged car.

I was sitting at a nearby cafe terrace and watched the whole thing. The driver was trying to park, they clearly miscalculated the space and ended up backing into the parked vehicle. The impact was slow and caused a minor dent and scratch on the car's body.

I was navigating down the Avenida Luísa Todi and intended to change to the left lane to make a turn. I checked my mirrors, but I must have had a blind spot because I didn't see the motorcycle passing. As I steered into the lane, I clipped the handlebar. The impact caused my side turn signal lamp to be broken. I am just so shaken up by the whole experience. I truly hope the motorcyclist is alright; that is my main concern right now.

I was on my way slowly along the Avenida dos Aliados. A heavy delivery truck was pulling out from a side street and its rear tail gate swung out wider than I anticipated. The metal corner of the truck struck my driver-side mirror, causing the glass to shatter completely. It was quite loud and really startled me. I wasn't going fast, maybe 20 km/h, but the proximity to the truck made it impossible for me to avoid the collision once I saw it moving.

I was performing a delivery and pulling out of the side street. I didn't realize how much the back of the truck would swing out in this narrow space. I heard the glass shatter and stopped immediately. I take full responsibility for the accident.

I was navigating through the narrow cobblestone streets near Praca do Comercio. There was a delivery van parked partially in the road, forcing me to maneuver around it. In my attempt to clear the van, I miscalculated the distance to the adjacent stone wall, and my rear passenger door scraped against a sharp masonry corner. It left a deep scratch along the panel. I am quite embarrassed because I have lived in this city for years and I should have known the street was that tight.

I was pulling away from the curb on a busy shopping street when a cyclist suddenly appeared from behind a parked delivery vehicle. I swerved slightly to avoid them and hit a concrete bollard on the sidewalk. This caused a crack in my front bumper fascia. It all happened in a split second, and I am honestly just relieved that I didn't hit the cyclist. The car damage is a nuisance, but the safety of the person on the bike is definitely the most important thing today.

I saw the driver trying to leave the parking space. A cyclist darted out from between parked vans, causing the driver to panic and swerve into the bollard. The car's front bumper has a visible crack from the impact with the concrete.

The traffic light turned red at the intersection, and I had to stop abruptly. The driver behind me didn't notice the change in time and struck my rear end. The impact caused a significant dent to my trunk and unfortunately, my right tail lamp is broken. I am stressed because I rely on this car to pick up my grandchildren from school every day. The other driver was very cooperative and we were able to clear the lane quickly so we didn't block the tram lines.

I looked down at my GPS for a split second to check the route. By the time I looked back up, the traffic had stopped. I attempted to brake, but I couldn't avoid hitting the car in front. I damaged their tail lamp and rear bumper.

I was circling the roundabout and intending to take the third exit. Another vehicle, which was in the outer lane, tried to exit simultaneously without looking. Our cars made contact as we both navigated the curve. It resulted in a long scratch along my front fender and a crack in the corner of the bumper. Man, this is such a bummer because I just had the car detailed last week. I really don't have the time to deal with all this paperwork, you know?

I was on my way home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was trailing a small hatchback when the driver suddenly slammed on the brakes because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried my best to stop in time, but the roads were a bit damp from the earlier rain, and I ended up bumping into the rear of his car. I have a dent on my front bumper and a noticeable scratch near the grille. I feel terrible about the whole situation, honestly.

Traffic stopped abruptly near the intersection. I managed to brake safely, but the gentleman behind me clearly didn't have enough distance. He collided with my rear bumper. I inspected the damage and found a dent and some scratches on the plastic trim. We were both going quite slowly, probably under 15 km/h, but the impact was definitely felt.

I was attempting to parallel park in a very tight spot near Rua Augusta. There was a lot of noise and pedestrians walking around, which made it hard to concentrate. I thought I had enough clearance from the car behind me, but as I turned the wheel to pull in, I misjudged the distance and grazed my rear side panel against their front bumper. There is a visible scratch on the paintwork now. I am so embarrassed; I should have just asked someone to help me guide the car into the space.

I was sitting at a cafe table on the sidewalk nearby. I watched the driver of the white Fiat trying to park. It was a very tight squeeze and they were moving very slowly, but they eventually miscalculated the angle and hit the car parked behind them. I saw a scratch appear on the side of the Fiat. It was clearly an honest mistake during a parking maneuver.

I was traveling eastbound on Avenida 24 de Julho at about 40 km/h. I indicated to move into the right lane to prepare for a turn, but as I began the maneuver, a delivery van sped up in my blind spot. I missed seeing him, and he didn't slow down, so our doors made contact. It caused a significant dent in my passenger door. I've been driving for years and this has never happened to me before, I am feeling really anxious about the insurance claim process and the repair costs.

My wife and I were driving down to the coast for lunch on a lovely sunny day. As we reached a junction on Estrada Monumental, the traffic lights were changing quite rapidly. I thought I had enough time to clear the intersection, but a small truck coming from the side street misjudged the timing and hit the side of my car. It shattered my passenger side window and broke the front headlight lamp. It was quite a shock, we had our groceries in the back and everything went flying. Very distressing for my wife.

I was coming from the side road and saw the light turning yellow. I thought the Renault driver would stop, but they accelerated. We ended up colliding at the intersection corner. I regret the incident deeply. I caused damage to their window glass and their lamp. My speed was approximately 25 km/h at the time of the impact.

It was a busy afternoon near the city hall. I was waiting in a line of cars when the vehicle in front decided to reverse suddenly to take a parking spot that opened up behind them. I honked, but they didn't stop in time and backed directly into my front end. It caused a dent in my hood and smashed one of my headlight lamps. I'm really worried about my insurance premium increasing after this, even though it wasn't my fault at all, you know?

Crossing the bridge toward Almada, the wind was quite strong, and the traffic was moving at a steady 60 km/h. A heavy truck in the left lane seemed to drift slightly into my lane while trying to compensate for a gust. I tried to pull over to the shoulder, but there wasn't enough space. The side of the trailer grazed my vehicle, leaving a very long, deep scratch along my entire passenger side. I am just glad it wasn't worse, but the paint damage is quite extensive.

The wind on the bridge was exceptionally strong today. I felt my trailer sway, and I believe I might have crossed the lane marking for a split second. I heard a scraping sound and pulled over immediately to check. I noticed a scratch on the Seat next to me. I apologize for the incident, the weather conditions were very difficult to manage at that moment.

I was pulling out of a side street onto Rua da Prata. The visibility was blocked by a large delivery truck parked illegally on the corner. I inched forward slowly, but I still didn't see a cyclist and a moped coming around. The moped rider had to brake suddenly and tipped over, hitting my front bumper. It left a dent in the metal and broke my indicator lamp. I am really anxious about the rider, but he seems okay. It was a very narrow street and I just couldn't see around the van.

I was navigating down Avenida da Liberdade when a taxi in front of me made a sudden U-turn without signaling early enough. I slammed on my brakes, but the car behind me, a large SUV, couldn't stop and hit me from behind. The impact pushed me into the back of the taxi. My trunk has a huge dent, and the rear window glass shattered from the force. It's a real mess, and I am quite shaken up by the whole experience. I was only doing about 30 km/h.

I was following the Audi closely. When the taxi ahead initiated an illegal U-turn, the Audi driver reacted quickly, but I simply lacked the reaction time to halt my heavy vehicle completely. I impacted their rear end. I saw the trunk sustain a dent and the rear glass shatter upon impact. It was a very unfortunate chain reaction caused by the taxi.

I was at the beach in Costa da Caparica and found a spot in the sand-covered parking lot. While trying to back out, I didn't notice a concrete bollard hidden behind some tall weeds. I reversed slowly, but the bumper hit it directly. There is a deep crack in the plastic bumper and a long scratch where it rubbed against the concrete. I feel like such a fool for not checking the area behind me more carefully. It's really frustrating because I just had the car cleaned yesterday, man.

I was driving slowly along Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, just heading home after a long shift. Traffic was quite heavy, stop-and-go. Suddenly, the car in front of me braked hard because a pedestrian started crossing. I hit my brakes, but I didn't stop in time and tapped their bumper. It was just a small bump, honestly, but I feel terrible about it. I have a dent on my front hood now. I’m just really stressed because I’ve never had an accident before and I don't know how the insurance process works here.

I had to stop abruptly because of someone crossing the road unexpectedly. The driver behind me didn't react quickly enough and hit my car. It was a low-speed impact, but clearly, I have a dent on my rear bumper now. I am glad no one was hurt.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: It was raining, and the roundabout was quite chaotic as always. I was trying to exit toward the city center when the other car, which was in the outer lane, just drifted into my lane without checking. I tried to steer away but felt the side of my car scrape against their fender. There is a visible scratch along my passenger side door. I’m really worried about the repair costs, man. It all happened so fast, like, I didn't even have time to honk properly.

I parked my car on the side of the street near the university earlier this morning. When I returned around 2:00 PM, I noticed someone had clearly hit the side of my car while trying to reverse park. There is a deep scratch and a noticeable dent on my rear driver-side panel. It’s frustrating because I take good care of my vehicle, and now I have to deal with the paperwork and repair scheduling.

I was sitting at the nearby cafe and saw a delivery van trying to park in the space behind this Nissan. The driver miscalculated the distance and scraped the side of the parked car. He got out, looked at the damage, then just left without leaving a note. I saw the whole thing.

I was crossing the intersection on a green light when another driver failed to stop at their red light. They hit my front corner. My headlamp is broken, and it resulted in a significant dent on the wheel arch. I am quite shaken up by the whole experience. The individual driving the other car apologized immediately, but the damage to my car is quite extensive. I’m just trying to make sure I fill out these forms correctly so I don't lose any coverage due to an error.

I am so terribly sorry, I was distracted by my GPS and didn't see the light turn red. I hit the side of the Toyota as I entered the junction. I accept full responsibility for the accident and the broken lamp and dent I caused.

Well, you see, I was just coming back from the market with my groceries, moving quite slowly as the street was packed with tourists. My foot must have slipped a bit, or perhaps I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar in the parking garage. I made a slight turn and heard a horrible scraping noise. When I got out, I saw a long, ugly scratch along the rear bumper. My granddaughter told me I should report it, even if it looks minor to some people.

I was heading home from work on the Eixo Norte-Sul, and traffic was moving at about 40 km/h. Suddenly, the car ahead of me swerved to avoid a piece of debris on the road and stopped dead. I slammed on my brakes, but the road was a bit slick, and I slid right into their bumper. My headlight is broken, and it left a bad dent in my grille. I am extremely worried about the cost of these repairs, as it’s a modern car with many sensors.

I had to brake hard to avoid an object on the road. The driver behind me followed at a safe distance but simply couldn't stop in time due to the rain. They hit my rear, which caused damage to their front headlight and bumper. It was an unfortunate accident.

It was very tight on this street with all the construction vehicles parked on the side. I was trying to pass a delivery truck when a taxi tried to overtake me at the same time. He didn't see me and swiped my side mirror and door. It’s just a nasty scratch, thankfully nothing worse, but it’s still annoying. I’m quite anxious about whether the insurance will cover this fully because the road was so narrow, and I’m afraid they might blame me for not stopping sooner.

I was pulling out of a parking spot in the square. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the cyclist or the other driver behind me. It was a very low-speed maneuver, but I ended up clipping the corner of a parked car. My own tail lamp is broken and it resulted in a scrape along the bumper. It’s embarrassing, honestly, I’ve been driving for years and never made such a silly mistake. I’m just notifying you so we can handle the repair for both vehicles.

I was heading home from work around 6:30 PM, traffic was quite heavy as usual. I slowed down because the car in front suddenly hit their brakes at the pedestrian crossing. I tried to stop in time, but the road surface was a bit damp and my car skidded forward a few meters, resulting in a low-speed impact. I hit the rear of the car in front, which left a noticeable dent on their bumper. I feel terrible about it, honestly, it was just a lapse in concentration during the evening commute, but I am fully taking responsibility.

I was stopped at the red light near the roundabout when suddenly I felt a significant jolt from behind. I checked my rearview mirror just before the impact and saw the Golf approaching too fast. My rear bumper definitely has a new dent now. The driver was very cooperative and apologized immediately.

I am so worried about this, I was trying to park my Fiat in a very tight spot near the plaza this morning.
