I thought I had enough clearance, but as I was turning the wheel to tuck the back in, I misjudged the distance to the adjacent parked car. I heard a slight scraping noise and immediately pulled back. I got out to check and saw a long scratch along the side panel of the other vehicle. I feel like such an idiot, I have been stressed all day about how to report this properly.

It was just a normal Tuesday morning, I was navigating the large roundabout near the hotel. The traffic was merging into the center lane, and as I moved to follow the flow, a van in my blind spot moved over at the same time. We both tried to brake, but there was a metallic contact. It caused a deep scratch and a small dent on my passenger door. I am really shaken up, you know, it just happened so fast and I am really not sure how I missed seeing the van coming.

I was changing lanes to take the exit, checking my mirrors as required. Suddenly I felt the side of my van scrape against the car beside me. The situation involved a genuine accident, neither of us saw the other. There is a visible scratch and a small dent on the side of their Peugeot as well.

I was looking for a parking spot near the town hall. I started reversing slowly, thinking the way was clear behind me. I didn't see the post or the sign, and I backed into a concrete pillar on the sidewalk. It wasn't very fast, maybe 5 km/h, but it was enough to smash my rear lamp. I feel so bad because it's a rental car and I didn't want to cause any damage. I am just really stressed about the repair costs and the insurance paperwork process now.

My wife and I were driving towards Estoril to enjoy the nice weather by the sea. I was following a car at a safe distance, but the sun was quite low in the sky, which blinded me for a second when they slowed down abruptly. I slammed on the brakes, but I still made contact with their rear end. It was quite a shock, hearing the glass shatter from their rear light and seeing the dent on their trunk. We are both very upset that this happened during our weekend outing.

I was just cruising along the Marginal at normal speed when I had to brake for a cyclist crossing the road. I felt the impact from behind immediately. The gentleman was very polite and admitted he didn't see me braking because of the sun. My rear light glass shattered and the bumper has a dent.

I was driving down this busy avenue, checking the traffic flow. I intended to change lanes to turn right at the next intersection. I signaled and began to move, but I miscalculated the speed of the car in the lane I was joining. I heard a scrape as our mirrors brushed against each other. It caused a light scratch on the paintwork. I stopped immediately to ensure everything was handled correctly. It was entirely my mistake as I failed to double-check the blind spot carefully before maneuvering.

I was waiting to cross the street at the pedestrian lights when I saw the Mercedes start to change lanes. The driver of the other car was already there, and they didn't have much room to react. There was a clear sound of contact, leaving a visible mark on the side of the car.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was going through the roundabout, keeping to my lane. Suddenly, a car came from the outer lane trying to take the exit directly across from me. I couldn't move out of the way fast enough, and we sideswiped each other at the exit. The impact caused a scratch along my side and broke my front lamp. I am just so anxious right now because I use this car to get to university every day and I don't know how long it will take to fix this.

I was in the roundabout, intending to exit. I thought I had space to maneuver but evidently, I misjudged the trajectory of the Corsa. We scraped against each other. My car has a scratch, and theirs seems to have a broken lamp.

I was travelling through the narrow streets of the city center. A delivery truck was parked with its tail sticking out, and as I tried to pass carefully, a cyclist swerved into the middle of the road. I had to pull away to the left to avoid him and I ended up scraping the side of a parked vehicle. It left a bad scratch and a damage to the passenger side door of the other car. I am really shaken, it was a very sudden situation involving the cyclist and the parked truck.

The traffic was moving at a moderate speed of around 30 km/h. Everyone suddenly braked because a motorbike fell over ahead. I pressed my brakes hard, but the road was quite slippery from the earlier rain. I couldn't stop in time and hit the back of the car in front. It caused a dent in their bumper and broke one of my lamps. It all happened within seconds and I feel quite overwhelmed by the whole experience. I have exchanged all the details with the other driver as required.

I stopped normally when the traffic ahead stalled. A moment later, I felt a heavy impact from the Qashqai. My bumper has a new dent, and I saw their front lamp was broken from the collision. We both stayed calm and filled out the accident report correctly.

I was travelling down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, and the traffic was quite heavy as usual. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to react quickly, but I couldn't stop in time and ended up bumping into the back of his vehicle. I am really sorry about this, it was just a lapse in concentration, and now I see it left a noticeable dent on my front bumper. I have already exchanged details with the other driver to sort out the repairs through the insurance.

I had to stop abruptly because someone stepped into the road unexpectedly. The driver behind me didn't have enough distance and hit my rear bumper. There is a clear dent on my car now. We were both going quite slow, maybe 20 km/h, but the contact was enough to cause this damage.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, trying to exit towards Avenida da Liberdade. I was in the middle lane, and I think I misjudged the position of the van next to me. As I turned, I heard a scraping sound. I immediately pulled over to check. It turns out there is a long scratch along my passenger side door. I feel so stressed about this, I've never been in an accident before, and I'm really worried about how much this is going to cost to get painted and fixed up.

I was trying to park in a tight spot near the university. I was moving very slowly, maybe at 5 km/h, but I underestimated the distance to the concrete pillar in the garage. I scraped against the side, and then my bumper hit the base of the pillar. It resulted in a visible scratch and a small dent now. I am so embarrassed; I was just trying to get to my appointment on time and I wasn't paying enough attention to my surroundings. It was completely my fault and I just want to handle the repairs properly.

I was on my way along the avenue when the car to my left suddenly decided to change lanes without checking if the lane was clear. They clipped my side, and the impact shattered my side indicator lamp. I made an effort to steer away, but there was nowhere to go due to the traffic. I am quite shaken up by the whole experience. The second vehicle stopped immediately, and we are both just trying to get the documentation sorted for the claim. The damage is strictly limited to the broken lamp unit on my passenger side.

I was in the middle lane and thought I had enough space to merge right. I could not spot the Nissan in my blind spot. I hit their side and broke their indicator light. I feel terrible about it, it was a genuine mistake on my part due to the sun glare.

I was driving along the Marginal road heading towards Cascais. A large truck in front of me drove over a loose stone on the asphalt, which was then flung directly into my windshield. It happened so fast that I barely had time to react before the glass shattered into a spiderweb pattern. It was a terrifying moment, but I managed to pull over safely to the side of the road. I am not hurt, but the windshield definitely needs to be replaced as it is now completely compromised.

Oh dear, I had such a terrible afternoon. I was parking my car in the narrow street near the Cathedral. I am 72 years old and my depth perception isn't what it used to be. I miscalculated the turn and scraped the rear fender against a stone wall. It makes me feel quite sad, as I have kept this car in pristine condition for years. I have a long, visible scratch now. I have already contacted my insurer to see how we can proceed with the repairs as soon as possible.

I was sitting at a nearby cafe terrace and saw the whole thing. The driver was trying to maneuver into a parking space and just misjudged the distance to the wall. It was a slow impact, resulting in a noticeable scratch along the side of the car.

location: Almada, near the 25 de Abril Bridge

statements.text: I was driving towards the bridge when the traffic suddenly came to a complete halt. I applied my brakes firmly, but the road was a bit damp and I slid a few meters before hitting the vehicle in front of me. The impact caused a dent in my bumper and broke the right-side tail lamp. I am very worried about the repair costs, dude. It was just one of those unlucky days where the road conditions and my timing didn't align. I have already exchanged insurance information with the driver I hit.

I was stopped completely because of the bridge traffic. The driver behind me came in too fast and couldn't stop. They hit my car from behind, causing damage to my bumper and breaking one of their lights. It was an honest mistake given the wet road surface.

I was traveling at about 40 km/h in the lane closest to the center line. Another vehicle was in the adjacent lane and began merging into my lane without noticing that I was still partially alongside them. I swerved to the right, but the side of their car still scraped against my left door panel. There is a clear, long mark on the paintwork. I am frustrated, but the other driver was very apologetic and admitted they simply didn't check their side mirror before changing lanes.

I was exiting the roundabout when a motorcycle came up quickly on my left side, attempting to overtake while I was already committed to the exit. I turned the wheel to avoid him, but the side of my car grazed his footrest and the frame. This resulted in a dent and a scratch on my rear door. I am so worried because the motorcyclist fell over, though he is okay. I have called the police to make a formal report and have my insurance details ready for the claim process.

I was riding my motorcycle and thought I had space to pass on the inside of the roundabout. The car driver didn't see me and pulled into my path. We collided, causing some cosmetic damage to their car. I was moving at about 15 km/h.

I was pulling into a parking space near the canal. I failed to notice that there was a decorative stone planter placed right on the edge of the curb. I moved forward just a bit too much and my front bumper made contact with the stone edge. It caused a significant crack in the plastic bumper fascia. I feel absolutely terrible about it, honestly. I've only had this car for six months and I'm quite attached to it. I have already contacted the workshop to see if it can be repaired.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista during the morning rush hour. Traffic was quite heavy, and the vehicle in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I did my best to press my brake pedal, but I was just too close and ended up bumping into his rear bumper at a very low speed. I feel terrible about it, honestly. My front bumper has a noticeable dent and some deep scratches from the impact. I am so worried about the repair costs, you know, it has just been such a stressful morning.

I was moving slowly in the middle lane when I had to stop abruptly for a person crossing the street. I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The second vehicle apologized immediately and was very cooperative. We pulled over to the side to exchange information. My rear bumper clearly shows a dent and some paint scratches where his car hit me.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, which is always chaotic. I was in the outer lane, trying to exit towards the A1, when a van to my left suddenly merged into my lane without checking. I attempted to steer away but we made contact along the side of my car. I was honestly so shaken up by the maneuver. The passenger side door has a long, visible scratch now. I really hope the insurance process isn't too complicated, man, I've never dealt with this before.

I was trying to park my car in a narrow space near the university. I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar in the garage. As I was turning the wheel, I heard a terrible scraping sound. It was my fault for not checking the sensors carefully enough. Now there is a bad dent and a scratch on my rear quarter panel. I am just so embarrassed to be calling this in, but I need to get it fixed as soon as possible because it looks really awful.

It was raining quite heavily while I was heading towards Cais do Sodré. The roads were slick and visibility was limited. I was attempting to change lanes when the car in the blind spot sped up unexpectedly. We sideswiped each other at about 30 km/h. It was a jarring experience and I am still feeling a bit anxious about the whole event. My front right side now has a dent and the headlight lamp is broken. I hope the individual driving the other car is alright, it was such a wet and dark afternoon.

I was traveling straight in the right lane when I suddenly felt a hit on my driver-side door. The insured driver was moving into my lane and didn't see me. The impact was strong enough to shatter my indicator lamp and dent the door panel. We both pulled over safely to assess the damage.

I was backing out of a parking spot near the hotel. I was going very slowly, maybe 5 km/h, but I didn't notice the low bollard behind me. I heard a loud crack and the rear tail light glass shattered completely. I've lived here for forty years and I usually know these streets like the back of my hand, but I was distracted by the heavy tourist traffic today. It’s a real shame about the light, as I pride myself on keeping my car in perfect condition for my weekly trips.

I was heading through the green light at the intersection. Another driver came from the side street, seemingly failing to notice the red light. I hit the brakes, but I still clipped their rear bumper. It was quite a shock, man, really unexpected. My front bumper took most of the force, leaving a large dent and a long, jagged scratch across the paint. I am just really glad that nobody was hurt, but I am super stressed about how long the car will be in the repair shop.

I was waiting to cross the street when I saw the silver Ford enter the intersection correctly. The other car definitely ran the red light and clipped the Ford. It happened in seconds. The Ford had a dent and scratches on the front bumper. I am happy to provide my contact details as a witness.

I was stopped at a red light on a very steep street in downtown Lisbon. When the light changed, my car slipped back slightly while I was releasing the clutch, and I tapped the car behind me. It was a mistake on my part, I suppose I wasn't used to the manual gearbox on such a slope. I felt terrible. My rear bumper has a dent and the brake lamp is broken. I'm just hoping the other driver isn't too upset about this minor accident.

I was parked behind the Audi at the red light. When the light turned green, the Audi started to roll back. I honked, but it wasn't enough to prevent the contact. The impact broke my lamp and caused a dent on my front bumper. It was an honest mistake by the other driver, and we have agreed on the details.

Driving along the coast road, the wind was quite strong. A truck in the opposite lane passed by very closely, and the air displacement caused my car to sway slightly. I brushed against the side barrier on the road. It caused a long, deep scratch along my driver-side doors. It's a real shame because I keep the car immaculate for my weekend trips with the grandkids. I'm quite concerned about the paint matching, given the color of the vehicle, so I hope the body shop is high quality.

I was entering the roundabout and was hit by someone failing to yield. It all happened so fast, like, I didn't even have time to react, you know? It was just a thud and then my car was dented on the side. The impact also caused a crack on my plastic side trim. I'm really worried about the repair costs, dude. This is like, the first time I've been in an accident, and I'm just super nervous about dealing with all the paperwork.

I entered the roundabout without noticing the vehicle already in the lane. It was a lapse in concentration on my part. I hit the Skoda on its side. You can see a dent and a crack on the trim of the other car. I take full responsibility for the collision.

I was navigating the roundabout at the Boavista junction around 8:30 AM when traffic suddenly slowed down. I pressed the brakes, but the car behind me didn't stop in time. He nudged my rear bumper quite hard. I am really worried about the repair costs, man, it is my first accident and I am stressed out. When I checked, it left a clear impact depression on the trunk lid and a long scratch along the plastic trim. It feels like such a nightmare to deal with all this paperwork this early in the morning.

I was following the Volkswagen through the roundabout. When he braked, I reacted, but the road was a bit damp and I slid forward, causing a minor collision. I am sorry for the trouble. I can confirm the impact caused a dent and a scratch on his vehicle, and I accept full responsibility for the accident.

I was parking my car near the Avenida dos Aliados late yesterday evening. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar in the parking garage. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had grazed the side of the car against the wall. It is just a surface scratch, honestly, but I want to get it fixed properly. I have been driving for over forty years, and you know, sometimes even at my age, you just have a momentary lapse in spatial awareness. It is really frustrating.

I was driving along the Marginal towards Cascais in the right lane. A van tried to merge into my lane without checking his blind spot properly. I did my best to swerve, but we still made contact near the headlight area. It was very sudden and quite loud. The impact resulted in a dent on my front fender and my left lamp is broken. I am so upset because this is my only car for work, and now it looks like I have to go through the whole repair process, which is just exhausting.

I admit I was looking at my GPS and moved into the lane prematurely. I did not see the Peugeot until it was too late. I heard the impact immediately. My van only has a minor scuff, but I saw that the Peugeot sustained a dent and had a broken lamp. I am ready to file the claim.

I was stopped at a pedestrian crossing on Rua Augusta. A delivery driver behind me was distracted and rolled forward into my bumper. It wasn't a high-speed collision, but it was enough to cause a crack in my rear bumper panel. I am quite worried about the insurance premiums going up, you know? It is like, I was just waiting for the people to cross, and suddenly, bam. The guy was nice about it, but it's still such a headache to get these things sorted out with the company.

Traffic on the bridge was crawling at about 20 km/h due to the typical afternoon congestion. I was focused on the brake lights ahead of me when the driver behind me failed to stop. The impact was significant. My trunk has a large dent now, and the glass shatter on the rear windshield is quite extensive. My back hurts a little, but I am more concerned about the car. It is a reliable vehicle and I really need it for my daily commute to the office. I am just hoping the repairs are fast.

I was in the car behind the two involved in the accident. The Toyota stopped normally for traffic, but the car behind it did not brake until the last second. It was definitely a rear-end collision. I saw the Toyota sustain a impact depression on the rear and the rear window had glass shatter everywhere. I stopped to ensure everyone was okay before continuing.

I was driving straight on Avenida da Boavista, sticking to my lane. Suddenly, a car from the adjacent lane veered too far to the left while turning. They ended up side-swiping my passenger door. It was honestly a very quick movement, and I couldn't avoid it entirely. You can see a very long, deep scratch running along the side of my car. I’ve been maintaining this car perfectly for years, so seeing this damage is truly disheartening. I hope the insurance covers the paint job properly without too much back and forth.

While I was maneuvering to turn onto the main square area, the lighting conditions were a bit difficult with the sun reflection. I underestimated how close the bollard was and turned slightly too wide. I ended up hitting the corner of my vehicle against the stationary stone fixture. The impact caused a dent in the bumper and my right turn signal lamp is broken. I feel quite foolish about it, honestly, as I have driven this route many times. My main concern now is the cost of the lamp replacement and body shop work.

I parked my car on the side of the road to go visit a friend at the university. When I returned about two hours later, I noticed a fresh, long scratch on my rear bumper. There was no note left by the oncoming driver, but looking at the paint transfer, it seems like a metallic blue car grazed me while trying to squeeze into the spot behind me. It is incredibly frustrating to find this when you come back. I just want to get it fixed so the car stays in good condition.

I was sitting at the cafe across the street and saw a blue car try to park behind the Golf. The driver misjudged the space and scraped the bumper of the Golf. They got out, looked at the damage, then just got back in and drove away quickly. I didn't get their license plate, but I clearly saw the scratch being made.

I was heading down the avenue when the light turned yellow. I decided to brake gently, but the driver behind me didn't anticipate the stop. My car was pushed forward, and the rear sustained a significant dent. Unfortunately, the force also caused some glass shatter in the trunk area from some items I had stored there. It was quite a shock, dude. My neck is fine, but I'm just worried about the resale value of the car now that it's been in an accident. I need to get this estimated as soon as possible.

I admit I was following a bit too closely. When the driver in front hit the brakes, I couldn't stop in time on the wet asphalt. I hit the back of his car. I am very sorry for the trouble. I saw the dent and the glass shatter on his vehicle. I have provided my insurance details for the claim.

I was travelling around the roundabout, and as I was exiting, another vehicle tried to push through from the inside lane. It was a very clumsy maneuver on their part. The side of their car caught my bumper, causing a long scratch and a broken lamp on the side. I am feeling quite anxious about the whole process, you know? It is my daily driver for the kids, and having it broken makes life difficult. I really hope the insurance company handles this efficiently so I can get back on the road.

I was heading home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic was really backed up near the roundabout. I came to a complete stop because the car in front of me halted suddenly, but the gentleman behind me didn't react quickly enough. He ended up bumping into my rear bumper at a very low speed. It happened to be a really stressful moment for me, you know, being in such heavy traffic and dealing with this, but luckily the damage is just a noticeable dent on the bumper. I'm honestly just glad no one was hurt during the impact.

I admit I was distracted for a split second by my GPS. When I looked back up at the road, the traffic had stopped and I couldn't brake in time. I hit the back of the Volkswagen gently. I feel terrible about the dent I caused on his vehicle; I am happy to cooperate with the insurance details.

I was trying to park my car in a very narrow spot in downtown Lisbon. I misjudged the distance between my car and the parked van next to me while backing up. It was so tight, and I think I panicked a bit when I heard a faint scraping sound. I got out immediately to check and realized you can see a long scratch along the rear passenger door. It was purely an honest mistake on my part because I didn't see how close the van really was. I am just so frustrated with myself.

I was navigating the roundabout near the riverfront when another driver attempted to merge into my lane without checking their blind spot properly. I tried to swerve to avoid them, but we ended up making contact with our side panels. My front lamp is broken, and you can see a significant dent where we collided. I've been driving for years and this is honestly the first time anything like this has happened to me, it's quite upsetting especially on such a sunny afternoon.

I was definitely in the wrong lane and attempted to exit the roundabout too quickly. I didn't see the Peugeot coming up beside me until it was too late. I clipped their side and unfortunately broke their lamp and caused a dent. I accept full responsibility for the error.

I was on my way along the coast road, maintaining a steady speed of about 40 km/h. Suddenly, a vehicle in the lane to my left veered sharply into my path, perhaps trying to avoid a pedestrian. There wasn't enough room to react and we side-swiped each other. The impact resulted in a nasty scratch and a dent on my front fender. It was all so sudden, I didn't even have time to blink, but thank goodness it wasn't a head-on collision or anything more serious.

I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for the bus when I saw the two cars collide. The driver in the left lane clearly drifted into the right lane without looking. It resulted in a clear scratch and dent on the Toyota's side. It happened quite fast.

It was raining quite heavily this morning in Coimbra, and the roads were very slick. I was stopped at a red light on Avenida da República when the car behind me failed to stop in time due to the wet conditions. They hit my rear bumper quite hard, and the force caused a major crack in my rear light assembly. I am extremely worried about the repair costs because I'm a student and money is really tight right now, but at least the other driver stopped to help.

I was maneuvering slowly out of a parking garage near the docks. There was a delivery truck backing up at the same time, and our blind spots must have aligned perfectly. He didn't see me and his rear corner made contact with my side window, causing the glass to shatter immediately. It was quite loud and really shocking. I am still shaking a bit from the surprise of the noise. I hope the insurance can cover this quickly so I can get back to my work.

I am terribly sorry about this. I was checking my mirrors but didn't see the car exiting the garage until I heard the glass shatter. It was a low-speed maneuver but clearly my visibility was compromised. I am ready to file the paperwork immediately.

I was visiting my niece for the weekend and needed to park on this very narrow street. I thought I had left enough clearance from the bollard, but as I turned the wheel to straighten the car, the rear bumper grazed against the metal post. It left a rather deep scratch along the paintwork. I feel so embarrassed because it was completely my fault for miscalculating the turn in such a tight space. I just want to get it fixed before I drive back home.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: The traffic was moving at about 30 km/h during rush hour. I put on my turn signal to move into the left lane. I checked my mirrors, but there was a motorcycle approaching quickly, and I suppose I misjudged his speed. We made contact, causing a minor dent and a mark on the side door. I feel terrible about it because I'm usually a very careful driver. I've been driving in Lisbon for over 40 years, and one just never gets used to these stressful situations.

I was moving through the traffic and the car in the right lane signaled and pulled over quite quickly. I didn't have enough room to pass safely. The contact caused a dent and scratch on their door. I am just relieved I didn't fall off my bike.

It was getting dark, and the traffic on the bridge was quite heavy. The vehicle in front of me slowed down suddenly for a patch of debris, and although I slammed on my brakes, I just couldn't stop in time. My front lamp collided with their rear bumper and is now broken. It was a very jarring experience, especially on the bridge where there's nowhere to pull over easily. I am just so glad that no one was seriously injured in the crash today.

I was heading around the roundabout near the city center when another driver tried to exit from the inner lane, cutting right across my path. There was no way I could avoid them. They hit the front of my car, which resulted in a broken lamp, a significant dent, and multiple scratches. Like, I was literally just driving to the store and now this happens. It's super frustrating and I am really worried about how much these repairs are going to cost me, man. It's just a bad day.

I made a bad call trying to exit from the inner lane. I was in a hurry and didn't see the Audi coming. I hit their front end, causing the broken lamp, dent, and scratches. I am fully responsible and will handle the insurance claim with them.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio around 2 PM. I was in the outer lane, planning to exit toward the airport. A delivery van suddenly swerved from the inner lane to exit, and I had to steer sharply to the right. We made contact while moving at about 20 km/h. There is a long, clear scratch on my passenger side door panel. I am quite shaken by the incident, but I am glad no one was hurt in the process.

I was inside the roundabout and misjudged the exit sequence. I didn't see the Seat Ibiza in my blind spot as I moved to the outer lane. We touched sides. My van is fine, but the second vehicle's car clearly has a long scratch along the side panel. I admit I was at fault for the lane change maneuver.

I was trying to park my car near the university in Coimbra. It was raining quite heavily and the street was narrow, so I was trying to be extra careful. Unfortunately, I miscalculated the distance to the bollard while reversing. I hit it at a very low speed. You can see a noticeable dent and a deep scrape along the rear quarter panel. I feel terrible about being so clumsy, and I am quite worried about how much these bodywork repairs are going to cost me.

I was navigating down Avenida Luísa Todi when a car next to me signaled to change lanes. I thought there was enough space, but as they moved over, our bumpers clipped. It was such a surprise, like, one second everything was fine and the next we were scraping. My rear lamp is broken after the contact. I've only had this car for a few months, so I'm honestly really upset about the damage to the light assembly.

I signaled to change lanes because I needed to reach the turn-off ahead. I looked in my mirrors but somehow missed the Peugeot. When I moved over, we made contact. It was a low-speed incident, but it was enough to break the individual driving the other car's rear lamp. I take full responsibility for the miscalculation.

It was a sunny afternoon, and I was crossing the intersection on Estrada Monumental. Another vehicle came out from a side street and failed to stop at the yield sign. They hit the side of my car. My side window glass shattered immediately from the impact. I am still shaking from the shock of the collision, and I am just hoping the insurance process goes smoothly. The second vehicle was very apologetic and stayed on the scene until the authorities arrived to document everything.

I was walking my dog near the intersection. The Nissan was going through the green light, and the silver car just pulled out without stopping. It was a sharp collision. The window glass of the Nissan shattered into the road. It was clearly the fault of the silver car driver.

I parked my car on Rua de Santa Catarina to go pick up some pastries at the local bakery. When I returned, I noticed a long, fresh scratch along the passenger door. There was no note left, but a shop owner told me that a truck had grazed it while trying to turn into the narrow street. It's really frustrating to come back to this, you know? The car was pristine before this happened. I just want to get it fixed as soon as possible.

My goodness, I was just driving along the Avenida on my way to visit my granddaughter, and the traffic light turned yellow. I slowed down quite gradually, as one should, but the gentleman behind me clearly didn't anticipate it. He ran right into my rear bumper. It caused a significant dent and smashed my rear lamp. I am quite shaken by the whole ordeal, and my hip is a bit sore from the sudden movement, but I am more worried about my poor car.

I was behind the BMW and got distracted by my GPS for a split second. By the time I looked back at the road, the driver had stopped for the yellow light. I slammed on the brakes but still tapped the back of her car. I am very sorry for the damage to her bumper and the lamp. It was entirely my mistake.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating around the Praça, intending to take the third exit. A vehicle coming from the inside lane suddenly moved across to take the same exit. There was no time to react and we collided. The impact caused a large dent on my rear quarter panel and smashed the tail lamp on that side. I am very frustrated because I was following the lanes correctly. I have photographs of the positions of both cars after the impact for your records.

I am new to driving in central Lisbon and found the roundabout layout quite confusing. I thought I was in the correct lane to exit, but I realized too late that I was cutting off the Audi. We made contact. I hit the back corner of his car, causing a dent and breaking his tail lamp. I accept full responsibility for the accident.

I was picking up my dry cleaning on Rua das Flores. I parked my car, and when I came back out, a delivery van was pulling away from the curb next to me. I noticed a new dent on my front fender immediately. I managed to stop the driver, and he admitted he had misjudged the turn while leaving the space. It's a small dent, but it's very visible. I'm really worried about the repair costs, as the bodywork on these Minis can be quite expensive.

I was driving home after work along Avenida da Boavista when traffic suddenly stopped. It was raining quite hard, and the roads were slick. I pressed my brakes, but my car slid a bit and I ended up hitting the bumper of the car in front of me at very low speed. I feel terrible about this, but it was just an honest mistake because of the weather conditions. My front bumper has a visible dent now from the impact. I am just really worried about the repair costs, to be honest.

The traffic was heavy as usual near the roundabout. I was completely stopped for several seconds when I felt a significant jolt from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the insured vehicle had touched my bumper. My car only sustained a small dent on the rear plastic trim. It was clearly an accident caused by the slippery road conditions.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was changing lanes to take the exit near Saldanha. I checked my mirrors, but I honestly misjudged the distance of the car in the adjacent lane. It was a stressful morning with lots of traffic, and I think I was just a bit distracted by my GPS. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had brushed against the side of a black sedan. There is a long, noticeable scratch on my passenger door now. I am truly sorry for my lack of attention.

I had gone into the city center to pick up some items for my sister's birthday, and I was trying to park in a very tight spot on Rua de Santa Catarina. I was going slow, maybe 5 km/h, but I turned the wheel too early and miscalculated the angle against the car parked next to me. It was such a silly mistake. Now my front corner has a scratch and a small dent. I feel really embarrassed about the whole situation because it was entirely my fault.

I was walking by the shop when I saw the Toyota attempting to parallel park. The driver seemed to be struggling with the space and unfortunately, they misjudged the turning radius. They lightly scraped the side of the parked vehicle. Both the Toyota and the other car ended up with some visible cosmetic damage, specifically a dent and a scratch.

I was on my way around the roundabout near the port. It was early, the sun was quite low and reflecting off the windows of the nearby buildings, which made it hard to see clearly. As I was exiting the roundabout, another driver merged too quickly and we ended up hitting each other. It was so confusing! My front indicator lamp is broken now. I am very anxious about how the insurance process works and whether my premium will go up because of this unfortunate event.

I was entering the roundabout and thought I had enough space to merge. The other driver must have been blinded by the sun because they didn't see me until it was too late. We collided at the exit. My bumper is fine, but the other driver's front lamp is definitely broken from the impact.

I was driving along the beautiful road near the coast in Cascais. It happened to be a lovely day, but the traffic was surprisingly dense for a Tuesday. I looked down at my phone for just a split second to check a message, and when I looked back, the car in front had stopped dead. I slammed on the brakes, but I hit them anyway. You can see a noticeable dent on my hood. I am so worried because this car is my pride and joy, and I really hope it can be fixed easily.

We were moving quite slowly along the Marginal. Suddenly, I felt a heavy impact from behind. I checked my rear mirror and realized the BMW had hit me. We both pulled over to the side immediately. The driver of the BMW was very apologetic and admitted they were distracted. The hood of their car is visibly dented.

The streets in the city center are always so narrow, and today was particularly chaotic. I was trying to navigate around a delivery van, and it slipped my attention the post I was navigating past. My side mirror brushed against it, which then caused the body of the car to scrape against the concrete bollard. It left a long, deep scratch along my rear quarter panel. I am just so frustrated with myself, and I honestly don't know how I failed to notice that post while I was turning.

I was driving down 24 de Julho heading toward the bridge. I signaled to switch lanes because I needed to make a turn soon. I didn't see the motorbike in my blind spot, and as I started moving over, we collided. It was a very low-speed interaction, thankfully, but my front lamp is broken and there is a dent where the impact occurred. I'm just so thankful that the oncoming driver is okay, as I was really worried about their safety during the whole thing.

I was riding in the lane next to the Mercedes. I think the driver didn't check their blind spot properly before changing lanes. I tried to swerve, but they hit my leg guard and the side of my bike before the car's front corner impacted mine. Their lamp is broken, and there's a dent on their panel.

My wife and I were out for a walk after having a coffee on Rua Augusta. When we came back to where I had parked my Mini, I saw that another car had clearly rubbed against my driver's side while trying to squeeze into the space in front of me. It left a nasty scratch along the side. It is really disappointing, especially since I try to be so careful about where I park the car. I have no idea who did it, as they didn't leave a note.

I was sitting at the café terrace and saw a large delivery truck trying to maneuver around the parked Mini. The driver clearly misjudged the gap and the side of the truck scraped the side of the car, creating a visible scratch. The truck driver just kept going, which was quite shocking to watch.

I was driving near the city hall and it was a bit confusing with the tram lines. A car pulled out from a side street without checking properly. I swerved to avoid a direct T-bone, but I still clipped them. My side window glass shattered from the impact and there is a significant dent on the passenger door. I am just exhausted by this whole incident and I hope the insurance company can handle the repairs quickly so I can get back to my normal routine.

I was on my way around the Boavista roundabout in Porto during the morning rush hour. I was in the middle lane when the driver to my left suddenly attempted to exit without checking their blind spot. I did my best to brake, but there was a significant impact on my passenger side door. I am honestly quite shaken up because I have never been in an accident before, and I am worried about the repair costs for the dent. I just hope the insurance process isn't too complicated, man, I really don't need this right now.

I was attempting to reverse park my Peugeot on Avenida dos Aliados yesterday afternoon. I was being careful, but I misjudged the distance to the vehicle behind me, which was a dark grey sedan. I felt a very slight contact, and when I stepped out, I noticed a visible scratch on my rear bumper. I feel terrible about the carelessness, as it was entirely my fault. I have contacted the other driver, and we exchanged our insurance details properly while we were waiting for the local authorities to finish their patrol.

It was raining, and the cobblestones were incredibly slippery near the city center. I was pulling away from the curb at a very low speed, perhaps 5 km/h, when my front light housing clipped a delivery van that had stopped illegally. I heard a crunch, and my lamp is broken now. I am so frustrated with myself, and I feel quite anxious about how this will affect my insurance premium. The delivery driver was quite patient, thank goodness, but I am still very upset about the damage to my car.

I was making a quick delivery and had parked for just a minute. I saw the Fiat driver trying to pull out in the rain, but they didn't account for the slick road conditions. Their front lamp hit my rear panel. It was clearly an accident caused by the weather, and there was no malice involved.

I was heading home along the coast road in Cascais. The traffic suddenly came to a complete halt because of some roadwork ahead. I managed to stop, but the driver behind me clearly didn't see the traffic stopped, as they slammed into the back of my car. My trunk has a large dent and a deep scratch from the impact. It was quite a shock, and I have been feeling a bit stressed ever since, wondering how long the car will be in the garage for repairs.

I was driving along the Marginal and I admit I was distracted for a split second by the ocean view. By the time I looked back at the road, the traffic had stopped. I tried to slam on the brakes, but I couldn't stop in time to avoid the rear-end collision.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the heavy traffic near Marquês de Pombal. I was in the right lane, and a bus was in the left. As the bus moved forward, it didn't leave enough space for my vehicle while trying to change lanes, resulting in a side-swipe along my passenger doors. There is a long scratch visible now. I am a bit worried about the insurance process, and the whole situation has me quite anxious. I hope the company can handle the repair quickly as I need my car for work next week.

I parked my car on this street to visit a bakery. When I returned, I noticed that another vehicle must have backed into my parked car. My front bumper has a significant dent, and the indicator lamp is broken. I am quite distressed, as I really cherish this vehicle and keep it in good condition. I have asked around the local shops to see if anyone saw the incident, but unfortunately, no one seems to have witnessed the collision occur. I am hoping CCTV might help identify the responsible party.

I was walking by when I heard a loud metallic sound. I saw a large white van reversing away from the Citroën quickly. It seemed like the driver didn't even stop to check for damage to the bumper or the lamp. I didn't get the license plate, sadly.

I was travelling along Avenida da Boavista around 11:00 AM. I checked my mirror and signaled to change lanes to avoid a stopped taxi. Just as I started to merge, another car accelerated in the adjacent lane. We made contact, which resulted in a scratch on my rear quarter panel. It was a very confusing situation because both of us thought we had the right of way. I am just glad no one was hurt in the process, as the roads were quite busy and it could have been much worse.

I was on my way towards Faro on the EN125. The sun was very bright, and when the car in front slowed down for a turning vehicle, I was momentarily blinded. I applied the brakes, but it was too late to come to a complete stop, and I tapped their rear bumper. The impact caused a large dent on my bonnet, and unfortunately, my windshield had some glass shatter from the force. It was a very foolish mistake on my part, and I am quite upset that I was not paying enough attention to the road conditions.

I was approaching the intersection near São Bento. The lights were changing, and I misjudged the timing while another driver was pulling out from the side street. We collided at low speed. My passenger side lamp is broken, and there is a visible crush on the wing. I am terribly worried about the repair costs, as I know parts for this model are not cheap. I feel so stressed about the whole ordeal, and I just want to make sure everything is settled through the proper insurance channels as soon as possible.

I was cautiously entering the intersection. The traffic was slow, and I thought I had a clear path, but the BMW appeared suddenly from the main road. We made contact, and it was a genuine misunderstanding of the signal timing. We are both cooperating fully with the insurance details.

Dear sir or madam, I am writing to formally report an accident that occurred this morning while I was traveling along the Avenida 24 de Julho. A large commercial vehicle in the lane next to mine veered slightly to avoid a cyclist and clipped my side mirror and door, causing a deep scratch and a noticeable crack on the plastic trim. I am quite concerned about the maintenance of my vehicle, as it is relatively new. I would appreciate it if you could advise me on the next steps for repairs as soon as you are able.

I was navigating the roundabout at a very low speed, maybe 15 km/h, when I misjudged the distance to the car entering the lane to my right. It was quite chaotic with the morning traffic and the rain starting to fall. I felt the impact on my rear passenger door. When I checked, there was a visible dent and some noticeable paint scratch marks on the panel. I feel terrible about this, as I have been driving for years without a single mishap, and the whole situation just feels like a clumsy error on my part.

The driver of the Golf cut into my lane quite suddenly while we were circling the rotunda. I didn't have enough room to brake completely. My front bumper made contact with their side door, which caused a dent and some scratches on their vehicle. The situation involved a minor collision but enough to stop us both in the middle of the flow.

Honestly, I was trying to park in a tight spot near the town hall, and I was being super careful, or so I thought. I guess I turned the wheel just a bit too soon, you know? I heard a scraping sound against the concrete pillar of the underground garage. It left a long scratch on the rear wing. I am really stressed out because I just got this car painted last month. Do you think this is going to be covered? I am just a student and this is a total nightmare for my bank account.

I was slowly maneuvering through the narrow street when a delivery truck suddenly reversed without signaling. I did my best to sound my horn, but it happened too quickly. They backed into the front corner of my Fiat. My left front lamp is broken, and you can see a deep scratch running along the bumper area. It was very loud and startling. I was just trying to head home after shopping, and now I have to deal with all this paperwork which is really quite a nuisance for my afternoon.

I was reversing to reach a delivery point and did not see the small car behind me due to my blind spot. I hit their front bumper, which broke their lamp and caused some surface scratches. I accept full responsibility for the accident as it was my error in judgment while navigating this narrow street.

The traffic was moving at around 30 km/h, and the driver in front of me suddenly hit their brakes because a pedestrian stepped out. I did my best to stop in time, but the distance was insufficient. My car made a solid impact with their rear bumper. It resulted in a visible dent right in the center of my hood near the grill. I have been very careful with this vehicle, and I am quite disappointed that I allowed myself to follow at an unsafe distance during this afternoon commute.

Back in my day, people checked their mirrors much more often, but nowadays it seems everyone is in a rush. I was driving along the side lane when this younger gentleman decided to switch lanes without looking. He clipped the side of my car. It caused a nasty dent and a long scratch along the passenger side doors. It was quite a shock, really. I was just heading out to see my grandkids, and this really ruined the whole afternoon. I suppose these things happen when people are in such a hurry all the time.

I was walking nearby on the sidewalk and saw the Volvo being hit. The driver in the other vehicle clearly merged without looking, and the impact caused a dent and mark on the Volvo's side. It was a clear-cut case of an unsafe lane change in moderate traffic.

The traffic was quite heavy near the train station, and I was creeping forward at about 20 km/h. The vehicle to my left attempted to merge into my lane while I was already alongside him. It caused a side-swipe that left a significant dent on my rear door and a deep scratch that goes down to the primer. I am very frustrated because I signaled my presence, but he just did not seem to notice me at all in his blind spot during the merge.

I admit I was at fault for the side-swipe. I was trying to exit the main road and didn't see the Renault coming up beside me. My front corner scraped their door, causing a dent and scratch. I am very sorry for the trouble this has caused and will cooperate with the insurance details.

I had parked my car on the street while I went to pick up some bread at the local bakery. When I returned, I noticed a fresh, long scratch along my rear bumper. There was a note left on the windshield, so I know it was the van parked behind me. I am quite upset, as the car was in perfect condition this morning. It is just a minor scratch, but still, I have to take time out of my day to get this sorted out.

I was waiting at a red light on Avenida da Boavista when I felt a sudden impact from behind. My foot was on the brake, but the force pushed my car slightly forward. The collision broke my rear lamp and left a nasty dent in the boot lid. I was really worried about the damage, as this is a newer model and parts can be expensive. The other driver apologized immediately, but it is still a huge hassle to deal with the repair shop and the insurance claim process.

I was momentarily distracted by my phone and didn't realize the Audi in front had stopped for the red light. I tried to brake, but I hit the rear of their vehicle, causing damage to their lamp and a dent in the boot. I take full responsibility for the accident.

I was pulling out of a parking space very slowly, maybe 5 km/h, and I failed to notice a bollard that was slightly obscured by the evening shadows. I heard a loud crunch as I backed into it. The glass on my rear light assembly is completely shattered. It is quite annoying to have done this myself, especially because I consider myself a very cautious driver. I am just hoping the repairs are straightforward and that I can get the car back on the road by the end of the week.

I was travelling home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was moving at maybe 10 km/h when the car in front of me suddenly braked hard. I tried to react quickly, but I just couldn't stop in time on the damp asphalt. My front bumper hit their rear bumper. I feel terrible about it, man. I got out immediately to check, and I noticed a noticeable dent on my hood from the impact. I am so worried about the repair costs, honestly.

I was stopped at the red light near the roundabout. Without any warning, the driver behind me failed to stop and ran into the back of my car. I exited the vehicle to exchange insurance details immediately. It was clearly a momentary lapse in attention due to the heavy evening congestion.

I was trying to parallel park near the riverfront in the late morning. I miscalculated the distance while turning the wheel and grazed the side of the parked car next to me. It was honestly a stupid mistake on my part, I was distracted by a phone notification. There is a long, visible scratch running across my rear passenger door. I feel quite embarrassed about the whole incident, but I want to make sure everything is handled correctly through my insurance. I apologize for the inconvenience caused to the owner of the other vehicle.

I was driving down Rua Augusta around 2 PM today. Another driver attempted to merge into my lane without checking their blind spot properly. I swerved to avoid a direct collision, but the side of our vehicles made contact. It happened so fast, and I was quite shaken up. Now there is a dent and a deep scratch on my driver-side door. I’ve lived in this city for forty years and I have never seen such reckless driving on this street, it's just getting busier every single year.

I moved into the left lane to prepare for my turn, but I misjudged the position of the car beside me. We made contact while I was changing lanes. I accept that I did not see the insured driver in time.

It was raining this morning, and the roundabout was very slippery. I was exiting when a van cut across my path. I tried to brake, but I hit the curb and then bumped into the side of the van. The impact broke my front lamp and there is a nasty crack on the bumper cover. I am so stressed out because this is my only car for work. Do you think the repair will take long? I just want to get back to my normal routine as soon as possible, you know?

I was pulling out of a parking spot near the shopping center. It was very crowded, and as I turned the wheel to exit, I missed seeing the car passing by in the narrow lane. We hit each other at a very low speed. My front bumper now has a dent and a visible scratch from the metal trim of the other vehicle. I feel terrible about it; I really thought the path was clear, but clearly, I was wrong. I've already exchanged contact details with the oncoming driver.

I was walking on the sidewalk nearby when I heard the collision. The Fiat 500 was moving slowly out of the parking spot, and the driver of the other vehicle didn't have enough time to stop. It was clearly an unfortunate accident due to the poor visibility in that spot.

I was driving slowly because of the tourists everywhere. The car ahead stopped abruptly for a pedestrian, and I couldn't stop my vehicle in time on the cobblestones. My front lamp is broken, and there is glass shatter all over the pavement from the headlight unit. It was a very quiet afternoon, and the loud noise of the glass breaking really startled me. I feel quite shaken by the whole experience. I am currently waiting for the tow truck to arrive, as I am worried about driving it further.

While driving on the main avenue, the vehicle in the adjacent lane drifted into mine. I had nowhere to go because of the concrete median on my left, so our side mirrors and doors scraped against each other. It resulted in a long scratch along my passenger side now. I maintained a steady speed of 40 km/h, but the other driver was clearly not paying attention to the lane markings. It's frustrating because I had just washed the car this morning, and now this happens.

I was checking my navigation system and drifted slightly to the right without realizing it. By the time I corrected, the side of my car had already grazed the Hyundai. I am fully responsible for this lane departure error.

The traffic heading towards Cascais was stop-and-go. I was distracted for a split second by the beautiful sea view, and when I looked back, the car in front had stopped. I slammed on the brakes, but I still made contact with their rear. My front lamp is broken and I noticed a significant dent in the bumper. I feel really foolish for looking away; I know better than to lose focus like that. It's a lesson learned the hard way for sure.

I was navigating the roundabout, following the flow of traffic. Another car entered the circle too fast and hit the side of my rear bumper. The impact caused a dent and a long scratch on the rear panel. I've been driving in Lisbon for years, and this intersection is always a bit of a nightmare during rush hour. I am just glad no one was hurt, honestly. The car is still drivable, but the damage is definitely visible and needs professional attention.

I was waiting at the pedestrian crossing nearby. The Audi was clearly already in the roundabout when the other vehicle entered without yielding. The collision was inevitable at that speed. I saw the whole thing happen while I was waiting for the green light.

I was attempting to maneuver into a very tight space on this narrow street. The road is quite uneven with the stones, and I misjudged the angle as I reversed. I ended up scraping the side of a parked delivery van. There is a noticeable scratch on my rear bumper. My hands were shaking a bit because I was running late to pick up my grandson from school, and I suppose I was rushing. I feel quite bad about hitting the van, as it was just parked there minding its own business.

I was travelling home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was moving at maybe 10 km/h when the car in front of me suddenly hit their brakes hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to react, but I didn't have enough distance, so I tapped the rear bumper of the car ahead. It was just a low-speed impact, but now I noticed a visible dent on my hood. I feel terrible about it, honestly, it was just one of those bad moments.

It was raining heavily near the airport, and the roundabout was quite slippery this morning. I was in the outer lane, and I think the other driver miscalculated their exit. They veered into my lane while trying to take the third exit, and their side panel scraped against my door. I tried to brake, but there was nowhere to go. I have a long, deep scratch running across the passenger door now. I am really stressed about the repair costs, I really hope this is handled quickly.

The visibility was poor due to the rain. I was exiting the roundabout and realized I was in the wrong lane, so I drifted over. I didn't see the Peugeot until it was too late. I accept that I was the one who shifted lanes improperly.

I was attempting to parallel park outside the shopping area on Rua de Santa Catarina. The space was quite tight, and I thought I had judged the distance correctly, but as I was backing in, I misjudged the angle. I heard a loud crunch against the parked car behind me. I stopped immediately. I am so embarrassed, man, this is my first accident and I'm really worried about the insurance hike. There is a nasty dent and a long scratch on the corner of my rear bumper now.

I was heading down the avenue at roughly 40 km/h, looking for my hotel. I signaled to change into the right lane, and I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. As I moved over, there was contact between my rear quarter panel and their front bumper. My side lamp is broken and you can see a deep scratch near the wheel arch. It happened so fast, I didn't even see them coming up beside me until the impact occurred.

I was maintaining my speed in the right lane, and the driver of the Seat suddenly moved into my space. There wasn't enough time for me to avoid the collision. It caused damage to my front bumper and their side light.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: I was entering the intersection at the roundabout when the lights changed. I think I might have been a bit distracted checking my GPS for the exact turn, and I didn't notice the van entering from the cross-street. It happened to be a low-speed impact, but the point of contact was right on my side window, causing the glass to shatter completely. I am honestly shaken up by the whole experience. I feel like such an idiot for not paying full attention to the traffic light change.

I was standing on the corner waiting to cross. The BMW clearly entered the intersection when the signal was turning yellow, and the delivery van was already moving. They collided in the center of the junction, causing the side glass of the car to break.

My wife and I were driving toward Cascais for the weekend, it happened to be a beautiful sunny day. We were cruising along the coastal road when the traffic ahead of us suddenly stopped. It was quite a shock, really. I hit the brakes, but the road was a bit dusty, and I just couldn't stop in time to avoid the car in front. The situation involved a gentle nudge, but the metal is clearly indented now. I have been driving for forty years and I feel awful about this simple mistake.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving in the center lane and there was a heavy truck in the left lane. It happened to be a very busy morning with lots of commuters. As the road started to curve, the truck seemed to drift slightly toward me. I moved to the right to avoid it, but I clipped the median barrier. It resulted in a long scratch and a dent along the side of my car. I’m quite frustrated because I was trying to avoid a bigger collision with the truck itself.

I was navigating through the narrow streets near the university area. I was going very slowly, maybe 15 km/h, but the road is quite narrow and cobbled. I turned the wheel too early while exiting a tight corner and the corner of my car hit a concrete post. My rear signal lamp is broken now. It is such a silly, minor thing, but it’s still annoying to deal with the insurance paperwork. I should have been much more careful in these old, narrow streets.

Traffic on the bridge was backed up, as it usually is during rush hour. I was at a complete standstill when I felt a sudden impact from behind. The car behind me didn't stop in time and pushed into me. It wasn't a huge hit, but it caused a dent in my trunk and the brake lamp is broken. I am really worried about the cost of these parts. I was perfectly stationary, so I don't see how this could be my fault.

I looked down for a second to change the radio station and failed to notice that the traffic had stopped abruptly on the bridge. By the time I looked up and applied the brakes, I hit the Audi. I am fully responsible.

I was heading to the city center and I thought I had checked my blind spot before merging into the lane. I suppose I missed the motorbike coming up. I heard a scrape against my side panel and pulled over immediately. You can see a noticeable scratch along the passenger door. I am so incredibly worried, man, I really hope the rider is okay. It’s a huge relief that they didn't fall off their bike, but I feel really guilty about my lack of awareness.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM when the traffic suddenly stopped. I made an effort to brake, but the road was damp from the earlier drizzle and I just couldn't stop in time. I bumped into the back of the car in front of me at maybe 10 km/h. It was such a silly mistake, I feel terrible about it. My front bumper has a visible dent and some paint scratch damage now, you know? I really just want to get this sorted out as soon as possible, man.

I was stopped at the red light near the roundabout when I suddenly felt a jolt from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the driver had slid into my rear bumper. We both pulled over immediately to exchange our insurance details. It happened to be a minor impact, but there is definitely a dent on my rear fender.

I was trying to parallel park on Rua da Prata this morning, which is always a nightmare with the narrow streets and the cobblestones. I thought I had enough clearance, but I must have misjudged the distance while turning the wheel. I heard a scraping sound against the side of the parked van next to me. I stopped immediately and checked the damage. You can see a long scratch on the side door panel of my Fiat. I'm so worried about the repair costs, this is honestly the first time I have ever hit another vehicle.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: It was really chaotic at the Marquês de Pombal roundabout. I was in the middle lane attempting to exit toward the avenue, and another car came up quickly from the right side, not giving me enough space. I did my best to swerve, but we made contact side-to-side. It happened so fast, and the noise was quite loud. My passenger door has a noticeable dent and a deep scratch running across it. I am truly shaken up by the whole experience and just hope the insurance process goes smoothly for everyone involved today.

I was navigating the roundabout when the Peugeot in the middle lane suddenly drifted toward my vehicle. I tried to steer away, but the space was limited. We ended up rubbing sides. It was quite a stressful moment during the rush hour traffic. My side panel now has a clear scratch and a small dent.

I was turning left at the intersection on Avenida Luísa Todi. I thought I had a clear window because the light was yellow, but the other driver entered the intersection faster than I anticipated. We hit each other at a very low speed, probably 15 km/h. My front right indicator lamp is broken, which is quite annoying because I need the car for work tomorrow. I am just really stressed about the paperwork and whether this will increase my monthly premiums, you know? It's been a very long day for me.

Back in my day, people were much more careful in parking lots! I was doing my weekly grocery shopping at the center here in Funchal. When I returned to my Citroën, I noticed a fresh scratch along the rear quarter panel. I suspect someone scraped it while reversing out of the adjacent spot. It is very disheartening to find your vehicle damaged like that when you weren't even present. I am reporting it so I can get it polished out by a professional, as I take great pride in keeping my car clean and tidy.

I was walking to my own car nearby when I saw a delivery truck trying to exit the spot next to this Citroën. The driver of the truck misjudged the turn and I heard the sound of metal scraping. The truck driver didn't stop, but I saw the scratch left on the Citroën.

I was driving slowly on Rua de Santa Catarina, looking for a place to turn around. Suddenly, a cyclist swerved in front of me, and I had to brake really hard. The car behind me didn't react quickly enough and tapped my rear bumper. It wasn't a heavy impact, but it caused a crack in the plastic trim. I am not really sure how to handle this since it's my first accident, but the second vehicle was very polite and we agreed to document everything properly for our respective insurance companies.

I was heading home after a long meeting in the city center. While driving on Avenida da República, I moved to change lanes into the left lane. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the other vehicle was in my blind spot. I heard a crunch as we made contact. It was completely my fault for not checking twice, and I feel quite bad about it. It left a noticeable dent on my passenger door and some paint scratch marks. I have contacted my broker to start the formal claim process immediately.

I was driving steadily in the left lane when the driver in the adjacent lane began merging into my space. I honked, but there was no time to avoid the collision. We hit at the side. My vehicle sustained a dent and a scratch on the driver's side panel.

The traffic on Avenida de Roma was incredibly heavy due to the construction work nearby. I was distracted for a split second by the GPS, and when I looked up, the car ahead of me had stopped for a pedestrian. I pressed the brakes, but I still made contact with their bumper. The rear lamp of the other vehicle is broken, and it left a dent in their trunk. I am really anxious about the insurance consequences because I have been a careful driver for years. I just hope this can be repaired quickly.

I was maneuvering in a tight spot near the cafe on Rua Garrett. The street is quite narrow and there was a delivery van unloading. While I was trying to reverse, I clipped a concrete bollard that I hadn't seen in my parking sensors. It resulted in the glass shatter of my rear passenger window. It was just a stupid accident during a routine day, you know? I am feeling a bit stressed about how long it will take to replace the glass because I use the car every single day for my commute.

Driving along the coast on Avenida Marginal, the wind was very strong today, which made steering feel a bit different. I was overtaking a slower car, and as I pulled back into the lane, I misjudged the position of the other vehicle coming up from behind. We side-swiped each other. My front light lamp is broken, and there is a dent and scratch on the fender. I am quite shaken, but everyone is physically fine, which is the most important thing. I am now waiting for the tow truck to arrive.

I was traveling at about 50 km/h on the Marginal road when the Hyundai suddenly swerved back into my lane while overtaking. I didn't have enough room to maneuver to the shoulder. The contact caused a dent and a deep scratch on my rear door, and broke the tail lamp housing.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM. Traffic on Avenida da Boavista was quite heavy as usual. I was trailing a silver car at a low speed, probably around 20 km/h. Suddenly, the driver ahead braked hard to avoid a pedestrian near the crossing. I tried to press the brake pedal firmly, but I just couldn't stop in time. I bumped into the back of his bumper. It was really stressful and I am worried about the cost of the repair. My front bumper has a noticeable dent now.

I was navigating calmly when I saw a pedestrian step onto the road near the crossing. I applied my brakes immediately to avoid a collision. Unfortunately, the driver behind me was a bit too close and could not stop in time, hitting my rear bumper. We exchanged details on the side of the road.

The sun was quite low today, creating a glare as I drove along the coast on Avenida Marginal. I was navigating at 50 km/h, and for a split second, the brightness blinded me. When I looked back at the road, the car in front had stopped for a signal. I braked hard, but the road surface was damp from the sea mist. I hit the back of the car. It resulted in a deep dent on my hood.

I had stopped at the traffic light near the beach when I felt a sudden impact from behind. I checked my mirror just before it happened, but there was nothing I could do. The driver behind me apologized immediately, saying the sun glare had prevented him from seeing that I was stopped.

Navigating the Marquês de Pombal is always a bit tricky for me, even after all these years of driving. I was carefully entering the roundabout, but perhaps I was a bit too hesitant. The driver in the adjacent lane seemed to be in a rush and misjudged the gap. He veered into my lane and hit my side. My lamp is broken and I have a impact depression on the wheel arch. It has been quite a stressful morning for me.

I was exiting the roundabout and thought the oncoming driver was staying in their lane. I moved over to take my exit, but realized too late that our paths were crossing. I hit his side as I pulled ahead. I apologized to the other driver for the contact.

I was attempting to park in a tight space on Avenida da República to run a quick errand. I was relying on the sensors, but I think I didn't notice a low-hanging metal fence post near the curb. As I turned, the side of my car grazed against the post. I noticed a noticeable scratch running along the rear quarter panel. I am quite frustrated about it as I try to keep my car in perfect condition.

I was walking by when I saw the Tesla trying to park. The space was really tight, and the driver was trying to avoid the cars in front and back. I saw him graze the fence post near the curb. I heard a sharp scratching sound and saw the damage immediately.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM heading toward the city center. Traffic was quite heavy, stop-and-go as usual. I was keeping a safe distance, but the driver in front of me suddenly braked hard because a pedestrian stepped out. I hit my brakes immediately but didn't have enough space to stop completely. I tapped their rear bumper at very low speed, probably under 10 km/h. It was really a minor incident, but it left a visible dent on my hood where I hit their bumper. I feel terrible about it, honestly.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, trying to exit toward the Avenida da Liberdade. I was in the middle lane and checking my mirrors to move to the outer lane. I suppose I misjudged the distance to the car on my right side. As I started to veer over, I heard a scraping sound. We both stopped immediately in the exit lane. There is a long mark on the passenger side door of my car. I am so sorry, man, I was just really focused on the traffic flow and didn't see him there.

The insured driver was clearly trying to change lanes to exit the roundabout. They didn't see me in the outer lane as they began their maneuver. I tried to brake, but there was nowhere to go. Their side mirror brushed against my quarter panel, resulting in a scratch on their vehicle. It was an honest mistake in the chaos of Lisbon traffic.

I was parking my car on the side of the street near the old university district. It was getting dark and the street lighting in that area is quite poor. I miscalculated the turn while backing into the parking space and my rear corner clipped a parked car. I feel so embarrassed. The impact caused a noticeable dent and a deep scratch on my bumper. I immediately left a note on the other windshield since the owner wasn't around. I am very worried about the repair costs, to be perfectly honest.

I was driving along the Avenida 24 de Julho, heading toward Cais do Sodré. It was around 2:00 PM. I decided to change lanes to the left to avoid a bus that was slowing down. I checked my mirror, but somehow I missed seeing the car in my blind spot. I pulled over and heard the sound of plastic breaking. My indicator lamp is broken now. I am incredibly anxious about the insurance process because I really pride myself on being a safe driver, you know?

I was walking on the sidewalk near the tram stop. I saw the Seat Ibiza attempt a lane change without noticing the car already in that lane. The front of the Seat hit the other car's rear panel. It happened to be a low-speed impact, but it was enough to break the lamp on the Seat's side. Both drivers acted very calmly and pulled over to exchange details.

The situation involved a lovely, sunny morning on the Marginal road. I was on my way to visit my granddaughter, just driving at a steady pace. Suddenly, the traffic ahead slowed down very quickly, perhaps because of some road work further ahead. I did my best to brake, but I was a bit distracted by the beautiful view of the sea and didn't react fast enough. I ended up rear-ending the vehicle in front of me. The collision caused a dent on my front bumper and, unfortunately, some glass shatter from the other car's rear light cluster.

I was pulling out of a tight parking garage in the city center. I had to make a very sharp turn to exit onto the main road. The angle was tighter than I realized, and I scraped the side of my car against the concrete pillar of the entrance. It happened to be a pure misjudgment of the vehicle's turning radius in such a cramped space. The result is just a long, ugly scratch along the side panel. It is quite frustrating, but luckily no one else was involved in the incident.

I was trying to squeeze into a very small parking spot in downtown Lisbon. I thought I had just enough room, but I misjudged the distance between my bumper and the car behind me. I heard a slight noise as I backed in. When I checked, I noticed a superficial scratch on the bumper of the car behind me and one on my own. I feel really bad, man, I just didn't see how close I was. The traffic was loud and I was a bit rushed, I guess.

I was entering the roundabout from the inner lane and intending to take the third exit. As I was about to maneuver out, another car entered from the outer lane and cut across my path. I had to brake suddenly and we sideswiped. The impact was enough to leave a dent on my front wheel arch and a long scratch along the side. It was a very confusing situation with so many exits on that roundabout. I am just glad no one was hurt in the process.

The driver of the BMW was already in the roundabout. I was entering and miscalculated the exit timing. I moved too quickly into the path of the BMW. We collided as they were trying to exit. It resulted in a dent and scratch on their passenger side. I take full responsibility for the misjudgment of the distance.

I was traveling north on Avenida Almirante Reis during the evening rush hour. It was raining quite heavily, which made visibility really difficult. The car in front of me stopped abruptly for a pedestrian crossing. I slammed on my brakes, but the road was slippery and I slid forward, hitting the rear of their vehicle. The impact was sharp. My front indicator lamp is broken and there is evidence of glass shatter from the other car's taillight on the pavement. I am deeply concerned about the damage to both vehicles.

I was navigating the roundabout at the Boavista junction around 6:00 PM in heavy traffic. I was moving at maybe 20 km/h when the car to my right drifted into my lane without signaling. I slammed on the brakes, but we still made contact. You can see a noticeable dent on my front right fender and some deep scratch marks along the panel. I feel terrible about the whole situation, honestly, I am quite anxious because this is my first accident and I am really worried about the repair costs and my insurance premiums going up.
