It happened to be a busy afternoon and I was trying to parallel park near the main shopping street. I misjudged the distance between my car and the white van parked behind me. As I reversed slowly, probably at 3 km/h, I heard a sound and realized I had clipped the rear bumper. There is a long scratch on the paintwork of my back bumper. I am so embarrassed by this; I was just trying to get a quick errand done, you know, and now I have to deal with all this paperwork.

I was sitting in my van waiting for a delivery when I felt a small jolt from the back. I stepped out and saw the driver of the Peugeot looking quite worried. The bumper of her car had scraped against mine, resulting in a visible scratch. We exchanged details calmly.

I was on my way home from work along the avenue when the light turned yellow. The vehicle in the adjacent lane tried to merge suddenly to catch the exit. I couldn't move further left because of the concrete divider. The impact damaged my passenger side door with a large dent and my front side lamp is completely broken now. This whole experience is honestly super stressful, dude. I was just minding my own business and driving at a steady 40 km/h, but these things happen so fast in this city traffic.

I was navigating on the EN125 towards Faro when traffic suddenly slowed down ahead due to a tractor entering the road. I pressed the brakes firmly, but the driver behind me failed to stop in time. He hit my rear bumper. You can see a very obvious dent on the center of the bumper. My back hurts a bit, and I am quite shaken. I have been driving for years and never had a situation like this where the person simply didn't notice the traffic flow had halted.

I admit I was distracted for a split second by the GPS. When I looked up, the Toyota in front of me was already stopped. I tried to brake, but I still made contact. There is a clear dent on their rear bumper from my front grille.

I was turning into a narrow street near the city center. I did not realize there was a low stone pillar partially obscured by some street decor. I turned the wheel a bit too sharply and the back quarter glass shattered against the edge of the stone. I feel like such an idiot, I was going maybe 5 km/h, but it happened in a blink of an eye. I am just really stressed about the repair, as I need the car for my job tomorrow.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I heard a distinct sound of glass shattering. I turned around and saw the driver pulling away from a stone pillar at the corner. The rear side window of the car was completely broken. It was clearly a low-speed maneuver that went wrong.

Traffic was crawling toward the bridge. The car in front of me slammed on their brakes, and I managed to stop, but the driver behind me rear-ended me, pushing me into the vehicle in front. My rear bumper has a major dent and my tail lamp is broken. I've been driving since I was eighteen, and I've always been very careful, but this morning there was nothing I could do. The weather was damp and visibility was a bit poor, making everything much more difficult.

I was crossing the intersection when the lights turned yellow. A taxi coming from the cross street tried to speed through as well and hit my side door. It left a significant dent and a deep scratch across the metal. I am really anxious because I'm not sure who had the right of way, though I am fairly certain I entered the intersection before the light turned red. The driver of the taxi seems just as confused as I am about how it all happened so quickly.

I was heading down the cross street and saw the light changing. I thought I could clear the junction, but the other driver entered at the same time. We collided at low speed. I noticed a scratch and a dent on his door from my front bumper area.

I was leaving the parking lot after a nice Sunday brunch. As I was turning to exit, I cut the corner a bit too close to a concrete bollard. It scraped the side of my car and smashed the indicator lamp. I feel so embarrassed. I was just thinking about my kids in the back seat and didn't pay enough attention to the curb. It is a minor thing, but it is quite annoying to have to explain this to my insurance agent tomorrow morning.

I was navigating through the narrow cobblestone streets when I had to swerve slightly to avoid a pedestrian who stepped out unexpectedly. My side mirror clipped the edge of a shop display window frame. The side mirror housing glass shattered and there is a dent on the passenger door where the frame made contact. I am really worried about the shop owner being upset, though I have already apologized. It was a very unfortunate maneuver, but I had to avoid hitting that person at all costs.

I saw the whole thing from across the street. The driver tried to avoid a tourist who walked into the street without looking. The car hit the corner of a store frame. I saw the glass from the mirror shatter and a dent appeared on the side of the door. The driver was clearly trying to be careful.

I was navigating the roundabout at the Rotunda da Boavista, trying to exit toward Avenida de França, when the traffic suddenly stopped. I hit my brakes, but the road was damp from the morning drizzle and I slid forward, tapping the back of the car in front of me. I felt terrible immediately because I know I should have kept more distance. You can see a noticeable dent on my front bumper and some deep scratches near the grille. I am really worried about how much these repairs will cost and how long the car will be in the shop.

I was slowing down to exit the roundabout when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the Volkswagen had slid into me. The driver was very apologetic and visibly shaken. We pulled over just past the exit to exchange our insurance details. My rear bumper has some damage, but thankfully everyone is okay.

It was late in the afternoon and I was trying to parallel park near a cafe on Rua Augusta. The street is quite narrow and there were many tourists walking around, which made me really nervous. While I was turning the wheel to back into the space, I misjudged the distance to the parked car behind me and scraped against their side panel. I feel so stupid for being distracted by the crowd. It resulted in a long mark on the rear passenger door. I hope the other owner is understanding about this little mistake.

I was on my way home from my granddaughter's house near Avenida dos Aliados. I remember it was getting dark and the lights were reflecting off the wet cobblestones. I entered the intersection cautiously, but a vehicle coming from the side didn't stop in time. It was all a bit sudden, I must admit. My headlight is broken and there is a nasty crush on the front fender. I am just glad I wasn't going fast, otherwise, it could have been much worse for both of us, really.

I was waiting to cross at the pedestrian signal. The traffic light for the cross-street was already turning red, but the driver of the black sedan didn't seem to notice. The Toyota entered the intersection lawfully and was struck on the front side. The impact caused the headlight of the Toyota to shatter instantly. I stayed behind to ensure the elderly driver was alright until the police arrived.

I was driving along the EN125 heading toward the airport. Traffic was heavy and moving quite slowly. I saw a gap in the right lane and started to change lanes, but I didn't see the van in my blind spot. I heard a loud scraping noise immediately and pulled back into my lane. It left a long scratch running along the side of my driver-side door. I feel like such an idiot for not checking the mirror twice before moving. The situation involved a really simple error, but the damage is definitely annoying to look at.

Traffic on the bridge was backed up, as it often is during the morning commute. I was at a complete standstill when a car behind me failed to stop. The impact was quite strong; it pushed my car forward a meter. The rear glass is shattered into pieces and the bumper has a massive dent. I am incredibly anxious because this is my only car for work. I have never had an accident before, so I'm not really sure what documents I need to provide to the insurance agency right now.

I was looking down for a second to adjust the air conditioning and when I looked up, the traffic had stopped. I couldn't stop in time on the bridge deck. I hit the Fiat from behind. The impact definitely damaged the rear end of their car, including the window glass. I accept full responsibility for this incident. It was entirely my lapse in concentration while driving in the queue.

I was navigating down Avenida da Boavista when a cyclist suddenly swerved out from between parked cars. To avoid hitting them, I steered slightly to the left, which brought me too close to the car in the adjacent lane. Our side mirrors clipped each other, and the side of my vehicle rubbed against theirs. It resulted in a persistent scratch mark along the paintwork now. It was a split-second decision between the cyclist and the car, and I think I made the right choice, but it is a real headache dealing with the insurance paperwork.

It was a busy Saturday afternoon on Rua de Santa Catarina. I was trying to pull into a tight parking spot near the shopping area. My visibility was limited because of a large delivery truck parked nearby. As I was maneuvering, I miscalculated the angle and the front corner of my car hit a metal pole. There is a significant dent in the bumper. I am quite worried about the repair costs, as I am currently on a very strict student budget and this wasn't really a great day to begin with.

I was driving along the river toward the city center. The car in front of me signaled to turn right but then hesitated and stopped unexpectedly. I tried to swerve, but I caught the corner of their bumper with my headlight. The light assembly is broken. I am so stressed out by this because I've only owned this car for six months. I've been very careful, but these things just happen when you least expect them, don't they? I just want to get it fixed as quickly as possible.

I was looking for a parking spot near the waterfront and slowed down abruptly when I thought I saw an empty space. The driver behind me couldn't avoid the collision. It caused damage to their front light. It was clearly my fault for stopping so suddenly without checking the traffic flow behind me first. I apologized to the driver and we filled out the declaration form right there on the sidewalk.

I was driving along the coastal road in Cascais enjoying the sunset. It was a beautiful day, though the sun was shining right into my eyes. I was merging into the center lane when I failed to notice a car driving alongside me. I veered into their lane and we scraped sides. My paint is damaged with a long scratch. I have been driving for over 40 years, and I must say it is quite embarrassing to have such a minor lapse, but the sun really was blindingly bright at that specific moment.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was proceeding through a green light at the intersection when a taxi suddenly crossed my path from the left. I slammed on the brakes, but I still clipped their rear corner. My headlight is broken and you can see a dent on my wing. It happened so fast that I barely had time to react. I'm honestly just shaking right now because I've never been involved in a collision before. Everything seems fine with me, but I really need to get my car inspected by the insurance assessor soon.

I was standing at the corner waiting for the light to change. The Nissan clearly had the green signal to proceed. The taxi driver seemed to be in a rush and tried to beat the yellow light but didn't make it. The collision was inevitable at that point. I saw the headlight of the Nissan break upon impact and noticed a dent on their side panel. I gave my contact information to both drivers.

I was navigating the roundabout at the Boavista junction, moving at about 20 km/h, when I started to change lanes to exit towards Avenida da Boavista. I checked my mirrors, but I honestly didn't see the black sedan already positioned to my right. There was a loud scraping noise as our sides touched. I am so worried about the repair costs, I really should have been more careful with the blind spot. There is a visible dent on my rear door and a long scratch along the side panel.

I was holding my lane in the roundabout when the driver of the Polo moved into my path suddenly. I tried to brake, but we made contact. It was just a low-speed impact, but there is clearly a dent and a scratch on the side of their car now.

It was pouring rain in downtown Lisbon today, and the visibility on Rua do Ouro was quite poor. I was trying to reverse into a tight parallel parking spot near the Santa Justa Lift. I thought I had enough clearance, but I misjudged the angle and my bumper grazed the pole on the sidewalk. I felt a slight jolt and stopped immediately. I am quite embarrassed because I usually pride myself on my parking skills, but the rain really made it difficult to see the curb properly. I noticed a deep scratch on the rear bumper.

I was driving home from my shift at the port, just cruising along Avenida Luísa Todi. Traffic was quite heavy for a Tuesday afternoon. The car in front of me slammed on their brakes because a pedestrian stepped into the road, and despite my best efforts, I couldn't stop in time. I bumped into their rear bumper at about 15 km/h. My front left lamp is broken now and you can see a noticeable impact depression on the hood. I feel terrible about the accident; I just wasn't fast enough to react to their sudden stop.

I had to stop abruptly to avoid a person walking across the street. The car behind me hit my rear end. My vehicle only has minor damage, but the other driver's lamp is broken and it left a dent on their Peugeot.

I was on my way along the coastal road in Funchal when a delivery van coming from the opposite direction seemed to veer slightly over the center line. It happened so fast. My driver-side door took the brunt of the contact as we passed each other. My car has a long scratch and a dent now. I was quite shaken up, man, because it happened to be a narrow road and there wasn't much space to pull over or dodge the van. It's really stressful dealing with this insurance paperwork on top of everything else.
I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the delivery van drift. The Seat Ibiza driver tried to move, but they still swiped each other. I saw a dent and a scrape along the side of the Seat.

I was looking for a spot to drop off my grandchildren near the shopping district. It was very crowded, lots of people everywhere. As I was turning into a side street, I misjudged the distance between my car and a concrete bollard. I heard a thud and realized I had hit it. My rear quarter panel has a nasty dent now. My grandchildren were a bit startled, poor things, but thankfully no one was hurt. It was just a simple driving error on my part while navigating these tight Porto streets.

I was driving back from the office along Avenida 24 de Julho. A taxi in front of me stopped suddenly to let a passenger out in an area where they shouldn't have been stopping. I braked hard, but my car slid on the damp pavement, hitting the back of the taxi. My front lamp is broken and I noticed a significant dent on the bonnet. It happened to be a very stressful afternoon. I am currently working with the second vehicle to provide all the necessary insurance details for the report.

Man, this has been such a bad day. I was cruising down the avenue and this dude in a delivery truck just drifted into my lane without looking. I made an effort to honk, but he didn't hear me, and he scraped the whole side of my car. There's a long scratch running from the front fender to the back door. I’m really worried about what the garage is going to charge to fix this. Do you think the insurance will cover the full repair cost? I really need my car for work.

I was trying to navigate the lane change, but I completely missed seeing the Toyota in my blind spot. I hit them while shifting over. I noticed a scratch on their side panel. I am happy to cooperate with the insurance claim.

Back in my day, people paid much more attention at these small intersections. I was travelling slowly, perhaps 20 km/h, near Rua de Cedofeita when a younger driver exited a side street way too quickly. They hit my front quarter panel, which caused a dent and shattered my side-view mirror glass. It was quite a shock, really. I had my groceries in the back and just wanted to get home for lunch. It is a shame about the car, it was in such pristine condition before this happened today.
I was sitting at the cafe terrace when I saw the Nissan hit. The other car didn't stop at the yield sign. I noticed a dent and shattered mirror glass on the Nissan.

I was driving home after work on the Avenida da Boavista when the traffic suddenly stopped. It was raining quite heavily, and the roads were very slick. I tried to brake, but I just could not stop in time and ended up hitting the bumper of the car in front of me at low speed. It was such a stupid mistake on my part, man. I feel terrible about it, and I am really worried about how much this is going to cost to fix the dent on my hood.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música when another driver attempted to merge into my lane without checking their blind spot. I tried to swerve to avoid them, but they made contact with my headlight. The traffic was incredibly dense, and I think they simply didn't see me while changing lanes. My front lamp is broken now. It was all very stressful, and I just hope the repair process is straightforward because I rely on this car every single day.

I apologize, but I did not check my side mirror properly before moving into the outer lane of the roundabout. I am very sorry for the confusion caused. I definitely hit the other driver's lamp in the process, which is my mistake. I am happy to cooperate with the insurance details.

I was driving along Avenida 24 de Julho heading towards Cais do Sodré. The car in the adjacent lane drifted into my lane while trying to avoid a delivery truck. I had no room to move over because of the parked cars, so we side-swiped. There is a deep dent and a nasty scratch along my rear door now. You know, I was just trying to get to my meeting on time, and this really ruined my whole morning, man.

I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for the tram when I saw the two cars collide. The driver in the right lane definitely drifted into the other car's path. It happened quite fast, resulting in a visible dent and mark on the BMW. Neither driver seemed to be speeding at the time.

I was passing through the intersection at Avenida da República when the traffic light turned yellow. I slowed down, but the car behind me didn't notice and bumped into my rear. The impact was strong enough to shatter my rear glass and break one of the brake lamps. I have been driving for thirty years, and I must say that the traffic in this city has become quite unpredictable lately. It was quite a shock, really, and my back is a bit stiff now.

I parked my car on Rua de Cedofeita this afternoon to run some errands. When I returned about an hour later, I noticed a long scratch along the driver's side door. It seems like someone must have hit my car while trying to pull out of the space ahead of mine. I checked the area, and there was no note left, but I did manage to talk to a local shop owner who confirmed a car had brushed against mine earlier.

I own the small shop nearby and I witnessed a silver sedan scraping the Mini parked on the street. They didn't stop to check the damage, they just drove off immediately. It left a visible scratch on the side of the car. I saw the whole thing from my front window.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was moving from the middle lane to the right lane on Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo. I signaled, but the individual driving the other car was accelerating in my blind spot. We made contact, which caused my side lamp to break and left a dent on my front quarter panel. I am extremely frustrated with myself because I thought I had checked everywhere, but clearly, I missed him. I am trying to follow the correct procedures for the insurance report.

I was heading in the right lane when the Audi started moving over. I didn't have time to brake before we made contact. It caused damage to his lamp and a dent on his car, while my own bumper was also affected. It was a simple accident caused by poor timing.

It was pouring rain on Rua da Prata today. I was at a complete stop at the stop line, waiting for pedestrians to cross. A van behind me hydroplaned or just didn't brake in time and hit the rear of my car. I have a dent and some scratches on the trunk lid now. I was quite shaken up because the impact was sudden. My husband told me to make sure I document everything properly for the claim, so here I am.

The road was very slippery due to the rain. When the driver ahead stopped for the pedestrians, I pressed the brakes but the van slid forward. I hit the back of the Ford Focus, leaving a dent and a scratch. I take full responsibility for the accident.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was quite heavy as usual. I was trailing a silver sedan when they suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I did my best to react, but I couldn't stop in time. My front bumper hit their rear, leaving a noticeable dent and several deep scratches. I feel terrible about it, honestly, it was just a lapse in concentration during the rush hour. I am really worried about the repair costs, but I have my insurance details ready.

I was stopped at the zebra crossing to let a group of tourists pass. Suddenly, I felt a solid impact from behind. I checked my rearview mirror just before the hit, so I knew there was no time for the driver behind me to stop. The rear bumper of my car has a clear dent and some paint scratches from the collision.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música, attempting to take the second exit. It was raining lightly and the road surface was quite slippery. I was maintaining a slow speed, maybe 20 km/h, but I misjudged the distance to the car on my right as I merged into the outer lane. We scraped against each other, causing a long horizontal scratch along my passenger side door. I was so nervous and confused in the moment, I just hope everything gets sorted out quickly by the insurance agency.

I was trying to park my car in a very tight spot near the river. I thought I had enough clearance, but as I was reversing, I accidentally clipped the bumper of the car already parked next to me. The situation involved a stupid mistake, and I feel embarrassed about it. It left a small impact depression on the corner of the other vehicle's rear fender. I left a note with my details immediately, as I want to handle this professionally and ensure the damage is repaired correctly.

I was heading down Avenida dos Aliados when the vehicle to my left suddenly decided to change lanes without signaling properly. I tried to swerve, but it was too late to avoid the contact. Our sides collided at low speed. The impact resulted in a nasty scratch across my rear quarter panel and my side indicator lamp is completely broken now. The other driver stopped immediately, and we both agreed to fill out the European Accident Report form right there on the sidewalk.

I didn't see the other car in my blind spot when I initiated the lane change. I moved over slightly, and then I heard the grinding sound of metal. We both pulled over to the side of the road. I can see the broken lamp housing on their car and several long scratches.

It was a busy afternoon near the bridge approach. I was following a van when traffic came to an absolute standstill. I slammed on the brakes but unfortunately slid on the wet pavement, hitting the van's rear. The impact caused a significant dent in their tailgate and the glass shatter of their rear tail light. I am really shaken up by the whole experience. I've never been in an accident before and the sound of the glass breaking was really distressing to me.

Back in my day, people were more careful, but today, I was just coming back from the pharmacy. I was turning into a narrow street when a delivery scooter cut the corner too sharply. I had to brake suddenly and nudged the curb, but then a taxi coming from the other direction grazed my front bumper. It caused a dent and a scratch on the side. I am quite upset as I always try to drive very slowly in these old city centers.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus when I saw the Fiat turn into the street. The taxi driver was definitely going a bit too fast for the narrow road. The cars grazed each other quite visibly. The Fiat definitely sustained a dent and some scratches from that contact.

I was driving along the coastal road in Cascais, enjoying the afternoon sun. I went to overtake a slower vehicle, and as I was pulling back into the lane, I didn't see the car in my side mirror that was accelerating. We ended up with a light scratch along the doors. It was entirely my fault for not checking the mirror a second time. I've already spoken to the other driver, and they were very understanding about the whole situation. It's a shame about the paint.

I was approaching the intersection near the university. The light turned amber, and I made a split-second decision to go through, but another car was already crossing from the perpendicular street. We collided at a very low speed. My front left corner hit their side, which broke my indicator lamp and left a dent on their door. I know I shouldn't have risked the amber light. I feel terrible for the inconvenience caused to the oncoming driver who was just trying to get to their destination.

I had the green light and was proceeding through the intersection when the Ford tried to beat the red light. They clipped my side. It's frustrating because I had to be somewhere important. I can clearly see a dent in my side panel and the broken plastic from their lamp on the ground.

I was driving through the city center of Braga. It was quite busy with students everywhere. I was looking at my GPS to find the correct parking garage and didn't notice that the traffic ahead had come to a halt. I bumped into the car in front. The impact was enough to cause a crack in their plastic bumper cover and a dent in my hood. I am really stressed out by this. I was being careful, but clearly not careful enough. I've already provided my insurance documentation.

I was trying to park in the historic center near the temple. The streets are extremely narrow here. I miscalculated the angle while reversing into the space and caught the pillar of a nearby building with my rear bumper, then slid into the car parked next to me. It caused a long scratch and a dent on the neighboring car's side panel. I am so upset with myself; I should have asked my passenger to guide me. I want to make sure the owner gets their car fixed properly.

I saw the whole thing from the cafe terrace across the street. The driver was trying to squeeze into a space that was clearly too small. They hit the stone wall first and then scraped against the parked car. I noticed a visible dent and a long scratch on the rear of that parked vehicle.

I was travelling home from work around 6:00 PM and traffic was quite heavy near the intersection. I was doing about 20 km/h when the car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I did my best to stop, but I just couldn't manage to pull up in time and tapped their bumper. It was a complete mistake on my part, I just got distracted for a second. You can see a visible dent on my hood and a long scratch along the plastic trim, so I am very worried about the repair costs.

It was raining quite heavily this morning near the airport and the roads were slick. I was navigating the roundabout when another vehicle entered from the inner lane and swung wide, clipping my front corner. Honestly, man, I'm just so stressed about this whole insurance situation because I need my car for university. My front passenger-side lamp is broken and there is a deep scratch right over the wheel arch. I feel like it wasn't my fault, but the whole thing is just a massive headache for me right now.

The rain made visibility very poor at the roundabout. I did not realize the individual driving the other car was in my blind spot as I moved to exit. I apologize for the contact; it was a simple error of judgment due to the weather conditions. My vehicle also sustained some minor contact, but I have already assessed the lamp and the scrape along the bumper.

I was attempting to park in a tight spot near the university area and I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar next to the bay. I was moving very slowly, probably under 5 km/h, but I still made contact with the rear quarter panel. It is just a minor dent, but it looks quite ugly. I have been driving for years and I am embarrassed, but I want to make sure I report it correctly so my insurance covers the repair properly. It was completely my own error.

I was on my way down the EN125 and reached an intersection. The light was yellow and I thought I could clear it, but a car coming from the side street miscalculated and hit my front corner. The impact was loud, and suddenly my headlamp was broken and there was glass shattered everywhere on the asphalt. I was so shaken up, you know? I didn't know what to do, my hands were shaking. I just hope this is a quick process because I need to get back to work for my shift.

I was waiting at the pedestrian crossing when the collision occurred. The driver of the Ford attempted to cross the junction as the lights were changing, and the individual driving the other car failed to stop in time, striking the front of the vehicle. I witnessed the lamp break and the glass shatter upon impact. Both drivers were clearly stressed but remained calm throughout the exchange of information.

I was pulling away from the curb after buying some bread at the local bakery. I didn't see the cyclist who was riding past, and as I turned the wheel, I scraped his bike frame with my front bumper. It left a noticeable scratch on the plastic, though thankfully the paint didn't peel much. I stopped immediately to ensure he was okay; he was fine, just a bit annoyed. I feel terrible about it because I should have looked over my shoulder one more time before pulling out into the narrow street.

It was early, about 8:30 AM, and the bridge was packed with commuters. Everyone was impatient. I was keeping to my lane when a van beside me started to drift over, trying to get ahead in the queue. He caught the rear quarter of my car, causing a nasty dent and a long, jagged scratch along the panel. I did my best to honk to alert him, but he didn't stop until we got to the other side of the bridge. It is just such a shame for my car to be damaged like this in morning traffic.

I was distracted for a moment adjusting my radio. When I looked back at the road, I had drifted slightly into the next lane. I heard the scrape and immediately realized I had hit the car next to me. I pulled over as soon as it was safe on the bridge. I caused a dent and a scratch on the side of the other vehicle. I accept full responsibility for the incident as it was my error.

I was heading to pick up my granddaughter from school today, the sun was quite low in the sky, which made it difficult to see the brake lights of the car ahead clearly. They stopped for a cyclist, and I tapped the back of their vehicle. My front lamp is broken, which is very unfortunate as I just had it serviced. I am an older driver and I find the modern traffic around here a bit overwhelming at times, especially with the sun glare. I apologize for the incident and wish to settle the claim quickly.

So, I was trying to back out of a parking spot in the city center. It was super crowded and I was trying to be careful, but I didn't see the metal bollard behind me until I heard the scrape. It just left a scratch on the back bumper. Man, I feel so stupid. I should have asked my friend to guide me out because the visibility in that spot is terrible. Anyway, I just wanted to report it immediately so I don't have issues later when I try to get it fixed.

I was sitting at the outdoor cafe right next to where the incident happened. The driver was reversing slowly but did not see the bollard behind the vehicle. The car made contact, resulting in a scratch on the rear bumper. The driver was very visibly upset with themselves but remained at the scene to inspect the damage. It was clearly a genuine mistake made in a very tight parking area.

I was approaching the junction at a moderate speed. The other vehicle didn't yield at the stop sign, and our sides collided in the middle of the intersection. My side window glass shattered from the impact and there is a deep dent on the driver's door. It happened so fast I didn't even have time to react. I am just really concerned about the glass and the door repair, as I have an important business trip next week. It's just bad luck, but I'm glad that neither of us was seriously injured in the crash.

I was travelling home from work around 6:30 PM, moving slowly in the heavy traffic on Avenida da Boavista. Suddenly, the car in front stopped abruptly for a pedestrian, and I couldn't react in time despite pressing the brakes hard. My front bumper hit their rear bumper. I am really stressed because this is my only car for work, and I hope the insurance covers it. It was just a small lapse in concentration, and I feel terrible about the dent and the scratch on my bumper.

I was circulating in the outer lane of the Rotunda do Relógio trying to exit towards the airport. I was signaling properly, but perhaps the driver in the inner lane didn't see me as they were also moving to exit. We made side-to-side contact at a very low speed, maybe 10 km/h. It’s just a visible scratch along the side panel. I’m quite anxious about this whole process since I’ve never had an accident before, you know? Man, this is really not the start of the week I wanted.

I was in the second lane of the roundabout and intended to exit as well. The insured driver seemed to be in my blind spot as I began to move out of the circle. We bumped sides gently. It was an honest mistake by both parties, and there is just a minor scratch on the passenger door.

I was on my way northbound on Avenida dos Aliados. There was a delivery van in the right lane that suddenly moved into my path without signaling. I swerved slightly to avoid a full collision, but my front passenger door clipped the rear of the van. It resulted in a deep scratch and a small dent in the metal panel. I’m quite shaken up by the maneuver, but I managed to stop safely. I’ve been very careful on the roads, so this unexpected lane change caught me completely off guard.

I was walking on the sidewalk near the corner. I saw the BMW driving in the left lane when the delivery van made a sudden, sharp turn to the left without using an indicator. The BMW tried to brake and steer away, but they still made contact. It was definitely a surprise for everyone involved.

I was heading home after visiting my daughter in the afternoon. The sun was quite low, and it was shining directly into my eyes as I approached the intersection. I didn't see the light change in time, and I ended up bumping into the car waiting ahead of me at low speed. The impact shattered the rear light glass of their car and broke one of my front lamps. I feel just terrible about it, as I always try to be a very responsible and cautious driver.

I was stopped at the red light on Estrada Monumental. I felt a sudden impact from behind. When I got out, I saw that my rear light glass had shattered from the hit. The other driver was very apologetic and admitted they didn't see me because of the bright sunlight.

I was navigating the narrow streets of Porto. A courier motorcycle came around the corner very fast, and I had to brake hard and nudge to the side. I ended up brushing against a metal street pole. It resulted in a dent on my front fender. Man, this street is so tight, and you know how it is with these delivery riders appearing out of nowhere. I am worried about the repair costs, so I wanted to report this officially as soon as I got home.

I was driving along the riverside road. The traffic was stop-and-go. The driver ahead of me hit their brakes suddenly for no apparent reason, and I couldn't stop in time. My front right lamp is broken and it left a scratch on the bumper. It’s quite frustrating because I was maintaining a safe distance, but the suddenness of their stop made it impossible to avoid. I am reporting this now so we can sort out the insurance documentation efficiently and get the vehicle fixed.

I braked because I saw a plastic bag blow across the road and thought it was an animal. The driver behind me tapped my bumper. My car only has a small scratch, but the other car definitely suffered a broken lamp during the impact.

It was late afternoon on a busy day. I was inside the roundabout and a white vehicle entered from the right without checking, forcing me to turn the wheel quickly. I side-swiped the curb, which caused a dent and a large scratch on my front passenger side door and fender area. I’m really anxious about the insurance premium, but I didn't have another choice to avoid a bigger accident with the other vehicle. The process is a bit overwhelming for me right now, to be honest.

I was attempting to parallel park on Rua do Ouro. I miscalculated the swing of my rear bumper and tapped the car behind me. It wasn't a hard hit, but enough to cause a scratch and a small dent on their bumper. I feel terrible about it. I waited for the owner to return so we could exchange details properly. It was purely my error in spatial judgment during the parking maneuver. I hope this can be resolved smoothly through the standard insurance claim procedure.

I returned to my car to find the other driver waiting for me. They explained they had accidentally scratched and dented my bumper while parking. They were very polite and honest about the mistake. We agreed to exchange insurance information right there on the street.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving home from my weekly errands, it was about 4 PM. I was changing lanes to prepare for a turn. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. We made contact at about 30 km/h. It resulted in a scratch on my door and the glass of the side mirror shattered completely. I have been driving for thirty years and it is quite embarrassing, but these things happen when you are tired. I just want to handle this legally and correctly.

I was driving slowly towards the traffic lights near the Serralves Museum when the car ahead stopped quite suddenly. I attempted to brake, but I didn't have enough time given the distance, and I ended up hitting his rear bumper at a very low speed. I feel terrible about it, honestly. My car has a visible dent on the hood now, right near the grill. I'm just so worried about how much the repairs will cost, as I really didn't mean for this to happen. It was just a lapse in my concentration.

I was attempting to park in a tight spot near the Praça do Comércio. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I miscalculated the turn and scraped the side of a parked vehicle. It was really frustrating because I was just trying to get to my lunch appointment on time. There is a clear scratch on my passenger door now, and I have already apologized to the owner who arrived shortly after. I am fully prepared to handle the insurance paperwork to cover the damage I caused to their car.

I returned to my car after running a few errands to find this person had scratched my driver-side panel while parking. They were very polite and admitted fault immediately, which was appreciated. It is just a minor surface scratch, but it is annoying to deal with the repair logistics.

I was navigating the roundabout at the Casa da Música, trying to exit towards the north. The traffic was quite heavy this afternoon. I attempted to switch lanes to make my exit, and I just didn't see the other car in my blind spot. There was a sudden bump, and we both pulled over immediately. My car has a noticeable dent and a scratch on the rear quarter panel. I am quite shaken up by the whole experience, as I have been driving for years without any incidents.

It was raining quite heavily while I was driving along the river. I put my signal on to change lanes, but the car in the next lane accelerated, and we made contact. My indicator lamp is broken now as a result of the collision. It was such a busy stretch of road, and I think the poor visibility made it very difficult to judge the speed of the other vehicle. I am just hoping the insurance process goes smoothly as I rely on my car for my daily commute to work.

I was maintaining my speed in the middle lane when the BMW tried to cut in front of me. I had nowhere to go due to the traffic. Their wing mirror hit my car, and I saw their lamp glass shatter onto the road. It happened to be a stressful situation.

I was driving along the coastal road heading towards Cascais when a cyclist suddenly swerved out from the shoulder, forcing me to veer slightly into the lane to my left. In doing so, I side-swiped a passing delivery van. It was a split-second decision and unfortunately, it led to this accident. You can see a long scratch and a shallow dent along the side of my car. I feel terrible about the whole situation, as everything happened so fast and I am still trying to process what exactly occurred.

I was walking my dog on the promenade and saw the whole thing. The Mercedes driver clearly tried to avoid the cyclist who entered the road unexpectedly. It was an unfortunate reaction, but the swipe against the delivery van was definitely caused by that sudden swerve.

I was coming home from my granddaughter's birthday party in Almada. I honestly thought I had the green arrow at the traffic light, but as I moved through the intersection, another vehicle appeared from the side. There was a loud impact, and the glass from my passenger side window shattered everywhere. I am physically fine, thank goodness, but I am very upset about the state of the car. It was such a nice day, and this accident really put a damper on the evening. My memory is a bit blurry on the exact timing, but it happened so fast.

I was looking for a parking space on this busy avenue. I was navigating at maybe 10 km/h, looking at the street signs, and I failed to notice that the traffic had come to a complete standstill. I bumped into the car in front of me. It's embarrassing, really. The impact broke my front lamp and caused a dent on the bumper. I'm just so stressed about dealing with this, you know? I consider myself a careful driver, but this was just a total brain fade on my part today.

I was waiting in the queue of traffic on Aliados. A taxi driver behind me didn't notice I had stopped and lightly nudged my bumper. It wasn't a major hit, but it left a deep scratch across the rear panel. We both got out to inspect the damage and exchanged insurance details right there on the street. He was very apologetic about the distraction. I just need to get the estimate for the repair so I can move on with my week, as I have a very busy work schedule.

I was distracted for a moment checking my GPS for the next pickup. By the time I looked up, the Toyota had stopped. I tapped their bumper. I accept full responsibility for the scratch on their vehicle. I have already contacted my fleet manager to initiate the insurance claim process.

I was backing out of my residential parking spot this morning in a bit of a rush to get the kids to school. I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar next to the exit. It happened so quickly, and I heard the sound of the metal scraping. My bumper now has a nasty dent and a significant scratch. I feel like such an idiot for not checking my rearview camera more carefully. This will be a real hassle to sort out before our trip this weekend. I am quite anxious about the repair timeline.

I was travelling through a green light near the port area when another driver didn't stop at their red light. They clipped the front of my car, causing my headlight to shatter and the lamp to break into pieces. It was quite a shock, and the sound of the glass shattering was very loud. I am just thankful that nobody was injured. It has been a very long day, and I am not looking forward to the garage repairs. I am just a bit shaken up by the whole ordeal, man.

I misjudged the light cycle at the intersection. I am deeply sorry for the accident. I hit the Audi on the side. I saw their headlamp break and glass go everywhere. I have admitted my fault to the driver and am ready to cooperate with the insurance company.

I was heading down Avenida da Boavista during the morning rush hour. Traffic was really heavy, and everyone was stop-and-go. Suddenly, the car in front of me slammed on the brakes because of a turning vehicle. I tried to stop, but the road was a bit slick from the morning mist. I couldn't stop in time and tapped the back of the car ahead of me. It was honestly such a stressful moment, man. I got out immediately to check, and it resulted in a visible dent on my front bumper. I feel terrible about it, really.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio near the airport, attempting to exit towards the second lane. It was quite chaotic with taxis moving everywhere. I misjudged the distance of the vehicle in the inner lane as I was pulling out. There was a slight graze between our side panels. I pulled over to the side immediately to exchange details. I am a professional driver and I take full responsibility for this incident. There is a noticeable scratch running along the rear passenger door of my vehicle.

I was proceeding correctly around the roundabout when the Volkswagen merged into my path without checking his blind spot. I attempted to veer slightly to the right, but we made contact. It was just a minor scrape on the paintwork of my side door. I was quite shaken, but we managed to pull over safely to clear the roundabout traffic.

It was getting dark and I was trying to parallel park near the Rua de Santa Catarina. The space looked big enough, but I miscalculated the angle of the curb and the proximity of the parked car behind me. I backed up just a bit too far and hit the front bumper of the car parked behind. I feel so embarrassed about it. I checked the damage and it left a dent and a deep scrape along the rear corner of my bumper. I have already contacted the owner to apologize.

I was driving along the Avenida 24 de Julho heading toward Cais do Sodré. The traffic was flowing at about 40 km/h. I signaled to change lanes to my left because I needed to turn soon. I suppose I didn't check my mirror thoroughly enough because a motorcycle was coming up fast. We made contact, and it caused his handlebar to hit my rear light assembly. The glass on the lamp is broken now. I am just really worried about the motorcyclist, though he seems fine, just shocked.

I was riding in the left lane when the car just moved over without looking. I attempted to honk, but he didn't hear me over the city noise. I clipped his rear light, breaking the plastic cover. I didn't fall off, but it was a close call. The driver was very cooperative and stopped right away to check on me.

I was driving home along the Marginal near Cascais with the beautiful ocean view on my left, thinking about my grandson's birthday. The traffic ahead slowed down quite suddenly because of a tourist crossing the street. I pressed the brake, but I think I was a bit distracted by the sunset, and my foot didn't engage firmly enough. I bumped into the car in front. The force was enough to shatter the glass on the rear light and leave a dent in my hood. I am quite distraught as this has never happened in my years of driving.

I entered the intersection at Praça Marquês de Pombal on the green light, or at least I thought it was green. The car coming from the perpendicular road moved forward too early. We collided at a low speed. It was really chaotic with all the tourists and pedestrians around. You can see a long scratch along my driver-side door where we made contact. I am just so anxious about how this will affect my insurance premiums, you know? It happened so fast I can barely remember the exact timing of the traffic signal.

I was walking near the metro station entrance and saw the incident. The Ford driver entered the intersection just as the light was turning yellow. The other vehicle didn't wait for the clear signal and pulled out. They hit each other's side panels. It wasn't high speed, but they definitely scratched each other's paint quite badly. It was just an unfortunate mistake by both parties.

It was raining quite hard on Rua da Constituição this afternoon. The streets were slippery and visibility was poor. I was slowing down behind a van that had stopped to make a delivery. Because of the slippery surface, my tires lost grip when I braked. I slid gently into the rear of the van. The impact wasn't heavy, but my front bumper pushed against their frame, and I noticed a crack in my headlight plastic. It's really frustrating, but at least nobody was injured in the incident.

I was driving northbound on the Avenida da República in the middle lane. I needed to move to the right lane to prepare for a turn. I signaled and checked my mirrors, but there was a blind spot issue with the SUV next to me. As I began to merge, we made contact. It caused a dent and some deep scratches on my front fender. It was a very brief moment of confusion. I am strictly following the formal reporting procedure as per your requirements for this type of collision.

I was driving in the right lane when the Mercedes attempted to merge. I didn't see his signal in time to adjust my speed. We made contact, resulting in a dent on my door and some paint damage on his fender. It was clearly a mutual misunderstanding of lane positioning in the heavy traffic flow.

I was trying to maneuver into a very tight parking space on Rua do Ouro. I know this street is notoriously narrow, but I thought I had enough clearance. I miscalculated the turn and grazed the metal bollard on the edge of the sidewalk. There is a long scratch on the side panel of the car now. It's just a silly mistake on my part, but I wanted to report it honestly so I can get it repaired through the policy. I was feeling a bit rushed because of the traffic behind me.

location: Alameda das Linhas de Torres, Lisbon

statements.text: I was approaching the roundabout on Alameda das Linhas de Torres. I looked to my right, but I failed to notice the small car already in the roundabout. I accelerated to enter and hit the side of his vehicle. I am quite panicked about the cost of the repair. My front bumper has a large dent and the signal lamp is broken. I have been driving for over forty years, and I really do not know how I missed seeing him there. I am terribly sorry for the disruption I caused.

I was already inside the roundabout when the Citroën entered without stopping. He struck the side of my car. My door has a significant dent, and the trim is damaged. It was a stressful experience, but the second vehicle was very apologetic and admitted his mistake immediately after the collision occurred.

I was driving around the roundabout at the Boavista square during the morning rush. The traffic was crawling, maybe 15 km/h. Suddenly, the driver ahead stopped abruptly because someone cut in front of them. I braked as hard as I could, but my car still rolled forward and tapped their bumper. It was an honest mistake and I feel terrible about it. My front bumper has a visible dent now from the impact. I am just really stressed about the insurance process, you know? I hope it is not too much trouble to fix.

I was trying to parallel park near a café on Rua de Santa Catarina around 3:00 PM. I misjudged the distance between my rear quarter panel and the car behind me. I was moving very slowly, just a few km/h, when I felt a light graze against the other car. There is a visible scratch on my paintwork now. It was completely my fault, I was a bit distracted by my phone navigation. I have already exchanged contact details with the other driver and everything is documented properly.

I was sitting in my car finishing an email when I felt a nudge from behind. The other driver apologized immediately. She had been trying to park and just didn't see how close she was to my rear bumper. There is a small scratch on my bumper trim. We were both calm and agreed to exchange information for the insurance report.

It was pouring rain on Avenida 24 de Julho. I was in the middle lane, moving at about 30 km/h, and I signaled to change to the left lane. I checked my mirror, but I suppose the visibility was poor due to the weather. I didn't see the van in my blind spot. We made contact, and now it resulted in a noticeable dent and a long scratch down the side of my passenger door. I am quite shaken up by the whole situation, as I really didn't intend to cut anyone off.

I was driving down the avenue when the Peugeot suddenly swerved into my lane without checking properly. Given the heavy rain, I did my best to brake, but we still sideswiped each other. My side panel is scratched and dented as well. It was clearly just an unfortunate accident caused by the terrible weather conditions this afternoon.

I was driving over the bridge in slow-moving traffic. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard. I tried to keep a safe distance, but I was distracted for a split second by the GPS. My front left lamp is broken from the impact with their rear bumper. I'm really anxious about the cost of the repair. I've lived here for forty years and have never had an accident like this before, so I'm feeling quite flustered. I have the insurance documents ready for review.

I was approaching the intersection when the traffic light turned yellow. I decided to stop, but the road was quite slippery. The driver behind me didn't react in time and slid into the rear of my car. The impact was strong enough that my rear window glass shattered upon collision. It was very loud and scary. I am just a student, and I am very worried about how this will affect my insurance premiums. I have never dealt with something like this before.

I was following the Citroën closely and when the light turned, she braked quite suddenly. I stepped on my brakes, but the road was slick from the rain. I couldn't stop in time. My front bumper made contact with her rear, causing her glass to shatter. I feel terrible, but it was just a genuine case of not being able to stop on wet pavement.

I was reversing out of a parking spot near the downtown area, moving at maybe 5 km/h. I thought the path was clear, but I didn't notice the post right behind me. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had backed into it. There is a deep mark on the rear bumper. I am quite embarrassed by this, it was a lapse in my concentration. I should have checked my sensors more carefully. I'm reporting this to get it repaired quickly as the car is fairly new.

I was sitting on the terrace of a nearby restaurant and saw the whole thing. The driver was backing up slowly and simply didn't see the bollard behind the car. It was just a minor accident, no one else was hurt, and the driver seemed very upset and apologetic about the damage caused to their own vehicle.

I was driving down the avenue during the lunch hour. Another driver was attempting a U-turn and did not notice me in the right lane. We sideswiped each other as they pulled out. There is a long scratch along the side of my driver-side door. The other driver stopped immediately, and we agreed that it was just a misunderstanding of the road signals. I'm documenting this to ensure both our cars are repaired correctly, as the situation involved a confusing intersection.

I was turning, and I admit I misjudged the speed of the approaching traffic. It was a hectic moment with a lot of cars. I sideswiped the Renault as I was moving into the lane. I have a scratch on my side panel. I am fully taking responsibility for the incident. It was not intentional, just a bad judgment call.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout when a vehicle coming from the second exit merged too early. I was already in the outer lane, and they just clipped my rear fender, leaving a noticeable dent. I have been driving for over forty years, and this is the first time I have been involved in such an incident. It was quite a shock, to be honest. The other driver was very cooperative, and we settled the paperwork right there on the side of the road.

I miscalculated the gap while exiting the roundabout. The Kia was closer than I initially realized. I felt the contact and stopped immediately to inspect the damage. I caused a dent to their rear side. It was clearly my fault, and I apologize for the inconvenience this caused the driver.

I was pulling into a parking space near the stadium. I was going very slowly, but I didn't see the concrete pillar because of the shadows. I hit it with my front left corner. My lamp is broken and I noticed a deep scratch on the bumper. It’s super frustrating because I am always so careful, you know? Being a young driver, this really stresses me out. I just want to get this fixed through my insurance as quickly as possible without any further hassle.

I was driving home from work, just moving at about 20 km/h in slow traffic, when the car in front of me suddenly stopped for a pedestrian. I hit the brakes, but I didn't have enough distance to stop completely and tapped their rear bumper. I feel terrible about it, honestly. My bumper has a significant dent now, and I am quite worried about how this is going to affect my insurance premiums moving forward. I hope they are okay, man, this whole situation is just really stressful for me right now.

I was proceeding normally when the traffic ahead signaled to stop. I came to a full halt, and moments later, I felt a heavy impact from behind. It was quite sudden. When I stepped out, I saw that the driver behind had impacted my rear bumper, causing a noticeable dent. We exchanged details calmly.

I was trying to park in a tight space near the square this morning. I miscalculated the angle while reversing and accidentally scraped the side of the parked car next to me. I feel so clumsy; I have been driving for years and never had an incident like this. There is a long, visible scratch along my rear door panel where I made contact. I stayed by the vehicle until the owner arrived so we could sort out the insurance papers properly. It was an honest mistake and I feel bad.

I was navigating the roundabout, moving to the second exit, when another vehicle merged unexpectedly from the inner lane. I tried to steer away, but their front fender hit my side, causing a scratch and shattering my indicator lamp. The oncoming driver seemed just as surprised as I was. It all happened in a split second at about 30 km/h. I am really anxious about the repair costs, as the lamp assembly is quite expensive, and I am not entirely sure how the liability will be shared here.

I was in the roundabout and thought the lane was clear to move over, but I failed to check my blind spot thoroughly enough. I made contact with the BMW as I shifted lanes. It was definitely my fault. I caused a scratch on their side and broke their indicator light. I apologized immediately to the driver.

It was raining, and visibility was quite poor around the city center. I was maintaining a steady speed of 40 km/h in the right lane when a van pulled out from a side street without looking. I swerved slightly to avoid a direct hit, but the van still clipped my front quarter panel. There is a deep dent and a scratch where the metal was pushed in. I have been driving in Porto for forty years, and the rain today made everything so much worse, you know how the cobblestones get.

I was walking to the nearby cafe when I saw the Toyota driving at a normal speed. The van just pulled out abruptly from the side street, giving the Toyota driver no room. I watched as the van scraped the side of the car, leaving a dent and a scratch. The Toyota driver was clearly doing his best to avoid the collision.

I was approaching the intersection with the green light. I think the other driver might have misjudged the timing of the yellow signal. As I crossed, they entered the junction and struck my front bumper, which broke my headlamp. It all happened so fast, man, I was just heading to the grocery store, you know? Now I have this broken lamp and I am worried about whether the car is safe to drive until the shop opens on Monday. It is just super frustrating and I am really stressed about the paperwork.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was transitioning lanes to get ready for the upcoming turn. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I failed to notice the car in the lane to my right. As I started to move, I felt a slight resistance and heard a scraping noise. I immediately pulled over to assess the damage. It resulted in a significant scratch on my passenger door. I am a very careful driver usually, so this is quite embarrassing for me. I have already contacted my insurance agent to see how we handle this according to Portuguese law.

I was driving in the right lane when the Mercedes ahead started merging into me. I honked, but it was too late to avoid the contact. We both pulled over safely. My vehicle has some minor paint transfer, and the Mercedes has a long scratch on its door. We exchanged phone numbers and details.

I was navigating the underground parking facility here at the venue. It was quite busy and the lighting was dim. While attempting a three-point turn, I missed seeing the concrete pillar behind me and reversed into it at a very low speed. My rear bumper sustained a visible dent. It is a bit disappointing as I take very good care of this car. My grandson was in the car with me, and he was quite startled by the noise, but thankfully no one was hurt in the minor impact.

I was stopped in traffic on this very busy street. The traffic was bumper-to-bumper, moving at maybe 5 km/h. Suddenly, the van behind me didn't stop in time and rear-ended me. The impact was quite jarring, and it shattered my rear glass window. It was so unexpected, man, I was just sitting there waiting for the traffic to clear. I am really worried about the shards of glass everywhere, it is a huge mess. I have to get this cleaned up and the window replaced as soon as possible.

I was driving behind the Ford when I looked down for a second to adjust my GPS. By the time I looked up, the traffic had stopped and I couldn't stop in time. I hit the rear of the Ford. My front bumper is slightly bent, and their back window glass shattered from the impact. I feel terrible.

I was proceeding through the intersection when another car failed to respect the stop sign. It happened so quickly. They clipped my side, which caused my side lamp to break and left a noticeable crack in my side mirror housing. I was quite shaken up, but I managed to keep my cool and exchange details with the other driver. I am professional about these things, so I made sure we took photos of everything before moving our vehicles. It is unfortunate, but accidents do happen in city traffic.

I was waiting to cross the street when I saw the whole thing. The black car didn't stop at the intersection sign and hit the side of the Audi. I saw the lamp break and the mirror housing crack. The Audi driver was very composed, and I offered my contact information as I saw exactly who was responsible.

I was on my way along the main road near the river when another vehicle attempted to overtake me on a very narrow stretch. They didn't leave enough space and side-swiped my rear quarter panel. It caused a deep dent and a crack in the plastic trim. I have been doing this commute for fifteen years and never had such a situation. The driver stopped, and we discussed the incident. I have all the documentation ready. I just want to get the vehicle repaired properly so I can get back to my normal routine.

I was travelling home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy, as usual. I was moving at maybe 20 km/h when the car in front of me suddenly hit their brakes because a pedestrian stepped out unexpectedly. I tried my best to stop in time, but my foot slipped on the pedal, and I gently bumped into their rear bumper. I feel terrible about it because I was distracted for a split second, and now I noticed a noticeable dent on my hood from the impact. I hope the oncoming driver is okay.

I was stopped completely because of the traffic light turning red at the intersection. Suddenly, I felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me tapped my bumper, causing a small dent on my rear trim. They seemed very apologetic and shaken up by the whole situation.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio, trying to take the third exit towards the airport. I honestly thought the lane next to me was clear, but as I started to merge, I heard a horrible scraping sound. It turns out I misjudged the distance of the vehicle in the outer lane. I stopped immediately to check, and there is a deep scratch along my passenger side door. It happened to be a stupid mistake on my part, and I'm really stressed about the insurance paperwork, honestly, dude, this is my first accident and I'm just so worried.

I was trying to parallel park on the side of Rua Augusta this afternoon. The spot was quite tight, and while I was reversing, I turned the wheel a bit too early. I scraped the parked car next to me. I feel so embarrassed about it. There is a small dent on the rear panel of my car and a noticeable scratch near the wheel arch. I have left my contact details on their windshield and called my insurance company right away to report the damage correctly.

I was sitting at the cafe terrace nearby. I saw the Toyota trying to park and they just miscalculated the angle, hitting the stationary vehicle beside them. It was a very low-speed impact, just enough to leave a mark and a dent on both cars.

I was traveling along the EN125 near Faro at about 70 km/h. It was a bright day, but I was blinded by the sun for a second as I was checking my mirror to change lanes. I moved into the lane before the car coming up behind me had fully passed. We clipped each other near the taillights. My rear lamp is broken and completely shattered on the housing. I am just relieved nobody was hurt, but I'm worried about the repair costs because my car is fairly new.

I was heading through the intersection at Avenida da República when another driver entered from the side street, seemingly failing to notice the stop sign. It happened so fast. There was a loud crunch and I felt the impact on my side. Now there is a massive dent on my door and the window glass shattered completely. I'm shaking a little bit from the shock, and I have to get my glasses fixed too because they fell off during the sudden stop.

I honestly thought I had the right of way as I pulled out. The situation involved a moment of complete confusion and I failed to see the car coming from my left. I accept full responsibility for the collision. The impact caused damage to their door and broke their side window.

My wife and I were driving down the Avenida 24 de Julho heading towards the waterfront for lunch. It was a beautiful, clear day. The driver in the adjacent lane suddenly swerved to avoid a delivery truck that had stopped illegally. In the process, they swiped the entire length of my passenger side. It left a very deep scratch along the doors. We managed to pull over safely afterward, but the traffic was absolute chaos. I’m just glad we didn't end up swerving into the tram tracks, that would have been a disaster.

I was navigating the narrow streets in Cedofeita when I had to reverse to let a bus pass. In my rush to move out of the way, I missed seeing the concrete post behind me. I backed right into it at low speed. It caused a significant dent on the trunk lid and one of my rear lamps is completely broken. It was a foolish mistake caused by the pressure of the narrow road and the bus driver honking. I just want to get this fixed so I can drive normally again.

I was commuting along the Eixo Norte-Sul during peak hour, traveling at about 40 km/h. Everything was stop-and-go. The vehicle in front of me braked very hard for a debris item on the road, and despite my best efforts, I bumped their bumper. It was definitely my fault for not keeping enough distance. There is a visible dent on my front bumper. I feel terrible for the oncoming driver, as they were just minding their own business in the middle lane.

I had to brake abruptly because someone had dropped a box on the highway. The driver behind me couldn't stop in time and hit me. It was a minor bump, just a dent on my bumper, but it was quite a shock during the morning rush.

I was entering the roundabout on Avenida da Liberdade. I was looking for my exit, and in the confusion, I didn't realize the car in the inner lane was also turning. We both tried to exit at the same time, and our mirrors and side panels clipped. You can see a long scratch down my door and my indicator lamp is broken. I feel quite stressed about this because I've been driving for years without a single accident, and now this happens.

I was walking on the sidewalk nearby and saw the two cars try to occupy the same space while exiting the roundabout. It was a slow-speed collision, but the impact was enough to break the light on the BMW and leave a long mark on the side.

I was finishing up my grocery shopping on Rua dos Combatentes. I was reversing out of my parking space, and I was so focused on the children running nearby that I failed to check my blind spot properly. I backed into a stationary van parked behind me. It left a clear dent on my rear bumper. I immediately checked to see if anyone was in the van, but it was empty, so I contacted the local police to report the incident and get the owner's information.

I was navigating down Avenida da Boavista around 5 PM during the peak traffic hour. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because a taxi pulled out into our lane without signaling. I slammed on my brakes, but the road was slightly damp, and I couldn't stop in time, making contact with his bumper. It was just a small bump, honestly, but I feel terrible about it. I have a dent on my front hood now, and I really hope this isn't going to be too expensive to fix, man. I'm just so stressed out by all this paperwork.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio trying to exit towards the airport. A blue van was in the outer lane and simply didn't see me as I was attempting to pull ahead to my exit. The driver swerved slightly and clipped the passenger side of my car. I stopped immediately, and luckily we were going very slow, maybe 15 km/h. There is just a long scratch along the passenger door panel. I am quite worried about how this affects my premium, as I really try to be a careful driver on these busy roundabouts.

I was in the outer lane of the roundabout and honestly didn't check my mirror correctly before pulling toward the exit lane. The driver of the Seat was right there in my blind spot. I heard a small scrape as our panels touched. It was completely my fault for not being more vigilant in such heavy traffic.

I was trying to park in a very tight spot near the square. I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar on my left while reversing. I wasn't going fast, maybe 5 km/h, but I heard a crunch and realized I had hit the pillar. I have a nasty dent and a long scratch on the rear quarter panel. It's so frustrating because I'm usually very careful when parking in these old city centers. I am worried about the repair costs, as the damage looks quite deep on the metal frame.

I was driving slowly up the narrow Rua de Santa Catarina. A delivery truck was parked on the side, and as I tried to pass, another car came down the street heading towards me. I moved slightly to the right to give him space but miscalculated the distance to a nearby utility pole. My side mirror hit the pole, which caused the lamp to break and left a scratch along the side. It was just a stupid mistake on my part, and I feel quite foolish for not stopping to wait for the other car.

I was walking down the street and saw the whole thing. The Citroën driver was trying to be polite by moving over to let the oncoming car pass. Unfortunately, he misjudged the proximity to the post on the sidewalk and clipped it. It happened to be a very low-speed impact, but the lamp definitely shattered immediately.

I was crossing the intersection at Avenida da República after the light turned green. A cyclist suddenly swerved across the intersection from my right, likely to catch the sidewalk. I braked instinctively, but he clipped the side of my front door. The impact was enough that it caused the passenger side window to shatter completely into pieces. It was a terrifying moment, and I hope the cyclist is okay. My car is full of glass now, and I just don't know how to handle this clean-up properly.

I was heading home on the EN125 when traffic just stopped dead. It happened to be a sunny afternoon, but there was a lot of glare coming off the road. I pressed the brakes, but I think I was a bit slow to react because of the sun in my eyes. I tapped the back of a van ahead of me. It left a clear dent on my hood and my right headlight lamp is broken. I've already exchanged insurance details with the individual driving the other car. Honestly, I'm just shaken up more than anything else.

Traffic was stop-and-go as usual on the 125. The lady behind me just didn't stop in time. She hit my rear bumper. My vehicle didn't suffer much, but she clearly had some damage to her front end, including a broken light and a dented bonnet.

Well, my grandson told me to be careful, but I suppose these modern cars are just too wide for these narrow streets. I was coming back from the market near the center and tried to make a turn. I suppose I hugged the corner a bit too close and grazed the stone wall of the building. It left a rather long scratch on my driver's side door. I feel quite embarrassed by the whole thing, honestly. I've been driving for forty years and never had a scratch like this happen before.

I was driving along the Avenida 24 de Julho in the middle lane. I checked my mirror and signaled to move into the left lane. I thought the lane was clear, but as I started to merge, a car in that lane accelerated. We made contact side-to-side. You can see a visible impact depression on the rear panel and a deep scratch where the paint was rubbed off. It’s annoying because it’s a new car, but it was just a blind spot issue and I take full responsibility for the merger.

I was cruising in the left lane when the Nissan started moving into my space. I honked, but he kept coming over. We sideswiped at about 30 km/h. His rear bumper caught my side panel. It was a simple accident, nothing too dramatic, but we both have some cosmetic damage on the sides.

It was raining quite hard, and the streets were slick. I was waiting at the junction to turn right, and as I moved forward, a scooter skidded on the wet pavement. I panicked and steered sharply left, hitting a parked delivery bike and a post. My headlight lamp is broken and there is a significant damage to the front fender. I am just a student, you know, and I'm really worried about what the insurance company will say. I was driving under the speed limit, I swear, but the road was just treacherous.

I had just finished a client meeting and was pulling out of a parallel parking spot on Rua da Prata. I thought I had cleared the car parked behind me, but as I turned the wheel, I heard a terrible scraping sound. It turns out I didn't pull far enough forward before turning. I have a long scratch across my back bumper. It is quite annoying as I really pride myself on my driving, and I am already late for my next appointment. I will call the shop later today to get an estimate.

I was sitting at the cafe terrace right next to the parking spot. I saw the Mini trying to leave. The driver started turning the steering wheel way too early while pulling out, and I heard the plastic scratching against the other car's bumper. It was definitely just a minor parking error.

I was heading home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was moving slowly, maybe 15 km/h, when the car in front of me suddenly hit their brakes because a cyclist cut across. I reacted as fast as I could, but my foot slipped slightly on the pedal and I gently bumped into their rear bumper. There is a noticeable dent on my hood where the impact happened. I feel terrible about it, honestly, it was just such a distracted moment in the middle of a stressful commute.

I was trying to park in a very tight spot near the Baixa district. I thought I had enough clearance while turning the wheel to back into the space, but I miscalculated the distance to the concrete pillar. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had grazed the side of my passenger door against the wall. It’s definitely a long, visible scratch running along the paintwork. I am really upset with myself because I take such good care of this car, but the space was just poorly marked and really narrow.

I was navigating the roundabout, moving at about 20 km/h, intending to take the third exit. Another vehicle suddenly merged from the inner lane without checking their blind spot properly. I tried to steer away, but their back fender clipped my front corner. The impact caused my headlight to shatter and I noticed a deep scratch on the bumper. It happened so fast, like, I didn't even have time to honk, man. I’m just really stressed about the repair costs and how long the car will be in the workshop.

I was circling the roundabout and honestly, I thought I had enough space to move to the outer lane. I didn't see the Seat Leon in my blind spot. I hit their corner with my rear quarter panel. I stopped immediately to exchange details. It was a complete misjudgment on my part during a busy afternoon in Porto.

It was raining quite hard this morning. I was in the middle lane, and I checked my mirrors to change into the right lane to turn. I clearly missed the van coming up fast in that lane. As I moved over, the side of my car hit their front panel. We both pulled over safely. It left a significant dent and a long scratch on my driver-side door. I feel so bad; I usually check my mirrors twice, but the visibility with the rain was just really, really poor today.

I was stopping at the pedestrian crossing near the square. The driver behind me, a young man, wasn't paying attention and didn't stop in time. He tapped my rear bumper at a very low speed, but it was enough to cause my rear windshield glass to shatter completely. I was quite shaken because I had my groceries in the back.
