The situation involved a low-speed impact, but now I have a noticeable dent and a deep scratch on my front hood. I am honestly quite worried about the repair costs and how this will affect my insurance premium next year.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio, signaling my exit correctly when another vehicle suddenly tried to cut across from the inner lane. It happened so fast that I didn't have time to react or brake properly. Their rear fender clipped my front left corner. My indicator lamp is completely broken and there is a long scratch running along the side panel. I am just really shaken up by the whole experience, dude. I really hope the repair process isn't going to be a massive headache for me.

I misjudged the gap while attempting to exit the roundabout. I did not see the other car in my blind spot as I was moving to the outer lane. I take full responsibility for the contact. My vehicle hit their side, breaking their lamp and leaving a scratch on their paintwork. I have already exchanged insurance details with the other driver.

I had gone out to do some grocery shopping in the city center. I found a tight parking spot near Rua Augusta and was trying to reverse carefully. Unfortunately, I miscalculated the distance to the concrete pillar near the wall. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had grazed the rear side of my car. It is just a long, ugly scratch, but I feel really foolish for being so careless. It's been a long week and I suppose I was just a bit distracted by my grocery list.

I was traveling along the N125 near Faro early this morning. The sunlight was quite intense, creating a glare that made it hard to see the lane markings clearly. I started to drift slightly to the right, and a vehicle passing me side-swiped my door. It caused a significant dent in the metal and a visible scratch across the paint. I stopped immediately to ensure the second vehicle was okay. It happened to be a mistake caused by the poor visibility, and I feel terrible that it resulted in damage to both our vehicles.

I was driving along the N125 when the driver in the other car began to merge into my lane. I attempted to honk, but they continued to move over, resulting in a side-swipe collision. My vehicle has damage to the passenger door, and I observed a dent and a scratch on the side of the Renault. We are both cooperating to resolve this through our respective insurance providers.

It was raining, so the cobblestones were slippery. As I approached the intersection at Rua de Santa Catarina, I applied the brakes, but the car slid forward slightly. I hit the back of a parked van that had stopped unexpectedly. The impact wasn't hard, but my headlight lamp is broken and there is glass shatter all over the road. I am really stressed because this is my only car for work and I rely on it every single day. I just didn't expect the roads to be this slick today.

I was walking near the intersection when I saw the Citroen attempt to stop. Given the heavy rain and the slick nature of the cobblestones, the vehicle simply could not stop in time. It slid directly into the rear of the delivery van. The impact resulted in the Citroen's lamp being broken and pieces of glass shattering onto the street. It was clearly an accident caused by the weather conditions.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was moving along Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, attempting to switch from the center lane to the right lane to prepare for a turn. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I missed the car that was in my blind spot. I steered right and felt a sudden jerk as we made contact. Upon inspection, there is a clear dent on my rear fender and a long scratch where our paints rubbed off. I am feeling quite anxious about this whole situation as I have never had an accident before.

I was pulling out of a driveway onto Rua do Ouro quite slowly. As I turned, I didn't notice the low bollard placed near the sidewalk edge. The front bumper made contact with the stone, and I felt a jolt. I looked down and saw a crack in the plastic casing of the bumper. Back in my day, we didn't have these sensors, and I suppose I have become too reliant on them instead of looking properly with my own eyes. It's a minor thing, but I want to get it fixed properly.

The traffic on Avenida Luísa Todi was stop-and-go. I was following the vehicle ahead, and when they suddenly decelerated, I failed to maintain enough of a gap to stop safely. My Audi hit the back of their vehicle. My front lamp is broken, and it resulted in a noticeable dent on the bumper. It was entirely my fault, and I feel horrible for the inconvenience I have caused the individual driving the other car. I am just trying to navigate the paperwork now to make sure everything is handled correctly for both of us.

I stopped my vehicle because a pedestrian was crossing the road. The driver behind me didn't stop in time and hit the rear of my car. I have assessed the damage to my vehicle, and I have observed a dent and a broken lamp on the Audi that hit me. We are currently filling out the accident declaration form.

I was driving through the city center near Avenida dos Aliados. There was a delivery truck parked partially in the lane, which forced me to swing wide to avoid it. As I did so, I got too close to a parked car on the side. I heard a scraping noise and realized I had sideswiped the bumper. There is a deep, visible scratch on my side panel. I am quite worried about how this repair will be handled since it is a relatively new car, and I hope the insurance process is straightforward.

I was navigating around the Rotunda da Boavista during the peak afternoon rush. Another driver entered the roundabout aggressively from the side, and I had to brake hard. I couldn't avoid the collision, and our fenders made contact as we both tried to exit. I have a damage to the passenger side and a long scratch along the door. It was quite chaotic with all the traffic, and I am just trying to make sure I have all the details correct for this claim. It's really stressful dealing with this during such a busy day.

I was entering the roundabout and thought I had enough clearance, but I miscalculated the speed of the approaching Mercedes. We clipped each other during the maneuver. There is a dent and a mark on the side of the Mercedes-Benz. I am ready to provide all necessary documentation to the insurance company so we can settle this matter.

I was driving home after work around 18:30. Traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy, just a sea of red brake lights. Suddenly, the car ahead stopped completely for a pedestrian. I hit my brakes, but I was just a second too slow and tapped their bumper. It was such a small impact, only about 10 km/h, but I can clearly see a dent on my front bumper now. I am honestly so stressed about this, I have never been in an accident before and I really hope the repair process isn't too complicated.

The traffic was at a standstill. I stopped smoothly for the crosswalk, and then I felt a thump from behind. It was not a violent hit, just enough to notice. When I checked my car, there was a visible dent in the rear bumper cover. The other driver was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the exchange.

I was navigating the roundabout at Praça de Espanha, trying to get into the exit lane for the A5. There was a delivery van next to me that seemed to drift into my lane without checking. I tried to steer away but felt a scrape along my passenger side. I managed to pull over immediately. I am so worried because this car is my only way to get to university, and now it left a long scratch running along the side panel. It was just a complete accident, honestly, everything happened so fast.

I was parking near the university area in Coimbra. It was raining quite hard and visibility was poor. I thought I had enough room to parallel park, but I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar near the curb. I heard a sickening crunch as I turned the wheel. It is really frustrating because I am always careful, but today was just one of those days. I noticed a deep scratch and a noticeable crush on the rear door now. I feel terrible about damaging the vehicle like this.

I was sitting at a cafe table nearby. I saw the silver Yaris trying to park in the rain. The driver was going slowly, but they cut the turn too close and scraped the side of the car against the structural pillar. I saw both the dent and the scratch as the driver stepped out to look.

I was on my way along the coast road, heading towards Belém. The morning sun was very bright, and it was quite blinding. As I moved to change lanes, I miscalculated the position of the car in the lane to my right. We ended up making contact, which caused my indicator lamp to get broken instantly. I feel absolutely awful about the mistake, man. It was totally my fault for not checking my blind spot thoroughly enough in that light. I have never had a claim before and I hope this doesn't affect my insurance premium too much.

While I was maneuvering out of a tight parking spot near the town hall, a plastic shopping cart that had been left in the middle of the road shifted in the wind. I could not spot it until it was too late. I was moving at maybe 5 km/h, but the corner of the cart hit my windshield. There is now a distinct crack on the lower passenger side. It is such a strange and unfortunate incident, but I am reporting it exactly as it happened so I can get the glass fixed properly.

I was walking by and saw the whole thing happen. The driver was pulling out carefully, but that stray cart hit the windshield just right. It didn't shatter the whole thing, but I saw a clear crack appear right there on the glass. The driver seemed very confused and upset by the situation.

My goodness, I was just heading out to pick up my grandchildren from school, like I do every Thursday. The traffic on Estrada Monumental was simply dreadful, stop and go for ages. I must have been distracted by the radio for a second, and when I looked up, the car in front had stopped dead. I pressed the brakes as hard as I could, but my car slid slightly on the damp tarmac and hit them. My front lamp is broken and there is a dent in the bumper. I am so shaken up.

I was at the red light when the Megane bumped into me. I felt the impact and immediately pulled over once we cleared the intersection. When I looked, I saw the front lamp of their car was broken and there was a dent on the bumper. The driver was very distressed.

I was travelling down the main avenue in Braga. I signaled my intention to move into the left lane to prepare for a turn. I checked my mirrors, but I believe the other vehicle was in my blind spot or speeding up as I moved over. There was a loud screech of metal and we both pulled over. I noticed a long, ugly scratch along my driver-side door. I feel quite worried about the repair costs, but I am relieved that nobody was injured. It was just a simple miscalculation, honestly.

I was going around the roundabout near the riverfront. A cyclist crossed unexpectedly, and I had to swerve hard to avoid hitting them. In my panic to avoid the cyclist, I clipped a concrete bollard on the side of the road. It was so loud, and unfortunately, the impact caused the glass shatter on my side-view mirror. I am incredibly anxious about this whole situation. I was only trying to be safe by avoiding the cyclist, but now I have this damage to deal with. I hope the insurance covers this type of incident.

I was dropping off a client in the city center. While waiting for them to get out, a courier on a bicycle brushed past my car. it slipped my attention him until I heard the contact. It was very low speed, but it left a dent and a visible scratch on the rear passenger door. It is quite disappointing because the car is fairly new, but these things happen in busy cities like Lisbon. I have the courier's details and we have filled out the declaration form correctly.

I was waiting to cross the street when I saw the bicycle hit the parked car. It didn't seem intentional; the cyclist was just trying to squeeze through a gap that was too small. The car sustained a dent and a scratch on the door. I saw the driver get out to inspect it.

I was driving along the Marginal enjoying the sea view, which I suppose was a lapse in concentration on my part. The driver in front stopped for a tourist who was crossing the road unexpectedly. I didn't brake in time and gently bumped the rear of their vehicle. My front indicator lamp is broken now. It is a bit embarrassing to admit, but I was definitely distracted by the scenery. I have spoken with the individual driving the other car, and we are both fine, which is the most important thing, I suppose.

I stopped for a pedestrian and felt a gentle bump from behind. There was no major damage, though the other driver's indicator lamp was clearly broken. We handled the insurance paperwork right there on the side of the road. The driver was very polite and admitted they had been distracted.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, just heading home after a long shift. Traffic was quite heavy, stop-and-go as usual. Suddenly, the van in front of me braked hard because a pedestrian stepped out. I pressed my brakes firmly, but I just couldn't stop in time on the damp asphalt. My front bumper hit their rear, and now I have a noticeable dent and some nasty scratches on the hood and bumper. I feel terrible about the whole situation, man, honestly. My insurance premium is probably going to shoot up now, which is just super stressful.

I was attempting to reverse into a very tight parking space near the square this morning. I thought I had enough clearance, but I was wrong. I misjudged the distance to the concrete bollard and scraped the side of my rear bumper. There is a long, visible scratch running along the passenger side panel now. I am so embarrassed; I have been driving for years and never had a silly mishap like this. I just wasn't paying enough attention to the sensor beeps, which is entirely on me.

I was driving along the avenue when the lane started to narrow. The driver in the adjacent lane decided to merge without looking. I did my best to sound my horn to alert them, but they swerved into my path anyway. Their side mirror caught my door panel, leaving a significant dent and a series of deep scratches in the paintwork. It was quite a scary moment for me, and I am still shaking a bit. I just hope the body shop can fix this quickly without needing to replace the whole door.

The traffic was dense and moving slowly. I was distracted by my GPS for a split second and steered slightly to the left to avoid a cyclist. I didn't realize there was another vehicle right next to me until I heard the screech of metal. I feel awful for causing the damage to the other person's door.

I was crossing the bridge heading toward Almada. The traffic had come to a sudden, complete standstill, which happens often there during peak hours. I braked in time, but the driver behind me was clearly not paying attention. They struck the rear of my Volvo quite hard. My rear bumper is severely dented, and the impact caused the glass in my rear tail light to shatter completely. I am just glad no one was injured, but it is such a hassle dealing with the paperwork and getting the car to the repair center.

I was driving two cars behind the incident. I saw the traffic stop abruptly. The driver in the Volvo stopped safely, but the small hatchback behind them didn't brake until the very last second. The situation involved a clear rear-end collision on the bridge. I pulled over to ensure everyone was okay before continuing my commute.

Well, my dear, it was such a bright and sunny morning, I was just heading out to pick up some fresh bread for breakfast. I was pulling out of a very narrow side street onto Rua de Santa Catarina. I didn't see the delivery van coming around the corner until it was right there. We bumped bumpers at a very low speed, but it was enough to break the plastic housing of my front headlamp. It is just such a nuisance, especially at my age, having to deal with these insurance forms.

I was maintaining a steady speed in the right lane of the avenue. A vehicle on my left suddenly changed lanes without adequate warning. I made an emergency maneuver to the right, but their rear wheel arch scraped against my side panel. It left a long scratch and a noticeable dent along the passenger side door. I am a very careful driver, and this is extremely frustrating. I have all the documentation ready and photos of both vehicles, as I want to handle this as efficiently and professionally as possible.

I apologize, I was trying to reach the turn-off and I simply did not see the vehicle in my blind spot when I initiated the lane change. It was a lapse in judgment on my part. I am happy to cooperate fully with the insurance process and provide my details to settle the claim for the damage.

The road was very busy with tourists. I was stopped at the red light near the shopping center. The car behind me started to roll forward while I was still stationary. They didn't realize I hadn't moved yet. They nudged into my bumper, resulting in a large dent in the plastic molding. I was really worried at first, but the individual driving the other car was very apologetic. We exchanged all the necessary insurance information right there on the side of the road. It's just a bit of a headache to get it fixed now.

I was navigating the cobblestone area near the plaza, trying to find a spot to unload some equipment. It was quite congested. A taxi driver was reversing out of a bay and didn't see me parked there. They hit the front of my car, which caused a crack in my bumper and completely broke the glass on my left fog lamp. I’m just really stressed about this because I use this car every single day for my work. I hope the repairs don't take too long, as I can't afford to be without a vehicle for a week.

I was reversing out of the taxi rank. The streets are very narrow and the glare from the sun made it difficult to see the small car behind me. I take full responsibility for the accident and the damage to the other car's lighting and bumper.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was heading north toward the airport. A truck was pulling out from a construction site and didn't seem to notice me in their side mirror. They moved into my lane while I was right alongside them. I had to swerve onto the shoulder to avoid a major collision. In the process, the side of my car was scraped against some barriers, and the truck's mudguard left a long, deep scratch along my passenger side. It was a really intense situation, and I am just glad that I managed to keep the car under control.

I was navigating home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was really heavy as usual. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing the road. I tried to press the brakes firmly, but I just couldn't stop in time. I ended up hitting his rear bumper at a very low speed. My front hood has a visible dent and some noticeable scratch marks now. I am quite worried about the repair costs, but I accept full responsibility for the accident.

I was stopped in the queue of traffic when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the Volkswagen Golf had hit my rear bumper. The driver came out immediately to apologize. My car sustained some surface scratches and a dent on the rear trunk area from the impact.

It was raining quite heavily this morning near the airport. While I was exiting the roundabout, I misjudged the distance of the car coming from the inner lane. We side-swiped each other near the exit. My front right indicator lamp is broken, which I noticed as soon as I pulled over. I feel terrible about the whole situation because the visibility was so poor and I was just trying to get to my morning meeting on time. It was a complete error of judgment on my part.

I was attempting to park my Fiat in a very tight spot near the square. I was turning the wheel too sharply and miscalculated the proximity to the car parked adjacent to me. I heard a scraping sound and stopped immediately. I checked the side of my car and found a long, deep scratch running along the passenger door panel. I am so frustrated with myself for being careless in such a crowded area. I left a note on the individual driving the other car's windshield since they were not around at that moment.

I was sitting at a nearby café terrace when I saw the driver of the Fiat attempt to parallel park. She miscalculated the angle and the front fender of her car brushed against the parked vehicle next to it. I definitely heard the scraping noise of the metal contact.

I was driving down the EN125 when a vehicle in the lane to my left started drifting into my lane without signaling. I made an effort to steer away to the right, but there was a concrete barrier there, so I couldn't avoid the contact. The other car hit my left side. I have a dent on the side door, a large scratch, and my side indicator lamp is broken. I am really shaken up by this incident, dude, everything happened so fast and I just didn't have enough time to react properly.

My grandson was helping me navigate to the doctor's office, and with all the construction work on the road, I got a bit distracted. The traffic light turned red and I did not notice it in time, causing me to hit the back of the car stationary in front of me. I am very upset because I have been driving for forty years without an accident. The impact caused a large dent in my front bumper. It is all quite embarrassing to be honest, but the individual driving the other car was very polite.

I was waiting at the red light when I felt a significant impact from the rear. When I stepped out to inspect, the elderly gentleman from the Renault was very apologetic. My rear bumper clearly has a dent from the force of the collision, but thankfully no one was hurt.

It was midday, and the street was very busy with tourists and deliveries. I was trying to maneuver past a delivery van that had stopped on the curb. As I passed, my rear side panel brushed against a metal signpost that I simply didn't see in my blind spot. I ended up with a significant scratch on the paintwork. I am truly annoyed, but it was purely my mistake. I should have been much more careful in such a narrow street. Now I have to deal with the insurance repair process.

location: Vila Nova de Gaia, near the bridge

statements.text: I was cruising at about 30 km/h heading toward the bridge. The traffic started to crawl, and the person in front of me slammed on their brakes. I hit them square on the rear. My front right lamp is broken and it resulted in a deep impact depression on the hood. I am honestly worried about the repair, man, this car is my pride and joy. I should have kept more distance between us. I'm just so stressed about the whole insurance situation and how long it will take to fix.

I was slowing down for the bridge traffic when I felt a heavy impact from behind. My car was pushed forward slightly by the force. I have a dent in my rear bumper and some broken glass from the other driver's lamp scattered on the road. We exchanged details immediately.

I was driving in the right lane when a taxi suddenly decided to switch into my lane without checking. I tried to pull over, but he side-swiped my driver-side door. You can see a visible dent and several deep scratches along the door panel. I am quite frustrated as I have kept this car in perfect condition until today. It is annoying to have to file a claim, but the taxi driver admitted he didn't see me coming. I hope the repair center can restore the original paint color quickly.

I was parking near the historic center of Évora. The cobblestone streets are always a bit tricky to navigate, especially with the narrow turns. While I was backing into a parking space, I misjudged the distance to a low stone bollard. I hit it with my rear bumper, causing a noticeable dent. I am so disappointed in myself. I should have had my partner get out to guide me, but I thought I could manage it on my own. It is a simple mistake, but very frustrating to deal with.

I was driving along the avenue when the light turned amber. I decided to stop, but the delivery truck behind me wasn't expecting me to stop so abruptly. He couldn't stop in time and hit the rear of my car. My rear lamp is broken and there are several scratch marks on the bumper. I'm just glad no one was hurt, although it happened to be a loud bang. I have never had an accident like this before, and it has left me feeling very anxious about driving in the city center.

I was following the Smart car when the driver braked very suddenly for the light. Even though I was only moving at about 20 km/h, I couldn't avoid the contact. I hit his rear, breaking the lamp cover. I apologized to the driver as soon as I got out to check the damage.

I was driving home from work near the Rotunda da Boavista, moving at maybe 20 km/h in slow traffic. Suddenly, the car ahead of me stopped abruptly for a cyclist, and I just couldn't brake in time. It was a stupid mistake, really. I hit the back of his bumper, and now there's this noticeable dent right in the middle of my front bumper. I feel terrible about it because the oncoming driver was quite calm, but I'm worried about how much this is going to cost to repair on my insurance policy.

I was slowing down normally because of the traffic flow when I felt a sudden impact from behind. The driver behind me didn't seem to notice the traffic had come to a full stop. It wasn't a hard hit, just enough to leave a small dent on my rear bumper. We pulled over immediately to exchange details.

It was such a hectic morning in downtown Lisbon. I was trying to parallel park into this really tight spot near the square. I misjudged the distance between my rear panel and the car that was already parked there. I heard this awful scraping sound and immediately realized I had grazed the side of their door. I'm honestly so embarrassed, it's just a long scratch, but I feel like such an amateur. I’ve never done anything like this before and I'm really nervous about the insurance claim process, man.

I was heading along the avenue when the vehicle in the lane to my right tried to merge into mine without seeing me in his blind spot. I tried to swerve, but we still made contact. There is now a nasty scratch and a dent along the side of my driver's door. The individual driving the other car apologized immediately, acknowledging he didn't check his mirrors properly. It was a very unfortunate sequence of events, and I am quite concerned about the repair timeline since I rely on this car daily for my business visits.

I admit I was at fault. I was distracted for a split second by my GPS and moved into the left lane without properly confirming the lane was clear. I scraped against the side of the Peugeot. We both pulled over safely to the side of the road to inspect the damage.

I was navigating the roundabout, moving at about 30 km/h, when another car entered the circle too fast from the right. I tried to avoid them, but they caught my corner. My front lamp is broken, and there's a significant dent on the wheel arch. It was raining, which didn't help with visibility. I am an older driver, and honestly, these roundabouts get more chaotic every single year. It’s just so unsettling when you’re driving carefully and someone else just comes out of nowhere like that, causing such a mess for everyone involved today.

I was slowly pulling out of a parking bay onto the main street when a delivery van suddenly cut in front of me. I had to brake hard, and while I didn't hit them, the impact of the sudden stop caused a small crack in my front windscreen, probably from a flying stone that hit at the same moment. It’s just a small crack, but it’s right in the line of sight. I’m quite stressed about this because I have a long drive ahead this weekend and need the car to be perfectly safe for my family.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the Citroën attempt to exit the parking spot. The van driver moved quite aggressively, and the lady in the Citroën had to stop very abruptly. I heard a distinct sound, likely debris being kicked up, and then saw the crack appear on her windshield.

I was navigating down the street when the bus next to me started merging into my lane. I flashed my lights, but they didn't seem to see me. The rear side of the bus clipped my front end. It caused a long scratch along the bumper and broke the front indicator lamp. I am extremely worried about the cost and the paperwork involved. I just started this new job, and dealing with insurance claims is the last thing I need right now. It was just a really bad moment, and I hope it's fixed soon.

The traffic along the coast was heavier than usual. I was slowing down for the intersection when the car behind me failed to stop. It was quite a jolt. The impact caused a large dent in my trunk and the rear window glass shattered completely. I've lived in this area my whole life, and people just get so impatient during the tourist season. My back is feeling a bit sore, but I'm mostly just concerned about the shattered glass being everywhere inside the car, it's a huge mess to clean up.

I must apologize. The glare from the sun was extremely bright as I came around the curve, and I momentarily lost sight of the car in front of me until it was too late. I hit the brakes, but I still made contact. I take full responsibility for the accident.

I was cruising along the lane, maintaining about 40 km/h, when a motorbike tried to squeeze through the gap between my car and the lane divider. They miscalculated the space and scraped their handlebar against my passenger side door. There's a long, deep scratch now. I was quite shaken by it because it happened so fast and they barely stayed upright. I really hope the insurance covers this efficiently because the car is quite new, and seeing it damaged like this really bothers me as a car enthusiast.

I had parked my car near the campus while I went to pick up my daughter. When I came back, there was a note on my windshield saying someone had bumped into me. The rear bumper has a large dent and the tail lamp is broken. I feel so frustrated, man, it's just really unfair that someone can hit your car and you aren't even there to prevent it. I don't know who did it, but the damage is pretty obvious, and it’s going to be a real pain to get it repaired this month.

I saw a delivery truck backing up in the parking lot. The driver clearly misjudged the turning radius and hit the parked Nissan. I saw the driver get out, write a note, place it on the windshield, and then drive away. I noted the license plate if you need it.

It was late afternoon, and I was crossing the intersection when another driver disregarded the red light. I tried to steer away, but we made contact. My headlight is broken, there is a deep scratch on the fender, and the impact caused a crack in the side mirror glass. It was a very confusing situation with so much traffic near the bridge. I am just glad no one was seriously injured, but the car is in a bad way. I’ve never been in a real accident before, so the whole experience has been quite overwhelming for me.

I was heading down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, and the traffic was quite heavy as usual. I slowed down because the car in front stopped suddenly, but the driver behind me didn't react in time. It was just a low-speed impact, man, I'm really worried because this is my main car for work. My bumper definitely has a dent now, it's pretty noticeable. I was going like 20 km/h before I hit the brakes, so it really shouldn't have caused this much stress, you know? I hope the insurance covers this without too much trouble.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, intending to take the third exit towards Avenida da Liberdade. The traffic was merging aggressively, and I misjudged the distance of the silver van in the outer lane. As I moved over, we scraped past each other. It was honestly just a small mistake on my part, and I feel terrible about it. There is a visible scratch along my passenger side door panel. I was moving at roughly 15 km/h during the maneuver. The individual driving the other car stopped immediately, and we exchanged details in a professional and calm manner.

I was maintaining my lane in the roundabout when the Seat suddenly moved into my space. I made an effort to brake, but there was no time to avoid the contact. It resulted in a scratch on my side trim, but thankfully no one was hurt. We both pulled over safely to the side to inspect the vehicles.

I had just finished my grocery shopping and was trying to reverse out of a tight parking spot near Rua Augusta. I miscalculated the turning radius because of a delivery truck parked poorly nearby. I heard a crunch and realized I had backed into a parked vehicle. My rear lamp is broken and it resulted in a deep scratch on the plastic casing. I am so upset with myself; I have been driving for years and never had an incident like this before. The owner of the other car was very understanding when I left my contact information.

It was a busy afternoon on Avenida 24 de Julho, and I was trying to merge into the middle lane. I checked my mirror, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot, or perhaps they accelerated too quickly as I was moving. We made contact, which resulted in a dent on my front fender. I'm honestly quite shaken up because I could not spot them coming at all. I was driving around 30 km/h at the time. I've taken photos of the position of both cars before moving them out of the way of traffic.

I was traveling straight in the middle lane when the Renault suddenly started to move into my lane. I swerved slightly to the left, but the cars still made contact. I noticed a dent on the side of my door. We both stopped as soon as it was safe to do so.

My wife and I were driving to visit our daughter in Funchal when this happened. I was coming out of a side street onto Estrada Monumental and a cyclist appeared out of nowhere. I braked instinctively, and the car behind me, not expecting such a sudden stop, bumped into my rear bumper. The impact caused the rear glass to shatter completely. It was quite a shock, especially at my age, but we are just glad that nobody was injured. It was a clear day, but the traffic was simply too close together for anyone's comfort.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the Toyota brake for a cyclist. The car behind it clearly didn't have enough distance and hit the back of the Toyota. It was a loud noise, and I saw the glass shatter instantly. Both drivers seemed shaken but stepped out immediately to talk.

I was attempting to parallel park on Rua de Santa Catarina, which is notoriously tight even for a small car like mine. I was trying to be careful, but I think I misjudged the distance to the vehicle parked in front of me. I ended up scraping the side of their bumper. It’s just a scratch, but I feel terrible about damaging someone else's property. I've been driving for about three years now, but I still get a bit nervous with these narrow streets, you know? I’ve already left a note on their windshield with my phone number.

I was traveling northbound on Avenida da República during the morning rush. The traffic signals turned yellow and the car ahead of me, a white van, decided to stop very abruptly. I applied my brakes with full force, but I couldn't stop in time. My front end hit his rear bumper. There is a visible dent on my hood and my passenger-side head lamp is broken. I am quite worried about the repair costs, to be honest. I was traveling at roughly 40 km/h, which is the speed limit there. The second vehicle was cooperative throughout the process.

I had to stop for the light at the intersection. I felt a heavy impact from behind almost immediately after coming to a complete halt. My bumper has some minor damage, and the driver behind me clearly had a broken lamp. We exchanged insurance information right there on the side of the road.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was in the middle lane of Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, and the driver to my right seemed to be drifting out of their lane. I did my best to beep my horn to alert them, but they continued to veer over. They side-swiped my driver-side door. It resulted in both a deep scratch and a long dent along the side of the car. It was quite scary, honestly. I did my best to keep the car steady so I wouldn't hit the center divider. I was moving at about 45 km/h. Everything happened so fast, man.

I was slowly moving through the intersection at Avenida dos Aliados. I had the green light, but another car coming from the cross street tried to beat the red signal. They clipped my front corner, breaking my lamp. It was really chaotic, and I was quite distressed as it was raining, making the roads slick. I definitely had the right of way, and I was only moving at around 10 km/h as I was entering the junction. I've already spoken to the police officer who arrived shortly after to take our statements for the official report.

I was waiting at the corner of the street. I definitely saw the Volkswagen entering the intersection on a green light. The other car definitely ran the red light and clipped the Polo's front end. It caused the lamp to break into pieces on the road. It was quite clearly the fault of the second driver.

We were driving across the bridge towards Almada. Traffic was heavy as it usually is on this bridge. The car ahead of me slowed down due to congestion, and the vehicle behind me failed to stop. They slammed into my rear, which pushed me into the car in front. The force of the impact caused a dent on my bumper, a deep mark on the tailgate, and the rear glass shattered from the secondary impact. I'm just so stressed about this; it’s a long bridge, and being stuck there after an accident is a nightmare, you know?

I was trying to park my Golf on the street near the Bolhão market around 10:00 AM. I was reversing quite slowly, maybe 5 km/h, but I clearly misjudged the distance to the car behind me. I felt a slight scrape as I made contact with the other vehicle's rear bumper. I feel terrible about the whole thing because I know how annoying these minor parking mishaps are, but I immediately stopped and checked the paintwork, noticing a long scratch along my rear door panel.

It was pouring rain this morning on the way to the airport. While exiting the roundabout, the van in front of me braked suddenly because of a cyclist. I tried to brake, but I just slid a bit on the wet tarmac and bumped into their bumper. My headlight hit their tow bar. It’s definitely a dented hood and my right lamp is broken. I'm really sorry about this mess, I should have kept a larger distance given the weather conditions.

The insured driver hit me from behind while we were exiting the roundabout. The traffic was heavy and I had to stop abruptly due to a road obstacle. They couldn't stop in time on the wet road. My bumper is fine, but their car shows a clear dent on the front and a shattered light unit.

Driving on the EN125 is always stressful with all the tourists. I was moving to the right lane to exit and I guess I miscalculated the positioning of the vehicle already in that lane. We sideswiped each other at about 40 km/h. My rear quarter panel now has a long scratch and a shallow dent from where we made contact. The situation involved a very unfortunate maneuver on my part, and I've already exchanged all my insurance details with the other driver.

I was driving straight in the exit lane when the BMW tried to merge without checking. They sideswiped the side of my car. I stopped immediately. Their car sustained damage to the quarter panel, showing both a scratch and a dent, while I unfortunately have similar paint damage on my side door.

Goodness me, I have been driving for forty-five years and never had an issue until today. I was just trying to pull into the tight spot near the cafe, and I suppose I turned the wheel a bit too early. I scraped the side of the car against the concrete pillar of the parking structure. It is just a surface scratch, but it really hurts to see my little car damaged like this. I was so careful, but the lighting in the garage was very dim.

The traffic was absolute chaos near the docks today, like always. I was stopped at the red light when the car behind me didn't stop in time. They hit me right in the rear. The force was enough to shatter my tail light glass and break the lamp housing completely. It was such a sudden jolt, you know? I’m really worried about the repair, it’s a brand new car and seeing that glass on the road is just so upsetting for me, man.

I entered the junction when the signal was green. A van crossed from the left, seemingly not seeing the red light. I swerved to avoid a direct T-bone, but we still clipped each other. My front bumper has a dent and a deep scratch. I am quite annoyed because I was driving very carefully, but accidents like these are so hard to avoid when others are not paying attention to the signals.

I admit I was distracted by my radio and I might have entered the junction late. I saw the Audi and tried to brake, but we clipped bumpers. The Audi has a dent and a scratch on the side of the front bumper. I am taking full responsibility for the error.

We were crossing the bridge in heavy traffic. The car in the next lane drifted into my path, and I didn't have enough room to swerve away because of the median. We sideswiped at about 60 km/h. It resulted in a long, nasty scratch along my driver-side door. I’m just glad it wasn't a worse accident, given the high speed and the narrow lanes on the bridge. I've got the photos of the damage and the oncoming driver's details ready.

I was heading down the Avenida da Boavista around 5 PM, and the traffic was quite heavy as usual. The driver in front of me suddenly braked hard because a pedestrian stepped onto the crossing. I tried my best to stop, but I tapped the rear of their car. It was really stressful, and I felt so bad about the situation. It resulted in a visible dent on my bumper from the contact. I am really worried about how this process will work with the insurance company since this is my first accident.

I was coming to a complete halt for a pedestrian crossing the road. The driver behind me did not stop in time and hit my rear bumper. My vehicle now has a clear dent where the other car made contact. Everything happened very quickly during the afternoon commute.

It was pouring rain this morning near the Rotunda da Boavista. While exiting the roundabout, I misjudged the distance and swiped the side of a van. I feel so embarrassed about it. There is a deep scratch on my side panel and my front indicator lamp is broken from the impact. The second vehicle was very patient, but I am quite shaken up by the whole ordeal. I just hope the insurance process isn't too complicated, man, because I'm just trying to get to work.

The other driver was exiting the roundabout and did not notice me in the lane. They scraped the side of my van. I noticed their indicator lamp was broken and there was a scratch on their door. It was just a simple miscalculation in the heavy rain.

I was attempting to park near the Avenida dos Aliados. I was trying to back into a spot, but I miscalculated the distance to the concrete pillar. My rear bumper made contact, resulting in a noticeable dent. I am so frustrated with myself; I have been driving for years and never hit anything like this. It’s just a small dent, but I want to get it fixed as soon as possible because the car is relatively new and I take good care of it.

I was walking by the parking area and saw the driver of the Fiat 500 hit the stone pillar while reversing. The situation involved a slow-speed impact, but it clearly caused a dent to the rear bumper of the vehicle. The driver seemed very upset about the mistake.

I was travelling down Rua Augusta at a very low speed. Another vehicle pulled out from a side street without looking properly. I couldn't stop in time to avoid them, and I clipped their rear wing. The impact caused the glass on my side mirror to shatter completely. I was shocked and confused when it happened, honestly, because I didn't expect anyone to pull out like that. I just want to ensure everything is documented correctly for the insurance so the glass repair can be authorized.

I was travelling along the EN125 when the car in front suddenly slowed down for a turning vehicle. I slammed on the brakes, but unfortunately, I still hit them. It was a stressful morning, honestly, and I feel terrible because I was distracted by my GPS for a split second. My headlight lamp is broken and I noticed a dent on the hood. I am quite worried about the expenses here. I have all my documents ready, and I am waiting for the inspector's report.

I was slowing down to turn onto a side road when I was rear-ended. The driver hit me with enough force to break their lamp and dent their hood. I am fine, but it was quite a sudden shock to the system on such a busy stretch of road.

I was travelling home on the Avenida da República after a long day at the office. The traffic was extremely dense. I attempted to move into the center lane, but I misjudged the gap between my vehicle and the taxi next to me. We made contact, which resulted in a long, visible scratch along my passenger side door. It was purely an error in judgment on my part. I am ready to provide all necessary details to resolve this claim as efficiently as possible for both parties.

I was navigating the narrow streets near Rua de Santa Catarina. It was quite chaotic with people walking everywhere. As I was turning a corner, I got too close to a parked car and scraped my side panel. I am so annoyed at myself, you know? You can see a dent and a deep scratch on the side. I should have been much more careful in such a tight space. I just hope the repair isn't too costly because I am on a tight budget lately.

I saw the Opel Corsa trying to turn the corner on the narrow street. The driver misjudged the turn and sideswiped a parked car. I saw a dent and a scratch left on the Corsa's panel. It was clearly a mistake by the driver in the tight urban space.

Well, I was heading near the Praça do Comércio, just enjoying the view, really, and I suppose I wasn't paying enough attention to the vehicle stopped in front of me at the crossing. I tapped their bumper with mine. It was a very low-speed maneuver, but it was enough to break my front indicator lamp. I feel quite foolish, as I have been driving for forty years and haven't had a single issue until this afternoon. My hands were shaking a bit afterwards, but I am fine.

I was heading to the station on the Avenida 24 de Julho. The driver in front stopped unexpectedly, and I didn't have enough time to stop my vehicle fully. I nudged the back of their car. It resulted in a dent on their bumper and a few scratches on mine. I am really worried about this incident because I need my car for work, dude. I’m just waiting for the insurance assessment to see how long the repairs will take. I hope it’s a quick process.

I was stopped in traffic when I felt a jolt from behind. The other driver clearly didn't stop in time. My bumper has a dent and the other car clearly has a scratch from the impact. Everything seems straightforward regarding liability.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM when the traffic came to a sudden halt near the intersection. I braked as hard as I could, but the road was a bit damp from earlier rain, and my Golf just didn't stop in time. I bumped into the car in front of me at maybe 10 km/h. When I got out to check, I saw a dent on my front bumper and some deep scratches along the edge. It was entirely my fault, I just didn't leave enough distance.

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a significant jolt from behind. I checked my rearview mirror just as the oncoming driver was pulling over. We both got out and inspected the damage, and it was clear that the impact had caused a visible dent and several scratches on their bumper. The driver was very cooperative and immediately admitted they had misjudged the braking distance on the wet pavement.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: Honestly, I feel so terrible about this. I was trying to merge into the middle lane on Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, and man, the traffic was just super heavy. I checked my mirror, but I guess I missed the car coming up alongside me. I heard this awful scraping noise, like metal on metal, and knew I messed up. I pulled over immediately. My car has a long scratch running along the passenger side door now. I'm just so worried about how much this is going to cost to fix, dude.

I was navigating the Rotunda da Boavista during the morning rush, which is always quite a chaotic experience for everyone involved. I was moving from the inner lane to exit when I unfortunately misjudged the position of the van next to me. It happened so quickly that I didn't even have time to react. I pulled over just past the exit to inspect the damage and saw that my front indicator lamp was broken completely. I feel quite embarrassed about the whole incident, but I am glad no one was injured.

I was standing near the metro station entrance waiting for my bus when I saw the two vehicles collide at low speed while navigating the roundabout. It appeared to be a simple miscalculation of lanes. One vehicle clipped the other, and I could clearly see a lamp broken on the smaller car. Neither driver seemed aggressive, they both pulled over properly to exchange their insurance details in a calm manner.

I was trying to park my car on a narrow street in Coimbra. It was getting dark, and I didn't see the concrete bollard near the curb properly. I reversed slowly, thinking I had more space, and ended up hitting it. The impact caused a noticeable dent and a deep scratch on the rear bumper. I feel really foolish for not being more careful, but I was just exhausted after a long day at work. I have already contacted my insurance agent to see how we should proceed with the repairs.

It was midday, and the sun was really glaring off the road. I was entering the junction on Avenida da República when the car to my right didn't stop at the sign. I slammed on the brakes, but we still connected. My side window glass shatter was instantaneous from the impact of the side mirror hitting it. I'm shaken up, but thankfully okay. I just hope the other driver is alright too. It's been a very stressful day, and I'm not entirely sure how all the paperwork needs to be filled out.

The sunlight was blinding at the intersection, and I honestly didn't see the stop sign until it was too late. I moved into the lane, and we collided. I feel terrible about it. I saw that their window had glass shatter from the collision force. I am ready to accept full responsibility for the accident as it was clearly my oversight due to the poor visibility and my lack of attention at the stop line.

I was driving through the narrow streets of Cedofeita to get to my granddaughter's school. It's always busy there, you know. I was looking for a spot and, well, I miscalculated the distance to the parked van on my left while I was trying to turn the corner. It was only at about 5 km/h, but I still left a dent on my front wing. I've been driving for forty years and I'm usually much more careful, but I suppose everyone makes a mistake once in a while.

I was travelling along the coast on Avenida Marginal. The traffic was moving at maybe 40 km/h. Suddenly, the car in front of me swerved and then braked hard. I tried to avoid them, but I clipped their rear corner. My headlight housing is now a lamp broken, and there is a significant impact depression on the hood. I am really worried because this is a new car. I've exchanged details with the other driver and we both agreed to file this through our respective insurance providers as soon as possible.

I saw a cyclist suddenly pull into the road, so I had to make an emergency maneuver. I came to a halt, and the BMW behind me couldn't stop in time. It was an unfortunate situation all around. When I checked the other vehicle, I saw their front lamp broken and a large dent. We are both cooperating fully with the police report to ensure everything is documented correctly for the insurance companies.

I was in the right lane on the Alameda, heading towards the stadium. I signaled to change lanes because I needed to take the next exit. I checked my blind spot, but the other car must have accelerated unexpectedly in that gap. We made contact, which resulted in a long scratch along the rear passenger door. It was just one of those things that happens in city traffic. I feel bad about the damage, but I'm thankful it was just cosmetic and not a more serious collision.

Traffic was crawling across the bridge at a snail's pace, maybe 10 km/h. I got distracted for just a split second looking at the river view, and I rolled forward into the back of a taxi. It was such a light tap, but the plastic bumper on my Smart car took a dent. I apologized profusely to the driver. We pulled onto the shoulder safely to exchange details. I've never been in an accident before, so I'm quite anxious about the whole process, man.

We were in stop-and-go traffic on the bridge when the driver behind me tapped my bumper. It wasn't a hard hit, but it did leave a dent on their own vehicle. I failed to notice any major damage to my taxi, but we exchanged information regardless. The driver was very apologetic and clearly shaken by the event. I told them not to worry, as these things happen on the bridge all the time.

I was trying to maneuver into a very tight space near the square. I thought I had cleared the concrete pillar, but I heard a sharp sound. Upon inspection, I realized I had hit the pillar with my bumper, resulting in a visible crack in the plastic trim. I've only had this car for a few months, so I'm quite disappointed in myself. I've taken photos of the damage for the insurance claim and will be contacting a repair shop to get an estimate as soon as I get home.

I was driving home from work around 6:00 PM in heavy traffic on Avenida da Boavista. The car ahead of me stopped suddenly because of a delivery van double-parked on the side, and even though I pressed the brakes, I couldn't stop in time. My front bumper hit their rear bumper. I feel terrible about this, I was just tired and distracted for a second, but I did hit them. There is a noticeable dent on my hood and some deep scratch marks on the trim.

Traffic was crawling along at about 20 km/h. I had to brake quite hard when the vehicle in front of me slowed down unexpectedly. The gentleman behind me clearly didn't react fast enough, and he tapped the rear of my car. I got out to check and saw the dent and scratches on his bumper. It was clearly an honest mistake, just a standard low-speed incident during rush hour.

I was trying to park in a very narrow spot in Coimbra near the university. I thought I had enough room, but I was so nervous because there were cars waiting behind me, and I turned the wheel too early. I scraped against the side of the car already parked in the space. I'm so embarrassed, it's just a long scratch on the rear door, but it looks quite ugly. I hope the owner doesn't mind too much, I've already left my contact details on their windshield.

It was early morning and the streets were still a bit damp. I was on my way along the avenue when the driver next to me tried to merge into my lane without checking their mirrors. I did my best to swerve, but we still made contact. It was all very quick, like a blur, man. My door has a large dent now and there is a nasty scratch running along the passenger side panel. I am just really stressed about how long the repairs will take.

I was in the right lane and honestly, I didn't see the BMW coming up from behind. I checked my mirror, saw nothing, and started to move over. We side-swiped each other at about 30 km/h. It was a complete miscalculation on my part. We both pulled over immediately to exchange insurance details. My own door is damaged as well, so I understand the frustration.

Oh dear, I was navigating along the coast road, enjoying the view of the Atlantic, and perhaps I wasn't paying enough attention to the car in front of me slowing down for the speed camera. It was a beautiful day, bright sun, but the glare made it hard to see the brake lights. I hit the rear bumper of the car ahead. The impact was quite loud; my front lamp is broken and my windshield suffered a glass shatter from the vibration and the minor jolt.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was moving through the intersection after the light turned green. A driver coming from the cross-street didn't stop at their red light and clipped my front bumper. It happened so fast, like I couldn't even react. I am just really worried about the damage, as I only got this car last month. There is a significant damage to the fender where they hit me. I am quite shaken up by the whole situation, honestly.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the pedestrian light. The Mercedes was definitely driving at a normal speed when the green light appeared. The other car simply accelerated through the red light and caused the collision. It was clearly the fault of the second driver. I saw the dent occur on the side of the Mercedes immediately upon impact.

I was navigating home to Sintra on the IC19 during the evening. Traffic was moving at about 70 km/h. I signaled to move into the center lane, but I miscalculated the speed of the car already in that lane. We made contact, and I ended up hitting their rear quarter panel. My headlight assembly took the brunt of it, so the lamp is broken, and there is a dent on my front wing. I feel awful about this, I just didn't see them.

I was in the middle lane of the IC19. The Volvo ahead of me started to merge, but they just didn't check their blind spot properly. I tried to move over, but they still made contact with my vehicle. It caused a bit of a mess, but luckily no one was injured. I saw their lamp broken and the dent on their front fender after we pulled over.

I was stuck in traffic, and I reached down to grab my water bottle. When I looked back up, the car in front had stopped for a pedestrian. I couldn't stop in time and just tapped them at a very low speed. My windshield has a glass shatter now, likely from the shock, and there is a scratch on the bumper. I am so annoyed with myself, man, I should have just waited to drink. It's totally my fault, I wasn't focused.

I was going around the roundabout and someone tried to cut inside me from the outer lane. I didn't have anywhere to go and we made contact. It was quite a stressful moment. My front lamp is broken, and there's a dent and a scratch on the passenger side door. I have lived in Porto my whole life and people drive like crazy here sometimes, you know? I just want the car fixed and back to normal, it's my only vehicle.

I was cycling near the roundabout when I saw the Audi inside the circle. The other car took the turn too sharply and tried to force their way in, which caused the impact. The driver of the Audi did everything they could to avoid it. I saw the damage to the lamp and the side of the car immediately after they stopped.

I was on my way towards the city center during the morning rush hour when the traffic suddenly stopped. I attempted to brake, but my car slid slightly on the damp pavement and hit the rear of the car ahead. The bumper now has a visible dent and several deep scratches from the impact. I am so incredibly worried about the repair costs, as I really need this car for my daily commute to university. I feel terrible about the whole situation, honestly, I was just trying to pay attention to the road.

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The driver behind me couldn't stop in time. My rear bumper is scratched and dented from the contact, but luckily nobody was hurt in the collision. It was a standard urban accident, very unfortunate for both of us on a rainy morning in Porto.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, and I must have misjudged the distance when exiting. I accidentally clipped the rear light of the van in the outer lane as I moved to turn off. The impact broke my front left lamp completely. I have been driving for over forty years, and I truly cannot believe I made such a silly mistake today. It was quite chaotic, and I feel quite shaken by the incident, though I am thankful that there was no damage to the bodywork or the chassis.

The traffic on the EN125 was very heavy as usual. I attempted to change lanes to avoid a slow-moving truck, but I didn't see the car in my blind spot. We made contact, causing a dent and several long scratches along my side door. I am feeling extremely anxious right now because I have never been in an accident before. I should have checked my mirrors twice, but everything happened so fast and I am just hoping the insurance process doesn't become too complicated for me.

I was cruising in the middle lane when the other driver suddenly drifted into my lane without signaling. I tried to swerve, but we still sideswiped. My car has a dent and some scratches on the passenger side panel. It was clearly a momentary lapse in concentration, but the damage is quite frustrating to deal with.

I was slowly pulling out of a parking space in the center of Porto. Due to the limited visibility and the glare of the morning sun, I failed to notice a concrete pillar nearby. My front bumper hit the pillar directly, causing a significant crack in the plastic molding. This is very inconvenient as I use this car for client meetings throughout the city. I am clearly at fault here, and I am documenting everything so the repairs can begin as soon as possible through my insurance provider.

I was checking my navigation system for a moment when the traffic in front of me halted unexpectedly. I could not brake in time and hit the vehicle ahead. The force of the impact resulted in a dent on my hood and a broken lamp on the right side. It happened to be a very stressful situation, and I am quite upset with myself for being distracted. I have been driving for over twenty years and I know better than to look at my phone, but here we are.

I was waiting to cross the street near the plaza when I saw the BMW hit the car in front of it. It looked like the driver of the BMW was looking down just before the impact occurred. The collision wasn't at a high speed, but it definitely damaged the front of his car, specifically the light and the bumper area.

The traffic was quite heavy on the way to the office. I moved to the left lane to make a turn, but I clearly misjudged the distance to the adjacent vehicle. We ended up colliding, which resulted in a dent and scratches on my rear door. I am a very punctual person, and this whole incident has really thrown off my schedule for the day. I have provided my insurance details to the other party so we can process this claim formally and correctly.

I was heading steadily in the left lane when the Audi driver attempted a merge. I was already alongside him, so there was nowhere for me to go. My car sustained a dent and scratches from the impact, but fortunately, no one was injured during the maneuver. It was a standard insurance matter.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was stopped at the traffic signal when a sudden loud noise occurred behind me. A car had failed to stop and hit my rear bumper quite hard. The impact caused the rear glass to shatter into pieces on the road. I am still quite shaky from the event; it really gave me a fright, you know? My grandkids were in the car earlier today, but thankfully they weren't with me during this incident. It is just such a messy situation for a Thursday afternoon.

The Circunvalação road is notoriously busy and confusing with all the lane changes. I was trying to merge right, and I could not spot the other car in the lane. We sideswiped each other, which resulted in a dent and multiple scratches on the passenger side of my vehicle. I am feeling very anxious about the repair process, dude. I have never dealt with an insurance claim before and I really don't want my premiums to go up because of this one mistake.

I was driving within the speed limit when the Skoda suddenly cut into my lane. I didn't have enough time to react, leading to the side-swipe. My car has some scratches and a dent on the driver side door. It's a real shame, but at least we can get it sorted out through the insurance companies.

I was navigating home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was trailing a silver car, and when the driver ahead suddenly braked for a cyclist crossing the road, I didn't have enough distance to react. I managed to slow down significantly, but my front bumper still made contact with their rear. I am really stressed about this because I haven't had an accident in ten years, and now I see you can see a noticeable dent on my hood and bumper.

I was minding my own business when I had to brake quite hard because a cyclist appeared out of nowhere in the middle of the road. I felt a bump from behind shortly after. When I pulled over to check the damage, I saw a crush on the driver's bumper. It was an honest mistake by the second vehicle, as the traffic was stop-and-go.

I was trying to park my car near the Rossio square area this morning. It was very crowded, and while I was maneuvering into a tight spot, I misjudged the distance to a concrete pillar on my right. I was moving at maybe 5 km/h, but I heard a scraping noise immediately. I checked the side of the car and found a long, deep scratch along the passenger door panel. I feel so clumsy for doing this, it's just really frustrating to have this happen on a Monday morning.

I was navigating the roundabout at Praça Mouzinho de Albuquerque. It was raining quite a bit, and the road surface was slippery. I was attempting to exit when a car on my left seemed to lose a bit of grip and drifted into my lane. We collided at a very low speed. I can clearly see a dent and a scratch on my rear door panel. I am just really worried about how the insurance process works and if this is going to be very expensive to fix.

The rain made the roundabout very slippery today. I was in the inner lane and tried to turn, but my car slid slightly towards the right lane where the Peugeot was driving. We made contact at low speed. There is some bodywork damage, specifically a dent and a scratch on the side of their car. It was just an unfortunate accident due to the weather conditions.

I was driving down Avenida 24 de Julho in the lane closest to the parked vehicles. Suddenly, a door from a parked car swung open right in front of me. I tried to swerve to the left, but I still grazed the edge of the door with my side mirror and rear panel. There is a visible scratch running along the passenger side. I really hope the second vehicle is okay, but this is such a nuisance to deal with right now, like, I have so much work to get back to.

I was heading slowly, perhaps 20 km/h, looking for a pharmacy on Rua de Santa Catarina. A delivery van in front of me stopped suddenly to unload, and I didn't stop in time. My front right corner hit their rear bumper. The impact caused my front lamp to break immediately. Back in my day, cars were a bit sturdier, but the plastic these days just cracks under any pressure. It's a real bother, especially since I had my grandson in the car and he got a bit of a fright.

I was walking down the street and saw the whole thing. The small Citroen was moving quite slowly but clearly didn't see the van stop abruptly. The impact was light, but enough to break the lamp on the car's front. Both drivers seemed shaken but were very polite to each other while exchanging information.

I was changing lanes on the Avenida da República to prepare for a turn. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the vehicle in the adjacent lane. As I started to pull over, I heard a grinding sound and realized I had made contact with the other car. There is a dent and a scratch on the side of my front wing. I feel awful about this, I really pride myself on being a safe driver, so this is quite embarrassing and stressful for me.

I was crossing the intersection at Rua de Cedofeita when another car coming from the cross-street didn't respect the yield sign. We collided at the intersection corner. The impact shattered the glass of my passenger window and broke the indicator lamp on the side. I am very shaken up by the whole experience. My daughter was in the passenger seat, but thankfully she wasn't hurt, just scared by the sound of the glass shattering near her.

I apologize, I completely misjudged the intersection and didn't see the other car until it was too late. I hit the side of their car. Their window glass shattered and the side lamp broke from the impact. I am taking full responsibility for not yielding, and I hope everyone is doing alright despite the damage to the vehicles.

I stopped briefly to drop off some groceries on Rua do Almada. When I was pulling out from the curb, I didn't realize how close the concrete planter was to the front bumper. As I turned the steering wheel to pull into traffic, the plastic part of my bumper caught the edge of the planter. I heard a distinct crack and found that the bumper plastic had actually cracked. It's a small issue, but I want to get it settled through the insurance since the car is still quite new.

I was standing near the storefront and saw the driver pull out. They turned a bit too sharply and hit the heavy concrete planter on the sidewalk. There was a loud cracking sound, and the front bumper definitely has a crack in the plastic now. The driver stopped immediately, looked at the damage, and seemed quite upset with themselves.

I was driving home from work around 6:00 PM in heavy Lisbon traffic. The flow was quite stop-and-go near the Marquês de Pombal square. Suddenly, the car in front of me braked hard because of a pedestrian, and I didn't manage to stop my Renault in time. I hit the back of the other car at a very low speed. My front bumper now has a noticeable dent and quite a few deep scratches from the impact. I am really worried about the insurance costs; this is the first time I've ever had a real accident.

Traffic was dense, and I had to stop abruptly. The driver behind me didn't react quickly enough and bumped into my rear bumper. My car sustained a dent and some scratches on the plastic trim. We pulled over safely to the side of the avenue to exchange information.

It was raining cats and dogs here in Porto this morning, and the narrow streets of Cedofeita were incredibly slick. I was trying to maneuver my Fiat into a very tight parking space near the local café. I misjudged the distance to the parked car next to me and ended up grazing the side panel. It was a really stupid mistake on my part, and I feel terrible about it. I checked the damage, and it resulted in a visible scratch along the door, nothing else luckily.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, which is always chaotic. As I was exiting, a van drifted into my lane without warning. I did my best to swerve, but we made contact with our side panels. My front lamp is completely broken and it left a large dent on the front fender. I am feeling quite shaken by the whole event, man. It just happened so fast, and I didn't see the van coming until we were already hitting each other. I hope this gets sorted out quickly.

I was in the roundabout and perhaps I didn't check my mirror well enough before changing lanes to exit. I felt an impact on my side. I stopped immediately and saw that the oncoming driver's front lamp was broken and there was a dent on their fender.

The EN125 is always busy, especially in summer. I was driving along the coast when the driver to my left moved into my lane without signaling. I had no time to react and we sideswiped. The impact left a deep scratch and a long dent down the passenger side door. I was quite frustrated, you know, because I was heading to a family lunch and now my whole afternoon is ruined. It’s stressful dealing with the paperwork, but I’m just glad it wasn't a head-on collision.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista, heading toward the coast. A car coming from a side street didn't respect the stop sign and pulled out right in front of me. I slammed the brakes, but I couldn't avoid clipping their rear corner. My side mirror glass shattered immediately upon impact, and shards were everywhere on the asphalt. It was a really loud sound that startled me. The oncoming driver was apologetic, admitting they were distracted by their GPS. I'm just lucky the glass didn't cut anyone in the car.

I was waiting to cross the intersection on foot. I clearly saw the Opel driving straight when the other vehicle emerged from the side road without stopping. The impact caused the Opel's mirror glass to shatter. Both drivers got out of their cars immediately to assess the situation.

Back when I was a young man, driving was so much easier, but now these modern cars are so wide! I was simply trying to park my Toyota outside the pharmacy in Coimbra. I must have misjudged the pillar near the entrance because I heard a sickening crunch. When I got out to look, I saw a nasty dent and a long scratch on the rear quarter panel. My wife was waiting in the passenger seat and she was quite upset about the whole thing. It is just such a nuisance, honestly.

I was driving slowly along the avenue because of the heavy rain. The car in front stopped suddenly because a tourist was crossing the road unexpectedly. My Nissan slid on the wet pavement and I tapped the back of their car. My right headlight lamp is broken and you can see a crush on the hood. I am really stressed about the repair process, dude. I’ve never had to deal with this before, and I don't want my premiums to go up for such a small accident, you know?

I stopped for a pedestrian and felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me had clearly skidded on the wet road. When I inspected the damage, I saw their headlamp was broken and there was a dent on their hood. We exchanged details calmly.

Traffic on the bridge was quite heavy this afternoon. I was in the middle lane when I tried to signal and shift to the left. I checked my mirror, but there was a blind spot, I suppose. I made contact with a car that was already there. We were traveling at about 40 km/h. Thankfully, it was only a minor graze, resulting in a series of paint scratches along the side of my car. I feel quite professional about this, acknowledging it was my error in judgment during the maneuver.

I was navigating through the city center, which is always so busy with trams and pedestrians. A delivery van parked illegally started pulling out into traffic without looking. I tried to veer away, but the side of my car caught the corner of his van. My passenger window glass shattered completely, and I noticed a significant dent on the door frame. I’m just glad I didn't hit any of the pedestrians on the sidewalk. It happened to be a very scary moment for me and the passengers in my car, man.

I was finishing a delivery and pulled out, failing to notice the Audi coming alongside. I heard the impact and stopped. The Audi had a shattered window and a dented door. I take full responsibility for not checking my blind spot properly before pulling into the lane.

I was visiting the square and trying to find parking. It was very crowded, so I had to make a very sharp turn in a narrow lot. I didn't realize there was a concrete post so close. I hit the rear corner of my vehicle against it. The rear tail lamp is broken and I noticed a deep scratch near the bumper. I've been driving for forty-five years and I rarely make these mistakes, but the lighting in that garage was just terrible. I feel quite embarrassed by the whole situation, but it happens.

I was driving home from work along Avenida da Boavista, moving at about 30 km/h in the right lane. Traffic was quite dense as it usually is during rush hour. Suddenly, the car in front of me braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I attempted to react, but I couldn't stop in time and made contact with their rear bumper. My car has a noticeable dent and some paint scratch damage on the front hood area. I am really worried about how much this repair will cost, honestly, it was just a moment of bad timing.

The traffic was stop-and-go. I saw the pedestrian and pressed my brakes firmly to stop. A few seconds later, I felt a solid impact from behind. I checked my car and saw a dent and a deep scratch on the rear bumper. The other driver was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the exchange of information.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música, trying to exit towards the city center. I think I might have underestimated the speed of the vehicle in the outer lane as I was changing lanes. I felt a scraping sound and realized I had clipped the other car. I noticed a broken lamp on my side and a long scratch along the side panel. Man, I feel so terrible about this, I just hope their insurance covers everything because I was clearly in the wrong lane maneuver.

I was attempting to parallel park in a very tight spot near the Praça do Comércio. I was moving at a very slow speed, probably less than 5 km/h, when I misjudged the distance to the parked car behind me. I heard a scraping noise and stopped immediately. Upon inspection, there is a visible scratch on my rear bumper. I feel really anxious about this because I have never been in an accident before, and I am not sure if my policy covers these types of minor parking errors.

I was walking by the square and observed the driver of the small Fiat attempting to park. They were moving very slowly but clearly miscalculated the gap and brushed against the silver sedan parked behind them. I saw a clear scratch on the bumper of the Fiat. It was an honest mistake while parking.

It was raining heavily this morning, making visibility quite poor along the avenue. I was signaling to change into the left lane when I failed to notice a car in my blind spot. I steered back, but the contact was already made. My front fender now has a significant dent. I have been driving for over forty years, and this is truly embarrassing for me to report. My grandson says I should take it slow when it rains, and he is absolutely right; I should have paid more attention.

I entered the intersection on a green light, or at least I thought it was. A van came from the side street, and we made impact. It happened so fast that I am still a bit shaken up. It resulted in a broken lamp and some glass shatter from the headlights on the road. Dude, I am just so stressed out by this whole situation, I really don't know what to do next. I just want to make sure the other driver is okay, honestly.
