There was a delivery van unloading supplies, and as I tried to squeeze past him, the road narrowed quite significantly. I underestimated the space and scraped the side of my vehicle against the brick wall of a building. It left a long, ugly scratch along the passenger side. I feel rather embarrassed, as I should have just waited for the van to move instead of trying to pass.

I was stopped at a red light on Avenida Luísa Todi. I was just checking my navigation when the car behind me failed to stop and tapped my rear. I jumped out to check the damage and found that my rear lamp was broken and there was a clear dent in the boot lid. I am a bit worried about how long it will take to get these parts replaced, as I rely on this car every single day for my job.

I was coming up to the traffic lights on Avenida Luísa Todi and got momentarily distracted by the sunset over the water. By the time I looked back at the road, the Ford Fiesta in front was stationary. I applied the brakes, but I wasn't able to avoid a collision. I damaged their rear lamp and caused a dent on their car.

I have been driving in Lisbon for forty years, and I usually have no trouble, but this morning at the Rotunda do Relógio, things were quite hectic. It was very busy with airport traffic. While I was attempting to exit the roundabout, a driver clipped the front corner of my vehicle. The impact broke my left lamp. It was quite frightening for me, and I spent a good twenty minutes calming down before I could even start to talk to the other driver about the incident.

I was waiting for my bus near the roundabout and witnessed the collision. The Dacia was correctly positioned to exit, but a faster-moving vehicle tried to pass on the outside, clipping the Dacia's front corner. I saw the lamp shatter and fall onto the asphalt immediately after the contact.

I was traveling along the waterfront on Avenida Infante Dom Henrique. Traffic was stop-and-go because of the road maintenance nearby. I came to a halt behind a bus, and the car behind me simply didn't stop in time. He hit me at about 15 km/h. There is a deep dent on my rear bumper and quite a few surface scratches from the impact. I am just glad no one was hurt, but it is such a nuisance to deal with all this paperwork now.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, just heading home after a very long day at the office. The traffic was quite heavy as usual, and I was moving slowly, probably at 20 km/h. Suddenly, the car ahead of me stopped abruptly for a pedestrian. I hit my brakes, but I didn't stop in time and tapped their bumper. It was completely my fault, man, I'm so stressed about the repair costs because I'm just starting out in my career. I noticed a visible dent on the rear bumper of the other car.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio at mid-morning. It was quite chaotic, with cars coming from every direction, and I think I misjudged the distance while merging into the outer lane. I felt a slight scrape as I passed the side of a delivery van. I pulled over immediately to check the damage; there is a noticeable scratch along my passenger side door. I feel terrible about this because I have never had an accident before, and I really hope the insurance process isn't too complicated.

I was travelling through the roundabout when the second vehicle tried to move into my lane without checking their blind spot. The situation involved a low-speed impact, but they definitely scraped the side of my van. I stopped right away to exchange details. It is frustrating to have to deal with this, but I am glad no one was hurt.

I was parking near the city center, and it was a very tight spot. I was trying to reverse carefully, but I miscalculated the angle against a concrete post. It was a silly mistake on my part, honestly. My car hit the post and I can see a clear dent and some long scratches on the rear panel now. I'm worried about how much this is going to cost me to fix. I should have been much more patient while maneuvering, especially with how cramped the parking spaces are around here.

I was approaching the intersection on Avenida Luísa Todi under the rain. The road surface felt quite slippery, you know? When the light turned amber, I did my best to brake, but I think I skidded slightly and nudged the vehicle in front. It was just a small bump, but I can see that my front left lamp is broken now. I am so worried because this is my only car for getting to university, and I really hope I can get it sorted out quickly without too many issues.

The light changed, and I slowed down normally, but the driver behind me didn't seem to account for the wet road. They hit my car from behind. I checked my vehicle and it seems okay, but their front light is definitely broken and hanging loose. We exchanged information immediately after the incident.

I was navigating along Avenida da França during the late afternoon. I wanted to switch lanes to make a left turn, and I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the car in my blind spot. I moved over and we made contact. It was such a loud noise, which really startled me. It left a long mark on the rear quarter panel of my car. I feel so bad about the mistake; I should have double-checked before moving over into the lane.

My goodness, I was just driving slowly along Rua da Prata looking for a pharmacy for my wife, and it was quite crowded with tourists everywhere. I was moving at maybe 10 km/h when I turned too sharply and brushed against a parked car. I didn't mean any harm, but I can see a distinct dent on my door now. It's truly a nuisance, as I have so many appointments to attend today and I simply do not have the time for all this paperwork and insurance fuss.

I was walking down the sidewalk when I saw the small Fiat turn too tightly while trying to navigate around the traffic. It clearly impacted the side of a parked vehicle. I saw the driver get out immediately to assess the dent. It was an honest mistake in a very narrow street.

I was heading towards Faro on the EN125 when the traffic suddenly came to a complete halt due to roadwork. I was distracted for just a split second by the GPS, and by the time I looked up, I was already too close to the car in front. I slammed on the brakes, but I hit them. My headlight cover cracked and I can see glass shatter on the ground from the impact. I am so panicked about this; I am just a student and have no idea how this process works.

I was maneuvering to leave a parking spot on Avenida dos Aliados. I was being quite careful, checking my mirrors, but there was a delivery vehicle coming up the lane faster than I anticipated. I didn't see him in time and our bumpers collided. It caused a significant dent on my bumper and my side lamp is broken as well. I am very embarrassed about this incident, as I have been driving for over thirty years without a single claim. It is truly quite upsetting for me.

I was on my way down the street when the Corsa pulled out of their spot without waiting for me to pass. I couldn't swerve in time because of the traffic in the other lane. We collided at low speed. Their car has a broken light and a dent. I stopped to exchange insurance details.

It was during the morning rush hour on Avenida da República. The traffic was bumper to bumper, and I was trying to merge into the lane to my right. I guess I didn't leave enough space because the other driver and I made side contact. There is a long scratch running along the side of my vehicle. I am just really stressed out about it because I was already running late for a very important client meeting. I'm sorry for the inconvenience caused to the other driver.

I was driving along the waterfront at about 40 km/h. The vehicle in front stopped suddenly because a tourist was crossing the road unexpectedly. I couldn't stop in time, even though I was at a safe distance. I impacted their rear bumper. It created a noticeable dent on my hood and their rear bumper. I'm just so worried about my insurance premiums increasing after this. I've always tried to be a responsible driver, but these city roads can be so unpredictable, especially with all the foot traffic around.

I was walking nearby and witnessed the incident. A pedestrian darted out into the street, forcing the first driver to slam on their brakes. The driver behind them didn't have enough time to react and rear-ended the first car. It was clearly an unavoidable situation for the second driver.

I was on my way home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic was quite heavy near the roundabout. I came to a complete stop because the car in front of me halted suddenly, but the driver behind me, perhaps distracted, failed to brake in time. I felt a solid jolt as he struck my rear bumper. When I got out to check, I saw a clear dent on my bumper. It was quite a stressful moment, especially since I'm already worried about my insurance premiums going up because of this unavoidable accident, you know?

I admit that I misjudged the distance between our vehicles while checking my GPS. I was traveling at a very low speed, probably under 15 km/h, but I couldn't stop in time to avoid hitting the back of the Golf. It was entirely my fault, and I am ready to cooperate with the insurance companies to settle the damage.

I was pulling into a parking space near the square this morning. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I miscalculated the angle while reversing. I heard a slight noise as I brushed against the side of the car parked next to me. I immediately got out and noticed a scratch on the rear passenger door. I feel terrible about it, honestly. I've never had a claim like this before, and I really hope the repair process isn't too complicated or expensive to handle through the normal insurance channels.

I was navigating through the narrow streets of the city center when a delivery truck tried to overtake me. The road was tight, and the driver of the truck didn't allow enough space, swiping the side of my car. I stopped immediately and saw a scratch and a dent along my front fender. It was all so sudden, and I was quite shaken up by the proximity of the impact. I just want to make sure my car gets fixed correctly without any further hassle.

I was in a rush to complete a delivery and didn't notice the Yaris was so close when I moved into the lane. I clipped the side of the vehicle while trying to pass. I fully accept responsibility for the damage caused to the other car.

It was pouring rain this morning on the way to the bridge. The traffic was bumper-to-bumper, and the road was incredibly slippery. The car ahead of me braked hard due to a sudden stop in traffic, and although I slammed on my brakes, my car skidded slightly into their rear. It resulted in a broken lamp and some glass shatter on the road. I am really distressed about the whole thing, as I've been driving carefully, but the weather just made it impossible to avoid.

I was walking on the sidewalk nearby when I heard the loud sound of glass shattering. I saw the Renault slip on the wet road surface and bump into the vehicle in front. The rain was very heavy, and visibility was quite low at that time of the morning.

The weather was lovely, typical for a Saturday near the coast, and I was enjoying a drive with my grandson. I was maintaining a steady speed of about 50 km/h in my lane, and I suppose the other driver was distracted as they veered into my lane without checking. It caused a long scratch along my passenger side door. I was quite alarmed by the sudden movement, but thankfully nobody was hurt. We both pulled over safely to exchange our insurance details, as it was clearly a minor but unfortunate error.

I am terribly sorry. I was adjusting my radio and didn't realize I had drifted into the next lane. I heard a scraping sound and realized immediately that I had hit the car next to me. I accept full blame for the scratch caused to the other vehicle.

I was just trying to park my car in the city center around 3 PM today. The spots are very tight, and while I was maneuvering, I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar in the parking garage. My side struck the edge of the pillar, resulting in a dent and a scratch on the side panel. It’s so annoying, and I'm really worried about how much the repair is going to cost me. I've always taken good care of this car, so seeing this damage is truly disheartening for me.

I was proceeding through the intersection on a green light, and out of nowhere, another vehicle entered from the cross street. I believe they might have misread the signal. I hit their rear quarter panel at a very low speed, maybe 15 km/h. It resulted in my front lamp being broken and a dent in the bumper. I'm feeling quite shaken, as this is my first accident in years, and I want to make sure everything is documented properly for the insurance adjustment.

I honestly thought the light was still yellow when I entered the intersection. I realize now that I was mistaken and should have stopped. I feel terrible about the damage caused to the other car's lamp and bumper.

location: Vila Nova de Gaia near the bridge

statements.text: I was stopped at the red light heading towards the bridge. The car behind me didn't notice I had stopped and bumped into me from behind. It wasn't a hard hit, just enough to leave a small dent on my trunk. I’m just a bit stressed about the insurance paperwork, as I’ve never done this before. I have a long day of errands ahead, and this is really setting me back. I'm just hoping we can get this sorted out quickly today.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus when I saw the car roll forward and tap the back of the Dacia. It seemed like the driver behind was looking at their phone and didn't see the traffic had stopped. The situation involved a very low-speed impact.

It was during the morning rush hour on the main avenue. I was changing lanes to the left to prepare for a turn, and I checked my mirrors, but I think I failed to notice the other vehicle in my blind spot. We made contact, which caused a scratch on my side and some glass shatter from the side mirror. I'm really anxious because I use this car for my daily commute to the office, and I'm worried about the time it will take for the insurance to process the repair work.

I was driving home after work along Avenida da Boavista when the traffic suddenly slowed down. I pressed the brakes, but I guess I didn't stop fast enough because I tapped the back of the car in front of me at maybe 10 km/h. It was completely my fault, I was just distracted for a second by the radio. My front bumper has a noticeable dent now, but the other driver was very polite about it. I am honestly just really worried about my insurance premiums going up after this, man, this is so stressful.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio during the morning rush. I was in the middle lane trying to exit towards the airport, and there was a van in the outer lane. I think I misjudged how close he was when I started to move over. There is a long scratch along my passenger side door now. I feel terrible about it, honestly, it was just a lapse in judgment while dealing with all the aggressive traffic. I'm just hoping the repair costs won't be too high for me to handle right now.

I was heading around the roundabout and the driver of the Seat Ibiza just drifted into my lane without checking properly. I tried to brake, but there wasn't enough room to avoid the contact. We both stopped safely at the side of the road to exchange our details. My panel only has a minor scratch.

I was trying to park my car in a tight spot near the square. I reversed a bit too quickly and underestimated the distance to the concrete bollard behind me. I heard a loud scraping sound, and when I got out, I saw a dent and a deep scratch on the rear bumper. I've been driving for years and I feel so embarrassed about such a silly mistake. The car is functional, but the visual damage is definitely there. I have already contacted the city maintenance department to report the damage to the bollard as well.

I was navigating slowly down this narrow street when a delivery truck pulled out from a side road. I tried to swerve, but the side of his truck grazed my front wing. My indicator lamp is broken and there is a long scratch on the paintwork. I am really frustrated because the street is quite tight for two cars to pass. I hope this is covered, as it really wasn't my fault, the truck just didn't wait for me to pass by before entering the main road.

I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for a friend when I saw the two vehicles collide. The BMW was traveling at a safe speed, but the delivery truck exited the side street very suddenly. The front of the BMW made contact with the truck's rear side. The damage to the lamp and the scratch on the BMW happened right in front of me.

I entered the intersection on a yellow light, thinking I had enough time, but a car coming from the perpendicular road started moving before their light was fully green. We collided at a low speed. My front door has a large dent, and the window glass shattered from the impact. I am feeling quite shaken, to be honest. It all happened so fast, and the noise of the glass breaking was really loud and terrifying. I'm just grateful that neither of us was hurt during this whole unfortunate event.

I was waiting at the red light and as soon as it turned green I started moving. The Renault was already in the intersection and didn't stop in time. The impact caused a dent in their door and shattered the window. I am very upset because this is my only car for work.

Well, it was a sunny afternoon, quite lovely actually, and I was on my way down the EN125 to visit my granddaughter. Traffic was moving steadily, but then the car ahead stopped quite abruptly for a pedestrian crossing. I reacted, but my foot slipped slightly on the pedal, and I bumped into their rear. My headlamp is broken now. I am so terribly sorry to the individual driving the other car; I've been driving for over forty years, and this is the first time I've ever had a little mishap like this. It is truly upsetting.

I was travelling along the Alameda towards the stadium. I checked my mirrors before switching to the left lane, but I must have missed the blind spot, and there was another car there already. We made contact, causing a superficial scratch along my rear quarter panel. The situation involved a complete oversight on my part; I honestly didn't see him there. The other driver stopped immediately, and we exchanged insurance information in a professional manner. I feel quite silly, but at least nobody was injured in this incident.

I was circulating the roundabout, and I was in the inner lane. As I prepared to exit, a car from the outer lane cut across me suddenly. My front bumper hit their side. There is a deep scratch and a crack in the plastic trim. The oncoming driver claims he didn't see me, but it was all very chaotic. I am just trying to remain calm and follow the correct procedures for the insurance claim, though the whole thing is incredibly frustrating for someone who follows the rules.

I am not sure how this happened, I was signaling to exit and I felt a bump. I think the second vehicle might have been speeding up in the roundabout lane. There is a scratch on my door and a crack on their bumper.

I was stuck in heavy traffic on the Avenida during the afternoon rush. It was stop-and-go for quite a while. Suddenly, the car in front of me braked hard because of a cyclist crossing the road. I couldn't stop in time, and I hit them. My front bumper has a significant dent and the headlight lamp is broken. I have all the documentation ready. It was a pure accident, I was not distracted, just unable to stop on time given the wet road conditions today.

I was heading slowly along Avenida da Boavista during the morning rush hour. The traffic was stop-and-go because of the light rain. Suddenly, the car in front of me stopped abruptly. I slammed on my brakes, but I could not avoid hitting the back of the other vehicle. It was just a low-speed impact, but now I noticed a visible dent on my bumper. I am quite worried about the repair costs, honestly, because I have only had this car for a few months. I should have kept a larger distance, I know that now.

I was at a complete stop in the traffic queue near the roundabout when I suddenly felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me hit my rear bumper. We both pulled over immediately to check the damage. My car has a significant impact depression on the trunk lid from the impact. The other driver was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the entire exchange of insurance details.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving in the right lane near the Marquês de Pombal square. I was trying to merge into the middle lane to prepare for a turn, and I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I missed the other vehicle in my blind spot. I moved over slightly and felt a scrape against the side of my car. I pulled over to the side of the road immediately. There is a long, deep scratch running along my passenger door. I am feeling terrible about this, as I was distracted by the GPS instructions.

I was attempting to reverse into a parking space near the center of Coimbra. It happened to be a very tight spot and there were many pedestrians walking by, which made me nervous. As I was turning the wheel, I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar nearby. I heard a loud scraping sound. When I got out, I saw a dent and a large scratch on my rear wing. It was completely my fault, and I feel so stupid for not checking my distance sensors more carefully while parking today.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the Fiat backing up. The driver seemed to be struggling with the tight angle of the parking spot. I saw the rear of the car hit the concrete pillar quite firmly. The driver got out immediately looking very distressed and inspected the damage, which clearly included a fresh scratch and a dent on the rear body panel.

It was late in the afternoon and the sun was quite low, making it difficult to see at the roundabout. I was navigating the circle, intending to take the third exit. Another driver approached from the inner lane and didn't see me, turning directly into my path. Their tire clipped my front end. The impact caused my front lamp to be completely broken. I am really shaken up, man. I've been driving for years and never had a wreck, and this just feels so sudden and unnecessary.

Back in my day, traffic on the Estrada Monumental wasn't this chaotic, let me tell you. I was driving home from the market at a steady 40 km/h. I signaled to switch lanes, and I thought I had plenty of room, but a delivery van accelerated in the lane next to me. We made contact near the side panels. It resulted in a nasty scratch and a dent on my front door. I am quite sure I checked my mirror, but perhaps the speed of the oncoming driver caught me off guard.

I was driving straight in the left lane when the Toyota in the right lane suddenly decided to merge without sufficient clearance. I made an effort to steer away, but there was no time. The side of my van brushed against their door, causing a scratch and a dent on their vehicle. I managed to stop safely a few meters ahead, and the other driver pulled over as well to exchange information.

I was pulling out of a parallel parking spot along the Avenida 24 de Julho. I failed to notice the cyclist lane merging behind me, and I turned my steering wheel too sharp as I pulled out. I felt a bump and heard a crunch. My front lamp is broken and there is a noticeable damage to the quarter panel where I hit the bollard while trying to avoid the cycle lane. I am really stressed about the repair costs, you know? It's just a bad day for me.

Driving through Braga, the traffic was surprisingly heavy today. I was maintaining a distance of about 15 meters behind the car in front. However, when the traffic light turned red at the intersection, the car ahead braked very hard. I attempted to stop, but the road surface was quite worn, and I slid slightly, causing a light rear-end collision. There is a small dent on the rear of the car I hit. I have always prided myself on safe driving, so this is quite embarrassing for me.

I was waiting for the traffic light to change near the park. I was stationary for at least five seconds before I felt a thud behind me. The driver of the BMW behind me failed to stop in time. My rear bumper sustained a dent. We both got out and acknowledged that it was an honest mistake caused by the slippery road conditions. The other party was very professional.

The streets in Lisbon are so narrow, aren't they? I was driving along Rua da Prata when a delivery truck started to pull away from the curb. I made an effort to give it space, but I was caught between the truck and a stone post on the sidewalk. I scraped my side against the edge of the pillar, leaving a long scratch. It happened to be a very tight squeeze, and I clearly miscalculated how much room I had to navigate around the truck. I feel quite foolish about the whole incident.

It happened to be a beautiful day, but the traffic on the Marginal was heavy. As I entered the roundabout near Cascais, I was looking for the exit toward the beach. A small hatchback in the outer lane cut across my path. We sideswiped at about 20 km/h. My front lamp was broken and the side window glass shatter was everywhere, which was very frightening. My wife was in the car with me and she is still very shaken by the noise of the glass breaking. We just want to get this fixed.

I was sitting at the cafe terrace overlooking the roundabout. I clearly saw the Nissan SUV and the smaller hatchback collide as they were exiting. The speed was low, but the impact was direct enough to break the lamp and shatter some glass from the window. The drivers both pulled over immediately to the side of the road to exchange insurance details. It looked like a genuine misunderstanding of lane priority.

I was travelling along Avenida da Boavista around 9:00 AM in heavy morning traffic. I noticed the car ahead of me stopped quite abruptly because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to hit my brakes, but I didn't have enough distance and tapped the back of their bumper. I feel terrible about the whole situation because it was my mistake entirely. When I got out, I saw a dent on their bumper and a few scratches on my hood. I am honestly just so worried about how the repair process is going to work.

I had to come to a full stop suddenly due to the traffic signal and a pedestrian. The driver behind me didn't react quickly enough and struck my rear bumper. There is a noticeable dent on my vehicle from the impact. We exchanged all the necessary insurance details immediately after checking for injuries.

I was navigating the roundabout near the Casa da Música. I was in the outer lane, planning to exit toward the city center, when another car suddenly veered into my path from the inner lane. I did my best to steer away but we made contact. My front passenger side lamp is broken, and there are long scratches along the side panel. It happened so fast, man. I was just trying to follow the lane markings and stay safe, you know? It's really stressful dealing with this on a Tuesday morning.

I was attempting to parallel park in a tight spot near the luxury shops on Avenida da Liberdade. I thought I had cleared the car behind me, but I miscalculated the distance while backing up. I heard a slight noise and stopped immediately. When I inspected the rear fender, I found a deep scratch on my bumper. I am quite embarrassed by this, as I pride myself on being a careful driver. I have already contacted the owner of the other vehicle to handle the documentation properly.

I was sitting at a nearby outdoor cafe and witnessed the parking attempt. The driver of the Mercedes was trying to reverse into a space, but they didn't judge the proximity to the car behind them correctly. They ended up scraping the rear fender. It happened to be a clear, low-speed accident.

I was driving on the EN125 when a heavy truck beside me seemed to drift slightly into my lane. I swerved to avoid being pushed off the road, but the rear of my car clipped the guardrail. The impact caused a dent on the passenger door, significant scratches, and the glass of my wing mirror shattered completely. It was honestly such a frightening experience, and I'm just lucky I didn't lose control of the vehicle entirely. I've been driving for years and have never been so shaken up by a commute before.

It was raining, and the cobblestones were incredibly slippery. I was pulling out of a side street onto Rua Augusta and didn't see a motorcycle waiting in my blind spot. I hit my brakes, but the car slid forward and tapped their headlight. The impact broke the lens on their lamp. I feel terrible because the rider was just sitting there, completely stationary. I've exchanged details with him and we are filing this report as requested. I really hope the repairs are manageable, as I'm a student on a budget.

I was waiting to turn when the Fiat slid on the wet pavement. They collided with my front end at a very low speed. My front lamp is broken as a result of the contact. We remained calm and professional while exchanging insurance information on the scene.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was heading in the right lane and needed to move to the center lane to reach my turn. I checked my mirrors, signaled, and began to move over, but I failed to see the car that was also changing lanes at the same time. There was a loud crunch and we both pulled over. My rear quarter panel has a noticeable dent from the impact. I am so sorry for the inconvenience caused to the other driver. I suppose I was just distracted by the GPS instructions and didn't check my blind spot well enough.

My grandson and I were heading to the pharmacy in the afternoon. The traffic was surprisingly heavy for such a quiet time of day. I was keeping a safe distance, but the car in front of me slammed on their brakes for a stray dog that ran into the street. I pressed the pedal, but my reaction wasn't as fast as it was thirty years ago, and I tapped his bumper. You can see a dent and the brake lamp is broken on his car. I am so glad nobody was hurt, really.

I had to stop very hard to avoid hitting a small animal on the road. The driver behind me was unable to stop in time and collided with my vehicle. This resulted in a dent on my trunk and a broken lamp. The other driver was very cooperative and we settled the paperwork.

I arrived at the intersection and thought the light was still green, but it turned amber. I didn't want to stop abruptly in the middle of the junction, so I accelerated, but a van was already coming through from the crossing street. We scraped against each other. You can see a deep dent on my passenger door and a long scratch along the side. I am just really stressed about how this will impact my insurance premiums. I've been driving for two years and never had a single incident until now, dude.

I was visiting the coast for a walk and was trying to fit into a parking bay near the beach. I misjudged the curb and the bollard next to the space. I brushed up against it, which caused a scratch on my side panel. I feel very foolish because I should have taken more time to maneuver. It wasn't a collision with another vehicle, just the bollard. I will be contacting my insurer to arrange the repair for the cosmetic damage as soon as I get home.

I was travelling down a narrow street in the city center. Another vehicle was parked illegally with their door slightly ajar. As I tried to squeeze past at a very slow speed, they opened the door fully and hit my rear side. The impact caused a dent in my car body and the glass of my side window shattered. I stopped immediately and called the police to document the situation. It was a very unfortunate series of events, but I have gathered all the contact details from the other party.

I was checking my bags in the backseat and opened the door without looking properly at the oncoming traffic. The Audi was passing by and my door collided with their rear panel. This caused a dent on their car and shattered their window glass. I accept full responsibility for this incident.

I was heading home from work around 6:30 PM, and traffic was quite heavy near the roundabout. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I attempted to stop, but the road was damp from the earlier drizzle, and I didn't have enough distance. My front bumper hit their rear. I felt so anxious because it was my first time in an accident, you know? When I checked the car later, I saw a clear dent on the hood and a long scratch along the side of the bumper.

I was at a complete standstill at the pedestrian crossing when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The driver behind me couldn't stop in time due to the wet road conditions. We both got out immediately to check, and there were visible scratches and a noticeable dent on the back of my trunk.

It was a busy afternoon, and I was trying to merge into the right lane near the hotel district. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I misjudged the distance of the vehicle approaching from behind in my blind spot. As I began to turn the wheel, I heard a sharp scraping sound. I immediately pulled over to the side. I am very worried about the repair costs, but I just want to be honest about my mistake. There is a visible scratch running along the passenger side door.

I was parking my car in a very tight spot near the Praça do Comércio. I was trying to be careful, but I miscalculated the distance to the concrete pillar in the parking garage. I must have been moving at maybe 5 km/h, but I felt a dull thud against the rear quarter panel. It really ruined my day, honestly. I checked the area afterward and confirmed you can see a distinct dent where I hit the pillar. I feel terrible about being so careless while parking in such a busy area.

I was walking toward my own car when I saw this vehicle attempt to park. The driver seemed to be struggling with the tight angle of the bay. I heard the impact against the pillar and saw the driver get out to inspect a clear dent on the rear panel of their car. It was clearly an honest mistake during a difficult maneuver.

Back in my day, driving in Porto was much simpler, but today was just difficult. I was navigating the roundabout when I felt the other car nudging into my lane. I believe the other driver was in a rush and didn't see me clearly while navigating the exit. My car ended up with a dent on the driver's side door and a broken lamp on that same side. It is very upsetting, especially since I was just going to visit my grandson for his birthday lunch today.

Traffic on the Marginal road was unusually heavy due to the seaside construction work. I was following a car closely at around 30 km/h when they suddenly hit their brakes to avoid a stray dog that ran onto the road. I managed to react but could not stop in time to avoid a minor impact. My front bumper hit their rear. I noticed a large crack in my bumper assembly immediately after the incident. I am quite worried about the repair costs, as the BMW parts are usually expensive.

A dog ran out onto the Marginal road, causing me to brake abruptly. The driver behind me was unable to stop in time and struck the rear of my car. I got out to assess the damage and saw a significant crack on the front of their vehicle, though luckily, my car fared much better. It was simply an unfortunate, high-pressure situation.

I was driving along the avenue and attempted to change lanes to make a left turn. I used my blinker, but I think the second vehicle was accelerating in the lane I was moving into. We collided at a very shallow angle. I am feeling quite stressed about this because I have a very busy week ahead. My car has sustained a series of scratches along the rear door and a small, but noticeable, dent near the wheel arch. I have the insurance documentation ready and want to resolve this quickly.

I was backing out of a tight street in Braga. It was raining, and the visibility was quite poor. As I reversed, I didn't see the parked vehicle behind me clearly because of the heavy mist on my rear window. I nudged the rear of the parked car. It was quite a shock when I heard the glass shatter. I immediately turned off my engine and went to inspect the damage. The other car's headlight assembly had its glass shattered. I am terribly sorry for the inconvenience caused.

I was standing nearby at a cafe when I saw the Nissan backing out. It was indeed pouring rain, and the visibility was very low. The driver was moving slowly, but they unfortunately hit a parked car, resulting in the headlight glass shattering upon impact. I stayed to confirm that it was clearly an accidental, low-speed event caused by the weather.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was commuting during the peak morning traffic. Everyone was moving slowly, about 20 km/h, but the traffic flow stopped suddenly due to a delivery truck blocking the lane. I pressed my brakes, but the car behind me didn't react quickly enough and struck my bumper. It’s quite frustrating because I take good care of my vehicle. My rear bumper now has a significant dent, and the rear left indicator lamp is broken. I really hope the repair process is straightforward, as I rely on this car every day.

Traffic stopped abruptly in front of me. I made an effort to apply the brakes, but I was perhaps tailgating a bit too closely in the congestion. I struck the back of the Ford in front of me. There is a clear dent and a broken lamp on the back of their car, which I regret causing. I have accepted full responsibility for the collision.

I was travelling down Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM heading towards the city center. Traffic was quite heavy, stop-and-go as usual. I slowed down because the car ahead of me braked suddenly for a pedestrian. I managed to stop, but the driver behind me didn't react quickly enough and tapped my bumper. I felt a small jolt, and after checking, I saw a clear crush on the rear bumper. I'm honestly so stressed about the repair costs, I've only had this car for six months, you know?

It was raining, which made the roundabout at the airport quite slippery. I was in the outer lane, carefully navigating to take the third exit. A silver vehicle tried to change lanes from the inside and scraped against my rear quarter panel. I tried to avoid them by steering right, but it was too late. I noticed a visible scratch running along the side of my car. I’m just shaken up because I’ve never been in a crash before and I am worried about the insurance process.

I admit I made a mistake. I was in a rush to reach the airport for a flight and didn't check my mirror properly when shifting lanes in the roundabout. I felt the contact immediately and stopped as soon as I could to exchange information. I am sorry for the inconvenience caused by this scratch.

I was parking my car near a local cafe in downtown Coimbra. I thought I had plenty of space while reversing into the parking spot, but I clearly misjudged the distance to the concrete bollard. I heard a scraping sound and then a dull thud. Upon inspection, I realized I’d caused a dent and a long mark on the rear passenger door. It’s my own fault, but it’s still very frustrating. I would appreciate it if the insurance could help cover the bodywork repair costs.

I was driving along the riverbank in Lisbon around 7 PM. It was dark, and the street lighting was dim near the construction zone. A delivery van came into my lane without signaling and clipped my left side. My front lamp is broken now, and I'm very concerned because I need the car for work tomorrow morning. It all happened so fast, I didn't even have time to brake before the contact occurred. I hope this can be processed quickly so I can get back on the road.

I was checking my GPS to find the delivery address and drifted slightly over the lane markings. I missed seeing the BMW until it was too late. I heard the sound of the plastic breaking as my side mirror hit their lamp. I take full responsibility for the incident.

I was stopped at the red light on Estrada da Circunvalação. The weather was foggy this morning. When the light turned green, I began to move forward, but another driver ran the red light from the crossing road. They hit my side door directly. It was frightening because the impact caused the window to cave in and the glass shattered everywhere. I’m just sitting here in the car waiting for the police, trying to calm down because my hands are still shaking.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus. I saw the Citroën moving forward on green when the blue car sped through the red light. The collision was quite loud, and I clearly saw the glass shatter upon impact. The driver of the Citroën had no time to react.

As I was driving up the steep hill on Rua de Santa Catarina, I decided to switch to the right lane to pass a stationary delivery vehicle. I checked my mirrors, but there was a blind spot and I missed seeing the motorcycle passing. We made contact, and it caused a long scratch along my passenger door. I feel terrible about it; I really thought the lane was clear before I initiated the turn. I hope the motorcyclist is doing okay after the scare.

I was filtering through the traffic when the SUV ahead started to change lanes without seeing me. I tried to steer away but couldn't avoid the contact. My handle hit their door and left a scratch. It happened to be a close call, but I am unhurt, just shaken up by the sudden movement.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving in the center lane of Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo during the morning rush. The traffic was very dense. A car to my right tried to cut in too early, and their side mirror hit my car. It resulted in a long scratch along the side panel. Honestly, I find driving in Lisbon to be very stressful sometimes with everyone in such a hurry. I just want to get this sorted out with my insurance company as soon as possible.

I was walking to my office and witnessed the whole thing. The car on the right was definitely trying to force their way into the center lane despite there being no room. The contact was audible and left a clear scratch. I saw both drivers stop immediately afterward to check the damage.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Porto

statements.text: I parked my car in the street while I went to buy groceries. When I came back, I noticed someone had hit my parked vehicle. I noticed a visible dent on the rear wing and the taillight glass shattered from the impact. There was no note left by the individual driving the other car, unfortunately. I’ve been driving for forty years and have always tried to keep my vehicle in good shape, so it’s very upsetting to find it damaged like this while it was parked.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was moving at maybe 20 km/h when the car in front of me suddenly braked hard for a yellow light. I tried to stop, but I just couldn't quite make it in time, man. I feel awful about it, honestly. My front bumper hit his rear bumper quite clearly. It really scared me, and I'm just worried about how much this dent is going to cost to fix, you know?

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a significant impact from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the driver of the Volkswagen getting out. There is a clear dent on my rear bumper now. It was definitely his fault for not keeping enough distance.

I was navigating the roundabout at the Rotunda da Boavista, trying to take the third exit towards the city center. The traffic was flowing fine, but as I started to merge, a car came up on my right side quite quickly. I attempted to steer away, but there was just no space left. We ended up scraping each other's side panels. It all happened so fast, and I was quite shaken up. I just hope the scratch isn't too difficult for the garage to polish out for the insurance claim.

I was attempting to reverse into a very tight parking space near the Baixa district. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I misjudged the distance to the concrete bollard on my side. I heard a scraping sound, and then felt the contact as I hit the corner of the parking barrier. It left a visible scratch and a small dent on the rear wing. I am really frustrated with myself for being so careless today, especially since I was just trying to finish my errands quickly.

It was raining, and the streets were slick. I was changing lanes near Avenida dos Aliados to reach the turn lane. I looked in my mirror, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. I pulled over just as they were passing, and our vehicles caught each other. My front light assembly took the brunt of the impact and is now broken. I am so sorry about this; I feel terrible, I was really trying to be careful given the wet weather conditions this afternoon.

I was driving straight in the middle lane when suddenly the BMW attempted to merge into my path without signaling. I slammed on my brakes, but the impact resulted in their lamp being broken upon contact with my side. It was a very startling situation.

I was driving to visit my sister in Almada this morning, just enjoying the sunshine, when I reached a four-way intersection. I am almost certain my light was green, but another car entered from the cross street. We collided at a very low speed, but the impact caused my passenger side window to suffer glass shatter instantly. I am quite old, and this has left me feeling very confused and overwhelmed. I really don't recall seeing the individual driving the other car until the very moment we crashed. I hope everyone is okay.

I was maneuvering to park near the riverside at Praça do Comércio. There was a lot of tourist traffic, and I was trying to be patient. I crept forward at maybe 5 km/h, but I miscalculated the positioning of the vehicle in front of me. I bumped into their rear bumper, which caused a dent and broke my own lamp. It was entirely my error. I feel embarrassed, but I wanted to report this formally as soon as I could to settle the repairs.

I was walking past the plaza when I saw the Mercedes driver trying to park. It was very slow motion, but they clearly failed to stop in time and hit the parked car. It happened to be a minor impact, but definitely enough to cause the described damage.

The traffic on Avenida da República was backed up for blocks. I was trying to merge left because my navigation told me to turn soon. I signaled, but the car next to me accelerated, and I think I misjudged the gap. We made contact along the side of the cars, resulting in a long, visible scratch. I am really stressed about the insurance paperwork, dude. I've never had an accident before, and I just want to make sure I'm doing everything correctly for the report.

I was driving down Rua de Santa Catarina when the delivery van in front of me stopped suddenly to unload goods. I was distracted for a split second by my radio and couldn't stop in time. I hit them, which caused a deep dent and broke one of their tail lights, resulting in glass shatter on the road. I feel terrible about this mistake. It was such a silly moment of lost focus, and now I have to deal with the damage to both our vehicles.

I stopped briefly to check an address. The Ford behind me didn't seem to notice until it was too late. The impact was quite loud. My bumper is dented and the rear light housing has experienced glass shatter. He apologized immediately.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving along the avenue when a cyclist swerved into the road. I had to steer sharply to the left to avoid him, and I clipped a parked vehicle on the side of the road. It caused a nasty scratch along my door and broke my side lamp. I am honestly just relieved the cyclist wasn't hurt, though I feel bad about hitting the parked car. The situation involved a reflex reaction, but now I have to handle the insurance details for the owner of the other vehicle.

I was navigating the large roundabout in Gaia, heading towards the bridge. It was quite busy with commuter traffic. As I was exiting, a driver from the inner lane cut across unexpectedly to take the same exit. We collided at the corner, leaving a dent in my passenger door. I am really annoyed, but I suppose it was just a misunderstanding of the lane markings. I'm trying to remain calm while we exchange these details for our respective insurance companies.

I was in the middle of the roundabout when the Opel accelerated to get ahead of me. They moved into my space before I had fully exited. I could not avoid the contact, resulting in a dent on their vehicle's side panel.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, and the traffic was quite heavy as usual. I was keeping a safe distance, but the driver ahead of me braked quite abruptly because a pedestrian stepped onto the crossing. I tried to press the brakes firmly, but I just couldn't stop in time. My front bumper hit the rear of the car ahead, resulting in a visible dent on my hood near the grill. I'm really worried about the repair costs, this is honestly the first time I've ever had an accident like this, and I'm just so shaken up.

I was slowing down for a pedestrian crossing on Avenida da Boavista when I felt a sudden impact from behind. I checked my mirror just before it happened and saw the second vehicle trying to stop. Thankfully, it was only a minor impact, but you can see a clear dent on my rear bumper where the car hit me.

It was raining quite heavily this morning while I was navigating the Rotunda da Boavista. I was changing lanes to take the exit toward the city center, and I didn't see the van in my blind spot because of the spray and the low light. I felt a sharp scrape along the side of my car. I pulled over immediately to check the damage, and there is a long, deep scratch running along my passenger side door. I feel terrible about the carelessness, I should have checked the mirror twice given the weather conditions.

I was trying to park my car in a very tight spot near the shopping area in Rua Augusta. I miscalculated the distance to the concrete pillar in the parking garage. As I was turning, the rear corner of my car grazed the pillar. It left a nasty scratch and a noticeable damage to the quarter panel. I am so upset with myself, I have always been so careful with this car. I have already contacted my insurance agent to see how the repair process works, as this is a bit embarrassing for me.

I was crossing the intersection at Avenida dos Aliados when another vehicle coming from the side didn't stop at the yield sign. It was all so sudden, I didn't even have time to react or sound the horn. Their front corner clipped my front lamp, shattering the plastic housing completely. I was so anxious waiting for the police to arrive, I just kept thinking about my schedule and how I would manage without the car. Everything happened so fast, but I am certain they did not yield correctly at the junction.

I honestly thought I had enough clearance to pass through the intersection, but I misjudged the speed of the other vehicle. My front bumper made contact with their side, and I noticed their lamp was broken during the impact. I accept full responsibility for not yielding as I should have.

I was commuting on Avenida da República during the morning rush hour. The traffic came to a standstill, and I hit the car in front of me at a very low speed. My car sustained a dent on the hood, and unfortunately, some glass shattered from the headlight assembly during the collision. It was a hectic morning with the kids and the rain, and I just lost focus for a split second. I am fully prepared to cover the repairs and have exchanged all relevant details with the other driver involved in this incident.

My goodness, I have been driving on the bridge for over forty years and never had a mishap like this. I was traveling toward Almada, keeping at about 70 km/h, when a young driver in the adjacent lane tried to squeeze in without signaling. I steered slightly to the right to avoid a direct crash, but our side mirrors clipped. It resulted in a long, ugly scratch along my driver-side door. I suppose I should have been more vigilant, even if they were the one who made the sudden, reckless move into my path.

I admit I was trying to merge into the lane to take the exit. I turned my wheel before checking my shoulder, and I heard a metallic scrape. I pulled over as soon as I could to apologize. There is a scratch on the side of their vehicle from the mirror impact.

I was finding a place to park near the square, which is quite difficult on a Saturday afternoon. I reversed into a spot near a low bollard, but I missed seeing it because it was obscured by the low sun glare. My rear bumper hit the bollard quite hard, creating a significant dent. I feel absolutely terrible as I only bought this car recently. I have taken photos of the location and the damage to send to my broker. I just hope the repair isn't too complicated given the location of the impact.

I was navigating along the river toward the center when a delivery truck merged into my lane unexpectedly. I tried to swerve, but my side hit their rear corner. My side mirror was damaged and the glass lamp cover on my signal light is broken, along with some surface scratches on the panel. It’s been a very stressful day, dude, I have so much work to get done and now I have to deal with all this insurance paperwork. The driver of the truck was helpful, but I’m just really annoyed that this happened.

I was walking on the sidewalk near the avenue when I saw the truck pull into the lane. The Mercedes was already there and couldn't stop. I saw the lamp shatter and heard the metal scraping. It was clearly the truck driver's error as he didn't check his blind spot.

I was crawling through traffic on Rua de Santa Catarina, maybe at 10 km/h. The vehicle ahead of me stopped abruptly, and I touched their rear bumper. It didn't feel like a hard hit, but I stepped out and noticed a crack in their plastic bumper insert. I am quite worried because my car is leased, and I really don't want to explain this to the company. The individual driving the other car was calm, but I am anxious about the insurance premium increase. It was my fault for not keeping enough space.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: Oh, what a morning. I was running late to meet my granddaughter for lunch, and I suppose my mind was elsewhere while driving down the avenue. I saw the traffic light change to yellow, but the car in front decided to stop instead of accelerating. I slammed on the brakes but slid on the damp road surface. I hit their bumper, leaving a noticeable dent and a scratch. I feel so foolish for being distracted, especially at my age. I've exchanged information with the oncoming driver, who was very patient with me.

I stopped for the yellow light, and I was rear-ended. The lady apologized profusely and was very shaken. The impact was enough to leave a dent and a scratch on my rear trim. I don't think she was speeding, just failed to stop in time for the conditions.

I was on my way home from work around 6:30 PM, and traffic on Avenida da Boavista was really heavy as usual. I was moving at about 20 km/h when the car in front of me suddenly hit their brakes because a cyclist cut in front of them. I made an effort to press my brake pedal, but I didn't stop in time and tapped their rear bumper. I feel terrible about it. My car has a dent on the hood now where it hit their bumper. I have already exchanged details with the other driver.

I was stopped in traffic on Avenida da Boavista when I felt a significant jolt from behind. The driver behind me clearly wasn't able to react to the traffic flow. My car sustained a damage to the rear bumper from the impact. The oncoming driver was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the process of filling out the declaration.

I was navigating the roundabout at Rotunda da Boavista trying to take the third exit towards Foz. It was raining slightly, and the road surface felt a bit slippery. I was changing lanes to the right to exit when I miscalculated the distance of the car in the lane next to me. I ended up scraping the side of my front fender against their rear passenger door. It resulted in a long scratch on the paint. I feel so stressed about this whole situation, it was a total mistake on my part.

I was trying to park my Fiat in a parallel space on Avenida da Liberdade this morning. I thought I had enough clearance while reversing, but I turned the wheel too sharply and the rear quarter panel of my car caught the bumper of the car parked behind me. I heard a loud noise and stopped immediately. When I checked, I saw a scratch and a small dent on the panel. I'm really sorry to have caused this inconvenience, I've lived here for years and never had an accident like this before.

It was just a split-second thing. I was pulling out of a side street onto Rua Augusta and was looking left to check for trams. By the time I looked right, I had nudged the car that was slowly passing by. It was moving very slowly, maybe 5 km/h. I feel quite worried because I'm young and I've never dealt with insurance paperwork. My front bumper hit their side and their signal lamp is now broken. I feel absolutely awful about it, man, I really hope this doesn't cost too much.

I was driving down the street at a very low speed when the insured driver pulled out suddenly without looking. The impact wasn't hard, but it was enough to break the lamp on my side. I spoke with the driver, who was quite anxious, but we managed to exchange all the necessary documents and signed the report right there.

I was approaching the intersection on Avenida 24 de Julho. The light turned amber, and I hesitated. The car in front of me had already started to slow down, so I ended up braking quite hard. The driver behind me, perhaps not expecting me to stop so abruptly, hit the back of my vehicle. The force of the impact caused a crack in my rear bumper assembly. It was a hectic moment, and I'm just trying to make sure I get everything reported correctly as requested by my policy terms.

I was standing on the corner waiting to cross the street when I saw the traffic light change. The Opel stopped quite suddenly for a yellow light, and the vehicle behind tapped it. I clearly saw the impact occurred at the rear of the car, causing some visible damage to the plastic bumper.

I was travelling in the right lane on Rua de Santa Catarina. There was a delivery van obstructing the lane ahead, so I signaled to move to the left lane. I checked my mirrors, or at least I thought I did, but I didn't see the car coming up fast in my blind spot. I hit their front fender with the rear side of my vehicle. You can see a noticeable scratch and a dent on my door now. I am very frustrated with myself for not being more careful in such busy traffic.

The traffic on the bridge was backed up, as it often is during the afternoon. I was at a complete standstill when I was suddenly rear-ended by a large SUV. The impact was quite strong, and it shattered the glass on my rear windshield. My car was pushed forward a few meters as well. I'm quite shaken by the incident, but I've managed to clear my car to the side of the road to avoid blocking the bridge traffic any further while we wait for assistance.

I was trailing the Ford Fiesta when traffic came to an abrupt halt. I made an effort to brake, but I was following a bit too closely given the conditions and the speed of the traffic. I hit the rear of their vehicle, causing their rear glass to shatter. I accept full responsibility for the collision.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was pulling out of a parking spot near the office block on Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo. It was very tight, and I misjudged the distance to the pillar and the adjacent car. I ended up scraping the side of my door against the corner of the other parked vehicle. There is just a light scratch on both vehicles, no major structural damage that I can see. I feel really bad about it, I've had this car for years and never had a single scratch until today.

Navigating the Rotunda do Relógio is always a bit stressful, especially when it's busy. I was in the outer lane, and a car cut across from the inner lane without signaling. I couldn't avoid them and we made contact. My front corner hit their rear quarter, resulting in a dent on my bumper and a broken headlamp on my side. I'm quite upset about it, as I was driving perfectly fine, but I understand that these things happen in city traffic.

I was moving through the roundabout and thought I had enough space to move to the outer lane. I didn't notice the Nissan coming up from the side. It was a clear misjudgment on my part, and I take responsibility for the accident that caused the dent and broken light on the other vehicle.

I was driving down Rua de Cedofeita, a very narrow street. I was trying to maneuver past a delivery truck when I clipped the corner of a parked car. It was really slow, maybe 3 km/h, but the bumper of the other car caught the plastic trim of my wheel arch and caused a crack in the housing. I am so sorry for this, I was just trying to give the truck some space. It's been a long day and I'm really anxious about the insurance repair costs.

I was navigating home from work along the Avenida da Boavista when traffic suddenly halted. I applied my brakes, but I didn't judge the distance correctly on the wet pavement. I ended up tapping the rear bumper of the vehicle in front of me at about 10 km/h. It was completely my fault, man, I'm so stressed about the repair costs because the bumper has a noticeable dent and a deep scratch. I'm sorry for being distracted, you know, just a long day and I feel terrible about the whole situation.

I was stopped at the red light when I suddenly felt a firm jolt from behind. I checked my mirrors and realized the driver behind me hadn't stopped in time. When I got out, I saw a clear dent on my bumper and a long scratch along the lower plastic molding. It happened to be a clear rear-end collision.

I was attempting to park in a tight spot near the university. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I miscalculated the angle of my turn while reversing. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had brushed against the side of a parked car. I feel so embarrassed about it. There is just a visible scrape along the rear passenger door panel. I’ve already left my contact details for the owner because I want to make sure everything is handled properly and quickly.

I was travelling down Avenida 24 de Julho heading towards the bridge. A delivery truck pulled out from a side street without looking. I swerved to avoid a head-on collision, but I clipped the side of a parked vehicle. My car has a crush on the driver's side door and a very long scratch that runs to the rear quarter panel. It happened so fast, I’m still trying to process the events. I hope my insurance covers the repair for the side panel damage.

It was a bit rainy, and the road was quite slippery today. As I approached the intersection, the light turned yellow. I tried to brake, but I skidded slightly into the junction. Another car was already turning across my path. We collided at a very low speed. My headlight lamp is broken and there is glass shatter on the road from my housing. I am 68 years old and this is the first accident I have had in decades; I am quite distressed.

I was making a legal left turn on the green arrow when the Renault skidded through the intersection and hit the side of my car. I could see the driver was braking hard, but the road was too slick. My car has damage to the front wing, and there is broken glass all over the pavement from the other car's lamp.

The traffic was moving at a crawl on the Avenida da República. I signaled to switch lanes to the left. I checked my mirror, but I must have missed the motorcycle that was filtering through. I nudged them, and although they didn't fall, I noticed a visible scratch on my side mirror housing and the door panel. I’ve been professional about this, we pulled over immediately, and I provided all my insurance details to the rider. I want to ensure the scratch is repaired properly.

I was filtering through the lane as permitted. The BMW driver signaled, but they didn't wait long enough before moving over. I was sideswiped, resulting in a scratch on my bike's handlebar and the car's door. The driver was very cooperative and apologetic about the mistake.

I was crossing the bridge when the car ahead stopped abruptly for no apparent reason. I hit the brakes, but I wasn't at a safe enough distance to stop in time. My front bumper hit their rear. It resulted in a dent to my hood and a broken headlight lamp. I'm a pragmatic person, and I recognize this is my fault for not leaving a larger gap. I am reporting this now so that the insurance adjustment process can begin as soon as possible.

I was trying to squeeze into a parking spot on Rua do Ouro. I thought I had finished the maneuver successfully, but when I came back from the shop, I realized I had scraped the car behind me. I feel absolutely awful about it. You can see a noticeable scratch on their rear bumper. I’ve left my name and contact number under their wiper blade, and I am waiting to hear back from them to settle the damages.

I was sitting at the café table directly across from the parking spots. I watched the driver of the Smart car attempt to park multiple times. On the final attempt, they clearly hit the car behind them. I saw them get out, look at the scratch on the bumper, and leave a note.

Driving along the Avenida Luísa Todi, I was distracted for a split second by the view of the river. When I turned my head back, I realized the traffic had slowed down. I swerved slightly to avoid the car in front, but I ended up side-swiping the vehicle in the adjacent lane. It caused a dent and a long scratch along their rear quarter panel. I am quite worried about how this will impact my insurance premium, but I know I am responsible for the damage I caused.

I was driving steadily in the right-hand lane. Suddenly, the driver in the middle lane drifted over without warning. They scraped along my rear quarter panel, causing a deep dent and a scratch. It was clearly a momentary lapse of concentration on their part, though they were very polite after we pulled over.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista during the morning rush hour. Traffic was quite heavy, and the vehicle in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a cyclist. I tried to press the brakes, but I was going about 30 km/h and just couldn't stop in time. My front bumper hit the back of the car ahead. There is a noticeable dent and some nasty scratches on the hood where it connected with their trunk. I feel terrible about the whole situation, man, I really wasn't expecting them to stop so quickly like that.

I was forced to stop abruptly to avoid a cyclist who swerved into the lane. The driver behind me did not maintain a safe distance and impacted my rear end. It resulted in a dent on my bumper and some surface scratches. I have documented the contact point and exchanged details.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, heading towards the exit for the A1 motorway. I was in the outer lane when a white van, which I think was trying to exit too, just clipped my passenger side as they were merging across. It happened so fast, I didn't even have time to honk. I pulled over safely near the exit ramp to check. There is a long, deep scratch along my passenger door. I am just really stressed about the paperwork, you know, I've never been involved in anything like this before.

I was trying to parallel park on Rua de Santa Catarina, which is notoriously narrow. As I was reversing into the space, I misjudged the distance to the car parked behind me. I was moving very slowly, maybe 5 km/h, but I felt a small bump. When I got out, I saw that my rear fender had hit their bumper, creating a small dent and a scratch. It was completely my fault, I was just trying to get to my grandson's school event and I must have been distracted by the rain.

The traffic on Avenida 24 de Julho was moving quite slowly. I was in the middle lane when the car to my left decided to change lanes without checking his blind spot properly. He swiped the side of my car as he cut across. The contact caused the plastic housing of my side turn signal lamp to break, and there is a significant scratch along the side panel. It was quite a shock, really. I'm a professional driver, so this is very frustrating and inconvenient for my daily schedule.

I admit I did not notice the other vehicle in my blind spot while attempting to move into the center lane. The maneuver was poorly timed. The contact resulted in a broken lamp cover on the other vehicle and some light scratching on my rear door panel. I accept full responsibility for the error.

I had a green light at the intersection near the town hall. As I passed through, a taxi came out from the side street, seemingly failing to stop at the red light. I hit his front quarter panel. My front corner took the brunt of it; you can see a visible dent on the frame and the glass from my headlight unit shattered all over the road. Honestly, I'm just lucky I wasn't going any faster. The taxi driver seemed just as surprised as I was, so I don't think it was intentional.

I was standing on the corner waiting to cross. I clearly saw the BMW enter the intersection on a green light. The taxi driver entered the intersection too late and collided with the BMW. I witnessed the glass shatter upon impact and saw the damage to the vehicle's front corner.

I was parking in one of the tight spots on Rua da Prata this afternoon. As I pulled into the space, I got a bit too close to the concrete bollard on the curb. I heard a scraping sound and stopped immediately. When I stepped out to look, I realized I had left a long scratch along the passenger side doors. It's really frustrating, man. I've only had this car for a few months and I'm still getting used to the dimensions. I should have been much more careful.

I was travelling towards the hotel zone in Funchal. The tourist in front of me suddenly stopped in the middle of the road to look at the view. I was on my way about 40 km/h and despite my best efforts to slam on the brakes, the distance was too short. I struck their rear bumper. It pushed my bumper in, causing a dent, and the force caused my left headlight lamp to break. I've lived here for forty years and people always drive unpredictably, but this really caught me off guard today.

I am a tourist and I was unfamiliar with the local road layout. I stopped to check the GPS for my hotel, which was an error in judgment. The car behind me collided with my vehicle. It resulted in a dent in my rear bumper, and I observed a broken lamp on the second vehicle's car.

I was heading home from work along the avenue. I signaled to switch to the right lane to prepare for my turn. I checked my mirrors, but there was a blind spot and I didn't see the motorcycle until it was too late. I moved over and we collided at low speed. The impact left a dent on my door panel and some scratches from the handlebars. I feel terrible about the motorcyclist, even though they were fine. It was just a simple, unfortunate mistake during a busy commute.

Traffic on the bridge was backed up, as it often is. I was stopped in a queue of traffic. Out of nowhere, the vehicle behind me rolled forward and hit my bumper. It wasn't a high-speed impact, but it was enough to cause a dent and leave some paint scratches on the rear bumper. The individual driving the other car apologized profusely, saying their foot slipped off the brake pedal. It's quite annoying, honestly, as I have to take the car to the shop now to get it repaired professionally.

I was distracted by my children in the backseat and momentarily lost focus on the traffic flow. My foot slipped off the brake while we were at a standstill, causing my car to nudge into the vehicle in front. I accept that I caused the dent and scratch on the other car.

I was navigating through the city center, trying to navigate around the delivery trucks. As I passed a parked van, a delivery person opened their door abruptly without looking. I couldn't swerve enough to miss them. The impact caused a deep scratch on my passenger door and a long crack on the side mirror housing. I was quite shaken up, man, it happened so unexpectedly. I attempted to stay calm and talk to the delivery worker, but it was just a chaotic moment for both of us on such a narrow, busy street.

I was travelling home from work around 6:00 PM in heavy traffic on Avenida da Boavista. The flow was stop-and-go. The driver in front of me suddenly braked hard for a turning vehicle, and although I slammed my brakes, I couldn't stop in time to avoid hitting their rear bumper. My car hit theirs at a very low speed. I can clearly see a noticeable dent and some surface scratches on my front bumper. I am honestly quite shaken up by this as I have never been in an accident before, and I am worried about the repair costs.

I was stopped in traffic when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The individual driving the other car hit my vehicle at a low speed because they were unable to stop fast enough. There is some minor damage to my rear bumper, specifically a dent and some scratches, but thankfully everyone is physically fine.

I was trying to park in a narrow space near the Marques de Pombal square. I thought I had enough room, but I miscalculated the angle of my rear wheel while reversing. I hit the bollard on the edge of the curb. It made a loud noise and caused a damage to the rear quarter panel. I am just so frustrated with myself because I was being careful, but these parking spots in Lisbon are incredibly tight. I have already called my insurance provider to report the incident and get guidance on the repair process.

I was walking by when I saw the Fiat 500 reversing into a tight parking space. The driver clearly misjudged the distance to the bollard and impacted it at a low speed. It resulted in a visible dent on the rear panel of the vehicle. The driver remained on site to assess the damage.

It was a busy Tuesday morning heading towards the bridge. I was changing lanes to take the exit when a van in my blind spot didn't yield. Our sides collided as we merged. I was going about 40 km/h. I immediately pulled over to a safe area. It left a nasty scratch and a dent on my front left wing. Man, I was just trying to get to my meeting on time, and now I have to deal with all this paperwork. I just hope the other driver is reasonable about this.

I was heading in my lane when the Renault driver attempted to merge into my path too quickly. I didn't have enough time to react before our sides scraped against each other. There is a dent and some scratches on the side panel of their vehicle.

I was approaching an intersection near the university. The traffic light turned yellow, and I hesitated for a split second before braking, but the road was damp. A car behind me didn't stop in time and hit my rear bumper. My taillight is shattered and I noticed a significant dent in the trunk lid. I am a bit shaken and my neck feels a little stiff, but mostly I am just worried about getting the car fixed as I need it for my daily classes. This has been a very stressful afternoon, truly.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving down Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, and I signaled to change into the right lane because there was a delivery truck double-parked ahead. As I was moving over, the car already in the right lane accelerated to block me, and we ended up side-swiping. It caused a long, deep scratch along my passenger door. I honestly feel like it could have been avoided if they had just let me in, but I know I should have double-checked my mirror one more time. It's just a real headache to deal with this.

I was maintaining my speed in the right lane when the Nissan driver tried to force their way in without checking their blind spot. I didn't have room to brake safely without causing a pile-up, so we grazed each other. Their car has a deep scratch on the side.

I was visiting the beach for the afternoon. When I returned to the car park, I found a note on my windshield saying my car had been hit by a delivery vehicle. Sure enough, the rear bumper has a dent and a very obvious scratch. I am quite upset because the car was parked perfectly legally in a marked spot. I've been taking such good care of this car, so seeing it damaged like this is really disheartening. I suppose accidents happen, but it’s still very frustrating to find it damaged.

I saw a delivery van reversing into the space next to the Citroën. The driver miscalculated the swing of their rear doors and struck the parked car. They left a note but didn't wait. I saw the damage to the bumper—a dent and some light scratches.

Well, I was just heading home to see my grandchildren when the traffic stopped dead near the Saldanha square. I hit the brakes, but the car behind me didn't manage to stop. He bumped into me, and my rear lamp is completely broken now. Oh, it was such a loud bang! I got out and spoke to the young man—he seemed just as worried as I was. We exchanged all our insurance papers right there on the sidewalk. It is such a bother, but at least nobody was hurt in the process.

I was distracted for a second by my GPS and didn't notice the traffic had stopped. I hit the Opel ahead of me at about 15 km/h. It broke their taillight assembly. I feel terrible about it, but I have already accepted full responsibility for the incident to the oncoming driver.

I was heading along the main road toward the bridge. There was a lot of congestion. A motorcycle tried to filter between lanes, and as I was shifting slightly to avoid a pothole, I hit the handlebars of the bike. The bike fell, and the motorcycle rider slid into my side panel. It caused a dent and some nasty scratches on the passenger door. I am so worried for the biker, even though he said he was okay. It was a very tense moment for everyone involved in the traffic today.

I was pulling out of a side street onto Avenida da Liberdade. I checked for traffic, but I must have missed the cyclist coming down the bike lane. My side mirror clipped their handlebars, and the mirror housing hit the passenger window, causing the glass to shatter. I feel so bad about the cyclist. They were startled and fell over. I immediately stopped to help. It happened to be a genuine oversight on my part, and I am prepared to handle the insurance claim for the broken glass and any damage to their bicycle.

I witnessed the Mercedes driver pulling out of the side street. The driver didn't see the cyclist in the bike lane. The mirror impacted the cyclist, which caused the car's side window glass to shatter. The driver stopped immediately and acted responsibly by helping the cyclist get back on their feet.
