I got out immediately to check and noticed a long scratch along the rear passenger door. It's such a nuisance, honestly, I've had a long day and this is just the last thing I needed. I am really sorry about the damage to the other vehicle's paintwork.

I was sitting at the outdoor terrace of the café watching the street. I saw the Peugeot driver trying to maneuver into the parking spot. They were going quite slowly, but they steered too close to the parked car, resulting in a visible scrape along the side of the stationary vehicle. It was clearly an accident caused by misjudgment of space.

It was raining quite heavily on Avenida 24 de Julho, making visibility very poor. I indicated to move to the middle lane, and I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the other car was in my blind spot. We collided, and the force was enough to cause a dent, a deep scratch, and a lamp broken on their side. I feel so anxious about this; I've never been in an accident before and I really don't want my insurance premiums to skyrocket. I was just trying to follow the flow of traffic.

Back in my day, people were much more careful at intersections, but today the streets in Porto are so chaotic. I was approaching the junction on Rua da Constituição and, honestly, I think the traffic light turned yellow just as I was entering. The other car clipped my rear door as I passed through, which caused a significant dent and caused the glass shatter on their side window. My poor car is such a mess, and I just wanted to get home for dinner, but now I have to deal with all this paperwork.

I had a green light and was entering the intersection when the Ford accelerated through the yellow. They hit my side, which shattered the glass of my passenger window and put a large dent in the door panel. I am quite shaken up by the sudden impact, but thankfully no one was physically injured during the collision.

I was driving over the bridge when traffic suddenly came to a dead stop. I was maintaining a safe distance, but the car ahead of me braked so hard that I couldn't avoid tapping them. My front bumper has a visible dent now, and there are some scratches where it hit their tow hitch. I am incredibly worried because I rely on this car for my commute to university, and I really hope the repair process isn't going to take too many weeks to complete.

Driving along the EN125 is always stressful due to the narrow lanes. A truck was driving slightly over the center line, so I moved further to the right, but I clipped the bushes and then sideswiped a parked car on the shoulder. It resulted in a long scratch down the passenger side of the parked vehicle. I feel terrible about it, honestly. I've been driving for twenty years and I should have been much more aware of the surroundings. It's just a complete nightmare dealing with all this today.

I was walking nearby when I heard the sound of metal scraping. I looked over and saw the BMW had side-swiped a stationary car parked on the roadside. The driver was very visibly distressed and pulled over immediately to examine the damage, which was a long scrape along the other car's side. The driver of the BMW was very cooperative.

I was attempting to park in front of a shop on Avenida da Liberdade. I thought the spot was larger than it actually was. While turning, I misjudged the position of a concrete planter and the corner of another vehicle's bumper. I heard a crunch, and when I inspected the damage, I saw a dent in my fender and the other driver's tail lamp broken. I am so embarrassed about the whole situation. I will pay for whatever needs to be fixed, just please let me know how the claims process works.

I was driving through the historic center of Porto. At the intersection, I didn't see the stop sign in time because I was looking for a parking space. I entered the junction at about 20 km/h and hit the side of another car. The impact caused a large dent, several scratches, and even caused the glass shatter on their rear window. I feel so incredibly anxious; this is my first accident and I'm just terrified about what my parents are going to say. I know I made a huge mistake and I accept full responsibility.

I was proceeding through the intersection when the Citroën just didn't stop. They drove right into my side door. It caused a massive dent, paint scratches everywhere, and shattered the side window. I am very frustrated because I have an important meeting to attend, but I appreciate that the second vehicle admitted they missed the sign immediately.

I was on the roundabout in Funchal, and it happened to be a bit confusing with the tourist traffic. I moved to the outer lane too early and ended up hitting the front corner of a car that was already there. There is a dent and a scratch on the side of their bumper. I've been living here for a while, but sometimes these tourist-heavy areas get really overwhelming with all the erratic driving. I feel quite bad about the damage and I've already called my agent to start the insurance claim process.

I was heading home after a long shift at the office, caught in that typical afternoon congestion on Avenida da Boavista. Traffic was stop-and-go, moving at maybe 10 km/h. Suddenly, the driver ahead of me braked hard for a turning bus, and I just couldn't react fast enough. I touched his bumper with my front end. I feel terrible about it, honestly. I got out to check and it left a visible dent and some noticeable scratches on my bumper. It was just a stupid lapse in concentration, man, I'm really worried about my insurance premium now.

I was attempting to park near the square to meet my grandson for a coffee. I misjudged the distance to the concrete bollard on the edge of the curb. I was moving very slowly, maybe 3 km/h, but I heard a sickening scraping sound. When I got out to inspect the vehicle, I saw a long, ugly scratch along the passenger side door. I have been driving for forty-five years and I rarely make such silly mistakes, but the sunlight was really reflecting off the pavement, making it quite difficult to see the curb clearly.

I was on my way along the avenue when the car in the lane to my right started merging into mine without looking. I honked but it was too late. We sideswiped, and the impact caused a dent in my rear quarter panel and left quite a few scratches along the door. I am really stressed out, like, I only bought this car six months ago. I hope the repair process isn't going to be a nightmare, because I need this vehicle for my internship every single day next week.

I moved over because I saw my turn approaching. I really miscalculated how close the Peugeot was to my rear corner. I am sorry for the trouble. My car also has some marks, but I am mainly concerned about the damage I caused to the other driver's car.

I was backing out of a tight parking spot on a side street near the faculty. There was a delivery truck parked awkwardly behind me. I thought I had enough clearance, but I heard glass shattering and realized I hit the truck's rear light fixture. My own headlight also took a hit and is now broken. I feel so stupid for not having someone spot me, but I was in a rush to get to my lecture. It is just such an inconvenient situation for everyone involved.

I was walking down the street when I saw the BMW backing out. The driver didn't see the truck's protruding tail section. The situation involved a low-speed impact, but clearly loud enough to shatter the glass of the lamp. I stayed to make sure the driver was okay.

I was at a red light on a busy intersection in Braga. The light turned green, and the car in front of me started to move but then stopped abruptly because a pedestrian stepped out. I did not have enough room to stop and hit their rear bumper. It created a noticeable dent in my hood. I am honestly just feeling really worried about the repair costs, man. I try to be a careful driver, but this just happened so quickly, and now I have to deal with all this paperwork.

I was heading towards the marina area, looking for a parking spot. I signaled to change lanes to the left. I checked my mirror, but somehow I missed the vehicle that was coming up quickly in that lane. We made contact, and it caused a dent and some scratches on my front fender. It was my fault for not checking twice. I am a pragmatic person, so I just want to get the claim settled quickly without unnecessary drama. I have already contacted the other driver to exchange insurance details.

The Renault driver moved into my lane unexpectedly. I slammed on the brakes but the side-mirrors clipped. I have damage to my side door too. It was clearly a mistake during a lane change. No one was injured, thankfully.

I was delivering some documents to the warehouse area. I was maneuvering around a forklift parked in an alleyway, and I misjudged the angle. My rear lamp hit a metal post and it shattered completely. I've been working these routes for years and I'm usually very attentive, but it was just a really tight space and I suppose I was distracted by my phone buzzing on the dashboard. I need to get this fixed urgently because I cannot drive at night without a functioning rear lamp, obviously.

The road was narrow due to some roadworks. A car coming in the opposite direction was driving slightly over the center line. We both swerved, but the side of my car still clipped theirs. It left a long scratch and a dent on my side door. I was quite shaken, it's a beautiful road but the conditions are treacherous today. I just want to make sure the claim is handled correctly, as this is a relatively new car and I am quite meticulous about maintaining its condition.

I was walking on the sidewalk and saw the whole thing. The road is very narrow there, and both drivers were trying to give each other space, but it was impossible. The side impact caused clear damage to the Audi. I am happy to provide my details for the insurance report.

I was travelling my grandkids home and the traffic was quite heavy near the historic center. I was distracted by the kids talking in the back, and the car in front of me stopped for a pedestrian. I hit them with enough force that my headlight glass shattered and the bumper sustained a dent. I feel terrible because I am usually a very careful driver, especially with the little ones in the car. It was just a complete lapse in my attention, and I am quite worried about the repair costs for the headlight.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM when the traffic suddenly stopped for a red light. I hit the brakes, but the road was damp and I just couldn't stop in time. I ended up hitting the back of the car in front of me at maybe 10 km/h. It was really stressful because it's my first car, you know? I checked the bumper and saw a dent and a visible scratch right on the center. I feel so bad about the whole situation, man, I was just trying to get home.

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. I checked my rearview mirror and saw the oncoming driver looking quite panicked. We both pulled over safely to the side. Upon inspection, my rear bumper had a clear dent and a scratch from the impact.

I was navigating the roundabout at Rotunda da Boavista, staying in the middle lane, when another car suddenly tried to merge into my lane without checking. It happened so fast, honestly. I attempted to steer away but felt the contact on the passenger side door. I was really worried about my insurance premium, like, is this going to be expensive to fix? It resulted in a long scratch running along the side panel. I have never been in an accident before and it was quite an overwhelming experience for me.

I was backing into a parking space near Praça do Comércio this morning. The sun was reflecting off the cobblestones and I misjudged the distance to the bollard on my right. I hit it at a very low speed, but it was enough to cause some damage to the rear fender. I am so annoyed with myself for being so careless. It left a noticeable dent and a deep scratch where the metal made contact. I have already contacted my insurer to report the incident as I want to handle this professionally.

I was trying to turn into a narrow side street off Rua Augusta while it was raining quite heavily. A van was parked a bit too far into the road, and as I tried to squeeze past, I clipped the corner of my car against their rear bumper. I heard a loud crack, and when I got out, I saw that my front lamp was broken. It was truly unfortunate weather conditions for driving. I am just relieved nobody was hurt, though I am definitely worried about the repair costs for the light assembly.

I was walking down the street when I saw the Smart car attempt to pass the parked van. It was raining and visibility was poor. The car scraped the van and I saw the driver's front lamp break upon contact. Both drivers exited their vehicles immediately to check the damage.

I was driving along Avenida dos Aliados at about 30 km/h when I checked my mirror to change lanes to the right. I thought the lane was clear, but as I started moving, another car appeared in my blind spot. I couldn't avoid the collision. It caused a dent and a scratch on my rear door panel. I feel terrible about the mistake. I've been driving for years without incident, so this is quite stressful. I just want to ensure everything is sorted out correctly with the second vehicle's insurance information.

My goodness, I was just driving home from visiting my sister in Funchal, and the traffic on Estrada Monumental was much heavier than I expected for a Tuesday. I was checking my groceries in the passenger seat and when I looked up, the car ahead had stopped abruptly. I slammed on the brakes but slid into them. The impact was quite jarring. My front lamp is broken and there is glass shatter all over the pavement. I am quite shaken up by the whole ordeal, and my hip feels a bit sore from the seatbelt.

I was stopped in traffic on the main road when I was suddenly hit from behind. The impact was forceful enough to shatter my rear tail light and break the lamp casing. The driver behind me seemed very upset and confused about what had happened.

I was driving North on Avenida da Liberdade, staying within the speed limit, when a delivery motorcycle suddenly swerved into my path to avoid a pedestrian. I reacted by steering sharply to the right, but I ended up brushing against a parked vehicle. It created a long, unsightly scratch down the passenger side door. It was an unavoidable situation given the motorcyclist's dangerous move. I am very frustrated because I take great care of my car's paintwork, and now this has happened despite me doing my best to remain alert.

I was maneuvering through the parking area near the Campo Pequeno bullring. It was very crowded with people leaving an event. I was pulling out of a tight spot when I hit a low concrete pillar that I hadn't noticed due to the evening darkness. The impact was quite soft, maybe 5 km/h, but it caused a visible crack on my front bumper fascia. Honestly, I'm just so exhausted from the day and this is the last thing I needed. I am reporting this immediately to follow the proper insurance protocol.

While looking for a place to park on Rua de Santa Catarina, I misjudged the height of the curb and the overhang of a metal post while turning. It was really tight and the street was narrow. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had caused a dent in my lower door panel. I am really annoyed at myself for such a silly mistake. I have been driving for over forty years, and you would think I would know how to gauge these distances better. It's just very discouraging.

I was navigating along Avenida 24 de Julho heading toward Belém. I needed to move to the right lane because my exit was coming up. I checked my mirrors, but there was a significant sun glare at that time of day, and I failed to see the car coming up alongside me. We made contact, which resulted in my side lamp being broken and some deep paint scratch along the rear quarter panel. I am quite anxious about the claims process, as I really need my vehicle for work. This was purely an honest mistake.

I was driving in the right lane when the Renault suddenly merged into me. I sounded my horn, but it was too late. The contact broke their side lamp and left a nasty scratch on their car. I'm just glad we were both driving slowly at the time, otherwise, it could have been much worse.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM yesterday when traffic suddenly stopped. I tried to brake, but the road was damp from the earlier drizzle, and I slid a bit, gently hitting the back of the car in front of me. I am so worried about the repair costs, dude, it was just a small lapse in judgment on my part. My front bumper has a visible dent and a long scratch on the paint now, and I feel terrible about the whole situation. Hopefully, the insurance covers this without too much stress.

I was stopped in heavy traffic when I felt a moderate jolt from behind. I checked my rearview mirror and realized the driver behind me hadn't stopped in time. When I got out, I saw that the impact had caused a dent and some deep scratches to my rear bumper cover. We exchanged details calmly.

I was navigating the roundabout at Rotunda da Boavista during the morning rush. I was in the middle lane, and as I did my best to exit toward the city center, another driver moved into my lane unexpectedly. I swerved slightly to avoid a full collision, but we still ended up grazing each other. It was honestly quite scary, and I'm still shaking a little bit from the adrenaline. It resulted in a noticeable scratch running along the side of my passenger door where we made contact. I just want to make sure this is documented correctly for the repair process.

It was such a busy afternoon near the Baixa district. I was attempting to parallel park in a tight spot. I thought I had enough clearance, but I misjudged the distance to the parked car behind me and heard a small 'thump'. I got out immediately to check and realized I had made a small crush on the edge of their rear bumper with my own front corner. I feel quite embarrassed by the mistake, but I left a note on the windshield for the owner so we could handle it through our insurance companies properly.

I was heading along Avenida Luísa Todi around noon. The sun was quite bright today, making it a bit hard to see the blind spots. I signaled to switch into the right lane, but it slipped my attention the motorcycle coming up beside me. We touched mirrors and the side of my fender. There is a dent and several scratches on my passenger side panel. I am just really relieved that the individual driving the other car is safe and didn't fall down. It was a genuine oversight on my part during a standard lane change.

I was riding in the right lane when the car suddenly moved over without checking the blind spot. I tried to lean away, but the car clipped my handlebar and the side of my leg, then brushed against the panel. My bike has some minor marks, but luckily I am okay.

I was travelling through a narrow street near Praia da Rocha looking for a parking spot. I didn't notice the low-hanging metal post near the curb because of the shadows cast by the buildings. I took the turn a bit too tight and hit my side mirror against it. The impact caused the glass to shatter immediately. The situation involved a very clumsy mistake, and I am quite upset about it, but these things happen when you are distracted by tourists and looking for a place to park on a Saturday afternoon.

I was heading home from the grocery store yesterday, passing through Vila Nova de Gaia. I was following a car at about 30 km/h when they slammed on their brakes because a pedestrian stepped out. I pushed my brakes as hard as I could, but I still clipped their bumper. My headlight lamp is broken and it left a dent on my hood from the impact. I've been driving for years and I usually take great care, but I was just distracted for a split second by my daughter talking in the back.

I was walking on the sidewalk when I saw the red car collide with the back of the white vehicle. The pedestrian had walked into the road, causing the first car to brake quite suddenly. The driver of the red car didn't have enough time to stop, and I saw the headlight shatter on impact.

I was crossing the intersection near the Braga Cathedral. I had the green light, but as I moved forward, a van coming from the side didn't stop at their red light. They clipped my front corner, resulting in a broken lamp and deep scratches along my bumper. It all happened so fast, and I was just shocked by the other driver's recklessness. I am filling out this report as requested so that my insurance company can verify the details and assist with the necessary repairs. Everything is documented with photos.

It was raining heavily in Lisbon today. I was traveling south on Avenida da Liberdade when the car in the adjacent lane began to hydroplane slightly. They drifted into my lane, and although I moved toward the center line, we still made contact. There are long, visible scratches along my passenger door where our metal collided. I've contacted the other driver, and we both agreed to provide our statements honestly. It was just a victim of the weather conditions and we are both thankful no one was physically hurt during the side-swipe.

I hit a patch of water on the road and my car lost traction for a second. I tried to steer out of it, but unfortunately, I veered into the side of the Mercedes next to me. I've caused some scratches to their door panel, and I take full responsibility for the incident due to the conditions.

I was parking near the river in Coimbra. It was a very windy day and as I opened my door to check the curb distance, the wind caught the door and pushed it hard against the concrete pillar of the parking garage. It left a significant crush on the edge of the door now. It is quite frustrating, honestly, because I really pride myself on keeping my car in good condition. I will need to have a body shop look at it to see if they can pop the dent back out.

I was backing out of my driveway in Cascais early this morning. I must have been distracted by the neighbor walking their dog, and it slipped my attention the low garden wall behind me. I backed right into it at a very low speed. My rear light assembly is broken and the glass is completely shattered on the ground. I feel terrible about it, as I've been a careful driver for years. I am reporting this immediately so I can get the light replaced as soon as possible, as it is a safety issue.

I was navigating home from work around 6:30 PM, the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was really heavy as usual. I was trailing behind a silver SUV when traffic suddenly stopped dead. I hit the brakes, but I just couldn't stop in time, you know? I tapped his rear bumper. I feel terrible about it, honestly. When I got out to check, there was a visible dent on my hood and some light scratching across the front bumper trim. I'm really worried about how the repair process is going to go with the insurance company.

The traffic was at a complete standstill due to the rush hour congestion. I was at a full stop for several seconds before I felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me didn't brake early enough. We both exited our vehicles to exchange information. I noticed damage on the rear bumper, specifically a dent where the impact occurred and some scratches along the plastic molding.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, heading toward the A1 highway entrance. I was in the outer lane when a van suddenly cut across from the inner lane to take his exit. I didn't have much room to maneuver, and we brushed against each other. It was just a low-speed scrape. I checked the passenger side of my car afterward, and there are some clear, deep scratches along the rear door panel. It was quite stressful, especially with all the planes taking off nearby making so much noise.

I was trying to park in a very tight spot near the university. I misjudged the distance while reversing and clipped a parked car behind me. I heard a crunch and realized immediately I had made a mistake. My rear passenger-side lamp is completely broken, and it left a noticeable dent on the quarter panel right above the wheel arch. I feel absolutely awful about hitting someone else's parked car, but I wanted to be honest and report this to you as soon as possible so we can get it fixed.

I was driving down Avenida dos Aliados early this morning. A delivery truck in the adjacent lane started drifting into my lane without signaling. I tried to steer away, but we made contact along the sides of our vehicles. It happened so fast. When I pulled over, I saw a long scratch running from my front fender to the middle of the passenger door, and a small dent near the handle. It was just a genuine accident during the morning commute, everyone was just trying to get where they needed to go.

I was maneuvering through the narrow lanes in the city center. I must have miscalculated the lane width while checking my mirrors for a turn. My rear panel scraped the side of the Peugeot traveling next to me. I stopped immediately to assess the damage, which included a scratch and a small dent on the other driver's passenger door area.

It was raining, which made the bridge surface quite slippery. The car in front of me braked hard because of an obstruction ahead, and I did the same, but the person behind me just couldn't stop. They slammed into my trunk with quite a bit of force. The impact caused the rear glass to shatter into pieces and created a large dent in my trunk lid. I am quite shaken up by the event, as the traffic flow on the bridge is always intimidating, especially in such bad weather conditions.

I was traveling in the lane next to the accident. I witnessed the car in front braking abruptly due to the traffic density. The Toyota Yaris reacted in time, but the vehicle directly behind it failed to maintain a safe distance and struck the rear of the Yaris, resulting in a shattered rear window and significant denting on the trunk.

I was passing through an intersection with a green light when another driver pulled out from a side road without stopping. I tried to swerve, but the front corner of my car clipped their rear bumper. It was an honest mistake by the oncoming driver, though it was scary. My front-right lamp is broken and there are deep scratches on the bumper and side panel. I am quite upset, as I have had this car for many years and always maintained it perfectly, and now this happens.

I was pulling out of a parallel parking spot along the avenue. I looked behind me, but I didn't see the car that was slowly passing by. I hit their side door with my front bumper. It was a very low-speed impact, just enough to cause a visible dent in their door panel. I feel really bad because I didn't check my blind spot well enough. I have exchanged all my details with the other driver, and we are both very keen to get this resolved through our insurers.

I was navigating along the avenue when the parked Citroen pulled out right into my side. It was a slow impact, but I could clearly see a dent on my driver-side door afterward. The driver of the Citroen was very apologetic and admitted they didn't see me coming while they were exiting the parking space.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: My family and I were heading out for lunch near the Rotunda da Boavista. While turning through the roundabout, the traffic moved unexpectedly. I drifted slightly and caught the side of a delivery bike rider, causing him to wobble, though he didn't fall. My front lamp is broken, and there is a long scratch on the side wing. I am really worried about the cost of the repairs as I know BMW parts are quite pricey. It was a hectic moment, and I think I just lost focus for a second.

I was returning to my car after shopping on Rua de Santa Catarina. A neighbor told me that while I was inside, someone had hit my car while parking and then driven off, but luckily, a witness left a note with their license plate. There is a clear dent on my rear fender. It is quite frustrating to return to your vehicle and find damage when you were nowhere near it. I have already contacted the police to file a report, and now I am providing the information to you.

I was walking by when I saw a driver attempting to park in a tight space. They hit the parked Volkswagen Polo fairly hard before quickly moving on. I took a photo of the car and the dent left on the Polo's rear fender. I waited for the owner to return so I could provide the information I gathered.

I was heading along the waterfront area, the traffic was moving at about 40 km/h. I indicated to change lanes to turn right, but I didn't realize there was a cyclist or a car in my blind spot. I hit the side of a van. It was a glancing blow, but it managed to shatter the side mirror glass and left a scratch all along my passenger door. I am feeling quite anxious about the whole situation. I was just trying to follow the GPS directions, and I feel like I made a careless mistake.

I was driving in the right lane when the Audi merged into me suddenly. I hit the brakes, but we still collided. The impact caused the passenger-side mirror glass of the Audi to shatter upon striking my side panel. I also saw a scratch on their door. We both pulled over immediately to exchange our insurance details as required.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista during the morning rush hour when traffic suddenly stopped. I did my best to brake, but the road was a bit slick from the morning mist. I ended up tapping the back of the car in front of me at maybe 10 km/h. It was such a stupid mistake, man. I am really worried about how much this is going to cost me. There is a noticeable dent on my front bumper and some deep scratch marks from their license plate frame. I feel terrible about the whole situation.

I was at a complete standstill waiting for the light to change when I suddenly felt a jolt from behind. I checked my mirror and realized the driver behind me hadn't stopped in time. My rear bumper has a significant dent and there are white scratch marks across the plastic. It was quite a shock, honestly.

I was navigating the roundabout at Rotunda da Boavista, trying to take the third exit. I was checking my mirrors to switch lanes, and I completely misjudged the distance of the car already in the inner lane. My side clipped their rear quarter panel. I feel like such an idiot, I just didn't see them in my blind spot. My front right lamp is broken and there is a long scratch along the side of the car. I am so stressed about the insurance paperwork.

I was heading slowly along Avenida da Liberdade looking for a parking spot. The traffic was dense and moving at a crawl. A delivery van suddenly pulled out from the side without signaling properly. I tried to swerve, but I still made contact with the side of his vehicle. There is a long, ugly scratch across my driver-side door panel. It is frustrating because I was being very careful. I hope the repair process is straightforward; this is my primary car for work.

I was pulling away from the curb to merge into the lane. I thought I had enough clearance, but I suppose I underestimated the speed of the car behind me. We brushed sides, leaving a visible scratch on their door. I accept my part in this.

It was pouring rain in downtown Lisbon and the visibility was really poor. I was turning into a narrow alleyway on Rua do Ouro and I misjudged the turn radius. I ended up hitting a decorative stone pillar on the corner of the building. It happened so fast. My side passenger window had some glass shatter upon impact, and I'm really worried about the shards everywhere. My daughter was in the passenger seat and she is fine, but we are both quite shaken up by the sudden sound of the impact.

I was trying to park in a tight space in the underground lot at Parque das Nações. I was adjusting my angle to get into the spot, but I clearly turned the wheel too early. I scraped the concrete support pillar. There is a deep dent on the rear wing and several layers of scratch marks on the paint. I really should have had my partner guide me into the spot. It's embarrassing, really. Now I have to deal with the claim, which is just another headache.

I was walking to my own car nearby when I saw the driver trying to park. They were moving very slowly, but they misjudged the turn and hit the pillar. I heard the crunch of metal against concrete. There is a clear dent and deep scratches on the rear quarter panel.

I was coming home from the bakery on a bright Sunday morning. I arrived at the intersection of Rua de Santa Catarina and another side street, and I thought I had the right of way. I proceeded through, but another driver appeared out of nowhere. I slammed on the brakes, but we still collided at a low speed. My front left lamp is broken, and it resulted in a dent in the bumper. I've been driving for years and never had an accident like this, so I'm quite upset about it.

I was entering the intersection at a moderate speed. I saw the other driver, but they didn't seem to stop at the sign. We collided, causing some damage to my bumper and their vehicle. My front lamp is broken, which made it impossible to continue driving safely.

I was traveling down Avenida da República in Coimbra. The traffic was relatively light for the time of day. I checked my mirrors, or so I thought, and started to change lanes to get into the left turning lane. I could not spot the car in my blind spot and we made contact. It left a long scratch along the side of my car. I feel so bad because the other driver looked quite frustrated, and I totally understand why. It was just a complete lapse in my concentration.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: I was driving around the busy square in Porto. Everything was fine, just my usual commute. I reached for a bottle of water on the passenger seat for a split second, and in that moment, the traffic ahead slowed down abruptly. I hit the back of the car in front of me. I felt the impact immediately. It left a significant dent on the middle of my hood where it buckled. I am so worried about the repair costs, I really hope this isn't too expensive to fix.

I was just sitting in traffic when I felt a hard hit from behind. I checked my rear bumper and saw a noticeable dent in the metal. The driver behind me came out immediately and apologized, admitting they had been distracted for a second.

Well, you see, I was heading to my granddaughter's school event, which is why I was maybe a bit distracted by checking the time. As I was merging on the road here in Braga, I didn't realize how close the other driver was. We ended up scraping sides. It's a real shame, a lovely day ruined. My side lamp is broken, and there are deep scratch marks along the side. I just want to get this sorted out quickly so I can get back to my day.

I was pulling out of a very narrow parking spot on Rua Augusta. It was quite difficult because there were tourists walking all around the car. I was so nervous about hitting a pedestrian that I focused too much on the sidewalk and not enough on the bollard to my right. I hit it at very low speed. It caused a dent and some heavy scratch marks on the rear passenger door. It's honestly just very stressful navigating these narrow streets in the city center.

I was sitting at a nearby café table watching the street. The driver was trying to exit their parking space. They were clearly being careful about the people walking by, but they turned too sharp and hit the metal bollard. There is a visible dent and scratch on their car door.

I was navigating home from work along Avenida da Boavista during the evening rush hour. Traffic was quite heavy and moving slowly. Suddenly, the driver ahead of me braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to press the brakes, but I didn't stop in time and hit the rear bumper of the vehicle in front of me at very low speed. My car sustained a noticeable impact depression on the hood, but luckily nobody was hurt. I am really worried about how this process will work and the costs involved.

I was navigating the Rotunda da Boavista, intending to take the third exit. Another vehicle was in the inner lane and suddenly tried to cut across to exit, failing to see me in the outer lane. We made contact, causing a significant scratch on the side of my passenger door. I was quite shaken up, man. I've only had this car for a few months, you know? It's really frustrating when other people aren't paying attention on these busy roundabouts.

I was exiting the roundabout and did not notice the other vehicle in my blind spot. As I merged, our side panels brushed against each other. It happened to be a simple misjudgment of distance on my part. I accept responsibility for the contact, which left a surface scratch on both our vehicles. We pulled over safely to exchange insurance details.

I had gone to the Baixa district this afternoon to visit a friend. While I was attempting a parallel park on Rua do Ouro, I miscalculated the distance to the concrete bollard on the pavement. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had hit the curb area. My car sustained a dent and a deep scrape along the rear bumper. I feel terrible about this, as I am usually a very careful driver, but the streets here are so incredibly narrow and difficult to navigate.

It was raining quite heavily while I was driving down Avenida dos Aliados. I was changing lanes to prepare for a turn when a delivery van accelerated in my blind spot. I didn't see him, and as I moved over, he clipped my front corner. The impact shattered the lens of my front lamp. I am very anxious about the repair costs because I use this vehicle every single day for my job and cannot afford for it to be out of commission for long.

I was driving in the right lane when the insured driver attempted a lane change without signaling properly. I did my best to avoid the collision, but the passenger side of my van made contact with their front corner. It resulted in their lamp being broken. Visibility was poor due to the rain, which certainly played a factor in this unfortunate incident.

I was cruising along the Estrada Marginal enjoying the view of the sea on this beautiful sunny Saturday. I glanced at my GPS for a split second, and when I looked back, the traffic ahead had come to a complete standstill. I was traveling at about 30 km/h, but I couldn't stop in time. I struck the back of a parked delivery truck. The impact caused a dent in my hood and my right lamp is broken. I'm quite embarrassed about the lapse in concentration, frankly.

I was pulling out of a side street onto Rua da Rainha. I was waiting for a gap in the traffic, and when I moved forward, a cyclist suddenly darted past. I panicked and hit the brakes, and my vehicle lurched forward just enough to hit a parked car in front of me. The impact caused a crack in my headlight casing and the glass shatter on the other car's side mirror. I've been driving for forty years, but this just shook my confidence entirely today.

I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for the bus when I saw the whole thing happen. The driver was trying to join the main road and didn't see the parked car clearly due to the low sun. It was just a small bump, but I saw the glass shatter on the mirror and the headlight cracked. It was clearly an honest mistake, as the driver seemed very distressed immediately afterwards.

It was about 6:00 PM and the traffic on Avenida da República was gridlocked. I was in the middle lane, and I needed to shift to the right to reach the exit. I signaled and checked my mirrors, but I suppose the second vehicle was in my blind spot. As I started to merge, we made side contact. It was just a paint scrape along the door panel. I am a very pragmatic person and I just want to get this documented correctly so we can proceed with the repairs.

I was traveling straight in the right lane when the insured driver initiated a merge. I blew my horn, but they didn't react quickly enough to stop. We made contact between my driver-side door and their rear passenger door. Both cars only suffered minor surface scratches. It happened to be a standard traffic incident during the evening rush hour, nothing more than that.

I was driving along the waterfront in Lisbon. The traffic lights changed quite suddenly, and the vehicle in front of me slammed on the brakes. I was at about 40 km/h, and despite hitting the brakes hard, I hit their bumper. The front lamp is broken and there is a deep crack on my bumper. I am quite worried about this as I use the car for my commute every day, and I am not sure how long the repair will take at the garage.

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The other driver hit me at a relatively low speed. My rear bumper sustained some damage, and I noticed their lamp was broken during our conversation. It was a straightforward rear-end collision caused by the sudden braking necessitated by the traffic signal change.

I was heading towards Belém on Avenida 24 de Julho. A large truck was driving on my right and started to veer into my lane while trying to avoid a double-parked delivery vehicle. I tried to pull over, but there wasn't enough room, and he sideswiped my car. It left a long scratch along the entire side of my vehicle. I'm just so anxious about this; I work hard to keep my car in good condition, and now this has happened through no fault of my own.

I was forced to nudge left because a delivery van was parked illegally in the right lane, blocking my path entirely. I didn't see the car in the lane to my left, and we made contact. It was an unfortunate situation, and I accept that the scratch was caused by my vehicle's movement. We pulled over at the first available space to avoid causing further traffic congestion.

I was driving home from work along the Avenida da Boavista when traffic suddenly halted. I applied my brakes but due to the damp road conditions, I couldn't stop in time and tapped the car in front. I feel terrible about it. There is a visible impact depression on the hood and a long scratch where I hit their bumper. I was only going maybe 15 km/h, but it was enough to make contact. I am really stressed because this is my first accident and I'm not sure how long the repair process will take.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relogio, preparing to exit towards the airport, when a car suddenly veered into my lane without signaling. I tried to swerve to the right but we still made contact. My left front lamp is broken now and it resulted in a deep scratch across the fender. It happened so fast, I was quite shaken. The individual driving the other car stopped immediately, and we both checked our vehicles. It's just a genuine mistake in heavy traffic, but I'm worried about the repair costs.

I was in the middle lane of the roundabout and didn't see the Seat beside me when I moved to exit. I feel awful about the broken lamp and the scratch on their car. I accept full responsibility for the maneuver. I was just trying to follow my GPS instructions and got a bit confused by the exits.

I was trying to parallel park near the market on Avenida Luísa Todi this morning. I thought I had enough room, but I miscalculated the distance to the car parked behind me. I heard a scraping sound and stopped immediately. When I got out, I saw a long scratch along the rear bumper of the other vehicle. I waited for the owner to return so I could provide my insurance details. It was just a silly, clumsy mistake on my part while trying to fit into a tight space.

I was pulling out of a side street onto Rua de Santa Catarina. The sun was incredibly bright, and I didn't see the delivery van coming until it was too late. We collided at a very low speed. My front door has a significant dent, and the side glass shattered from the impact. I am just so rattled by the whole situation, you know? It’s embarrassing to admit, but I just didn't look properly before checking for traffic. I hope the van driver is okay.

I was sitting at the café terrace nearby and saw the whole thing. The Toyota pulled out slowly, but the delivery van didn't have enough time to react. There was a loud crunching sound when the glass shattered and the door dented. It looked like a completely honest mistake caused by the glare of the morning sun.

It was late afternoon on the Avenida Marginal. The traffic was bumper-to-bumper as usual heading into Cascais. I attempted to change lanes to avoid a stationary bus, but I didn't check my blind spot carefully enough. A car was already there, and my side panel collided with their door, resulting in a large dent. I am an experienced driver, but I simply made a lapse in judgment. I have documented the damage and exchanged all the necessary contact details with the other driver immediately.

I was coming down the steep hill on Rua do Alecrim. A taxi in front of me stopped suddenly to pick up a passenger. Even though I was only doing about 20 km/h, I wasn't far enough back. I hit their rear bumper, which caused my front lamp to break and left a dent on my bumper. My goodness, it's just one of those things, isn't it? I’ve been driving for forty years, but today my mind was just on my grandson's birthday lunch. It was entirely my fault.

I had to brake firmly because a passenger hailed me. The gentleman behind me hit my bumper. He was very polite and admitted he didn't pay attention. I can see his lamp is broken and there is a dent. I have my own minor damage to report, but this was a clear, unintentional incident.

I was navigating along the Avenida 24 de Julho near the docks. I was distracted by a large truck in the adjacent lane and drifted slightly to the left. I felt a brief scrape as I caught the side of a parked car. I pulled over immediately to check the damage. It is a long, ugly scratch along the side of the other vehicle. I am honestly quite stressed about how much this will cost to fix, but I want to ensure the owner is compensated properly for my error.

I was leaving the parking area near Praça da Batalha. I misjudged the turning radius while trying to exit onto the main road. I clipped a bollard with my front lamp. The impact was enough that the lamp is now broken. It's incredibly annoying because I was trying to be careful, but I just turned the wheel too early. I’m quite worried about the repair costs, so I hope my insurance covers this kind of clumsy accident. The situation involved a completely solo incident, just me and the bollard.

Traffic on the Avenida da República was stop-and-go. I was following the car ahead, but when the traffic light turned orange, they braked much harder than I expected. I didn't maintain enough distance, and I rear-ended them. I noticed a noticeable dent and scratch on my bumper. Man, I feel so stupid. I was just having a bad day, and this really tops it off. I’ve already provided my details to the other driver. It was purely an issue of me not keeping a safe gap between our cars.

I stopped at the traffic light because it changed to orange. The driver behind me didn't stop in time and hit my rear. We both got out to check. It left a dent and scratch on his front bumper. He was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the whole process. We exchanged details without any issues.

I was entering the Rotunda da Boavista when a cyclist appeared out of nowhere. I swerved to avoid them and unfortunately clipped the side of a van that was also in the roundabout. The impact caused a large dent on my passenger door and the window glass shattered. I feel terrible about the accident. I was trying to do the right thing by avoiding the cyclist, but I failed to see the van in my peripheral vision. It’s been a very confusing and overwhelming afternoon for me.

I was on my way around the roundabout when the Audi suddenly swerved into my path to avoid a cyclist. I had no time to brake. Their car hit my side, causing a dent and shattering their glass. It happened to be a very unfortunate situation for all of us involved today.

I was travelling home after work around 6:30 PM. The traffic on Avenida da Boavista was extremely heavy as usual. I was keeping a safe distance, but the car in front of me braked quite abruptly due to a cyclist crossing the road. I tried my best to hit the brakes, but I still rolled into the back of the car. It was really stressful, and I felt terrible about the damage. My car has a noticeable crush on the front bumper now, and I am quite worried about the repair costs for both vehicles.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal. It was raining slightly, and the road surface was quite slippery. I was staying in the middle lane when another vehicle tried to change lanes without signaling properly. I didn't have enough time to react before we made contact. There is a long scratch running along the passenger side door of my car. I'm honestly just shaken up by the whole experience, man, it happened so fast and I didn't see him coming at all.

I was merging into the roundabout and honestly, I misjudged the distance to the car next to me. I thought I had enough space to switch lanes, but I was wrong. I feel bad for the driver next to me. My car only has a small scratch, but I accept that it was my fault entirely. It happened to be a stupid mistake.

I was trying to parallel park near a cafe on Rua de Santa Catarina. The parking spot was tighter than I initially thought. As I was turning the wheel to back in, I miscalculated the angle and clipped the bollard on the curb. It was really frustrating because I was just meeting some friends for a quick coffee. My car now has a dent and a deep scrape along the rear quarter panel. I should have been more careful, but I was distracted by the heavy afternoon pedestrian traffic.

I was travelling along Avenida 24 de Julho heading towards the train station at about 50 km/h. When I reached the intersection, the lights changed to yellow, and I couldn't stop in time without skidding. A van turning left didn't check if I was still moving and we collided at low speed. My front left lamp is completely broken. It was a very confusing situation and I am quite worried about the insurance process because I have never had to deal with an accident like this before.

I was turning left at the intersection. I saw the light changing and thought I had enough time to clear the junction. I didn't see the Toyota coming through the yellow light. It was my misjudgment of speed and time. I am sorry for the damage to the other vehicle's lamp.

I was on my way on the Eixo Norte-Sul highway during the evening rush hour. Everything was moving slowly. Out of nowhere, the car behind me didn't notice that traffic had come to a standstill. They rear-ended me quite hard. My rear bumper has a significant dent and one of my rear lamps is broken. I am fine, thankfully, but it happened to be a very loud bang. I was just trying to get home to my family after a very long day at the office.

I was driving in the lane next to the accident. The traffic was very dense. I saw the car behind the Audi fail to slow down in time. It looked like the driver was distracted for a split second before slamming into the back of the Audi. It was clearly a rear-end impact.

I was cruising slowly near the city center. A taxi in the lane next to me decided to pull over suddenly to let a passenger out. I didn't have enough room to swerve, and we side-swiped each other. The paint on my driver-side door is scratched. The taxi driver was actually quite polite and we exchanged details immediately. It was just one of those unlucky city things, you know? I hope it won't be too expensive to buff out those scratches.

I admit I pulled over quite abruptly for my customer. I was focused on the fare and didn't check my mirror as carefully as I should have. The contact with the other car was minor but resulted in a visible scratch on their bodywork. I apologize for the incident.

I was enjoying a lovely drive along the coast on the Estrada Marginal. It was a beautiful day, but the sun was quite low. When the car ahead of me slowed down for a pedestrian crossing, the glare made it hard to judge the distance perfectly. I hit my brakes but couldn't avoid a light collision. My hood has a dent and a piece of the headlight glass shattered. I've been driving for years and I am quite embarrassed by this, but it was just a moment of bad luck with the sun.

I was driving in the right lane on Avenida da República. A car tried to move into my lane at the same time I was accelerating. I made an effort to avoid it, but they hit the side of my car. It's really frustrating because I just had the car washed and now there is a long scratch down the side. I am worried about how the insurance will view this since it was a lane change situation, but I was definitely established in my lane.

I am not sure if I checked my blind spot well enough. I thought the lane was clear, but as I moved over, I heard a scrape. I stopped immediately to check on the other driver. I suspect I might have been in the wrong here, as I was the one changing lanes.

I parked my car in a designated area near the square. When I returned about an hour later, I noticed a significant dent in my rear bumper. A witness who was sitting at a nearby table told me a delivery truck had backed into my car while trying to turn around in the tight street. It is such a shame because the car was in perfect condition. I am just really annoyed that the driver didn't leave a note and just drove off, even if someone else saw it.

I was having a coffee on the sidewalk and saw the whole thing. A large white delivery truck was trying to turn around. He didn't see the Mini behind him and backed right into it, causing the dent. He didn't even stop; he just kept driving away. I thought it was right to help the owner by providing this account.

I was navigating home from work along Avenida da Boavista during the evening rush hour. Traffic was quite heavy, and the vehicle in front of me stopped abruptly for a pedestrian crossing. I tried to brake, but I couldn't stop in time on the damp road surface. I hit the back of the car ahead at low speed. I am honestly quite shaken up by the whole experience. It left a noticeable dent on my hood and some light scratches near the grille. I just hope the repair process isn't too complicated, man.

I was navigating the roundabout near the Casa da Música. I moved from the inner lane to the outer lane to exit, but I miscalculated the distance to the car next to me. I heard a scraping sound as our side panels made contact. I immediately pulled over safely to assess the situation. There is just a long scratch running along the passenger side door. I feel terrible about the mistake, it was completely my fault for not checking my blind spot thoroughly enough while navigating the heavy afternoon traffic.

The individual driving the other car was trying to exit the roundabout and drifted into my lane without noticing I was right there. I honked, but it was too late. There is a mark on the side of my car. We exchanged details calmly and agreed to file the insurance reports immediately.

I was trying to park my car in a very tight spot near the square. While reversing slowly, I failed to see the stone pillar behind me until it was too late. I bumped into it at a very low speed. My rear bumper has a significant dent now. I am really worried about the repair costs as this is my only car. It was just a momentary lapse in concentration, and I feel really embarrassed about the whole incident. I checked the area for any other damage, but it seems limited to the bumper.

I was driving down the avenue and attempted to change lanes to make a turn. The sun was reflecting off the asphalt, making it hard to see the car in the lane next to me. I signaled, but the other driver was slightly ahead. We clipped mirrors and fenders. My front lamp is broken, and there are deep scratches on the bumper. I'm honestly so worried about this, like, I've never been in an accident before and don't know the proper protocol for the insurance claim, dude.

The BMW driver tried to switch lanes quite suddenly while I was already beside them. I did my best to steer away, but there was nowhere to go due to the traffic. Our cars made contact, resulting in a broken lamp and some scratches on my front wing.

I was driving to pick up my granddaughter from school when I arrived at the intersection. I thought I had the right of way, but I must have misread the signal. Another vehicle entered the intersection at the same time, and we collided at the front corner. My side window glass shattered from the impact and there is a large dent on the side door. I am quite shaken, my hands were trembling while I waited for the police to arrive. It happened to be a very unfortunate misunderstanding of the road signs today.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus. I saw the Toyota enter the intersection without stopping for the red light. The other car hit it on the side, causing the side window to shatter and creating a significant dent. Both drivers seemed visibly upset.

The traffic was moving very slowly uphill near the university campus. I was following the car in front at a distance of about 5 meters. Suddenly, the driver ahead did an emergency stop, and I couldn't react fast enough on the steep incline. My front bumper made contact with their rear bumper. I have a dent in the center of the bumper. It is quite frustrating, but I suppose these things happen in busy student areas. I will wait for the adjuster to review the vehicle at my earliest convenience.

I was proceeding along the avenue when a delivery van drifted into my lane while trying to reach a service entrance. I tried to swerve, but the van side-swiped my passenger side. The contact resulted in a long, deep scratch along the two doors and a small dent near the wheel arch. I am quite annoyed by this because my car is brand new, but the driver was very cooperative and we immediately filled out the amicable settlement form right there on the sidewalk.

I was checking my GPS to find the correct entrance and momentarily lost track of my lane position. I moved to the left and felt a bump. I realized I had scraped the Mercedes. I apologize for my lack of attention, which caused the scratch and dent.

It was a foggy morning in Ericeira, visibility was quite poor. I was maneuvering out of a narrow street and didn't see the post on the corner. I clipped it with my rear light, which caused the lamp to break completely. I'm honestly so worried about this because I have to drive to work every day and can't afford to have the car in the shop for too long, you know? It's just really stressful when these things happen out of nowhere like that, man.

I was entering the roundabout and the car in front of me hesitated and then stopped unexpectedly. I was looking to my left to check for incoming traffic, and by the time I looked forward, I had already tapped their rear bumper. My front bumper has a minor dent and some scratches. It was a stupid mistake, and I regret not being more focused. I have been driving for over forty years and I feel quite foolish about this whole thing today.

I stopped at the roundabout because the traffic hadn't cleared yet. The Nissan behind me didn't notice I was stationary and bumped into my bumper. My car suffered a dent and scratches on the rear plastic trim.

I was traveling at about 30 km/h on the avenue. I signaled to change lanes to overtake a bus. As I started to merge, another driver accelerated quickly from behind in the next lane. We made contact near the side mirror, which caused the side window glass to shatter and left deep scratches on my door panels. It happened so fast that I barely had time to react. I am very concerned about the glass repair since it's an electric vehicle and the sensors are integrated there.

I was sitting at a nearby cafe terrace. I clearly saw the Tesla indicate to change lanes. The other car accelerated into the gap and they collided. I heard the glass shatter and saw the scratches on the Tesla's door.

I was navigating the roundabout near the Casa da Música, trying to exit towards Avenida da Boavista. Traffic was quite heavy for a Tuesday morning. As I was maintaining my lane, a dark sedan drifted too close on my right side. I tried to steer away, but we made contact. My front passenger side door has a noticeable dent and some deep scratch marks. I am just really stressed about how this will affect my insurance premium, you know? It all happened so fast, I was just trying to get to work.

I was attempting to exit the roundabout and misjudged the distance between our cars. I accept full responsibility for the lane change maneuver. My vehicle impacted the side of the other driver's car. I am very sorry for the inconvenience caused today.

I was pulling into a narrow street parking spot near the Baixa district. The sun was reflecting off the shop windows, which made it quite difficult to see exactly how close I was to the car parked in front of me. I thought I had cleared it, but I heard a scraping noise. I stepped out and found a scratch along my rear bumper. I feel terrible about it; I've never hit a parked car before and I'm honestly quite embarrassed by the whole situation.

I was heading down toward the city center when traffic stopped very suddenly in front of me. I slammed on my brakes, but the road was a bit damp and I just couldn't stop in time. I bumped into the back of a blue hatchback. I got out to check and saw that I had caused a dent on my bumper and my right front lamp is broken. I feel absolutely awful about it, man. I was just distracted for a second looking at my GPS.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus when I saw the Peugeot fail to stop in time behind the other vehicle. The road was slick from the morning mist. It was a clear rear-end collision at low speed.

I was driving along the coast road, enjoying the nice weather with my wife, when a motorcycle tried to squeeze through a gap between me and the central barrier. I did not see him in my side mirror until it was too late. He scraped along the side of my car. There is a long scratch and a dent on my rear fender. I am just really concerned about the repair costs, as the car is fairly new and I have always been very careful with it.

It was about 6:00 PM and the traffic was extremely dense. I was in the middle lane when the driver in the adjacent lane suddenly decided to merge into my space without signaling. I honked my horn but there was no time to maneuver away. We made side-to-side contact. I have a dent on my front left wheel arch now. It is incredibly frustrating to deal with this at the end of such a long work day, but I am just glad no one was physically hurt in the collision.

I apologize, but I did not check my blind spot before moving to the middle lane to reach my exit. I heard the horn but it was already too late to avoid the impact. I have accepted the fault for the incident.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: Well, I was going to pick up my granddaughter from school, just like I do every afternoon. I was turning into the parking area, and perhaps I misjudged the height of the concrete bollard on the curb. I heard a sickening sound. It seems I hit the edge of the barrier quite hard. There is a crack in the plastic bumper and some glass shatter from the indicator light. My eyes aren't what they used to be, and the glare from the afternoon sun really made it quite hard to see the pavement.

I was crossing the bridge heading south. Traffic was stop-and-go as usual during the peak hour. I was looking for a radio station when the car ahead braked very sharply. I did not react in time and nudged his bumper. It is my fault, absolutely. My front lamp is broken and there is a dent on the hood. I am just so worried about how much this is going to cost to fix, and I am quite anxious about the claims process. I really should have been paying better attention to the road.

I was stationary in traffic on the bridge when I felt a sudden impact from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the driver of the Yaris had hit me. We both pulled over to the shoulder immediately to exchange information.

I was trying to park in one of the tight spots on this busy shopping street. I am quite experienced at parking, but this spot was unusually narrow. As I was backing in, I miscalculated the angle and grazed the side of a delivery van parked nearby. It left a long, ugly scratch along my driver-side door. I feel absolutely terrible about hitting another person's vehicle. I have already left my contact details on their windshield in case they return before I get this sorted out with the insurance company.

I was navigating the roundabout near the stadium. A van was on my left, and as we were going around, it started to cut into my lane. I swerved to avoid a major collision, but I still made contact with the rear of his vehicle. I have a dent on my side panel, a deep scratch, and my indicator lamp is broken. I am honestly shaken up by the event. I have been driving for twenty years and never had an accident like this before; it's very stressful.

I was walking my dog near the roundabout and witnessed the collision. The van driver definitely encroached on the other lane while taking the turn too sharply, causing the BMW to swerve and hit him. It was definitely accidental.

I was driving home from a meeting, keeping to the right lane. The traffic was flowing at a steady 40 km/h. Suddenly, a taxi to my left tried to move into my lane to pick up a passenger. I didn't have enough time to react. The side of his bumper rubbed against my side, leaving a long scratch along my door. I was quite frustrated as I am usually very cautious. It's just a nuisance to deal with the paperwork, but thankfully it was only a minor cosmetic scrape.

I was navigating around the roundabout near Boavista when the traffic suddenly slowed down. I tried to stay in my lane, but a white van in the lane to my right drifted inward while trying to take the exit toward Avenida da Boavista. I heard a scraping sound against my passenger side door. I was going very slow, maybe 15 km/h, but the contact left a clear scratch on my car. I feel terrible about this because I have never had an accident before, and I am really worried about how much this is going to cost.

I was exiting the roundabout and honestly didn't see the car in my blind spot. I moved over slightly to make the turn and we made contact. The situation involved a low-speed scrape, and I am sorry for the trouble.

It was raining quite hard this morning near the Cais do Sodré area. The car in front of me stopped suddenly for a pedestrian who stepped off the curb, so I braked firmly. Unfortunately, the driver behind me didn't react in time and bumped into my rear bumper. My taillight is definitely broken and it resulted in a visible impact depression on the bumper panel. I am just really shaken up by the whole experience because the streets are so slippery today with the storm, and I hate dealing with all these forms.

I was looking for a parking spot on this narrow street and misjudged the distance to a concrete planter while reversing. I was going extremely slowly, practically idling, but I clearly miscalculated the angle. I heard a crunching noise against the rear quarter panel and realized I had caused a dent and a deep scratch. It is so frustrating because I usually pride myself on being a careful driver, but the visibility here is tricky with all the shoppers around. I just want to get this repaired properly without too much delay.

I was driving along Avenida da República, heading towards the marina, and maintaining a steady speed of about 30 km/h. Another driver attempted a lane change without signaling and clipped my driver-side mirror, which then caused a long scratch down the side of my door. Everything happened so fast, and the other driver seemed just as surprised as I was. It's a real headache dealing with the insurance paperwork, especially when I have so much work to finish today. I just hope the repair process is straightforward.

I admit I was distracted by my GPS and moved into the lane without checking my mirrors correctly. I felt a slight jolt when I realized I was too close to the other vehicle. I apologize for the scratch.

My goodness, it was quite a typical Tuesday morning, I was on my way to visit my daughter in Foz, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was just crawling along as it usually does. I was keeping a safe distance, but the young man behind me simply didn't notice that traffic had come to a full stop. He bumped right into the back of my Volvo. It left a significant dent on the tailgate. I told him not to worry, accidents happen to everyone, but I do need to report it for the repairs.

I was parking near the hotel area on Estrada Monumental. I thought I had plenty of room, but there was a sharp curb I missed seeing properly. As I backed up, the rear bumper caught a metal signpost, which resulted in a long, ugly scratch across the paintwork. I feel so silly about it; I've been driving for years and never had a simple parking error like this. The car is otherwise in perfect condition, and I hope this small damage doesn't impact my insurance rating too negatively.

I was exiting the roundabout near the stadium. I checked my mirrors, but a motorcycle was coming up very fast in the lane beside me. When I started my turn, the rider tried to pass in the gap that was closing. He swiped my front corner and broke the fog lamp unit. I stopped immediately, and thankfully the motorcyclist was fine, just a bit shaken up. It was a very unfortunate misunderstanding of intentions on the road. I am just really concerned about the repair costs, as I have limited coverage.

I was travelling through the narrow streets of downtown Lisbon. A tourist opened his car door right into the path of my vehicle as I was passing by at about 20 km/h. My passenger side mirror hit the edge of the door, and the impact caused my passenger side window glass to shatter completely. It was quite a shock, honestly. I've lived here a long time, and you have to be so careful with people opening doors suddenly, but this just happened too quickly to avoid. I am really worried about the glass shards.

I was navigating the roundabout and signalized my exit, but I failed to notice the Peugeot in my blind spot as I transitioned lanes. I apologize for the contact. My passenger side panel sustained some scratches and a small dent where we brushed against each other at low speed.

I was driving home from work along the waterfront when I reached the intersection. The light turned yellow, and I hesitated. The car behind me didn't anticipate the stop and nudged my rear end. I am quite shaken up by the whole experience, as I have never been in an accident before. I just want to ensure everything is processed correctly through my insurance.

I was cruising along the coast road toward Cascais. A motorcyclist was overtaking me on the left and seemingly lost control slightly due to the coastal wind, brushing against my side mirror. I was passing the car when a sudden gust of wind pushed me toward the vehicle. I clipped the mirror and lost some balance but managed to stay upright. I stopped immediately to assist the driver. My handlebar hit their door, causing the damage we discussed.

It was late in the evening and the street lighting on Rua do Ouro was quite dim. As I was maneuvering into a parking spot, I misjudged the proximity to a concrete pillar. statements.text: I was stopped in traffic on this main avenue when I heard a loud noise behind me. Before I could even react, another car struck the back of my vehicle. The impact was quite jarring. I was distracted for a split second by my navigation system and failed to notice the traffic had stopped. I hit the back of the Volkswagen at low speed. I take full responsibility for the accident and the damage to the tail lamp and the hatch.

I was exiting the roundabout near the Serralves Museum when another vehicle merged into my lane unexpectedly. We were both moving at a slow pace of about 20 km/h, but we still ended up colliding. It was raining, the road surface was quite slick, and I was trailing a larger SUV on the Estrada da Circunvalação. The impact caused the rear glass to shatter completely. I was so surprised and confused for a moment, wondering what had happened. The other driver apologized immediately, but my car is in a bad state now. It has been such a long, exhausting day and I just want this settled.

I was riding in the left lane when the car suddenly swerved toward me. I moved to the edge of the lane to avoid a fall, and that's when the side of the car made contact with my handlebar, causing a scratch along the door panel. It was quite scary, to be honest.

My bumper has a noticeable dent and several deep scratches from the impact. I am so upset with myself. My daughter has been warning me about the visibility in this car, and I guess she was right. I just want to get the repairs sorted as soon as possible so I can drive comfortably again.

I was on my way down the narrow Rua Augusta when a cyclist swerved into the middle of the road. To avoid hitting them, I had to veer to the right and I grazed the stone wall of a building. It wasn't a hard hit, but it was enough to break my rear lamp. I’m just relieved the cyclist didn't get hurt. My insurance paperwork is ready, and I have photos of the broken lamp. It’s been a very long day and I’m just exhausted from dealing with all this.

I was stopped at a red light on Avenida da Republica. The driver behind me was clearly distracted by their phone or something, and they didn't see the light had turned red. They slammed into the back of my Audi. The impact was quite significant. My bumper is dented, there are deep scratches, and the glass from my tail light completely shattered. I am a very cautious driver, so I’m quite frustrated that this happened while I was fully stopped and waiting legally at the traffic signal.

I am deeply sorry. I looked down at my GPS for a split second and didn't notice the Audi had stopped. I hit them at about 20 km/h. My front is damaged, and I caused a dent, scratches, and broken glass on their rear light. I accept full responsibility for this incident.

I was driving slowly towards the traffic lights near the Serralves Museum when the car in front of me suddenly stopped. I tried to brake, but the road was damp from the morning drizzle and I didn't stop in time. My front bumper hit their rear bumper. I feel terrible about it, honestly, it was just a lapse in concentration. I checked my car and there is a visible damage to the hood near the grill. I'm really worried about my insurance premiums going up after this, you know?

I was navigating the roundabout, moving from the inner lane to exit towards Avenida de França. I suppose I misjudged the distance because I felt a slight scrape against a van that was already in the outer lane. It was my fault entirely, I was just a bit confused by the heavy mid-morning traffic. I stopped immediately to exchange details. You can see a long scratch along the passenger side door of my Peugeot. I'm just so stressed about the repair costs, man, this is the last thing I need right now.

I was travelling through the roundabout when the Peugeot driver suddenly pulled out of the inner lane without signaling properly. They grazed the side of my van. It was a low-speed impact, but clearly enough to leave a scratch on their vehicle. We pulled over safely just past the roundabout exit to settle the insurance paperwork.

I was attempting to reverse into a tight parking spot near a cafe on Avenida da Liberdade. I was trying to be careful, but it slipped my attention a bollard behind me as clearly as I thought. I hit it at a very low speed. It resulted in a noticeable dent on my rear tailgate and a deep scratch in the paintwork. I am quite embarrassed by this, it was a simple mistake while running errands for my family this afternoon. I've been driving for years and rarely have these kinds of mishaps.

I was moving from the left lane to the right lane to prepare for a turn near the river. I checked my mirrors, but I must have missed the car in my blind spot. We made contact, and my driver-side headlight was struck during the maneuver. The lamp is definitely broken now. I am very anxious about the legal process here; I really hope the oncoming driver is okay. Everything happened so fast in the afternoon rush, I feel quite shaken by the whole experience.

I was traveling straight in the right lane when the Seat attempted to change lanes without seeing me. They hit my front fender and their own headlamp unit broke upon impact. We both pulled over immediately to ensure we were not blocking traffic and exchanged our insurance information.

I was cruising along the Marginal road enjoying the view of the sea. Traffic suddenly slowed down, and while I braked, the car behind me failed to react in time. They slammed into my rear bumper quite hard. The impact caused a large dent in the boot lid and the rear tail lamp is broken. I have been driving this route for twenty years, and honestly, I have never seen such a sudden backup. I am currently waiting for the tow truck as the car is not drivable.

I was looking at the scenery for a split second too long and didn't notice the BMW had stopped ahead of me. I hit them at about 30 km/h. I feel terrible about damaging their car. I broke my own bumper and damaged their rear lamp and body panel. I take full responsibility for the accident.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving down the avenue when the vehicle to my right swerved to avoid a cyclist. They came into my lane and side-swiped my passenger door. It resulted in a long, deep scratch along the side panel. It was a difficult situation because of the cyclist, but it’s still frustrating. I don't really know how these claims work, but I hope it's straightforward. I’m quite worried that the repair will take a long time, as I need the car for my commute every single day.

I was walking on the sidewalk near the intersection when I saw the car to the right swerve abruptly to avoid a bicycle. The driver didn't check their mirror and hit the Audi traveling in the next lane. It was a clear side-swipe, very unfortunate for both parties involved. I waited to provide my contact details as a witness.

It was a very busy afternoon at the Praça do Comércio. I was trying to maneuver out of a parking spot and misjudged the distance to a concrete planter. I backed into it at a very low speed, maybe 5 km/h. I felt a bump and realized I had put a dent in my rear bumper. I'm usually very cautious, but I was just distracted by the tourists and the general noise of the square. I have informed the local authorities as well to be safe.

I entered the intersection, believing I had the right of way, but another vehicle came from the side. We collided at the corner. My front headlight is completely broken, and there is glass shattered all over the road from the impact. I am so worried about the costs, man.
