This is my first real accident in this city, and it’s honestly quite a stressful situation. I just want to make sure the claim is handled correctly and quickly so I can get back to work.

I was proceeding through the intersection when the Mercedes came out from the side street. I made an effort to brake, but we still hit. My bumper and their lamp were damaged. There was glass from their shattered headlamp on the pavement. We both exchanged insurance information in a calm and orderly manner.

I was driving to the office this morning along the Avenida da República when the traffic came to a sudden halt. I was able to stop, but the gentleman behind me didn't quite make it. He nudged my rear bumper. It didn't look like much, but upon closer inspection, you can see a distinct scratch across the bumper paint. I've exchanged details with him and he was very polite throughout. It is just a routine nuisance, really, but one that needs to be addressed through proper channels.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista when the traffic ahead suddenly stopped. I tried to brake, but the wet asphalt made it hard to stop in time, and I ended up bumping into the car in front of me at about 10 km/h. Honestly, I feel terrible about it, I'm just so worried about my insurance premiums going up because of this silly mistake. You know, it was just one of those days where everything goes wrong, and now there is a noticeable crush on the back of his bumper. I really hope we can get this sorted out quickly.

I was navigating the roundabout at the airport when another driver tried to exit from the inner lane and just cut right across me. I honked, but it was too late, and we made contact. It was a stressful situation, man, I'm really shaken up by the whole thing. It left a deep scratch and a dent on my front passenger door. I've been driving in Lisbon for years and I've never had anything like this happen before, it's just so frustrating to deal with all this paperwork right now.

I was exiting the roundabout and thought I had enough space to maneuver, but I clearly misjudged the proximity of the other vehicle. My car scraped the side of the Seat, and I accept full responsibility for the collision. It was an honest error while navigating the busy roundabout traffic during the rush hour.

I was attempting to parallel park on the side of the street near the university center. I was going very slowly, maybe 2 km/h, but I miscalculated the distance to the parked car behind me and scraped my rear bumper against their fender. It was entirely my fault, I was a bit distracted by my kids talking in the backseat. I noticed a visible mark on the side of the car now. I feel quite embarrassed about the whole incident, but I want to ensure the owner is compensated for the damage.

Driving along the river, I went to switch lanes to avoid a stationary bus. I checked my mirrors, but I must have missed the motorcycle lane. As I moved over, I clipped the side of a van. I immediately pulled over to check the damage. My front side is dented, and the indicator lamp is broken. I'm just incredibly worried about the safety of the other driver, though thankfully everyone seems physically fine. It's been a very long day and I'm just hoping the insurance process is straightforward.

I was driving straight in the middle lane when the Volvo suddenly moved into my path. I couldn't swerve fast enough to avoid contact, and the side of my van was grazed. The impact damaged the Volvo's lamp and created a dent. It was unfortunate, but these things happen in heavy city traffic.

My wife and I were driving to pick up our grandkids for the weekend. The sun was quite bright, and when the traffic light turned amber, the car in front of me stopped extremely abruptly. I slammed on my brakes, but I still slid into their bumper. My headlight and the glass cover have suffered a major glass shatter. At my age, these things are quite stressful, especially with all the noise of the traffic on this busy road. I just want to make sure everything is handled correctly by the insurance company.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus when I saw the collision. The traffic light changed unexpectedly, causing the first car to stop very suddenly. The driver of the BMW tried to react, but the distance was too short, and he hit the car ahead. The impact definitely broke some glass on the front of the BMW.

I was making my way through the city center, following the flow of traffic. I attempted a lane change because my navigation said to turn right soon. I thought the lane was clear, but as I started to merge, a car came up from behind in the blind spot. We made minor contact. There is a long, visible scratch running across the side of my car. I feel so anxious about this, I've only had this car for three months and I'm just really upset with myself for not being more careful.

I entered the intersection while the light was green, but a delivery vehicle coming from the opposite side tried to beat the red light while turning. I had no time to maneuver away. The collision damaged my front corner, specifically causing a dent and breaking the headlight lamp. I have been very busy with work meetings all morning, and this accident has put me behind on everything. I just want to provide the facts as they occurred so we can close this file.

I was turning left and thought I had cleared the intersection, but I miscalculated the timing of the oncoming traffic. The Audi hit the side of my bumper. I see the damage to their lamp and the bodywork. It was my misjudgment of the intersection clearance.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: Driving around the roundabout, I was in the middle lane, and I think I might have drifted slightly because of the heavy rain today. A car beside me was affected by my movement, and we bumped side-by-side. It’s mostly a dent on my door panel. I'm just super worried about how much this is going to cost. Is there a way to speed up the assessment? I rely on this car to get to my job every single day, so being without it is honestly a massive headache for me right now.

I was heading towards the hotel district when the car in front slowed down for a pedestrian crossing. I was looking at my GPS for a split second, and when I looked back, I was already too close. I hit their rear bumper. It resulted in a broken lamp and some surface scratches. I feel truly terrible, as this was a complete lack of attention on my part. I've lived here for forty years and always pride myself on being a safe driver, but today I simply failed to pay enough attention.

I was pulling into a very tight parking space in the city center. I thought I had cleared the pillar, but I heard a loud crunching sound. I definitely misjudged the angle of my turn. It resulted in a dent and several scratches on the back door. It is very annoying to deal with, but I suppose it is my fault for being in such a rush to get to my appointment. I will make sure to take photos of the damage as requested for the claim assessment.

I was driving home after work on Avenida da Boavista when traffic suddenly halted. I tried to brake, but I think the road was a bit slippery due to the afternoon drizzle, and I bumped into the car ahead of me. It was honestly such a stressful moment, man. I immediately got out to check, and there is a noticeable dent on my front bumper. The other driver was calm, but I am just really worried about how this is going to affect my insurance premium, you know? It was just a complete lapse in judgment on my part.

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a sudden impact from behind. It was not a heavy crash, but enough to feel the jolt. I got out and saw the driver of the Golf looking quite anxious. He admitted it was his fault immediately. It left a impact depression on the rear bumper of my car from the impact.

I was navigating the roundabout near Praça do Comércio and realized too late that I was in the wrong lane to exit toward the bridge. As I tried to merge, I failed to notice the vehicle in my blind spot. I heard a scraping sound, which was terrifying. I pulled over right away. There is a long scratch along my passenger side door. I feel awful about this, I really should have been more careful with the traffic flow in the center of Lisbon during rush hour.

It happened to be a busy afternoon near the university in Coimbra. I was attempting to park my Fiat in a very tight spot between two other vehicles. As I was reversing slowly, I misjudged the distance to the car behind me and nudged it. I feel terrible, truly. Upon inspection, there is a small dent and a scratch on the corner of my rear bumper. I left a note on the other car's windshield because the owner was nowhere to be found, and I want to resolve this properly.

The sun was quite low, and it was blinding me as I approached the intersection on the N125. I entered the junction thinking I had the green light, but another car was coming from the side. We collided at low speed. The impact shattered the glass of my headlight and left the lamp broken on the driver's side. I am quite shaken by the experience, as it happened so suddenly. I have already contacted my insurer to provide the details of the incident and ensure everything is documented correctly.

I had the green light at the junction. The driver of the Citroën just didn't stop. It was a low-speed impact, but the front of his car hit my side. His headlight glass is shattered and the lamp is broken. I am fine, just frustrated by the damage to my vehicle's door and trim.

I was driving along Avenida da República, planning to turn right at the upcoming street. I checked my mirrors, or at least I thought I did, and started to move into the right lane. Suddenly, I heard a harsh sound of metal rubbing against metal. I immediately stopped the car. I noticed a deep mark on the rear wing of my vehicle. The oncoming driver was kind enough to pull over as well, and we exchanged details. I am deeply sorry for the mistake, as it was completely my fault.

I was navigating through the busy roundabout in Porto, which is always quite chaotic, you know? I was just trying to follow the lane markings, but the car to my left started drifting into my lane. I didn't have enough time to react, and we made contact. It left a significant dent and the lamp is broken on my front side. It was a very confusing situation, and I am just glad no one was hurt in the middle of all that traffic, man.

I was waiting at the roundabout entrance when I saw the Opel and the other vehicle make contact. The Opel driver was in his lane, but the other car drifted over. I saw the front bumper get dented and the lamp get broken on the Opel. It was definitely a miscalculation by the driver of the other vehicle.

Well, it happened to be a rather drizzly morning here in Porto, and I was running some errands for my grandchildren. As I was exiting the parking zone, I misjudged the height of the concrete bollard on the edge of the curb. It happened to be a slow impact, but I heard a sharp snap. When I got out to look, there was a visible crack on my front bumper cover. It's quite embarrassing for a driver of my experience to make such a simple error, but the weather was certainly not helping my visibility today.

I was heading towards Cascais on the Marginal. The view of the ocean is lovely, but I got distracted for a split second by a passing ship. When I looked back, the car in front of me had stopped abruptly. I slammed on the brakes, but couldn't avoid the collision. There is a dent and a scratch on my bumper. The individual driving the other car was very professional about it, and we exchanged all the necessary insurance documents right there on the side of the road.

I had to brake hard because the traffic ahead stopped suddenly. A moment later, I felt the impact from behind. The driver of the Yaris was very polite and admitted he was distracted. My car sustained some damage, and his car shows a dent and a scratch on the front end.

I was travelling along the avenue when a delivery van started pulling away from the curb without looking. I tried to swerve, but the side of my vehicle still caught the edge of his trailer. It happened so fast. There is a long scratch along the side panel and the side mirror glass is shattered. I am quite worried because this is my only way to get to work, and I hope the repairs don't take too long. It was just an unfortunate accident in heavy traffic.

I was attempting to maneuver into a street-side parking space near the center. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I heard a crunch as I reversed. It turns out I hit the metal pole of a street sign. I feel so foolish. There is a nasty dent on the rear panel, and the tail lamp is broken. I have already contacted my insurance provider as per the policy requirements. I know this is entirely my fault and I am prepared to cover the costs as needed.

I was on my way down Avenida da Boavista during the morning rush when traffic suddenly slowed to a complete halt near the intersection. I managed to brake in time, but the driver behind me clearly didn't see the stop. I felt a firm impact on my rear bumper. When I stepped out, I could clearly see a large, distinct dent in the center of the bumper where their car had made contact. I am quite worried about the repair costs as this is my only car for work.

It was completely my fault. I was looking at my GPS for a split second and didn't realize the traffic had bunched up in front of me. I hit the back of the Volkswagen Golf at low speed. There is a visible crush on the insured's bumper and some minor scuffing on my front grille.

I was parking my car in a tight spot near Rua Augusta earlier this afternoon. I misjudged the distance between my bumper and the concrete bollard on the edge of the curb. As I reversed slowly, I heard a sickening grinding noise. Upon inspection, I found a deep scratch along the side panel and a noticeable dent where the metal pushed in. It was a complete error in judgment on my part, and I feel quite foolish for being so careless while parking in such a busy area.

I was proceeding through the green light at the intersection of Avenida dos Aliados. Another driver attempted to cross too quickly and caught the corner of my vehicle. The impact was enough to shatter my front left signal light lens completely. My hands were shaking for an hour afterward. I have been driving for over forty years, and you know, you think you've seen everything, but this intersection is always dangerous. I am thankful it wasn't worse, but I do need the lamp repaired immediately to be safe.

I was waiting to cross the street and saw the whole event. The Toyota definitely had the green light. The other car tried to beat the amber signal and clipped the Toyota's front corner. It was a loud bang, and I saw pieces of the broken lamp plastic scatter across the asphalt.

The traffic on the bridge was quite heavy today, as it usually is at 5 PM. I was in the middle lane when a van suddenly merged into my lane without signaling properly. I didn't have enough room to avoid them entirely. We made contact, resulting in a long, unsightly scratch running down the passenger side of my doors. It is frustrating because I was just driving home after a very long day at the office and now I have to deal with this administrative process.

I was stopped at a red light on Avenida da República. The car in front of me started to roll backward slightly. I honked my horn, but they didn't stop in time. Their trailer hitch hit my front grille area. While the bumper held up, there is a very clear crack in the plastic molding. I’m quite anxious about this because I'm not very experienced with filing insurance claims, and I really hope the process is straightforward for someone like me.

I was distracted by a phone call and forgot to put the handbrake on properly while waiting at the light. My van rolled back a few centimeters into the Citroen. I am very sorry for the trouble; there is a visible crack in their plastic trim.

I was traveling slowly along Rua de Santa Catarina. A delivery vehicle pulled out from a loading zone without checking if the lane was clear. My passenger side door took the brunt of the impact. It resulted in a noticeable dent in the door panel and several deep scratches in the paint. It is such a bother, as I have an important client meeting tomorrow and now I have to arrange for repairs and a rental car. The driver was apologetic, but that doesn't fix the damage.

It was a lovely sunny afternoon in Setúbal. I was driving near the river when I stopped to let a pedestrian cross. The car behind me slammed into my rear. The force was quite significant, and unfortunately, the rear window glass shattered completely. My daughter was in the backseat, and we were both terrified. I need this handled urgently because I cannot drive the car with the rear window in this condition. I am still quite shaky from the shock of the event.

I was sitting at a cafe terrace nearby. The Hyundai driver stopped perfectly for the pedestrian crossing, but the car behind never even tapped the brakes. It was a heavy collision, and I saw the rear glass shatter everywhere on the road. The occupants looked very shaken.

I was driving along the coast road when a scooter tried to squeeze between me and a bus. The rider panicked and swerved into my left side. They managed to stay upright, but their handlebar left a deep, long scratch along my driver-side door. I’m a professional and I value my car, so this is quite distressing to see. I have provided the rider's details, and I hope we can resolve this quickly through the insurance portal as I have very little free time.

While exiting the Rotunda do Relógio, a car in the outer lane cut across my path to take the exit, despite me being already positioned in the lane. They hit my front right corner. The impact caused a dent in the fender and cracked the housing of my headlight, which is now broken. My back is feeling a bit stiff, and I am worried about the repair complexity with all these sensors in the lamp unit. I'm just looking for a straightforward repair authorization.

I made a mistake. I thought I had space to cut across to the exit but I misjudged the speed of the Audi. I hit their front bumper and light. It left a dent and the lamp is broken. I accept full responsibility for this incident.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Liberdade was quite heavy as usual. I stopped for the red light, but I didn't see the car behind me coming in time. He bumped into my rear bumper. I feel terrible about the whole situation, man, I'm just really worried about the insurance premiums going up. When I checked the back of my car, I saw a noticeable dent and a long scratch across the bumper. It was just a complete accident, honestly.

I was distracted for a split second by the GPS. By the time I looked up, the traffic had stopped completely and I couldn't brake in time. I am very sorry for the trouble caused to the driver in front, as I clearly hit the back of his vehicle while we were waiting at the traffic light.

I was navigating the Rotunda da Boavista in Porto during the lunch rush. It was raining quite heavily, which made visibility difficult. As I was exiting towards the main road, another driver didn't yield and clipped my side. It happened so fast. My front lamp is broken now, and I am quite shaken up because I have never been in an accident before. I'm just trying to make sure I followed all the procedures correctly. It is just such a stressful day for me, you know?

I was trying to parallel park near the center of Coimbra this morning. I thought I had more room behind me than I actually did. I backed up slowly, but I still misjudged the distance and grazed the car parked behind me. I feel incredibly embarrassed about the whole thing. You can see a visible scratch on my rear passenger door now. I spoke to the owner of the other vehicle immediately to exchange details. It was purely a mistake on my part due to my poor depth perception.

I was on my way along Avenida dos Aliados and I decided to change lanes because the left lane was blocked by a delivery van. I checked my mirror, but I suppose the individual driving the other car was in my blind spot. We made contact, and it caused a dent and a scrape along the side of my car. I feel awful because I should have been more careful. I have always tried to be a safe driver, but today was just one of those days where I made a bad judgment call.

I was traveling straight in the middle lane at about 30 km/h. Suddenly, the Seat started moving into my lane without giving me any time to react or swerve out of the way. We made side-to-side contact near the passenger door, resulting in some paint transfer and bodywork damage.

It was a beautiful morning in Funchal, and I was on my way to visit my daughter when I reached the junction on Estrada Monumental. I proceeded through the green light, but another car coming from the cross-street entered the intersection prematurely. The impact shattered the passenger-side window of my car. I am quite elderly, so the sound of the glass breaking was very startling and has left me feeling rather unsteady. I am thankful we were both driving slowly, as it could have been much, much worse for us.

I was maintaining a steady speed of 45 km/h on Avenida da Boavista when the car beside me drifted out of its lane. The situation involved a very sudden maneuver, and before I could hit the horn, they swiped the entire side of my car. My front lamp is broken, and there is a deep dent and a long scratch along the side panel. The second vehicle apologized profusely, admitting he had been distracted by his phone. I am really frustrated because the repair costs for this luxury model are likely quite significant.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the two cars collide. The driver in the right lane clearly drifted into the left lane without checking his mirrors. The impact was loud, and I saw glass and debris scatter across the road. Both drivers stopped immediately to inspect the damage.

The traffic in central Lisbon is always a nightmare. I was crawling along at maybe 10 km/h behind a tourist coach when it suddenly braked hard to pick up a passenger. I hit the brakes, but I still rolled forward enough to scrape the paint on my front bumper against the rear of the bus. I noticed a noticeable scratch from the friction. I feel very annoyed at the situation, but I suppose it is my fault for not keeping enough distance behind such a large vehicle.

I was heading down the Estrada de Benfica during the afternoon. I was in the slow lane, and a large delivery truck was in the adjacent lane. As the road curved, the truck driver didn't seem to account for the lane narrowing and drifted over. He clipped my driver-side mirror and door, leaving a long, deep scratch. It was terrifying, man. I was honking like crazy, but he didn't even notice until I managed to get alongside him at the next intersection. I just want my car fixed as soon as possible, you know?

I was going around the roundabout on Avenida da Republica. I was in the inner lane intending to exit at the third junction. Another driver tried to exit from the outer lane, cutting directly in front of me. I slammed on the brakes but still ended up hitting their rear side. It resulted in a dent to my front fender and a broken headlight. I have been driving for over forty years, and this is the first time I have been involved in such an unpleasant incident. It is just very disappointing to see such reckless driving.

I misjudged the exit maneuver on the roundabout and tried to pull out too early. I didn't see the driver coming around the inside lane until it was too late. I take full responsibility for the damage to the other vehicle's fender and lamp unit. It happened to be a very clumsy mistake on my part.

I was navigating the roundabout near Boavista around 5:30 PM, just trying to get home from work. The traffic was quite heavy as it usually is at that hour. As I was exiting towards Avenida da França, the driver in the adjacent lane turned sharply without signaling. I slammed on the brakes, but I still clipped their rear bumper. I feel terrible about it, honestly, I was just driving normally and then suddenly there was this loud thud. I noticed a noticeable dent on my front left fender now. I am just really stressed about the repair costs.

I was driving around the roundabout and moving to the outer lane to exit. I admit I might have misjudged the distance of the car in the other lane. I heard a scraping sound and felt the impact on my side. We both pulled over immediately to exchange our details.

I was parking my car on Rua Augusta to pick up some documents. I was moving very slowly, maybe at 5 km/h, trying to align with the curb. I suppose I miscalculated the swing of my rear bumper because I ended up scraping against the concrete post near the shop entrance. I am very frustrated with myself for being so careless. I can see a long, deep scratch running along the paintwork on the back right panel. I have already contacted the shop owner to ensure everything is documented correctly.

The situation involved a drizzly morning here in Porto, and the streets were quite slick. I was approaching the intersection near the town hall when the light turned yellow. I slowed down, but the car behind me didn't seem to notice in time. They hit me right in the rear. It was quite a shock, honestly. I got out to check, and my rear right tail lamp is completely broken into pieces. The second vehicle was very apologetic and admitted they were distracted by their navigation system for a second.

I take full responsibility for the accident. The rain made the road surface slippery and I didn't leave enough of a gap between my vehicle and the car in front. I hit the back of the Peugeot, which caused their tail lamp to break upon impact.

I was driving along the main avenue in Setúbal on my way to the market. I was in the left lane going about 30 km/h. Another vehicle tried to merge into my lane without checking their blind spot. I did my best to swerve to avoid them, but we ended up colliding side-to-side. My car has a significant dent on the passenger door and a visible scratch that runs the length of the rear quarter panel. It was quite scary, to be honest. I am just glad no one was hurt, but the damage looks quite expensive to fix.

My family and I were visiting the coast. While I was reversing out of a tight parking spot near the beach, I accidentally backed into a stone pillar that I completely failed to see. The impact was quite loud. The rear window glass shattered completely and fell all over the boot. I feel so incredibly stupid for not using my parking sensors properly. It's ruined our afternoon plans completely, and now I have to deal with the glass cleanup and the insurance claim process. It's just a mess all around.

I was walking my dog past the parking area when I saw the Nissan backing up. The driver seemed to be distracted, and they hit the pillar at a low speed. I saw the glass shatter instantly. I approached to see if they needed any help since the window was totally gone.

I was stopped at the red light on Avenida de Roma waiting for the signal to change. Suddenly, I felt a strong jolt from behind. A delivery van had hit my rear bumper. I got out and saw that my rear bumper has a large dent and the left brake lamp is completely broken. The driver of the van was very cooperative and we filled out the accident report immediately. It's such a hassle, but at least both of us are safe and the paperwork is being handled by our respective insurers.

I was checking my delivery manifest while stopped, and when I moved forward, I didn't realize the traffic in front hadn't started moving yet. I bumped into the back of the Toyota. I caused damage to their lamp and the bumper area. I am truly sorry for the trouble.

I was navigating towards the city center on the Estrada Monumental. The situation involved a beautiful day, very sunny, which actually made it hard to see because of the glare. A motorcycle was weaving through the traffic and clipped the side of my car as it tried to squeeze through a gap that was clearly too small. There is a long, ugly scratch across the passenger side door. The motorcyclist kept going for a bit before stopping. I am quite shaken up by the whole experience, man. I just hope the repair isn't too complicated.

Back when I was heading to my granddaughter's school, I reached the crossroads near the museum. I had the green light, but a vehicle came from the right and ignored their stop sign. It happened so quickly, like, one moment I'm driving and the next, there's a loud crash. My front right lamp is broken and you can see a deep dent in the wing. It's all quite stressful for someone my age. The police arrived later to take notes, and I've been trying to keep track of all the forms since then.

I am deeply embarrassed. I was distracted by a phone call and I could not spot the stop sign at the junction. I entered the intersection and collided with the side of the BMW. I've accepted full liability for the damages to the lamp and the car body.

Traffic on the bridge was moving at a crawl, maybe 15 km/h. I was following the car in front when they suddenly braked hard for no apparent reason. I hit the brakes as hard as I could, but the road was damp and I slid a few meters, hitting their bumper. It was a very low-speed impact, but it left a clear dent on my hood now. I feel terrible about it. I was keeping a safe distance, but the conditions were just against us today. I have photos of the bumper.

I was attempting to parallel park on a narrow street. The space was quite tight, and as I was turning the wheel, I didn't notice the low bollard near the curb. I scraped the rear fender against it, which left a long scratch. When I reversed slightly to adjust, I hit the edge of the bollard again, and that impact caused the rear passenger window glass to shatter. It was such a silly mistake, I feel really anxious about the insurance premium increase. I just want to get it fixed as soon as possible.

I was sitting at the outdoor café right next to the parking spot. I watched the driver try to park. They were moving very slowly but seemed to underestimate the position of the bollard. I heard the scraping sound first, and then the sound of the glass shattering when they hit it a second time.

I was travelling around the Boavista roundabout in Porto during the mid-morning rush. I was checking my mirror to change lanes when the car in front suddenly slowed down for a taxi. I pressed the brake, but I just couldn't stop in time on the damp pavement. I bumped into their rear bumper at about 10 km/h. It was completely my fault, I feel terrible about it. There is a noticeable dent on the center of my hood and a long scratch across the right headlight area.

Traffic was quite heavy as we were exiting the roundabout. I had to brake firmly because a taxi pulled out in front of me without signaling. The gentleman behind me unfortunately did not have enough distance to stop, and he impacted my rear bumper. My vehicle has a clear dent and a scratch from the collision.

I was trying to parallel park near the city hall around 3 PM. I misjudged the distance between my rear quarter panel and the car parked behind me. I was moving at maybe 2 km/h and heard a light scraping sound. I stopped immediately and realized I had grazed the paint on the other car's door. There is only a scratch on my vehicle's rear panel. I am so embarrassed, I usually never make mistakes like this, but I was in a rush for a meeting.

I was navigating through the narrow streets near Baixa. It was quite busy with tourists and delivery vans everywhere. While turning a sharp corner, I miscalculated the swing of my car and brushed against a stone pillar near a shop front. It was a very low-speed impact, just enough to shatter the glass of my rear passenger-side lamp. I'm really anxious about the repair costs because I'm a student and money is tight right now. Does insurance cover this kind of silly mistake?

I was standing outside my coffee shop when I saw the Seat Ibiza turning the corner. The driver was going very slowly, but they just didn't see the stone pillar. The rear lamp struck the stone and shattered. It was clearly an honest mistake, they looked quite worried.

I was heading towards Cascais along the coastal road. The sun was really low and glaring off the sea, making it very hard to see. The driver ahead stopped for a pedestrian crossing and I just hit the brake too late. I was going about 30 km/h. The impact caused a significant dent on the lower portion of my bumper and my right fog lamp is broken. I've been driving for years and this is my first incident; I feel absolutely terrible about it.

Traffic on the bridge was backed up, as usual. I checked my blind spot before moving into the middle lane, but a black hatchback had accelerated into the gap at the exact same moment. We side-swiped each other at about 40 km/h. It was really loud and terrifying. There is a long, deep scratch running along my passenger door and the rear fender. I should have been more careful, man, I'm just so rattled by the whole thing right now.

I was in the middle lane moving at a steady pace. The driver of the BMW tried to merge without seeing me. I tried to swerve, but we still scraped side-to-side. My car has some light scratches along the driver's side door, but no major damage.

Oh dear, I was taking my granddaughter to the park and it was quite a drizzly afternoon here in Funchal. When I entered the roundabout near the hotel, I was looking for my exit and didn't notice the van coming around the inside lane. We collided near the front bumper. My front left corner has a dent, a deep scratch, and the lamp glass is broken. I feel quite foolish, as I have been driving for over forty years and rarely have these kinds of mishaps.

I was heading home from work yesterday evening, around 6:30 PM. The traffic was bumper-to-bumper as it usually is on this stretch. I was checking my navigation system for a split second and, when I looked back, the vehicle in front of me had come to a complete stop. I hit the brakes, but I still made contact with the rear of his car. It resulted in a dent on my front bumper. It was a lapse in concentration, and I accept full responsibility for the collision.

I was sitting at a complete standstill in traffic when I felt a sudden impact from behind. The driver behind me didn't stop in time. My rear bumper has a significant dent, but luckily, no one was hurt in the incident. The driver was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the exchange.

I was crossing the intersection when another car entered from the side street. I don't know if they didn't see the stop sign, but it all happened so fast. My side window glass shattered from the impact and the debris was everywhere. I am so shaken up, you know? I really didn't expect this on a Tuesday morning. Everything happened in slow motion and I just want to make sure I'm doing the right things for the insurance claim, dude. I'm worried about the repair process.

I was moving along the avenue in the right lane. I signaled to change lanes because I needed to turn left shortly. I started to merge, but the driver in the other lane accelerated, and we made contact. It happened to be a graze rather than a direct hit. I have a impact depression on the rear panel and a scratch along the side. I should have checked the mirror one last time before moving, but it was just a bad split-second decision in heavy traffic.

I was traveling at about 40 km/h when the Ford started moving into my lane. I didn't have enough room to dodge them, so our sides touched. My side door has some scratches and a slight dent from the contact. The oncoming driver apologized immediately.

It was raining quite heavily when I arrived at the parking garage near the stadium. I was trying to fit into a tight space and underestimated how close the concrete column was. As I turned, I scraped the side of my car against the corner of the pillar. It resulted in a scratch and a small crack in the plastic bumper housing. I've been driving for thirty years and it is quite disheartening to have such an avoidable accident, especially in my own neighborhood.

I was navigating the roundabout at the Boavista junction, moving quite slowly because of the heavy morning traffic, when the car next to me suddenly swerved into my lane without signaling. I slammed on the brakes but couldn't avoid the contact. It was really stressful, honestly, I am still shaking a bit. I just hope the repairs aren't too expensive or take too long because I need this car for work every single day. The impact resulted in a clear dent on my rear passenger door.

I was navigating through the narrow streets near the city center. A delivery van ahead of me stopped abruptly to unload goods, and because the street was so narrow, I couldn't maneuver around it quickly enough. I nudged the rear of his vehicle at a very low speed. My front right indicator lamp is broken from the contact. I feel quite worried about the insurance premiums going up, but I know it is important to report this honestly and follow the correct procedures.

I had stopped my van briefly on the street to deliver a package to a local shop. I felt a sudden jolt from behind and realized the driver behind me had misjudged the distance and bumped into my rear bumper. The individual driving the other car was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the entire exchange of details.

I was driving in the right lane and started to change to the middle lane. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I didn't see the other car in my blind spot. We collided, and there is now a scratch and a small dent on my side panel. I am quite concerned about the repair costs, as I have always been a very careful driver. This is a very stressful experience, and I hope the claims process is straightforward and quick.

I was maintaining my speed in the center lane when the vehicle to my right suddenly veered into my path. I had no time to move away, so we scraped alongside each other. It happened to be a fairly minor impact, but it was still quite a shock for me.

I was on my way slowly through the intersection when another car came from the side street. I don't know if they misjudged the signal or if they just weren't looking, but we collided near the passenger side. My side window glass has shattered completely due to the impact. I am feeling very anxious about everything, especially the paperwork. I have never been in an accident before in my life, and this is truly an overwhelming situation to deal with on a busy Tuesday afternoon.

I was waiting to cross the road at the pedestrian signal when I saw the two vehicles approach the intersection. It seemed like the driver from the side street did not stop in time for the red light. I witnessed the impact clearly, and I am happy to provide my contact details as an official witness to the insurance companies.

I was parking my car near the park under the nice afternoon sun. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I must have turned the wheel too sharply because I ended up scraping the side of my car against the concrete wall of the underground parking exit. It resulted in a deep scratch along the passenger door. I am feeling quite disappointed in myself for being so careless. I would like to get this repaired as soon as possible, as the car is fairly new.

I was driving along the Monumental road returning from my grocery shopping. It started to drizzle slightly, making the tarmac quite slick. The vehicle in front of me braked very suddenly for a pedestrian crossing, and despite my attempt to stop, I slid slightly on the wet road and hit the back of their car. I am quite worried because my rear lamp is broken and you can see a noticeable dent on my hood. I am just hoping that everyone is okay and that the insurance can handle this.

I saw the pedestrian crossing and braked, as is required. The driver behind me didn't stop in time and hit me. It was definitely the weather conditions making the road slippery, as they seemed to be trying to stop. Thankfully, it was only a low-speed impact.

I was driving down the avenue when a car from the outer lane decided to merge without sufficient space. I tried to avoid it, but they swiped the side of my car, leaving a long scratch along the rear quarter panel. I am quite an experienced driver, but even so, this caught me off guard. I have the insurance details of the oncoming driver, and we both agreed to document the damage immediately so there would be no confusion later on.

I was trying to move over to the left lane to make an upcoming turn. I checked my mirrors, but I must have missed the car that was already there. We ended up making contact while moving at slow speeds. I admit full responsibility for the error in judgment.

It was quite a busy day with tourists everywhere near the shopping district. I was trying to maneuver out of a narrow alleyway. I didn't realize how close the stone wall was because the sun was glaring right into my windshield. I hit the wall at a very low speed, which caused a dent on my front bumper. My grandson was in the car with me, and he was a bit frightened by the noise, which makes me feel even worse about the whole incident.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was quite heavy as usual. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to hit my brakes, but I wasn't fast enough and tapped the rear of the other vehicle. It was totally my fault, I feel terrible about it. My front bumper has a noticeable dent and some deep scratches from the impact. I am just really worried about how much this is going to cost to repair, man.

I had to stop abruptly because a person stepped into the crosswalk without looking. The driver behind me didn't react in time and bumped into my rear bumper. There is a visible dent on my trunk and a long scratch where their car made contact. It was an honest mistake in dense traffic.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, heading towards the exit for the A1 motorway. It was raining quite a bit, and the roads were slippery. I was changing lanes to the right, and I failed to notice the van next to me in my blind spot. I ended up scraping against his side panel. I feel so anxious about this, I've never been in a crash before. My car door has a long, ugly scratch along the side. I just hope the insurance process isn't too complicated, honestly.

I was trying to parallel park near the center of Coimbra this morning. I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar near the curb. I was moving very slowly, maybe 5 km/h, but I turned the wheel too sharply and hit the corner of the pillar. My rear passenger side panel now has a dent and some nasty scratches. It’s my own car, and I’m just so frustrated with myself for being so clumsy. I really need this fixed before the weekend as I have a long trip planned.

It was about 3:00 PM and I was driving down the avenue. The sun was extremely bright, making it hard to see clearly. Another car was pulling out from a side street and didn't see me, so they veered into my lane. I swerved to avoid a direct hit, but my front corner caught their side. My headlight is broken now and there is a deep scratch along my bumper. I am really stressed about the paperwork involved and whether the repairs will take weeks to complete.

I was pulling out onto the main road and the glare from the sun was blinding. I missed seeing the other vehicle coming down the lane until it was too late. We brushed against each other. My car is fine mostly, but theirs has a broken lamp and some paint scratches.

Oh man, I was cruising along the Marginal toward Cascais. The traffic was stop-and-go because of the beach crowd. The driver ahead of me braked suddenly to look at the sea, I guess, and I couldn't stop in time. I hit the back of his car. The impact shattered one of my front indicator lenses and caused a big dent on my hood. I am honestly just so worried about how much this is going to cost me, you know? It was totally a moment of distraction on my part.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the BMW hit the car in front. The driver in the BMW was looking to the side right before the impact. There is glass shattered all over the road from the lamp and a significant impact depression on the hood.

My grandson was with me in the back seat, and we were heading to get some groceries on this lovely Tuesday morning. I approached the intersection and thought the light was still green, but it turned amber quickly. A delivery van was coming from the right, and we touched fenders. It was quite a shock, really, at my age one doesn't expect such things. The side of my car has a small dent and a very long scratch from the van's sliding door metal rail. I am just so shaken up.

I am a delivery driver, so I am on these roads all day. I was merging left on the Avenida and I checked my mirrors, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. We made contact, just a light graze at maybe 20 km/h. You can see a series of scratches down the side of my vehicle. It is unfortunate, but it's just part of the job sometimes, I suppose. I've already provided my details to the other driver so we can get this settled professionally.

I was driving in my lane when the delivery driver merged suddenly without enough space. My side panel rubbed against his vehicle. It didn't cause a major crash, just some superficial scratches on the paintwork. The situation involved a minor incident, but still frustrating to deal with during my lunch hour.

I was trying to navigate the very tight streets in downtown Porto. The road was narrow with cars parked on both sides. I was backing up to let a bus pass, but I miscalculated the distance to the bollard behind me. I heard a crunch, and when I got out, I saw that my rear tail lamp was broken into pieces. I’m honestly so upset because I love this car, and the repair costs are likely going to be quite high for such a small, silly mistake.

location: Autoestrada A2, Near Alcácer do Sal

statements.text: I was travelling south on the A2 highway, heading to the Algarve for the weekend. The traffic suddenly slowed down to about 40 km/h due to road work ahead. I braked, but the person behind me was definitely following too closely and couldn't stop. They slammed into my rear bumper. My car has a large dent and paint scratches from their license plate frame. I'm just relieved that nobody was hurt, but I am really worried about the quality of the repair work being done.

I didn't notice the traffic slowing down as quickly as it did on the highway. By the time I hit the brakes, I had already struck the back of the Volvo. It left a clear dent and scratch on their bumper. I admit I wasn't keeping enough distance, and I take responsibility.

I was entering the roundabout near the train station. I thought I had clear space to enter, but a motorcycle was coming around the circle faster than I anticipated. I had to brake hard, and while I didn't hit him, the sudden stop caused the car behind me to nudge my rear bumper. My bumper now has a spiderweb crack in the plastic cover. I am just really stressed about this because it's a newer car and I wanted to keep it in perfect condition, you know?

The Tesla in front of me slammed on his brakes because of a motorcycle. I was following at a normal distance, but I didn't have enough time to stop completely on the wet road surface. I hit his bumper at a very low speed. It caused a small crack in his bumper.

I was heading down Avenida da Boavista around 5 PM, heading towards the city center. The traffic was quite heavy as it usually is at that hour. The vehicle in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing, and I just couldn't react fast enough. I pressed the brakes, but I still bumped into their rear bumper. It happened to be a very low-speed impact, but now there is a visible dent on my front hood. I feel terrible about the whole situation, as I really should have kept more distance.

I was trying to park my car in a very tight spot near the Rossio square. I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar on the side of the parking garage. As I was turning the wheel to tuck in, I heard a nasty scraping sound. I got out immediately to check and saw a significant scratch along the passenger side door. I am so stressed out about this; I have only had this car for three months and it was my first time parking in this specific underground lot.

I was walking nearby to get some coffee and saw the driver attempting to maneuver into the parking bay. They were moving very slowly, but the space was clearly too small for that vehicle. I saw the side of the car graze the pillar and heard the metal scraping against the concrete. It was definitely an honest mistake during a difficult parking maneuver.

I was navigating the roundabout near the Casa da Música. I was in the middle lane, and another driver in the outer lane decided to exit suddenly without signaling. I did my best to steer away, but there was no time. We made side-to-side contact. I am really shaken up, man. My car has a dent and a long scratch on the rear fender now. I don't know how much this is going to cost to fix, and I have to go to work soon. It’s just a really bad day for me.

I admit I was distracted by my GPS and moved to the exit lane quite abruptly while on the roundabout. I did not check my side mirror carefully enough before turning. I felt the impact on my front bumper and immediately pulled over to exchange details. I am fully responsible for the contact.

It was raining, so the road was quite slippery while I was travelling along the Marginal road towards Estoril. A delivery truck in the lane next to me drifted slightly into my lane while avoiding a cyclist. I attempted to move as far to the left as possible, but the truck's side panel still swiped my driver-side door, causing a long, ugly scratch. I’ve lived in Cascais for thirty years and never seen the traffic this chaotic, honestly. I'm just grateful that nobody was hurt in the rain.

I was proceeding through the intersection at the green light. Suddenly, a car came from the right side and hit my front corner. The light was green for me, but the individual driving the other car seemed completely unaware. My front lamp is broken, and I noticed a noticeable dent in the bumper. I am just really concerned about the insurance process because I need this car for my daily commute to the university. I hope everything gets settled quickly because this is my only vehicle.

I honestly thought I had the green light, but I must have misread the signal in the glare of the morning sun. I drove into the intersection and collided with the other driver's front bumper. I feel terrible about it. I have already confirmed with the other driver that I will cooperate fully with the insurance claim report.

I was reversing out of a narrow alleyway in the city center. I checked my rearview mirrors, but I suppose I missed seeing the glass storefront display or the bollard properly because of the low light. I reversed into it, and my rear window suffered a complete glass shatter. It was a very stupid mistake, and I am quite embarrassed by it. I just want to get the glass repaired as soon as possible, as the car is not safe to drive in this condition.

I was changing lanes to prepare for a right turn. I checked my mirror, but I failed to see the motorcycle in my blind spot. I started moving over and heard a shout, so I immediately steered back. We made slight contact, which caused a scratch on my rear door panel. I am quite distressed, as I never want to be the reason someone falls off their bike. Fortunately, the rider kept his balance, but I feel really guilty about my lack of attention during the maneuver.

I was riding in the right lane when the car suddenly started merging into my path. I had to brake hard to avoid a worse accident, but the car still clipped my handlebar and left a scratch on their door. I am shaken but okay. It was just a classic blind-spot error, I suppose.

Traffic on the bridge was stop-and-go as it usually is. The driver behind me didn't stop in time when the line came to a halt. They hit my rear bumper quite hard. My rear lamp is broken and it left a significant dent in the trunk area. This is highly inconvenient as I was on my way to a business meeting in Almada. I am currently waiting for the police to document the scene so I can get back on my way.

I was trying to maneuver into a public parking space near the square. Another driver was pulling out at the same time and didn't see me clearly. We both ended up scraping our bumpers against each other. It’s just a scratch on the side, but it’s still very frustrating. I am a careful driver, but this busy area makes it impossible to avoid little incidents sometimes. My grandson told me to take extra care, and I suppose he was right.

I was reversing out of my spot and simply did not see the other car approaching from behind. The situation involved a lapse in judgment on my part. We both stopped instantly and checked for damage. There is a small scratch on both of our bumpers. We are currently exchanging insurance policy details.

I was travelling at a steady 30 km/h along the avenue. A taxi driver attempted to pull over to pick up a passenger without signaling, and his rear quarter panel caught my front fender. It caused a noticeable dent. I am quite worried about the repair costs as this is a luxury car. I need a formal assessment for my insurance company to process this claim. I hope the taxi driver admits his fault because it was clearly his maneuver that caused the collision.

I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for the bus when I saw the taxi pull toward the curb very suddenly. The Audi was passing at the same time and couldn't avoid the collision. It wasn't a high-speed accident, but the contact was clear. Both drivers stepped out immediately to talk.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM yesterday when traffic suddenly stopped. I tried to brake, but the road was damp from the light drizzle and I ended up bumping the back of the car in front of me at very low speed, maybe 10 km/h. I am honestly quite shaken up by this; it is my first time being involved in a collision and I am worried about the insurance premiums. There is a noticeable dent on my front bumper where I hit the other vehicle's trailer hitch.

I was waiting at the red light when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. I checked my rearview mirror and saw the driver had hit my bumper. He came out immediately to apologize. My vehicle only shows a minor dent on the rear step, so the situation involved a very light impact overall.

I was attempting to park my Peugeot in a tight space on Rua da Prata this morning. I thought I had enough clearance, but as I was turning the wheel to tuck the car in, I misjudged the distance to the stationary vehicle next to me. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had grazed their rear quarter panel. I feel terrible about it because the other car was parked perfectly. There is a long scratch on my passenger side door where the metal made contact.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, and I must admit I was a bit distracted by my GPS instructions. I was changing lanes to take the exit toward the A1 when I didn't notice the second vehicle coming up on my right. We ended up colliding at a shallow angle. It happened so fast. My car has a dent and a deep scratch on the rear wheel arch. I am very worried about the repair costs, honestly, it was just a silly moment of distraction.

I was maintaining my lane in the roundabout when the BMW driver suddenly swerved into my path without signaling. I slammed on the brakes, but we still touched. I have a dent on my front fender and a scratch along the door panel from the side-swipe.

It was late at night, around 11:30 PM, and I was driving home along the riverfront. The street lights were dim, and I was trying to merge into the right lane. I didn't see the van in my blind spot until it was too late. I clipped their side, and my headlamp shattered against their frame. I am really sorry, man, I just didn't check the mirror properly. It resulted in a scratch on my bumper and my front lamp is broken.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the Toyota try to merge into the right lane. The driver didn't seem to notice the van already there. It happened to be a clear case of a failed blind-spot check. I saw the lamp break and heard the scraping sound of the vehicles colliding.

I have been driving for forty-five years, and I usually consider myself quite careful, but today was just one of those days. I was heading to pick up my granddaughter from school, and the traffic was incredibly heavy on Avenida da República. I signaled to switch lanes, and I suppose I misjudged the speed of the approaching car. We bumped fenders as I merged. My car has a visible crush on the side panel. It is quite frustrating, but these things do happen in the city traffic, I suppose.

I was driving steadily in the left lane when the driver in the Mercedes decided to move over. He came into my lane too quickly for me to avoid him. We made contact, resulting in a dent on his passenger door and my front bumper.

Honestly, this is just so typical of my luck. I was trying to squeeze into a parking spot in the city center. I am usually very good at this, but I miscalculated the angle of the curb. I ended up scraping the side of my car against a concrete bollard, and unfortunately, it also caught the bumper of the car parked in front. There is a deep scratch along the side. I am really worried about what the insurance company will say about my record, man.

Driving along the Marginal in Cascais is usually pleasant, but today the sun was blindingly bright as I headed west. A car in front slowed down abruptly for a pedestrian crossing, and because of the glare, I didn't see them stop until the very last second. I slammed the brakes and skidded a bit, hitting them. My front lamp is broken and there is a dent on the hood. I am so stressed out; I hope the individual driving the other car is okay, despite the damage to their car.

I had to brake firmly for a person crossing the street. I was already stopped when I felt a hard hit from behind. The Audi driver was very apologetic about the glare. My rear bumper has a significant dent and a broken rear light assembly.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving along the avenue when the lane suddenly narrowed due to roadworks that weren't clearly marked. The vehicle to my left also tried to merge into the remaining lane at the same time. There wasn't enough space for both of us, and we side-swiped each other. It caused a long scratch and a dent on my driver-side door. It’s quite annoying because I was keeping a steady speed and the signage was really poor in that area.

The road narrowed unexpectedly. We were both trying to merge. I thought I had the right of way, but we both converged on the same spot. We hit each other's side doors. My car has a scratch and a dent from the impact.

I was navigating the cobblestone streets of Porto, trying to find a hotel. The streets are incredibly narrow, and I was turning a corner when my front-side bumper caught the edge of a brick wall. It was a very low-speed maneuver, probably 5 km/h, but the corner was much sharper than it looked. My headlamp is broken, and it resulted in a large scratch running down the panel. I am just really annoyed with myself for hitting the wall; it’s a beautiful city, but the driving is difficult.

I was travelling home after work around 18:30 in heavy traffic. The car in front of me suddenly stopped because the light turned red at the intersection. I braked as hard as I could, but the road was a bit slippery from the light drizzle and I couldn't stop in time. My front bumper hit their rear bumper. I feel terrible about it, honestly. I got out immediately to check on the other driver. It resulted in a noticeable dent on my hood where it met their trunk. Everything happened so fast, I am just so shaken up.

I was stopped at the red light near the roundabout when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. I checked my mirror and saw the second vehicle had rear-ended me. When I stepped out, I saw a dent in my rear bumper cover. The oncoming driver was very polite and apologized immediately, admitting they just didn't see me stop in time.

I was trying to parallel park in a very tight spot on Rua de Santa Catarina. I misjudged the angle while reversing and scraped against the side of the car parked behind me. I feel so embarrassed about it. I immediately stopped and waited for the owner to return so we could exchange details. It resulted in a long mark on the rear passenger door of the other car and a matching scratch on my front bumper. It was entirely my mistake, the spot was just way too small for my car.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving in the middle lane when I signaled to move to the right. I looked, but I suppose I missed the other car in my blind spot. As I started moving over, I heard a loud scraping noise and realized I hit the other vehicle. I corrected my steering immediately. We pulled over safely. My car has a dent and a deep scratch along the side panel. The situation involved a lapse in judgment on my part, and I really hope the other driver is okay.

I was driving straight in the right lane when this car suddenly came into my lane without looking. I did my best to swerve, but there was a dent and a scratch left on my rear quarter panel. It happened in a split second. The driver apologized right away when we stopped to exchange insurance information.

It was pouring rain this morning near the Boavista roundabout. I was exiting the roundabout and thought the car next to me was staying in the inner lane, but they decided to exit as well. We clipped each other during the turn. My front lamp is broken and it resulted in a bad scratch on the fender. I am so worried about the repair costs, man. It's just been a really stressful morning and I definitely could have been more careful with my positioning in such heavy, wet traffic.

I was maneuvering to turn into a narrow side street near the downtown area. A delivery van was parked slightly protruding into the road, and as I tried to squeeze past, I hit my side mirror against their rear corner. My mirror's glass shattered instantly. It was a very low-speed impact, maybe 5 km/h, but the sound was quite startling. I am very frustrated with myself for being so reckless in such a narrow passage. I have documented the glass shatter and the position of both vehicles for the report.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the Smart car attempt to pass the delivery van. The driver clearly underestimated the distance. There was a loud pop when the mirror hit the van, and I saw the glass shatter all over the pavement. The driver stopped immediately.

I was driving along the coast, heading towards Cascais. The morning sun was quite low and very bright, which made it hard to see the brake lights of the car in front of me clearly. By the time I realized they were stopping for a pedestrian crossing, I was too close. I hit the brakes hard, but still made contact. I noticed a significant dent on the trunk of the car I hit. I feel terrible about this because I am usually a very careful driver, but the light was just blinding.

I was slowing down for the pedestrian crossing on the Marginal. The driver behind me didn't seem to notice until the last second. They hit my rear bumper quite hard, causing a large dent. I checked my car and the driver was very apologetic, explaining that the sun had blinded them temporarily.

I was parked on the side of Rua de Cedofeita, and as I was pulling out into the traffic, I didn't check my side mirror well enough. A car was passing by, and I sideswiped their passenger side. It resulted in a long, ugly scratch along their door. I am just really anxious about how the insurance process works and how much this will affect my policy. I have all the photos of the scratch and the location where it happened. I truly didn't see the other vehicle coming.

I was visiting the aquarium with my grandchildren. While reversing out of the parking space, I miscalculated the pillar nearby. I backed into it, which caused a dent in my trunk and my rear lamp is completely broken. It was a foolish mistake; I was just distracted thinking about the tickets and the kids. I feel quite silly about it, honestly. My granddaughter was crying because of the loud noise. I am just glad no one was hurt during the maneuver, just a bit of damage to the car.

I entered the intersection, thinking I had the green arrow, but I might have been mistaken. A car coming from the cross-street struck my front side. There is a nasty dent and a long scratch on the fender. I am so confused because I really thought the light was for me, but clearly, something went wrong. I have exchanged all details with the other driver. I am just hoping the repairs won't take too long as I need my car for my sales appointments next week.

I had the green light and was proceeding through the junction when the Audi suddenly pulled out in front of me. I couldn't stop in time. My front bumper hit their side, causing a dent and scratch. It was definitely their fault, but the driver was at least very professional about admitting they might have misread the signal.

I was driving along Estrada Monumental towards the city center. A scooter ahead of me had to brake suddenly because a pedestrian stepped onto the road, and I had to brake hard to avoid hitting the scooter. The car behind me, unfortunately, did not react fast enough and collided with my rear end. The impact was quite strong; my rear light glass shattered and the lamp unit is completely broken. I am just relieved that the scooter rider didn't fall, but my car is in a bad state now.

I was walking on the sidewalk and saw the whole thing. The car had to slam on its brakes because of the scooter, and the car behind didn't have enough distance. The crash was quite loud, and I saw the rear lamp glass shatter all over the road. The driver of the Volvo stayed calm and called the police.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, you know, during the rush hour traffic. It was super crowded and everyone was moving at like 20 km/h. Suddenly, the car in front of me stopped completely for a pedestrian. I did my best to brake, but I didn't leave enough distance and my front bumper hit the back of his car. It was really stressful, man. I got out and saw a visible dent on his rear bumper. I feel so bad about the whole situation because it was totally my fault for being distracted.

I was stopped at the designated pedestrian crossing when I felt a significant impact from behind. I checked my rearview mirror and realized the driver behind me hadn't stopped in time. Upon inspecting the vehicle, I noted a clear dent on my rear bumper cover. We exchanged details calmly.

I was circling the Rotunda do Relógio trying to exit towards the airport. It was raining quite heavily, and the visibility was poor. As I moved to the outer lane, I didn't see the van next to me properly and we ended up scraping against each other. It was just a small scratch along my passenger side door. I am really worried about how much this will cost to repair, as it’s a relatively new car and I’m trying to be very careful with my expenses.

I was attempting to park in a very narrow spot in downtown Coimbra. I must have miscalculated the angle while reversing at very low speed, maybe 5 km/h. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had clipped the rear fender of a parked vehicle. There is a visible dent and a long mark on the other car's panel. I left a note on their windshield immediately because I know how annoying it is to find damage on your car when you return to it.

I was heading home from work on Avenida dos Aliados. I checked my mirrors before merging lanes, but there was a huge blind spot and I missed seeing the motorcyclist coming up fast. When I moved, he had to swerve and clipped my side mirror, causing the glass to shatter completely. I stopped immediately to assist. It was truly an honest mistake, I just didn't see him in the flow of traffic at that specific moment.

I was riding in the right lane when the car in front of me started merging without using their indicator. I made an effort to avoid the collision, but my handlebar struck their mirror, resulting in the glass shattering. I did not fall, but my bike sustained minor scrapes to the mirror casing.

It happened to be a beautiful morning in Funchal and I was driving to the supermarket on Estrada Monumental. As I reached the intersection, the sun was right in my eyes and I completely missed the stop sign for a split second. I entered the junction and bumped into a car crossing my path. My front right lamp is broken as a result of the impact. I am so embarrassed; I pride myself on being a safe driver, but today I just made a really careless mistake.

Traffic on Avenida da República was stop-and-go as usual. I was looking for an address on my phone for a second and looked up too late. The car ahead had already stopped, and I hit them. My front bumper has a deep dent and the left lamp is broken. I feel terrible about this because it was entirely my fault. I'm just thankful that nobody was injured, as that would have been a much worse situation.

I was walking along the sidewalk and saw the whole thing. The Ford Focus driver didn't brake in time because they were clearly looking down at something in their hand. The situation involved a low-speed impact, but definitely enough to cause the damage to the headlamp and bumper I see now.

I was driving home along the coast on the Marginal road. The light turned yellow and I decided to stop, but the driver behind me didn't expect it. He hit me from behind at around 30 km/h. The force of the impact caused my rear tail light glass to shatter and you can see a significant dent in the tailgate. I am really shaken up by the suddenness of it all, but I am just glad nobody in either car was hurt in the collision.

I was following the VW Polo and misjudged the distance. When they stopped suddenly for the yellow light, I couldn't stop in time. I hit the back of their car. My front bumper is okay, but I clearly caused the damage to their rear light and the dent on their trunk.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on the Avenida was extremely heavy as usual. I stopped my Renault behind a black sedan at a red light near the Marquês de Pombal square. Unfortunately, I was distracted for a split second by my phone notification and my foot slipped off the brake. I gently tapped the rear bumper of the car ahead, resulting in a small dent and a long scratch on my front bumper. I feel terrible about it, honestly, it was completely my fault for not paying attention.

I was sitting at the traffic light waiting for it to turn green when I suddenly felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me didn't seem to stop in time due to the dense traffic. When I got out, I saw that the collision caused a slight dent and some scratches on the plastic bumper of my vehicle. We exchanged insurance details right there on the side of the road.

Man, this is so stressful, I'm just a student, you know? I was navigating the busy roundabout at Boavista in Porto. It was raining slightly and the road was super slick. I was changing lanes to exit when I didn't see the van in my blind spot. I clipped their side and it broke my headlight lamp and left a nasty scratch down the passenger side. I feel so bad, dude, I was just trying to get to my class on time and wasn't careful enough with the lane change.

I was trying to park my Fiat in a very tight spot on Rua da Prata this morning. I thought I had enough clearance while turning the steering wheel, but the angle was sharper than I estimated. I ended up scraping the rear quarter panel against a concrete pillar in the parking garage. It left a deep scratch there now. It is incredibly frustrating because the space was quite narrow and I was being careful, but I clearly misjudged the proximity to the wall.

I was walking by the parking area when I saw the driver attempting to maneuver the Fiat into the narrow spot. They were going very slowly, but the car made a scraping sound against the pillar. I saw the driver get out immediately to check the damage, which looked like a visible scrape along the side of their car. It was clearly an honest mistake while trying to park.

The traffic was moving slowly along Avenida dos Aliados. I signaled to switch lanes to the right to prepare for a turn. I checked my mirrors, but I think I had a blind spot because I could not spot the motorcycle coming up. I swerved slightly and knocked into them. My car sustained a damage to the driver's side door and the indicator lamp is broken. I am so relieved the motorcyclist is okay, but I am really worried about the insurance paperwork and the costs involved for these repairs.

My wife and I were driving down the EN125 near Faro to visit our grandchildren. The weather was bright, but the sun was hitting the windshield at an awkward angle. While merging onto the main road, I didn't notice the pickup truck coming from my left side. We made contact, causing a long scratch and a shallow dent along my driver-side door. We are both over 70, so we were a bit shaken up, but thankfully it was only a low-speed side-swipe and no one was physically hurt in the process.

I was driving along the EN125 at about 50 km/h when the Toyota attempted to merge without seeing me. I made an effort to brake, but we still ended up swiping each other. My side of the truck is fine, but their car definitely has a dent and a scratch where we made contact. It was an unfortunate incident, but the elderly couple was very polite and cooperative throughout the whole insurance exchange.

I approached the intersection at Alameda das Antas. The light had just turned yellow, and I misjudged the distance required to stop safely. I crossed the line just as the cross-traffic started moving. A small van clipped my rear passenger door. The force caused the window glass to shatter completely. I am honestly quite shaken by the experience; the noise of the glass breaking was very loud. I acknowledge that I should have braked earlier, but the timing of the signal caught me completely off guard.

I was idling in the heavy afternoon congestion near Praça de Espanha. I was looking at my GPS to double-check my route. I thought the car in front had started moving, so I eased off the brake, but they were actually still stopped. I bumped into their rear bumper. It resulted in a visible dent on my hood near the grill. I feel incredibly stupid for not paying attention to the road ahead. I have already contacted my insurer to start the process for the bodywork repair.

I was waiting for the traffic to move forward at the intersection. Suddenly, I felt a thump from behind. I checked my rearview mirror and saw the Hyundai driver had hit my bumper. They came out immediately to apologize. There is a small dent on their hood where they hit my tow bar. It happened to be a clear-cut case of inattention in slow-moving traffic.

I was parked on a very narrow street in Cedofeita to drop off some groceries. When I pulled out of the parking spot, I didn't realize how close the concrete post was to my corner. I heard a crunch and saw that I had scraped the side panel and shattered my side marker lamp. I'm just so annoyed with myself, I've had a long week and clearly wasn't focusing on the spatial awareness of my vehicle while exiting the bay. I'll need to get the lamp and the scratch fixed soon.

I was on my way at about 40 km/h along the Avenida da República. A delivery truck in the adjacent lane began merging into my lane without checking. I did my best to steer away, but their back corner clipped my passenger side. It left a long, deep scratch and a noticeable dent along the door panel. The driver was very cooperative once they realized what had happened. I'm just hoping the repair process is straightforward, as I use this car daily for my professional appointments and can't afford to be without it for too long.

I am a delivery driver in Lisbon. I was changing lanes to make a delivery, and I simply didn't see the Tesla in my peripheral vision until it was too late. I clipped the side of their car. It was my fault entirely for the lane change. I checked the damage and there is a dent and some scratches on their door. I provided all my company insurance documentation to the driver to assist with their claim.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Porto

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marechal Gomes da Costa. It was raining quite hard, and visibility was reduced. As I was exiting, a car from the inner lane tried to force their way out and hit my passenger side window, causing the glass to shatter inward. I had to pull over immediately because the shards were everywhere. It was a really scary moment for me, and I'm just trying to make sense of the accident report forms now. I hope the insurance company can process this quickly so I can get back on the road.

I was waiting at the roundabout entrance when I saw the two cars collide. The driver in the inner lane seemed to lose control slightly on the wet pavement and drifted into the Volvo. The impact was right on the passenger window of the Volvo, which shattered instantly. It was a rainy day and both drivers were moving slowly, but the contact was unavoidable given the sudden movement of the second vehicle.

I was driving down Avenida da Liberdade around 5 PM in heavy traffic. The car in front of me suddenly braked for a pedestrian crossing, and although I tried to brake, I didn't stop in time. I hit the rear of the other vehicle at a very low speed. It was totally my fault, man, I was just a bit distracted by the radio. My bumper has a clear dent and a deep scratch from the impact. I am so worried about the repair costs, you know, being a student and all.

Traffic was stop-and-go as usual near the center of Lisbon. I stopped safely at the pedestrian crossing, but the driver behind me failed to stop. They bumped into the back of my Golf. I got out and saw a dent on my bumper and some paint scratches. The other driver was very apologetic and admitted they were distracted.

Navigating the Rotunda da Boavista in Porto is always chaotic, but today was worse than usual with the rain. I was changing lanes to exit toward the bridge when I misjudged the proximity of the van next to me. I heard a scraping sound immediately. When I pulled over, I saw a long scratch along the side of my car. I feel terrible about the accident; I have been driving for years and never hit anyone before, it's just such a stressful situation for me.

I was parking near the market on Avenida Luísa Todi this morning. It was quite busy with people shopping. As I was reversing into the spot, I missed seeing the concrete post hidden by a trash bin.
