I backed into it slowly, but I still managed to put a significant dent in my rear quarter panel. I was quite embarrassed as people were watching. I am just hoping the insurance covers the repairs because I really need the car for my daily commute to work.

I was walking by the market and saw the small Fiat backing into the parking space. The driver seemed to be checking their mirrors but clearly missed the concrete post partially obscured by the waste container. The car hit the post at a low speed, resulting in a visible crush on the rear panel. It was clearly an honest mistake.

I was pulling out of a very tight parking spot on Rua de Santa Catarina. The street is extremely narrow, and I must have miscalculated the turn while exiting. I grazed the side of the car parked in front of mine. It left a long, visible scratch along my front fender. I feel quite bad about damaging the other vehicle, even though it’s just a superficial mark. I’ve already left my contact details under their wiper blade to ensure everything is handled properly.

It was raining heavily on Avenida 24 de Julho, and visibility was quite poor. The taxi in front of me slammed on their brakes, and I couldn't stop in time on the slick road. I hit the back of his taxi. My front bumper has a noticeable dent and my right lamp is broken from the impact. I've been driving for years and I usually pride myself on my reaction times, but today I was just unable to avoid it. I am very sorry for the inconvenience.

Traffic stopped abruptly due to a cyclist on the road. The BMW behind me clearly couldn't handle the wet surface and rear-ended my taxi. My bumper is fine, but the BMW has a broken lamp and a dent on their hood. We exchanged insurance info and both agreed the weather was the main factor.

I was travelling down Avenida da Boavista when a bus pulled out from the stop suddenly. I tried to maneuver to the left to give him space, but I ended up getting too close to the parked cars on the side of the road. I scraped the rear wing of a parked sedan. It’s just a scratch, but I feel terrible about it. The bus driver didn't even notice what happened, so I had to stop and take responsibility for the damage I caused.

I saw the whole thing from the cafe terrace. The bus pulled out, forcing the Audi to swerve. The Audi driver couldn't avoid the parked car and caused a scratch on its body. It was clearly a forced maneuver by the bus, not the Audi driver's fault, though they stopped to take care of the damage.

I was crossing the intersection at Estrada de Benfica during the afternoon rush. Another driver was turning, and we both moved into the same space simultaneously. It was a low-speed impact, but my front left side now has a dent and the turn signal lamp is broken. I am so worried about the costs, man. I am a young driver and I really need this car to get to university every day. I hope everything is sorted out quickly without too much stress.

We both misjudged the intersection timing while turning. It was a minor collision at very low speed. My car sustained minimal damage, but the other driver's front lamp is broken and it resulted in a damage to the bumper. We both were confused as to who had the right of way in the moment.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 9:00 AM heading to my office. The traffic was quite heavy as usual, and when the car in front of me suddenly braked hard, I didn't have enough time to react fully despite driving slowly. I managed to slow down, but my front bumper tapped their rear bumper. It was a low-speed impact, but now I can clearly see a visible dent on the hood and some surface scratches where we made contact. I feel terrible about this, I just hope the repair process isn't too complicated.

I was stopped in the queue when I suddenly felt a nudge from behind. I checked my mirror and realized the driver behind me had misjudged the distance during the stop-and-go traffic. We pulled over immediately to exchange details. It resulted in a clear dent on my bumper and a few noticeable scratches on the paintwork.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, intending to take the third exit. As I was moving from the inner lane to the outer lane, I misjudged the position of the van next to me. It was a rainy Tuesday and visibility was poor, man, I'm really stressed because this is my first accident. I felt a crunch and when I checked, my front right lamp was broken. It was honestly just a silly mistake on my part while trying to merge safely in the busy city traffic.

I was attempting to reverse into a tight parallel parking space near the university. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but I must have miscalculated the angle of the curb and the position of the parked car behind me. I heard a scraping sound and stopped immediately. Upon inspection, there are clear white scratches along the side of my rear quarter panel. I feel quite embarrassed about the whole incident, honestly, as I have been driving for years and pride myself on being careful, but this parking spot was just incredibly narrow.

I was heading along the EN125 towards Faro when I decided to shift into the right lane to prepare for my turn. I looked in my mirror, but I clearly missed the other vehicle moving up in my blind spot. I steered into the lane and felt a jolt as we sideswiped each other at about 40 km/h. It resulted in a dent and several deep scratches along my passenger door. I am really worried about how much this is going to cost to fix, and I just feel completely responsible for this lapse in attention.

I was proceeding straight in the right lane on the EN125 when the car next to me suddenly veered into my lane without signaling. I slammed on the brakes but we still made contact on the side. I have a dent and deep scratches on my front driver-side panel as a result.

I was travelling down the narrow Rua de Santa Catarina to drop off some shopping bags. A delivery truck was backing out of a side street and didn't see me coming. I made an effort to sound my horn, but it happened too fast. The edge of their heavy loading gate hit my side window, causing the glass to shatter completely. I am shaken up, just an old lady out on a Tuesday afternoon trying to run errands, and now this happens. It's just such a mess, glass everywhere on the passenger seat and the door frame.

I was approaching the intersection on Avenida Luísa Todi. The light had just turned yellow, and I made a quick decision to proceed, but the driver coming from the cross street was also trying to clear the intersection. We hit at a low speed. My front bumper has a significant dent and the headlight assembly is completely destroyed, with the lamp broken. It's a professional matter, I need the car for my daily visits, so I hope the insurance assessment can be processed promptly. I have documentation from the scene as well.

I was waiting at the pedestrian crossing nearby. I saw the Citroën try to beat the light at the same time the other car was crossing. The situation involved a low-speed impact, but I clearly heard the sound of plastic breaking and saw the headlight glass shatter on the ground.

Traffic on the bridge was backed up, as it often is during the morning commute. I was following the car in front at a distance of about 5 meters, doing maybe 20 km/h, when they braked abruptly for a stalled vehicle further ahead. I slammed on my brakes, but I just couldn't stop in time. The impact caused a noticeable dent on my hood. It's very frustrating because it was just a minor slip in focus, and I've been driving for years without a single incident like this until now.

I was trying to park on Rua da Prata. The street is quite busy with tourists and pedestrians, which made me quite nervous. I was reversing slowly when I could not spot the metal bollard on the edge of the sidewalk. I heard a nasty scraping noise against the passenger door. I checked and there are deep scratches along the side. Man, I feel so stupid. I just wanted to get a quick coffee and now I have to deal with this whole insurance claim process. It's just really discouraging, you know?

I was navigating North on Avenida da Liberdade at a moderate speed. A vehicle in the left lane attempted to make a right turn without checking his blind spot effectively. We sideswiped, causing damage to my driver-side door. There is a large dent and a long scratch where our paints rubbed together. I am quite shaken as the traffic here in Braga can get very aggressive during the rush hour. I am just trying to be factual here so that the insurance can settle this correctly and efficiently.

I was in the middle lane and moved to the right, failing to notice the driver alongside me. It happened to be a momentary lapse in judgment. I take full responsibility for the collision. The side of his vehicle has a dent and some scratches from my rear bumper area.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: I was circling the roundabout when another vehicle entered too quickly from the side and clipped my front corner. The impact broke my front left lamp and there is also a visible crack in the plastic bumper housing. I have been driving for over forty years, and while I try to be as careful as possible, these things can happen even to the best of us in such congested city centers. I am quite worried about the repair costs, but I have already taken photos of the damage for the insurance records.

I was navigating home after work around 6:30 PM. The traffic on Avenida da Boavista was really heavy as usual. I slowed down because the car in front of me braked suddenly, but the driver behind me, who I think was distracted by his phone, didn't react in time. He hit my rear bumper quite hard, causing a noticeable dent. I am honestly quite shaken up because I have never been in an accident before and I am worried about the cost of repairs for my car.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio during the morning rush. I was in the right lane to exit towards the airport, and there was a delivery van in the inner lane. As I moved to exit, the van tried to cut across to the same exit, and his side mirror grazed my rear door. It left a long mark on the paint. I stopped immediately, and the driver was very apologetic, admitting he just didn't see me in his blind spot.

I admit fault in this situation. I was in the middle of the roundabout and intended to exit, but I miscalculated the positioning of the Peugeot beside me. My van made contact with his side, resulting in a scratch on his bodywork. We exchanged information immediately.

It was raining heavily on Avenida 24 de Julho. I was maintaining about 40 km/h in the right lane. A car tried to change lanes without signaling and clipped my front right side. The impact smashed my signal lamp and left a nasty scratch down the passenger side door. It happened so fast that I barely had time to brake. I'm really stressed about this, as I rely on this car to pick up my children from school every afternoon.

I was standing on the sidewalk waiting for the bus when I saw the silver Nissan driving correctly. The second vehicle changed lanes way too quickly given the slick conditions. The collision broke the lamp on the Nissan and caused visible scratches. It was clearly the fault of the car that merged into the lane.

I was pulling out of a parallel parking spot on Avenida dos Aliados. I checked my mirrors, but as I started to move into the lane, a delivery motorcycle sped past and I clipped him with my front fender. He fell over, but thankfully he wasn't hurt. My car has a small dent on the wheel arch from the contact. I feel terrible about it, honestly, I should have double-checked my blind spot one more time before moving.

I was driving down the lane when the Fiat pulled out. I think the driver didn't see me because of the other parked vehicles. I swerved but couldn't avoid the contact. The Fiat hit my leg guard, causing a dent to her fender. I am fine, just a bit shaken.

The traffic was moving at about 30 km/h on Avenida da República. I stopped at a pedestrian crossing because someone was waiting to cross. The car behind me hit the back of my vehicle with significant force. The impact pushed me forward slightly, and my rear window suffered glass shatter, along with a massive dent on the trunk lid. It was very loud and scary. I hope the repair process goes smoothly as I need the car back by next week for a business trip.

I am terribly sorry for the accident. I was looking at my GPS for a split second and didn't notice the Audi in front of me had come to a complete stop for the pedestrians. I hit him quite hard, causing damage to his trunk and rear glass. I accept full responsibility for the collision.

I was cruising along the Estrada Marginal enjoying the sea view. A car was merging onto the road from a side street and he didn't check his speed. He merged way too quickly, clipping the side of my car. It left a long, ugly scratch along the driver's side door. It's frustrating because the car is fairly new. I spoke to the individual driving the other car, and he was quite apologetic, acknowledging he didn't estimate the speed of the traffic on the main road correctly.

I was walking my dog on the nearby path and saw the whole thing. The Tesla was driving steady at the speed limit. The other vehicle entered the main road without looking and swiped the side of the Tesla. The impact clearly left a mark on the side of the Tesla. The other driver should have waited for a clear gap in traffic.

I was on my way home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was moving slowly, maybe 15 km/h, when the car in front of me braked suddenly to avoid a cyclist. I tried to press the brake pedal immediately, but I just couldn't stop in time. I hit the rear of the other vehicle with my bumper. I felt really bad because it was my fault, and now you can see a noticeable dent on my hood from the impact.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, and honestly, it was so confusing with all the construction work going on today. I was in the outer lane trying to exit toward the highway when a van suddenly cut into my lane from the inside. I tried to steer away, but we ended up side-swiping each other at a very low speed. It was just a minor scratch on my passenger door, but I am still pretty shaken up by how quickly it all happened.

I was driving in the middle lane of the roundabout and needed to exit. I checked my mirror, but I suppose the Peugeot was in my blind spot because I didn't see them before I started moving over. We made light contact, resulting in a scratch on their side panel. It was an honest mistake on my part, and I've already apologized to the other driver.

I was trying to parallel park in front of a cafe on Rua da Rainha this morning. I thought I had plenty of space, but I misjudged the distance to the concrete bollard on the sidewalk. As I turned the wheel to reverse, I heard a horrible scraping noise. When I got out to look, I saw a dent and a deep scratch on my rear bumper. I feel so embarrassed about it, as I've been driving for years and have never done anything this clumsy before.

It was pouring rain this afternoon, and the visibility near the waterfront was really poor. I approached the intersection and thought the light was still yellow, but it turned red just as I entered. Another car was already moving through, and I clipped their rear corner. My front lamp is broken and there is glass shatter all over the road from my headlight casing. I am so worried about the repair costs, this is just not my day, man.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus when I saw the collision. The weather was truly terrible, very heavy rain. The driver in the Renault clearly misjudged the intersection timing, and the impact caused their headlight to shatter. I stayed to make sure everyone was okay and confirmed that the Renault's lamp was indeed broken during the impact.

I was navigating along the main tourist area in Funchal when I decided to change lanes to get into the correct lane for the exit. I turned on my indicator and checked my side mirrors, but I suppose the oncoming driver accelerated just as I started to move over. We ended up rubbing fenders at about 30 km/h. There is a visible scratch along my driver-side rear fender. I truly believed the lane was clear when I checked, but the timing was just unfortunate.

I was pulling out of a very narrow parking spot on Rua de Cedofeita. The streets in this part of Porto are so tight, and I was trying to be extra careful. I guess I failed to notice the post hidden behind a delivery truck. I backed into it at a very low speed. It caused a damage to the rear hatch and my taillamp is broken. My grandson usually tells me to be more careful with these narrow streets, and I suppose he was right this time.

I was navigating down Avenida Luísa Todi on my way to the market. The traffic was stop-and-go because of the roadworks. I was looking at the traffic light ahead and didn't notice that the driver in front had stopped completely. I tapped their bumper. The situation involved a very minor impact, but there is a clear dent on my front bumper now. I am quite annoyed with myself for being distracted by the lights, but thankfully nobody was hurt in the process.

I was completely stopped in traffic. I felt a sudden bump from behind. It was not a violent impact, but it was enough to leave a small dent on the Seat's bumper. I checked my own vehicle and luckily there was no significant damage. We both exchanged insurance details calmly and left the road clear for others.

Driving through Coimbra is always a bit stressful with all the hills and the constant start-stop traffic. I was coming down a steep street and the car ahead stalled. I hit them from behind at about 20 km/h. My front lamp is broken and there is a noticeable dent on my front panel. It happened to be a genuine accident caused by the steep incline and the unexpected stop of the vehicle ahead. I am very sorry for the trouble caused to the other driver.

I was driving up the hill when my engine stalled unexpectedly. Before I could restart it, the car behind me hit my rear. The impact broke their headlight. It was a purely accidental situation given the difficult conditions on that street. We exchanged information, and I am currently waiting for my own vehicle assessment.

I was driving home after work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I did my best to hit my brakes, but I was just a bit too late and tapped the back of his bumper. It was totally my fault, I was a bit distracted by the radio. I can see a visible damage to the rear bumper of my car, and it's quite worrying because I need my car for work tomorrow.

I was driving steadily toward the city center when traffic came to a sudden halt. I stopped safely, but moments later I felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me admitted he was distracted and apologized immediately. My rear bumper sustained a clear dent from the impact.

I feel absolutely terrible about this, man. I was just trying to squeeze into this really tight parking spot near Rua Augusta, you know? It’s super busy here today and I was trying to be quick so I wouldn't block traffic behind me. I misjudged the angle while reversing and scraped the side of the car parked next to me. There is a long scratch on my passenger door now. I’m just so stressed about how much this is going to cost to fix, honestly, I didn't mean for this to happen.

I was navigating the roundabout, and honestly, the traffic was moving quite fast. I signaled to change lanes to exit towards the center of Porto, but I think I didn't check my blind spot well enough. I heard a loud noise and realized I had clipped another vehicle. My front lamp is broken, and there is a deep scratch along the side panel. It happened so fast, and I'm really shaken up by the whole experience. I just hope the oncoming driver is okay, this has never happened to me before.

I was walking near the roundabout and saw the Peugeot attempt to switch lanes abruptly. The driver of the other vehicle didn't have enough time to react. I saw the Peugeot's lamp shatter upon contact with the side of the other car. It was clearly an unfortunate driving error due to lack of visibility.

I was heading along Avenida 24 de Julho this morning in the right lane. A delivery van suddenly pulled out from the side without checking, and to avoid hitting him head-on, I swerved slightly to the left. In doing so, I sideswiped a car that was cruising in the next lane. You can see a long, ugly scratch across my driver's side door now. I’m quite frustrated, as it happened to be a reaction to the van, but I acknowledge I made contact with the other vehicle. It’s all very stressful.

It was a lovely afternoon, I was running some errands for my granddaughter, picking up a few items from the pharmacy. As I entered the intersection at Avenida dos Aliados, the traffic lights seemed to have switched, and I suppose I moved forward too quickly. Another vehicle entered from the cross street, and we collided. My front bumper has a noticeable dent and my headlight lamp is broken. I feel quite embarrassed as I have been driving for forty years without an incident. It was just a simple lapse in my concentration.

I had the green light at the intersection. The other driver entered the junction while I was passing through, leading to the collision. My car sustained damage to the front corner, including a broken lamp and a dent in the fender. I am relieved that nobody was physically hurt.

I was parking at the Alameda shopping center, it was extremely packed as it’s Saturday. I thought I had cleared the concrete pillar, but clearly I hadn't. I heard a scraping sound and then a thud. When I got out, I saw a dent and a long mark on the rear quarter panel of my car. I’m so annoyed with myself for being so clumsy. I really should have had my partner guide me into the space, as it was quite a tight turn.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving towards Saldanha in heavy morning traffic. I signaled to switch to the center lane to avoid a parked bus, but I miscalculated the speed of the car in that lane. We made contact, resulting in a scratch along the passenger side of my vehicle. I stopped immediately and we both pulled over to exchange details. I am a very careful driver, but this morning I was definitely rushing because I was late for a meeting, which I now realize was a poor decision.

I was maintaining my lane on the main avenue when the driver to my right attempted an unsafe lane change. I could not avoid the contact. The impact resulted in a surface scratch on my vehicle's rear door panel. The driver was cooperative throughout the exchange.

It was raining quite heavily in Porto, and the visibility was poor. I was reversing out of a narrow side street onto Rua de Santa Catarina. I could not spot the delivery truck passing by because of the rain on my mirrors. My side mirror hit his side mirror, and the glass shattered completely. It was just a low-speed impact, but the sound was quite alarming. I feel terrible, but I genuinely didn't see him coming in the gray conditions. It’s been a really difficult day with this weather.

I was cruising down Avenida da República and keeping a decent distance. Suddenly, the car in front slammed on their brakes for no apparent reason. My vehicle’s sensors warned me, and I did what I could, but the road was a bit slick, so I couldn't stop in time. I hit them, causing a dent in my hood and a broken lamp. I'm just so disappointed because I try to maintain my car in perfect condition. It’s just one of those things that happens in city traffic.

I was driving at a normal speed when I had to stop for a cyclist who crossed the street suddenly. The driver behind me hit my vehicle. The impact was enough to break one of my rear lamps and leave a dent in my bumper.

I was heading home to Cascais along the coastal road. It was quite a beautiful day, honestly, but then this bike lane situation caught me off guard near the turn. I moved over slightly to allow a cyclist more room, and I accidentally scraped the concrete divider on the side of the road. You can see a long, deep scratch on the side panel of the car. I’m just glad I didn't hit anyone else, but the car is definitely damaged. I have already contacted the dealership to see how soon they can look at it.

I was navigating home after work around 18:30. Traffic was quite heavy on the Avenida da Boavista. I came to a full stop because the car in front of me halted abruptly due to a cyclist crossing the street. Unfortunately, the driver behind me didn't react in time and hit the rear of my Golf. It was a low-speed impact, but I can see a visible dent on my bumper. I am honestly quite shaken up by this; it happened so fast, and I really do not know what to do about the repairs.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio during the morning rush. I was in the middle lane when a van suddenly cut across from the inner lane toward the exit. I tried to brake, but there was a light scrape between our vehicles. I am really worried about how much this is going to cost, you know? It's just a long scratch along my passenger side door, but it looks really obvious. I'm just a student and this is my first car, so I'm pretty stressed about the whole claims process.

I was moving through the roundabout and misjudged the distance while merging into the exit lane. I realized too late that the Seat Ibiza was still beside me. My rear panel made contact with their door. It was a momentary lapse in judgment on my part.

It was such a rainy afternoon, and I was trying to park in a tight spot near the university. My vision was obscured by the heavy downpour on the windshield. I miscalculated the turning radius and nudged the vehicle parked ahead of me. Upon inspection, I noticed a dent and a scratch on the corner of my bumper. I feel terrible about damaging someone else's car, as I have always been very careful when parking. I have already left my contact details on their dashboard, just as one should.

I was travelling along the Avenida Luísa Todi in the right lane, maintaining about 40 km/h. A car to my left signaled and started moving into my lane without checking their blind spot. I hit my brakes, but their rear wheel struck my front light, which is now broken. I am so upset because I was headed to my daughter's graduation. It is just a broken lamp, but the whole situation has left me quite rattled and confused about the next steps to take for the insurance.

I intended to change lanes to reach the upcoming turn-off. I checked my mirror, but I clearly didn't notice the Yaris already being there. My bumper clipped the front of their car, and I heard the sound of plastic breaking. I take full responsibility for the error.

Traffic on the bridge was crawling at maybe 20 km/h due to the high volume of commuters. The driver behind me was clearly distracted and did not stop in time when the flow slowed down. The impact was quite strong; it caused a significant dent on my trunk and the rear window suffered a glass shatter from the vibration and force. I was honestly worried for my own safety given the speed of the traffic behind us. Thankfully, nobody was injured, but my car is in a bad state.

I was on my way in the lane next to them. I saw the silver BMW slowing down normally with the flow of traffic, but the car behind it didn't slow down at all. The driver of the trailing car seemed to be looking down at their phone just before the impact occurred. It was quite a loud crash.

I was reversing out of a driveway onto the street when I didn't see a bollard partially obscured by a shop display. My bumper made contact with it. It resulted in a crack on the plastic trim. I've lived in this neighborhood for forty years and I know these streets like the back of my hand, but today, with all the commotion from the nearby market, I simply had a momentary lapse in my concentration. It is quite embarrassing to have to file a claim for such a small error.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I had a green light and proceeded through the intersection. Another driver entered from the side street, seemingly failing to notice their red light, and hit the front corner of my vehicle. The impact was right near the headlight, which is now broken, and there is a noticeable impact depression on the fender. I am incredibly frustrated because my car is brand new. I'm trying to remain calm, but the whole situation feels very unfair given that I followed all the traffic rules perfectly.

I was heading home after a long shift and I genuinely thought the light was still amber when I entered the crossing. I realized my mistake immediately when I saw the Audi. I am so sorry for the damage caused to the front of your vehicle.

I was travelling west along the Estrada Monumental when a heavy delivery truck tried to overtake me on a narrow section of the road. There wasn't enough clearance, and the side of the truck brushed against my driver-side door. It left a long, deep scratch along the side of the car. I did my best to move as close to the sidewalk as I could, but there was nowhere else to go. It was a very tight squeeze, and I'm really worried about the paint job repair costs.

I was delivering goods to a hotel nearby. The road is very narrow and I honestly thought I had cleared the Citroën, but the trailer must have swung a bit too far to the right during the overtake. I apologize for the contact.

It was around midday, and I was stopped at a pedestrian crossing to let someone pass. The person behind me, who I think was looking at their GPS, didn't notice I had stopped. They collided with my rear bumper. The force caused a dent, and the rear tail lamp is now broken. I am a very cautious driver, so this is quite distressing for me. I have taken photos of both cars and exchanged details with the other driver, who was very polite and admitted fault immediately.

I was waiting to cross the road on foot. I saw the Nissan stop properly for the pedestrian. The car behind it didn't brake at all and just drove straight into the back of it. It seemed like the driver was distracted by their dashboard display.

I was navigating the narrow streets of downtown Lisbon. While trying to squeeze into a parallel parking spot, I misjudged the angle and my rear quarter panel grazed the stone wall of a building. It's just a scratch, but it's quite visible on the paintwork. I am really annoyed with myself because I consider myself a good driver, but these streets are just so tight and difficult to navigate. I've checked the damage, and it doesn't look like any structural components are affected, just the surface.

I was driving home from work around 6:00 PM in the heavy Porto traffic. The car in front of me suddenly stopped because of a pedestrian crossing. I hit my brakes hard, but given the damp road conditions, my car skidded slightly and tapped the rear bumper of the vehicle ahead. I am so sorry for this, I honestly didn't expect the traffic to halt so abruptly. I noticed a visible dent and a long scratch on my front bumper where the metal pressed against theirs. I feel really terrible about this whole situation.

I was stopped at the pedestrian crossing on Avenida da Boavista when I suddenly felt a strong jolt from behind. My car was pushed forward about half a meter. When I got out to check, I saw a dent and a large scratch on my rear bumper. The driver behind me was quite shaken up and admitted immediately that he hadn't been able to stop in time due to the slippery road.

I was attempting to park in a very tight spot near the riverfront. It was my first time visiting this area, and I misjudged the distance between my car and the concrete pillar in the parking garage. As I was turning the wheel to back in, I heard a sickening scraping noise. I stopped immediately, but when I checked, I found a deep, jagged scratch along my passenger side door. I am feeling quite anxious about the repair costs, to be honest. I really should have asked someone to help guide me into the space properly.

I was circling the roundabout, trying to navigate toward the correct exit, when the individual driving the other car suddenly attempted a lane change without signaling correctly. I tried to avoid them, but they caught the front side of my vehicle. It was quite chaotic, with cars honking and everyone trying to keep moving. My front lamp is completely broken and there is a noticeable scratch running along the side fender. I've been driving for years and never had an issue like this; it's really distressing to have my car damaged in such a busy, confusing spot during rush hour.

I was merging to get off the roundabout and I admit I didn't check my side mirror as carefully as I should have. I heard a loud crunching sound as I hit the other car. My car only has a minor mark, but the other driver's front lamp is definitely broken and they have a scratch on the side of their fender. I feel responsible for the confusion.

I was navigating along the EN125 towards Faro when a delivery van drifted into my lane while trying to overtake a cyclist. I tried to move as far to the right as possible, but there was no shoulder space. The van sideswiped me, causing a significant dent in my rear quarter panel and a long, ugly scratch that runs all the way to the fuel cap. It was a very close call and I am still shaking a bit from the shock. I really hope the insurance process isn't too complicated to handle.

I was crossing the intersection when the traffic lights changed faster than I anticipated. Another car entered from the side street at a low speed. We both hit our brakes, but our front corners collided. My front lamp is broken, and there is glass shatter all over the road from the headlight casing. It’s a very modern car, and I’m quite worried about the repair timeline since I rely on it for my daily commute to the office. I was just focused on the flow of traffic and didn't see him coming until the very last second.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the pedestrian crossing light. Both drivers seemed to be driving cautiously, but the light cycle was quite short. They collided at the intersection point. It wasn't a high-speed crash, but the impact caused some clear damage, specifically a broken lamp and glass shatter on the ground. Neither driver seemed to be speeding, just an unfortunate timing error.

It was a busy afternoon and I was trying to pull out of a very narrow space on Rua de Santa Catarina. I was so worried about not hitting the car behind me that I miscalculated the angle of my front bumper. I brushed against a bollard on the edge of the sidewalk. It wasn't a hard hit, but the paint job on the front corner is ruined with a nasty scratch. Man, I feel so stupid. I just wanted to get home before the evening traffic started building up, you know?

I was enjoying a drive along the coast with my grandkids. As we reached a point near the Estoril Casino, the traffic slowed down significantly because of a sightseeing bus stopping. I attempted to slow down gently, but the car behind me didn't react in time. They hit the back of my vehicle. There is a visible dent on the rear trunk lid now. It's a shame, really, as the car was in such perfect condition before today. We weren't hurt, thank goodness, but it has certainly put a damper on our afternoon family outing.

I was distracted by the beautiful view of the ocean and didn't notice the BMW in front of me slowing down. When I looked back at the road, I had no time to stop safely. I bumped into their rear bumper. I feel terrible about it. I caused a dent in their car, but I'm glad nobody was injured during the accident.

I was navigating through the narrow cobblestone streets in the city center. A delivery cyclist swerved suddenly, forcing me to veer toward the side of the road. I hit a stone decorative post. The impact wasn't fast, but it caused a dent in my hood and the headlight assembly is completely ruined with the lamp broken and bits of glass shatter scattered around the front of my vehicle. I'm quite stressed out by the costs involved here. I've lived in this city all my life and driving through these narrow streets is always a challenge, even for experienced drivers.

I was driving down a narrow secondary road in Gaia, returning from a grocery run. A vehicle coming the opposite way was hugging the center line very closely. We both tried to pull over, but there was contact between our side mirrors and the body panels. I noticed a long scratch along my driver-side door. I wasn't speeding at all, as these roads are quite tight. It's frustrating because I maintain my vehicle very meticulously, and seeing it damaged like this is quite upsetting to me.

The road was extremely narrow and I think we both underestimated the clearance. My passenger side brushed against the other car. I stopped as soon as I heard the noise. There is a surface scratch on both our vehicles. It was an honest mistake caused by the road conditions, which aren't really built for two large vehicles to pass each other comfortably.

I was moving from the middle lane to the right lane to prepare for a turn. I checked my mirrors, but I must have missed the other car in my blind spot. As I turned, I heard a sharp impact. Their car hit my front corner, causing a dent and breaking my turn signal lamp. I'm honestly so worried about how this will affect my insurance premium, dude. I've been driving this car for three years without a single scratch. This is so stressful and I just want to get it sorted as soon as possible.

I was navigating home from work along Avenida da Boavista when traffic suddenly came to a complete standstill near the roundabout. I tried to brake, but the road was damp from the earlier rain, and I unfortunately tapped the back of the car in front of me at very low speed. My front bumper hit their rear bumper, causing a visible dent and some scratches on the plastic trim. I am incredibly worried about the repair costs because I have never been in an accident before, you know? It was just a complete lapse in concentration.

I was stopped in heavy traffic when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The driver behind me didn't stop in time. When I got out to check, I saw a dent and a long scratch on my rear bumper. We exchanged details immediately and were both very cooperative given the stressful situation.

I was trying to parallel park in a very tight spot near the center. I misjudged the distance to the car parked behind me while reversing at maybe 3 or 4 km/h. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had grazed the side of the other vehicle with my rear panel. You can see a noticeable scratch on their door now. I feel terrible about the whole situation as it was entirely my fault. I stayed until the second vehicle returned to the car so we could settle the insurance paperwork properly.

I was navigating the roundabout, moving from the inner lane to the outer lane to take my exit. I must have miscalculated the blind spot because I failed to notice the van coming alongside me. We made contact, and it resulted in a dent on my passenger door and some scratches along the side panel. It was such a frantic morning, man, and I honestly just didn't see him there. I hope the repair process isn't too complicated because I need the car for my daily commute to the university.

I was heading through the roundabout when the other car pulled into my lane without checking. I did my best to swerve, but there was a significant impact on my side. I can see a deep dent and several scratches on the driver's side of my van. We both pulled over to the side immediately.

It happened to be a busy afternoon with lots of tourists on the road. I signaled to move into the left lane, and I thought the car behind me was slowing down to let me in. Unfortunately, he accelerated slightly, and the front of my car grazed his rear quarter panel. It caused a long, visible scratch across the paintwork. I have always been a very careful driver, so I am quite disappointed with myself for making such an error in judgment while navigating the traffic flow here.

I was walking along the sidewalk and saw the Opel Corsa try to change lanes. The other driver didn't seem to notice the signal or perhaps didn't want to yield. There was a loud scraping noise when the two vehicles touched. I saw a clear scratch on the body of the car.

I was distracted for a split second by the GPS on my phone, and when I looked up, the traffic in front had stopped. I slammed on the brakes, but I still rear-ended the SUV in front of me. The impact was quite hard, and I can see a deep dent on my hood and my headlight glass shattered upon impact. I feel so embarrassed and anxious about this. I know I shouldn't have been looking at the screen, and I am worried about the insurance premiums going up because of this.

I was backing out of a narrow side street onto the main road. The visibility was poor due to the parked delivery vans. I missed seeing the cyclist crossing, but luckily I only made a very slight impact with the bumper of a stationary car behind me. It left a small, localized dent on the bumper. I have been driving this route for years, and it is just a very difficult corner to maneuver around. I have provided my details to the owner of the parked car immediately.

My car was parked legally on the side of the road. When I returned, I noticed a fresh dent on my rear bumper. The driver of the Fiat was still there and admitted to hitting it while reversing. We documented everything right there on the street.

I was stopping at a pedestrian crossing because someone was waiting to cross the street. The driver behind me didn't notice I had stopped and bumped into me. The collision was not too fast, but it broke my tail lamp and caused a scratch and a small crush on the rear hatch. I have been a driver for forty years and honestly, these city streets have become so chaotic lately. It is just a real nuisance to deal with all this paperwork, but the other driver was very polite.

I was heading in the right lane when a vehicle tried to merge into my lane without leaving enough space. I did my best to move toward the center line to avoid them, but we ended up rubbing sides. There is a long scratch running along the length of my passenger side doors. Dude, it happened so fast I didn't even have time to react properly. I'm just lucky neither of us lost control of the cars because there were other people around on the street at the time.

I thought I had enough room to move into the lane. It seems I misjudged the distance between our vehicles. There is a surface scratch on my door panel. We pulled over safely and agreed to fill out the amicable accident report forms.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: Traffic was crawling along at about 20 km/h. The vehicle ahead of me braked suddenly to avoid a scooter that cut them off. I hit my brakes hard, but the road was a bit slick, and I slid forward just enough to hit their rear bumper. It resulted in a visible dent on my front bumper. I am really stressed out about this because I am late for an important meeting, and now I have to wait for the police report to be finalized.

I was waiting at the bus stop nearby and saw the whole thing. A scooter darted in front of the line of cars, causing a chain reaction. The Mini driver didn't have much time to stop and bumped the car in front. I saw a dent on the Mini's bumper.

I was on my way home after work along Avenida da Boavista, and the traffic was quite heavy as it was around 6 PM. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to stop, but the road was a bit slick from the morning drizzle, and I didn't manage to stop in time. I bumped into the back of his vehicle at a very low speed. I feel terrible about it, honestly, I was really trying to be careful, but it happened so fast, and now there is a noticeable dent on my bumper.

I was entering the roundabout near the airport, and I honestly thought the car in the inner lane was going to exit at the previous turn. I moved to the middle lane to take the exit towards the highway, but the other driver decided to keep going around the roundabout. We made contact, and it caused a nasty scratch and a dent on my passenger door. I am really stressed out about how the insurance process works, as this is my first accident since I got my license, you know?

I was already inside the roundabout, maintaining my lane to head towards the terminal. The insured driver simply cut into my path without checking his mirrors properly. There wasn't much I could do to avoid the collision at that point. It resulted in minor bodywork damage to the side of his car.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: It was a busy afternoon near the square, and I was trying to merge into the right lane to turn. I checked my mirror, but I suppose the other vehicle was in my blind spot. As I began to steer over, I heard a loud scraping sound. I stopped immediately, and when I got out, I saw a long scratch along the rear quarter panel of my car. I feel quite embarrassed by the whole situation, as I am usually very attentive when driving in such crowded city areas.

I was parking in a very tight spot near the shopping area. I was focusing on the pillar behind me and didn't realize how close the curb-side bollard was on my front right side. As I turned the wheel, I heard that awful grinding noise. It turns out I managed to get a deep scratch and a impact depression on the fender. I am just so worried about how much the repair will cost; it was such a simple mistake but I feel really foolish for hitting it.

I was walking past the parking zone and saw the whole thing. The driver was trying to maneuver into a space and clearly misjudged the distance to the concrete bollard on the corner. It was a low-speed impact, but the sound was quite distinct. It left some visible damage on the front bumper area.

I was heading my usual route to pick up my granddaughter from her music lessons. The traffic light turned amber as I was approaching the intersection, and I made the split-second decision to stop, but the driver behind me clearly didn't expect it. He collided with my rear end, which resulted in my tail lamp being broken and a crack on the plastic bumper trim. I'm just shaken up by the noise of the impact and thankful that neither of us was moving particularly fast when it happened.

The light changed quite quickly from green to yellow. The lady in front of me slammed on her brakes very abruptly. I was following at a safe distance but not enough to account for such a sudden stop on this dry pavement. My front bumper hit her rear corner.

I was just cruising along the road at about 40 km/h, admiring the view of the ocean, when the car ahead suddenly slowed down to turn into a hotel driveway. I hit the brake pedal, but I was distracted by the sun glare and reacted a second too late. My car hit the back of his vehicle, causing a dent and breaking one of his rear lamps. I am terribly sorry for the inconvenience, as I know I should have kept a better distance given the bright conditions.

I was moving through the busy traffic near the waterfront. A delivery van suddenly pulled out from the side of the road without signaling properly. To avoid a full-on collision, I swerved to the left, but I still clipped the side of his vehicle. It left a long, ugly scratch along my driver-side door. I’m quite anxious about the repair process, as I’ve heard these body panels can be expensive to fix properly, and I really just want to get my car back to normal as soon as possible.

I was pulling out slowly from the loading zone. I checked my mirrors, but the Mini was moving quite fast and was in my blind spot. I heard a scrape and saw that we had grazed each other along the side. It was just a minor contact, really.

I had been out running errands all morning, picking up some fresh bread and groceries near the old market. When I returned to my parked car, I noticed that another vehicle had hit mine while parking. There was a significant dent on the passenger side door. It is such a nuisance because I have to deal with the insurance paperwork now, and I really had a long day ahead of me. I am just hoping the repairs are straightforward so I don't have to be without my car for too long.

I was heading toward Cascais when the traffic unexpectedly ground to a halt. The driver behind me didn't notice the stopped flow of cars and hit me with quite a bit of force. The impact caused a massive dent on my tailgate and the rear glass shattered completely. I'm feeling very overwhelmed by this situation, man, because I've never had an accident this significant before, and the glass everywhere is just really worrying me. I am trying to keep calm but it’s hard when your car is damaged like this.

I was momentarily distracted by my GPS and didn't see the traffic had stopped ahead of us on the Marginal. By the time I looked up, it was too late to brake effectively. I hit the rear of the Qashqai, damaging his trunk and breaking his rear window.

I was carefully navigating the roundabout, signaling to exit, when another car suddenly accelerated from the entry lane. He didn't yield to traffic already in the circle and swiped my rear bumper, breaking my tail lamp and leaving a deep mark on the paint. I am very frustrated because I followed all the rules of the road. It’s just annoying to have to lose time dealing with the workshop, especially when I have such a busy week of client meetings ahead of me.

I was waiting at the roundabout entrance and saw the whole incident. The Audi was already in the lane, but the other driver just charged into the roundabout without waiting for a clear opening. It caused a collision that broke the tail lamp of the Audi.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista during the morning rush hour when the traffic suddenly came to a complete stop. I hit the brakes, but the road was a bit slick from the earlier rain, and I unfortunately tapped the back of the car in front of me. I am feeling really nervous about the insurance process, man. I honestly didn't see him stop that quickly. There is a visible dent on my bumper where I hit his hitch. I just hope this isn't too expensive to fix, you know?

I was navigating the roundabout at Rotunda da Boavista, trying to exit towards Cedofeita. I was in the middle lane, and I think I misjudged the distance of the car in the inner lane. As I moved to exit, our sides scraped against each other. It was quite chaotic with all the traffic. I have a long, noticeable scratch running across the passenger door panel. I am quite worried about my premiums going up after this mistake.

The other driver attempted to exit the roundabout from the middle lane while I was properly maintaining my lane on the inside. He clearly didn't check his blind spot. My car also sustained a significant scratch along the driver's side panel due to his sudden maneuver.

The traffic lights at the intersection were changing, and I think I was a bit distracted by the GPS. As I entered the crossing, I clipped the rear corner of a van that was turning. My front right indicator lamp is broken now, and it's hanging off slightly. I feel really bad about the whole situation. It happened so fast that I barely had time to react before the contact was made.

I was waiting to cross the street when I saw the Renault enter the intersection just as the light turned red. It clipped the back of the white van. The impact clearly broke the light housing on the Renault's front corner.

I was driving along the avenue and attempted to change lanes to the left to prepare for a turn. I checked my mirrors, but I suppose I could not spot the car coming up quickly in my blind spot. I feel terrible about the scratch I caused to their vehicle. I stopped immediately to accept fault and assist with the necessary insurance paperwork. statements.text: Navigating the Marquês de Pombal roundabout is always intense with so many lanes. I was in the middle lane when the bus on my right moved left unexpectedly. I am just glad it wasn't a more serious accident, but the bodywork damage is definitely visible. I have already contacted my insurer to get the repair estimate underway.

I was pulling away from the bus stop area and preparing to shift lanes within the roundabout. I didn't see the Nissan in my side mirror until it was too late. I clipped the side of his vehicle, resulting in a scratch and a dent on his passenger door. I've reported the incident to my company and have provided my details to the driver of the SUV.

statements.text: I was stopped at a red light on Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa when I was suddenly hit from behind. The impact was quite strong, enough to shatter my rear glass and create a large dent in the tailgate. I am still feeling a bit shaken because it was such a sudden jolt while I was stationary. The other driver was very polite and admitted that he was distracted by his mobile phone for a split second, which led to the collision.

The driver behind him clearly wasn't looking at the road and drove straight into the back of him without braking. The sound of the glass shattering was quite sharp. I stayed to confirm to both drivers that the Volvo was indeed stopped at the red light when the collision happened.

Suddenly, the car in front of me stopped abruptly for a pedestrian. I hit the brakes as hard as I could, but I still slid and tapped their rear bumper. The situation involved a low-speed impact, but now I have a noticeable dent and a scratch on my front bumper. I feel so stressed about the repair costs, honestly, I just don't know how I'm going to manage all this paperwork.

I was stopped in traffic on Avenida da Boavista when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. The driver behind me didn't brake in time and bumped into my rear. There is a small dent and a few scratches on my bumper now. We exchanged details immediately and everything was very calm.

I was trying to parallel park near Praça do Comércio on a very tight spot. I misjudged the distance while reversing and scraped against the side of the car already parked there. It was entirely my fault, and I feel terrible about it. I was trying to be careful, but the street was so crowded and I just got confused with the mirrors. It left a visible scratch on the rear passenger door of the other vehicle. I have already contacted the owner to sort out the insurance details.

Coming around the Rotunda da Boavista, I tried to exit toward Avenida da França. A car coming from the inner lane moved out unexpectedly. I am really worried because this is my main car for work and I need to get it fixed quickly. It was a messy situation, but we both stopped right away to check.

I was exiting the roundabout and thought the lane was clear, but the Renault appeared in my blind spot. We made contact at low speed. My car has a scratch and a broken lamp on the side. We have filled out the accident report correctly.

I was walking down Rua de Santa Catarina and saw the whole thing. The Fiat tried to pass the delivery truck slowly, but the driver clipped the edge of the open truck door. The mirror glass shattered on the ground immediately. The driver stopped and looked very upset.

I had to brake suddenly because of a taxi. The Toyota behind me couldn't stop and hit my rear. I noticed a dent on my bumper and my tail light is broken. The driver of the Toyota was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the process.

We both tried to merge into the same exit lane at the same time. I tried to brake, but we touched. I'm honestly so worried about the repair costs, you know? My front corner hit his side, resulting in a dent on my fender and my headlight lamp is broken. It was just such a stupid, confusing moment for both of us.

I was circulating in the outer lane of the Rotunda da Boavista when the Peugeot tried to cut across to take the exit. I didn't see him in time to move out of the way. The impact broke my side lamp and caused a dent on my rear passenger door. It happened very quickly during the morning commute.

I was on my way along the Avenida 24 de Julho heading towards Cais do Sodré. The traffic was moving at about 40 km/h. I signaled to change lanes to the left to prepare for a turn, and I checked my mirrors, but I simply didn't see the van in my blind spot. As I began the maneuver, we made contact. It caused a long scratch and a shallow dent along the side of my car. I feel awful because the individual driving the other car was clearly visible, but I just had a momentary lapse of concentration.

Back in my day, people drove more carefully, but these streets in Porto are getting busier every year. I was reversing out of a small street onto the main road, checking both ways, but I didn't notice the low bollard behind me until it was too late. I was going very slowly, maybe 5 km/h, but the bumper hit the post directly. It didn't dent the metal, but it did cause a nasty crack in the plastic bumper housing. My grandson usually drives this car, but I had to take it for a quick errand today.

I was walking my dog on Rua de Cedofeita when I saw the Citroën reversing. The driver seemed a bit unsure and backed into the stone bollard near the corner. The situation involved a low-speed hit, but I heard a loud noise when the plastic bumper cracked. The driver stopped immediately and looked quite concerned about the damage to the vehicle.

I was travelling down Avenida da República during the evening rush. The driver in front of me suddenly hit their brakes because of a cyclist crossing the street. I didn't have enough distance to react and ended up colliding with their rear end. I feel really bad, man. My front bumper took most of the impact, resulting in a dent and a broken lamp on the driver's side. It's my first accident, so I'm honestly quite shaken up and just want to get this sorted as quickly as possible.

It was a busy afternoon near the square, and finding parking is always a nightmare. I found a spot, but as I was trying to pull in, I misjudged the angle against the car already parked there. I scraped my side against their rear door. It was a total accident, just me being clumsy with the steering wheel. There is a visible scratch running along my passenger door now. I left a note on the other car's windshield because the owner wasn't there, and then I called you folks right away.

I was moving through the narrow lane on Rua de Santa Catarina. The street is quite tight for two cars to pass. A delivery truck was coming in the opposite direction and didn't leave enough room for me to pass safely. We scraped sides as we passed. My mirror hit his side, which led to a dent, a deep scratch, and unfortunately, my wing mirror glass shattered onto the pavement. I was driving slowly, but it was just impossible to avoid contact in such a tight space with that truck.

The street was very crowded and I was trying to stick as close to the side as possible. The Audi driver didn't slow down enough for the narrow section. Our sides made contact, causing some denting and scratching on his side, and I saw his side mirror glass shatter. I stopped immediately to check the situation.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I had a green light at the intersection, but as I entered, a car coming from the cross-street didn't stop in time. I tried to steer away but it was too late. We hit on the corner of the intersection. My front right side has a dent and the turn signal lamp is broken. It was a very confusing experience because I was sure I had the right of way. I'm just thankful that nobody was hurt, though I'm really anxious about the insurance claim process.

I was sitting in traffic on Avenida da Liberdade this morning, listening to the radio and waiting for the lights to change. I looked away for a second to adjust my seat, and when I looked back, the car in front had stopped abruptly. I hit the brakes, but I still tapped their rear bumper. You can see a small dent on my hood from where I made contact. I feel quite foolish for the lapse in attention. I immediately exchanged details with the other driver, who was very understanding about the whole incident.

I was waiting for the traffic light to turn green. I felt a bump from behind, and when I checked, it was the Mercedes driver who had hit me. There was a slight dent on my rear bumper. We both got out and exchanged insurance information immediately. It was a genuine accident caused by a moment of inattention.

I was navigating home from work around 6:30 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy as usual. I was trailing a small hatchback, and when the driver ahead braked suddenly to avoid a cyclist, I misjudged the distance. I pressed the brakes as hard as I could, but my car still slid forward and bumped into his rear bumper. I feel terrible about it; it was just a moment of distraction, and now you can see a visible dent on my front bumper.

I was stopped safely in the traffic lane when I suddenly felt a significant jolt from behind. I checked my rearview mirror just before the impact and saw the gentleman behind me failing to stop in time. My rear bumper definitely took a hit, and I am quite shaken by the sudden noise and vibration.

location: Roundabout at Praça de Espanha, Lisbon

statements.text: Man, I am honestly so stressed out right now. I was navigating the busy roundabout near Praça de Espanha, trying to get to the exit for the highway. I think I drifted just a little bit too far to the left while checking my mirrors, and I accidentally scraped the side of a van that was also circulating. I feel like such an idiot, I really didn't see him there in my blind spot. There is a long scratch running along my passenger door now. I hope this doesn't cost a fortune to fix.

I was trying to park my car in a very tight spot near Rua Augusta this morning. I thought I had enough clearance, but as I was maneuvering to straighten the vehicle, I miscalculated the angle and hit the concrete pillar of the parking garage wall. I heard a loud crunch and realized I had done some damage to the rear fender. It resulted in a noticeable dent and several deep scratches on the side panel. It was entirely my fault, and I am just hoping the insurance process is straightforward.

I was walking by the parking area when I saw the driver attempting to maneuver the Nissan into the space. The space was quite narrow, and it looked like they underestimated the distance to the pillar. The impact caused visible damage, specifically a dent and scratches on the back area of the car. I stayed to confirm that the driver was alone.

I was on my way slowly along Avenida 24 de Julho when the traffic light turned yellow. I slowed down, but the car behind me didn't notice, and he bumped into my rear corner. It wasn't a high-speed accident, but it was loud enough to be scary. My rear tail lamp is completely broken now. I am just a bit shaken up by the whole experience, you know? I really don't like dealing with these things, but I suppose that is what insurance is for, right?

I was traveling along the EN125, heading towards Faro. I needed to change lanes to take the upcoming turn-off, and although I checked my mirror, I must have missed the car in the lane beside me. As I began to merge, I felt a sharp scrape. The driver in the other lane signaled, and we both pulled over immediately. There is a nasty scratch along my driver-side door. I feel quite embarrassed by the oversight, as I pride myself on being a cautious driver.

I was maintaining my lane on the highway when suddenly the Toyota beside me started moving into my space. I honked, but it was too late to avoid the contact. We both pulled over safely. My vehicle has a deep scratch, and I am glad we were driving slowly enough that nobody was hurt, though the car damage is quite unfortunate.

I was picking up my grandson from school in Braga, and as I was reversing out of the parking space, I didn't see the low concrete barrier behind me. I backed up just a little bit too far, and the plastic bumper hit the barrier with a sickening sound. When I got out to check, I saw a large crack running through the lower part of the bumper. It is such a shame because the car was in perfect condition until this afternoon. I should have been much more careful.

I was entering the roundabout at Praça da Batalha around noon. The weather was bright and sunny. Another vehicle tried to exit the roundabout from the inner lane and didn't see me in the outer lane. We collided at a very low speed, causing contact between his front bumper and my rear passenger side. My rear bumper is pushed in with a clear dent, and the indicator lamp is completely broken. It was a very confusing situation with so many cars merging at once, but we exchanged details immediately.

I was navigating the roundabout to take the third exit. I thought the lane was clear, but as I turned, I realized the driver in the other lane was closer than I anticipated. We made contact, resulting in damage to both our vehicles. I have a dent on my bumper and some broken glass from the indicator, and I acknowledge I made a mistake in timing my exit.

I was driving down Rua do Ouro when I had to brake suddenly because a pedestrian stepped onto the crossing. The taxi behind me was following too closely and couldn't stop in time. He hit my rear end, and the force was enough to cause the rear window glass to shatter. It was a stressful experience, especially being in the city center with so much traffic behind us. I am mostly concerned about the glass shards being everywhere. I have already contacted the police to report the incident.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving along the avenue when the car next to me suddenly swerved to avoid a pothole and scraped my driver-side door. I had no room to move over because of the median on my left, so I just had to hit the brakes. The situation involved a quick incident, but it left a long, ugly scratch across the paintwork. I am quite frustrated as I keep my vehicle in excellent condition. The second vehicle apologized profusely, and we have shared our insurance information to resolve this through official channels.

I reacted instinctively to a large pothole in the road and drifted into the adjacent lane. I didn't see the Audi there, and we sideswiped each other. I take full responsibility for the maneuver. My car has a scratch on the side, and I have already provided my insurance details to the owner of the Audi.

It was pouring rain here in Porto, and I was trying to park outside the stadium. Visibility was very poor, and I misjudged the distance to the vehicle parked in front of me. I bumped into his rear bumper at very low speed. My car sustained a small dent on the hood from the contact. I feel quite foolish, as I usually park with much more care, but the weather really made things difficult today. I have left a note with my contact details on the other vehicle since the owner wasn't present.

I was observing from a nearby café. The rain was very heavy, and the driver of the Skoda was struggling to park. I saw the vehicle hit the car in front quite slowly, causing a visible dent on the bumper. The driver immediately got out, inspected the damage, and left a note on the windshield of the other car before waiting for the owner.

I was driving towards the city center during the morning rush hour. Traffic was quite heavy, and the car in front of me suddenly stopped for a pedestrian crossing. I attempted to brake, but I wasn't quick enough, and I hit the back of the other vehicle at maybe 10 km/h. It was really stressful, man, I'm just so worried about how this is going to affect my insurance premiums. My hood has a noticeable dent and some deep scratches near the front grille now. It was completely my fault, I just didn't react in time.

I had come to a complete stop at the zebra crossing on Avenida da Boavista when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. It was a low-speed impact, but it was enough to cause visible damage to my rear bumper. The second vehicle was quite shaken and admitted immediately that he had been distracted for a split second.

I was trying to park my car in a very narrow spot in Coimbra. It was raining quite heavily, and the visibility was poor. I thought I had enough clearance, but I heard a scraping noise against the concrete pillar of the parking garage. I got out to look and saw a significant scratch on my rear passenger door. It was such a silly mistake, I was just trying to get out of the rain and get home to my family. I feel quite embarrassed about the lack of spatial awareness I had today.

I was driving straight on the main avenue when another vehicle, parked on the side, suddenly pulled out without signaling or checking their mirrors. I tried to swerve, but the side of my car hit theirs. I felt a heavy thud, and now I noticed a significant dent on my side door. I am really worried because this is a new vehicle and I hope the repairs don't take too long. Everything happened so fast, I didn't even have time to honk before the impact occurred.

I was exiting a parallel parking space on Avenida dos Aliados. I checked my mirror, but I suppose I missed the approaching vehicle because of the parked van blocking my view. I moved out and heard a collision. My car also sustained a dent on the driver's side. It was an honest mistake on my part.

I was traveling along the EN125 toward Faro. The traffic lights suddenly turned amber, and the car in front of me braked much harder than I anticipated. I slammed on my brakes, but I could not avoid hitting the back of their bumper. The impact caused the rear glass of their car to shatter, and my own hood has a large dent from the collision. I am really shaken up by this, you know? It’s just one of those bad days where everything seems to go wrong while trying to get to work.

I was pulling into a narrow street to drop off some groceries near the Baixa district. There was a parked delivery truck that made the passage very tight. I miscalculated the swing of my rear bumper and caught the edge of a parked hatchback. It resulted in a deep scratch and a small dent on my rear quarter panel. It was entirely my fault, as I was too focused on the traffic behind me rather than the proximity to the parked vehicle. I'm just hoping for a straightforward claims process.

I was walking down Rua da Prata when I saw the driver attempting to maneuver past the delivery vehicle. The driver was going very slowly, but they misjudged the angle and made contact with a parked car. It was clearly a low-speed accident caused by the narrowness of the street and limited space.

I had a green light at the intersection and proceeded to go straight. Suddenly, another car tried to make a turn across my lane without seeing me. I honked and applied the brakes, but we collided near the front corner. My front turn signal lamp is completely broken and hanging off. I am feeling really frustrated and anxious about the whole situation because I have a very busy week ahead. I truly thought the oncoming driver would wait, but it seems they were in a rush and misjudged the timing.

Traffic on the bridge was moving, then stopped completely due to an accident further ahead. I stopped, but the driver behind me didn't notice the flow had halted. They hit me right in the rear. I’ve checked my car, and there is a clear, deep dent in the trunk lid. It was quite a shock, and I’m just waiting for the authorities to clear the road. I hope my insurance will cover the repairs quickly, as I rely on this car for my daily commute across the river.

The traffic was stop-and-go on the bridge. I looked down at my dashboard for a second to adjust the radio, and by the time I looked up, the car in front had stopped. I couldn't stop in time. I hit the rear of the Megane, causing a dent to his trunk.

I was driving down the one-way street in Porto. A car exiting from a private driveway swung out too wide, sideswiping my passenger side. The impact shattered the passenger side mirror glass and left a long, deep scratch along the door panel. I am quite worried about the repair costs, as the mirror assembly looks like it took a hard hit. I’ve been driving in this city for over forty years, and it's just exhausting to deal with these kinds of incidents during my afternoon errands.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was moving from the left lane to the middle lane to prepare for my exit. I checked my mirrors, but there was a blind spot issue, and I clipped the side of another car that was also changing lanes. The contact damaged my rear bumper and broke my tail lamp. I feel terrible, man. I was just trying to follow my GPS instructions and got a bit confused with the road layout. I'm really sorry to the oncoming driver; I hope everyone is okay and we can get this sorted out soon.

We were both changing lanes at the same time in the heavy traffic on the avenue. I saw the Ford Focus coming into my lane, but it was too late to avoid the contact. The collision dented my door and broke the light housing on his vehicle. It was an unfortunate case of both of us not seeing each other.

I was heading home from work along Avenida da Boavista during the peak traffic hours. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because a pedestrian started crossing the road unexpectedly. I hit the brakes, but I could not stop in time and tapped their rear bumper. I noticed a visible dent on my front bumper. I feel terrible about the accident; I was really trying to be careful, but everything happened so fast and I am quite worried about my insurance premium increasing after this.

I was driving down Boavista and had to brake suddenly for a person crossing the street. The driver behind me didn't react quickly enough and bumped into the back of my vehicle. It was clearly a low-speed impact, but it left a noticeable dent on my trunk lid. I am disappointed as my car is relatively new, but I appreciate that the second vehicle stopped immediately to exchange information.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal, heading towards the city center. I believe I was in the correct lane, but I think I misjudged the distance when exiting. I felt a scraping sensation on the side of my vehicle. I am honestly quite shaken up by the whole experience. It's my first time being involved in any incident in Lisbon, and I just want to make sure I follow the correct procedure for the repair. There is a deep scratch along my passenger door.

I was trying to park my car in a narrow spot on Rua Augusta. I thought I had enough clearance, but as I was reversing, I turned the wheel too early and clipped the side of the vehicle parked next to me. I immediately got out to check. It caused a visible dent and a long scratch on the rear quarter panel of my own car. I feel so embarrassed because it was a completely avoidable mistake on my part while trying to fit into a tight space.

I was walking down Rua Augusta when I saw the driver attempting to reverse into a parking space. They miscalculated the angle and hit the car already parked there. It was a clear accident; no speeding or recklessness involved, just a simple misjudgment of the space. I saw them immediately get out to inspect the dent and scratch on both vehicles and wait for the other owner to return.

Traffic was quite heavy coming off the 25 de Abril bridge. I was changing lanes to take the exit for Almada. I checked my mirrors, but I must have missed the car in my blind spot. I heard a sharp noise and realized I hit their rear lamp. It broke the plastic cover. I am so sorry for the delay I caused to other drivers. I have been driving for years without incident, and this is very stressful for me, especially in such busy traffic.

I was travelling slowly along the cobblestone street of Santa Catarina. A delivery truck was parked partially on the road, so I had to maneuver around it. I misjudged the proximity to the car coming from the opposite direction and we sideswiped each other. It left a significant scratch along the driver-side door. I am really annoyed with myself because I was driving so slowly. I have been very careful today, and it is just unfortunate that this happened in such a busy, narrow street.

I was driving down the road when I saw the Renault trying to pass a delivery vehicle. The driver didn't leave enough room for me to pass safely, and our cars scraped against each other. It was definitely an accident caused by the narrowness of the street and the parked truck. There is a scratch on the side of my car. We both pulled over to exchange details calmly once we realized what had happened.

I was driving along the EN125 near Faro, enjoying the sunny weather. I got distracted for a split second by the view, and when I looked back, the traffic had stopped completely. I could not avoid hitting the car in front. The impact was strong enough to create a dent in my hood and break the lamp on the other vehicle. I feel terrible. I'm an older driver, and I suppose my reactions aren't what they used to be. This is a very stressful situation for me.

I parked my car in the city center to attend a meeting. When I returned, I noticed a fresh scratch on my passenger door. I checked the surveillance nearby and spoke to a shop owner, who confirmed that a car backing out must have clipped me while I was gone. It's just a cosmetic scratch, but it's frustrating as I keep my vehicle in very good condition. I am filing this claim so that I can have the body shop look at it next week.

I work in the cafe right next to where the Nissan was parked. I saw a silver car pulling out of the space next to it earlier this morning. The driver clearly hit the side of the Nissan while reversing, left a scratch, and just drove off without leaving a note. I saw the owner come back later and discover the damage. I am providing my contact details in case they need a witness report.

It happened to be a busy day in downtown Lisbon. I was at a stop sign, and I think I took my foot off the brake slightly too early before the car in front moved. My car rolled forward and tapped their bumper. The situation involved a very minor incident, but it left a small crush on the other car's bumper. I am quite worried about the repair costs, you know? I really didn't mean to hit them, it was just one of those silly mistakes.

I was driving down Avenida de Roma when the vehicle in the lane to my right decided to merge without looking properly. I tried to swerve, but they hit my side. The impact caused a deep scratch along my door and smashed my indicator lamp. I am very frustrated because I was driving safely in my lane. This whole situation is very inconvenient for my work schedule, and I just want the repairs handled as quickly as possible by the insurance company.

I was moving into the right lane on Avenida de Roma to prepare for a turn. I admit I might have moved over too quickly before checking my blind spot thoroughly.
