I heard a collision, and we both stopped immediately. There is a mark on the side of the BMW and their lamp is broken. I acknowledge it was my mistake and I am ready to cooperate with the insurance claim process completely.

I was driving home after work around 6:00 PM, and the traffic on Avenida da Boavista was extremely heavy as usual. I slowed down because the car in front of me braked suddenly, but the driver behind me didn't react in time. He hit the back of my car quite hard. The situation involved a massive shock, you know? I got out to check the damage and found a clear crush on the rear bumper. I am really worried about how much this is going to cost to repair properly, man.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, and I believe I was in the correct lane to exit. Another driver suddenly tried to merge into my path without checking his blind spot. I made an effort to steer away, but he clipped the side of my door. I was quite shaken up as it was my first incident driving in Lisbon. There is a visible, long scratch running across the driver's side door panel. I hope the insurance process isn't too complicated, as I really need my car for my commute.

The traffic was dense as we entered the roundabout. I signaled to change lanes to take the exit, but I failed to see the Peugeot alongside me. It was an honest mistake on my part due to the congestion. I grazed his side as I turned, resulting in a scratch. I feel terrible about the situation and fully accept responsibility for the collision.

I was attempting to park in a tight spot in the city center of Coimbra. It was a stressful maneuver because the streets are very narrow and there were cars honking behind me. I misjudged the distance and grazed the concrete pillar of the parking structure. It caused a dent and a deep scrape along the front fender. I am so embarrassed, but I want to report it correctly so it can be fixed. It’s been such a long day and this is the last thing I needed.

I was crossing the intersection when the lights were green, but another vehicle turning left miscalculated my speed. They impacted my front corner at a low speed, which was enough to break the lamp on my vehicle. It happened so fast that I barely had time to react. I am very concerned about the safety of my car, given the damage to the lighting unit. The weather was rainy and visibility was poor, which probably contributed to the oncoming driver not seeing me clearly.

I was walking on the sidewalk near the intersection when I saw the accident occur. The Toyota entered the junction on a green light, and the second vehicle turned too early. It was definitely a low-speed impact, but it was enough to leave the lamp on the Toyota broken. It looked like a simple accident caused by the heavy rain and poor visibility at that moment.

I was travelling along the coast road, heading toward the beach. I moved to the right lane to prepare for my turn, but it slipped my attention the cyclist or the car next to me clearly because of the sunlight glare. I veered slightly and made contact with the side of a parked van. It left a visible scratch on my side mirror and the passenger door. I am really stressed about the insurance paperwork, as I’ve never had to file a claim before and I hope it is straightforward.

While navigating a narrow turn near the city hall, the back end of my car swung slightly too wide. I accidentally brushed against a bollard. It wasn't a hard hit, but it was enough to cause the glass shatter on my rear passenger side light. I feel quite foolish about the whole thing. I've been driving for years, but this road layout is very tricky. I just want to ensure that the repair is handled quickly so I can return to my work schedule.

The traffic in Cascais was busy this morning. I was waiting to turn at a junction when a motorcycle swerved to avoid a pedestrian and ended up brushing against my front bumper. It caused a minor dent and some surface scratches. The motorcyclist was fine, thankfully, but he was quite shaken. We exchanged details immediately and decided to call the insurance. I am just a professional trying to get to my morning meeting on time, so this delay is quite frustrating for everyone involved.

I was riding down the street when a pedestrian stepped off the curb unexpectedly. I had to swerve hard to avoid hitting them. In the process, I clipped the front of the Mercedes that was waiting at the intersection. I am very sorry for the damage caused; it resulted in a dent and a scrape along the car. My priority was to avoid an injury to the pedestrian.

I returned to my car after grocery shopping at the local market to find that another vehicle had hit my bumper. It seems they tried to park and didn't see my car. The impact was enough to create a crack in the plastic bumper cover. There was no note left, but a witness nearby pointed out the vehicle that had just driven off. I am quite frustrated as I take very good care of my car. I hope the camera footage from the shop can help identify the responsible party.

I was walking to my own car when I saw a silver sedan backing into the parked Renault. The driver of the sedan didn't seem to notice or just didn't care, because they pulled away quite quickly after the contact. I inspected the Renault and clearly saw a crack in the bumper. I stayed around because I knew the owner would be upset to find such damage.

I was on my way down Avenida da Boavista around 9:00 AM when the traffic came to a sudden, unexpected halt. I applied my brakes firmly, but unfortunately, I couldn't stop in time to avoid hitting the car in front of me. The impact was quite low-speed, but I still felt the jolt. I am really worried about the repair costs, to be honest. I got out immediately to check, and there is a visible damage to the front bumper. I hope the insurance process isn't too complicated, man, I'm just so stressed about this whole situation.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio during the afternoon rush. I was in the outer lane, intending to exit towards the airport, when another driver tried to change lanes without signaling properly. I made an effort to pull over to avoid contact, but we ended up side-swiping each other at a very slow pace. It was such a frustrating moment because I was already late for my meeting. I checked my passenger side door afterward and there is a long scratch running across the panel. It is just really bad luck, honestly.

I was driving on the roundabout and honestly, I thought I had enough clearance to move into the outer lane. I clearly misjudged the position of the Seat Ibiza in the adjacent lane. The situation involved a simple error of judgment on my part. We both stopped safely at the exit and exchanged details. I saw the scratch on his car; it's unfortunate but these things happen in busy Lisbon traffic.

I was trying to park in a tight spot near the university. I miscalculated the distance while reversing into the space because the sun was hitting my mirrors at a really awkward angle. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had clipped the rear bumper of the car behind me. I felt terrible immediately. Upon inspection, I noticed I noticed a small dent and some significant scratching on the rear quarter panel of the other vehicle. I have already contacted the owner to explain what happened; I just want to make things right.

The traffic on Eixo Norte-Sul was moving very slowly, maybe 30 km/h. I was keeping to my lane when the driver to my left decided to merge into my path. I didn't have enough room to swerve, and we made contact. My left headlight lens is completely smashed, and there are deep scratches along the side of the wing. I am quite shaken up because I have never been in an accident before. It all happened so fast, and I was just trying to get home after a long day at the office.

I admit I was looking at my GPS for a split second and didn't check my blind spot thoroughly enough before moving right. I drifted into the lane occupied by the Toyota. I heard the crunch of the lamp breaking immediately. I take full responsibility for the mistake as I failed to yield during the lane change.

I was proceeding through the intersection when the lights turned amber. I didn't want to slam on the brakes, so I proceeded, but the car coming from the cross street entered the junction prematurely. We collided at a very low speed. I was driving with my daughter in the back, and we were quite scared, but thankfully no one was hurt. My front bumper has a noticeable dent now. I am a very careful driver, so this is quite distressing for me to deal with today.

I was standing on the corner waiting to cross the street. I saw the Renault entering the intersection just as the light was changing. The other vehicle didn't wait for the light to fully turn green for them and pulled out into the junction. It happened to be a low-speed impact, but clearly, it left a dent on the bumper of the Renault.

I was on my way along the coast near Cascais, enjoying the nice weather. The car ahead of me braked very hard for a cyclist. I tried my best to stop, but I tapped the back of their vehicle. My headlight is broken and, honestly, there is glass shattered all over the road from my indicator casing. I feel terrible about the incident. I am an older driver, and I try to be very vigilant, but the sudden stop caught me off guard. It is a very regrettable situation for everyone involved.

I was heading north on Avenida da República during the early evening. The traffic was dense and moving in starts and stops. As I accelerated to match the flow, the car beside me drifted into my lane without warning. We made contact, and I felt the car vibrate. I pulled over to the side immediately. Upon inspection, there are clear, long scratches along my rear door panel. It is very annoying as the car is fairly new, but these things happen in heavy urban traffic.

I was trying to avoid a pothole in the right lane and drifted slightly left without realizing how close the Audi was. It was unintentional. I heard the scrape as the side mirrors and panels made contact. I accept that I was the one who drifted out of my lane, causing the scratch on the other vehicle's side.

I was trying to navigate the narrow streets of Porto. It was raining slightly, and the cobbles were very slippery. As I turned a corner, I lost a bit of traction and slid into the back of a parked delivery van. It was really a slow maneuver, maybe 10 km/h, but it was enough to cause damage. My front lamp is broken, and there is a visible dent on the hood. I am really quite anxious about how to report this as I am still learning the local driving conditions here.

Traffic on the bridge was backed up, as it usually is. I was stopped, but the driver behind me failed to stop in time and hit my rear bumper. The impact caused some of my rear light housing to break, leaving glass shattered on the bridge surface. It was quite a shock; I didn't see it coming at all. I am just a professional trying to get home, and this is a major inconvenience. I hope we can resolve the insurance claim quickly without too much administrative hassle.

I was distracted by my radio for a second, and when I looked up, the traffic had already stopped. I pressed the brake, but the wet surface made it difficult to stop completely. I tapped the back of the Skoda. I acknowledge that I was at fault for the rear-end collision and the resulting damage to the rear lights.

I was pulling out of a parking space in the downtown area. I thought I had checked the mirror thoroughly, but I misjudged the angle of the car coming up behind me. We touched bumpers as I exited. It was just a light graze, leaving a scratch on my side panel and the other person's bumper. I feel really silly, you know? It's the kind of thing you just don't expect to happen when you're being careful, but there you go. I'm just hoping it's not too expensive to fix.

I was walking down the street when I saw the small car pulling out of the parking spot. It didn't look like the driver saw the oncoming vehicle. They collided at a very slow speed. I saw the mark on the car; it's definitely a scratch, nothing more, and luckily no one was injured.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista during the morning rush hour when the traffic came to a sudden halt. I pressed my brakes hard, but given the wet road conditions from the light rain, I couldn't stop in time. I ended up bumping into the car in front of me at a very low speed. I felt terrible about it. The impact caused a noticeable dent on my front bumper, but fortunately, no other parts of my car were damaged during the small collision.

Man, this is so stressful, you know? I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio near the airport, and I guess I misjudged the distance while merging into the outer lane. I turned the wheel a bit too quickly and scraped the side of a van. I noticed a clear scratch and a dent on my passenger door now. I am really worried about how much the repairs will cost, as I am still just a student trying to get by.

I was driving steadily inside the roundabout when the driver of the Peugeot attempted to change lanes without checking his blind spot properly. He clipped my rear panel, resulting in a deep scratch and a small dent on his car's side. It was clearly a lapse in concentration, but it was just a minor accident.

I was proceeding along the right lane of Avenida dos Aliados. I signaled to move to the middle lane, not realizing there was a car already occupying the space. I only noticed when I heard the impact. My front indicator lamp is broken from the contact. I feel quite shaken by the incident, as I honestly did not see the other driver at all during the maneuver.

The driver of the Seat moved into my lane without sufficient space or warning. I tried to brake, but he still hit my side mirror. His indicator lamp was shattered during the brief impact, which occurred at a low speed of approximately 20 km/h.

I was travelling home along the coast in Cascais. It was late, and I was quite tired after a long day. As I approached the intersection, the driver in front of me braked very hard for a pedestrian. I didn't react quickly enough and struck his rear end. The impact caused a dent in my hood and the glass shatter of my headlight. I'm really upset with myself for not maintaining a safer distance.

I was walking nearby on the sidewalk of the Estrada Marginal when I saw the Mercedes collide with the back of the station wagon. The Mercedes driver seemed distracted or slow to react. There was a loud bang, and I saw shattered glass on the pavement and a large damage to the front of the Mercedes.

I was driving down the narrow street when a delivery truck started pulling away from the curb. I tried to steer around him, but the road was simply too narrow. I ended up brushing against the side of his truck. The side of my car now has a long scratch and a shallow dent. I'm quite worried about the insurance premiums going up, as I'm working on a tight budget lately.

I was checking my mirrors to pull out from the side of the road. I thought I had space, but the Citroen driver was moving faster than I anticipated. We made contact, resulting in some scratches and a dent on his passenger door. It was an unfortunate case of misjudged speed.

It was a busy afternoon here in Braga. I was taking the exit from the roundabout when another driver entered without yielding properly. I had to hit my brakes to avoid a direct crash, and in the process, I clipped the central island's curb. This caused a crack in my wheel cover. It really wasn't my fault, but the other driver just kept going. I am so frustrated, honestly.

I was standing near the roundabout observing traffic. The Polo driver was forced into a sharp turn by a reckless entry from another vehicle. I saw him hit the curb while trying to avoid the other car. There is a visible crack on his front wheel hubcap from the impact.

I was driving along Avenida da Boavista during the morning rush hour. Traffic was quite heavy, and the vehicle in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a pedestrian crossing. I tried to press the brake pedal, but I could not stop in time and hit the rear bumper of the car ahead at a very low speed. It was a really stressful situation, man, I feel terrible about it. I checked my car and noticed a clear dent on the front bumper. I am really worried about how much this is going to cost to repair, you know?

I was waiting at the traffic lights when I suddenly felt a bump from behind. It was not a violent impact, but it was enough to see that my rear bumper was pushed in. The driver behind me came out immediately and was very apologetic. We exchanged contact details and checked the damage to both vehicles.

I was attempting to park in a tight spot near the shopping area in Baixa. I thought I had enough clearance while reversing into the space, but I miscalculated the angle. I must have been going at about 5 km/h, but I heard a scraping sound against the concrete pillar nearby. When I got out to look, I saw a long scratch along the rear passenger door. It was purely an honest mistake on my part, and I feel quite embarrassed about the whole incident. I hope the insurance process is straightforward.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, which is always quite chaotic with all the taxi traffic. I was in the outer lane, intending to exit towards the highway. Suddenly, a van appeared in my blind spot while trying to cut across the lane. I made an effort to steer away, but there was contact between our side panels. I pulled over to the side immediately. My door has a visible dent and some paint damage, like a deep scratch. It was all so fast, and honestly, I am quite shaken by the experience.

I was turning right to exit the roundabout when I felt a graze on the side of my van. I did not see the other car until the last second because of the heavy traffic and the sun glare. We stopped safely and confirmed that our vehicles had made contact during the lane change.

I was driving home from work along the Avenida 24 de Julho. It was raining quite heavily, and visibility was limited. The car beside me started to drift into my lane. I honked, but they didn't seem to hear me, and their side mirror struck my driver's side window. The impact caused my side window to shatter instantly. I had to pull over immediately to clear the glass from the seat. It was a terrifying moment, and I'm really concerned about driving the car in this state with the window broken.

I was pulling out of a very narrow side street onto the main road. I was being very cautious, moving at probably less than 10 km/h. I didn't see the cyclist coming from the sidewalk, and when I saw them, I swerved to avoid them and clipped a parked car. My front turn signal lamp is completely broken now. I am so relieved the cyclist was okay, but I am really upset about the damage to my car. It was just a lapse in concentration, and I feel truly terrible about hitting that parked vehicle.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the tram when I saw the Yaris pull out slowly. The driver seemed to be looking for cyclists, but they swerved suddenly to avoid one and hit the parked car. It was definitely a low-speed accident and not malicious at all.

I was stuck in traffic on Avenida da República, it was one of those days where nothing moves. I was just checking the radio when the car in front stopped abruptly for a delivery truck. I didn't have enough time to react and tapped the back of their car. It wasn't a major hit, but my front bumper has a visible dent and the passenger side headlamp is broken. I feel like such an idiot, I was only distracted for a second, you know? It's just a lot of hassle for everyone involved.

Well, you see, I was visiting the market area and trying to park my car in a space that was perhaps a bit too tight for a vehicle of this size. I was being quite careful, or so I thought, watching the mirrors and checking the sensors, but I must have misjudged the distance to the wall. There is a rather significant scratch along the rear fender now. It's a shame, really, as I try to take such good care of the paintwork, but these things happen when you are running errands in the busy city center.

I was on my way down Avenida dos Aliados and there was this black car in the left lane that started moving into mine without checking. I attempted to speed up to avoid it, but they hit my rear quarter panel. It left a nasty dent and a long scratch down the side. I am really frustrated because I was on my way perfectly fine, man. It's like people don't even look before they switch lanes anymore. Now I have to go through all this paperwork and wait for repairs. This is exactly what I did not need this week.

I was merging into the right lane as I needed to take the next exit. I checked my mirror, but I suppose the Audi was in my blind spot. I heard a scraping sound and realized we had touched. We both pulled over immediately to resolve the issue and share our insurance information.

Traffic was backing up as usual on the bridge. I was behind a large van and the driver ahead performed an emergency stop. Despite my best efforts to brake, the road surface was a bit slick, and I slid forward, hitting the van. The impact caused the front grille to cave in, resulting in a large dent, and my headlight housing shattered on impact. I am quite shaken by this, as it's my first accident in over ten years of driving. I have notified the authorities as required by the protocols for bridge incidents.

I was looking for a parking spot on Rua da Prata. I saw an opening, but as I turned the corner to enter the space, I failed to notice the metal post marking the pedestrian area. I was moving very slowly, maybe 3 km/h, but the corner of my bumper hit the post. It broke my rear tail lamp completely. It was just a silly, careless mistake while I was distracted looking for street parking. I am feeling really bothered about the cost of the repair, as I know these modern lamps are quite expensive to replace.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 9:00 AM in quite heavy traffic. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because of a cyclist crossing unexpectedly. I applied my brakes, but I couldn't stop in time on the wet asphalt and gently bumped into his rear bumper. I am really worried about this, honestly, because I have never been in an accident before and the insurance process is quite intimidating for me. There is a visible dent on the rear bumper of the other car where I made contact.

Traffic was slow and I had to stop abruptly when a bicycle cut into my lane. The driver behind me didn't react fast enough and hit my car from behind. The situation involved a low-speed impact, but it left a noticeable dent on my trunk.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio trying to exit towards the airport. It was mid-afternoon and the roundabout was busy. As I was changing lanes to take the exit, I misjudged the distance to the vehicle in the adjacent lane and grazed their side panel. The situation involved a stupid mistake, really, and I feel terrible about it. My car has a long scratch on the passenger side door, and I believe the other driver sustained a similar scratch on their vehicle during the maneuver.

I was parking near the University of Coimbra this morning. I was trying to reverse into a tight spot, and I suppose I missed seeing the post clearly or turned the wheel too early. I scraped against a parked car while backing up. It was quite embarrassing, to be honest. I looked at the damage and there is a clear scratch and a small dent on the rear fender of the other vehicle. I left a note on their windshield with my contact details immediately.

I was walking by and saw the driver of the Renault attempting to park. They reversed too quickly and scraped the side of a parked car. I saw both a scratch and a crush on the rear fender after they stopped.

I was driving home from work along Avenida 24 de Julho when a delivery van suddenly pulled out of a side street without looking. I swerved to avoid a head-on collision, but I ended up scraping the side of a taxi waiting in the lane next to me. The taxi's side lamp is now broken and there are several scratches along the side of the door. I am feeling extremely stressed about the costs involved, as my car is relatively new and I take great care of it.

I was proceeding through the intersection when the traffic light turned amber. I thought I had time to pass, but a car coming from the cross street entered the junction prematurely. We collided at a very low speed. My front lamp is broken, and there is glass shatter on the road from the impact. I am quite shaken up by the event. I have been driving for many years, and I truly regret this lapse in judgment regarding the traffic signal timing.

I was moving through the intersection when the oncoming driver entered the junction. They hit the corner of my car, shattering my headlight glass and breaking the plastic housing. It all happened so fast, but I am just glad no one was hurt.

I was driving on Estrada Monumental, and I wanted to move into the left lane to turn. I checked my mirror, but I must have missed the car in my blind spot. As I began to merge, I heard a grinding noise and realized I had made contact with another vehicle. There is a visible mark on the rear passenger door of the other car. I feel awful about this, as I usually consider myself a very careful driver who is always checking mirrors twice.

The traffic on the bridge was backed up, as it often is during the evening rush hour. I was looking down for just a second to change the radio station, and when I looked up, the car ahead had stopped completely. I didn't have enough distance to come to a full stop. I hit them, causing a dent in their tailgate and breaking the glass of my own fog lamp. I am very worried about the repair costs, man, this is definitely going to hurt my savings.

Traffic was stop-and-go. I was at a complete standstill when I felt a hard jolt from behind. The impact caused a significant dent to my rear bumper and hatch. I remained in my car until the other driver approached.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: I was driving near the city center, and the situation involved a very busy morning. I was trying to merge into a line of cars when my bumper hit the side of a stationary vehicle. The situation involved a low-speed impact, but it caused a crack in the plastic bumper of the other car. I am very concerned about the implications of this incident for my insurance premium, as I am trying to keep everything in order. I exchanged all the necessary details with the second vehicle immediately.

I was attempting to navigate through the narrow streets of Cedofeita to find a parking space. While turning a corner, I miscalculated the swing of my back wheel and lightly brushed against a parked car. I checked the damage and found a thin scratch along the side of their door. I am truly sorry for the inconvenience, as I know how hard it is to maintain a car in such a busy city with these tight parking spots.

I saw the driver maneuvering the small Volkswagen around the corner. They turned too sharply and the rear of their car rubbed against a parked silver sedan. I observed a long scratch on the paint afterward.

It was raining heavily in Porto, and the streets were quite slippery. I was on my way up towards Avenida dos Aliados and had to brake for a pedestrian crossing. The driver behind me didn't anticipate the stop and hit my car from behind. The impact was quite forceful, resulting in a large dent on my trunk and the glass shatter from my rear lights scattered on the road. I am really anxious about the car being safe to drive after such a hit.

I was following the Audi, but the rain was so heavy that my visibility was reduced. When the driver ahead stopped for the crossing, I skidded on the wet pavement. I collided with the back of their car, causing damage to their trunk and rear lights.

I was navigating the roundabout near the Casa da Música when another driver attempted to exit from the inner lane and cut across my path. I tried to brake, but I couldn't avoid the contact. It happened so fast, man, I'm really stressed about the repair costs and my premium going up. My car has a visible damage to the rear passenger door and quite a few deep scratches along the side panel. It was just a stupid mistake in heavy afternoon traffic, and I feel really frustrated because I had been driving so carefully all day.

I was attempting to parallel park near the city hall around 10:00 AM. I misjudged the distance while reversing into the spot and ended up scraping the bumper of the car parked behind me. I feel terrible about it; I really should have been more attentive. I checked the damage immediately, and it resulted in a clear scratch on my rear bumper. The other driver wasn't there at the time, so I left a note with my contact details. It was completely my fault, and I just want to handle this through my insurance properly.

I was navigating toward Faro when the traffic ahead suddenly slowed down. I slammed on my brakes, but the road was a bit damp and I slid right into the back of the car in front of me. I am so worried about this. The impact left a significant dent on my hood and my front left lamp is broken. The second vehicle was very understanding, but I am still shaken up. I just didn't expect the traffic to halt so abruptly on the highway like that. I'm hoping the insurance process is straightforward.

I was stopped at the traffic lights when I felt a hard jolt from behind. I got out and saw that the driver behind me had hit my vehicle. My bumper is damaged, but the driver was very apologetic and cooperative. We exchanged our insurance details right there on the shoulder of the road. It was an unfortunate accident caused by the sudden stop of the line ahead.

I was driving down a narrow street in downtown Lisbon yesterday. It was quite crowded with tourists, and as I did my best to squeeze past a delivery van that had stopped to unload, I miscalculated the clearance. I felt a jarring sound against the side of my car. I stopped immediately to inspect the vehicle and found a long, deep scratch along my passenger side door. I am really anxious about the repair timeline since I use the car every single day for my commute. I have already taken photos of the area and the van's position.

I was navigating north across the bridge during the evening rush hour. I checked my mirror and signaled to change into the center lane, but it slipped my attention the vehicle in my blind spot. We made contact, causing some bodywork damage to both cars. I feel awful about the oversight. There is a noticeable dent and a set of scratches on my front quarter panel. I should have been more careful given how busy the bridge is at that time of day. I am really worried about how much this will cost to fix.

The other driver attempted to switch into my lane while I was on my way at a steady 60 km/h. They clipped my driver-side mirror and the side of my car. We both pulled over safely after the bridge to inspect the damage. The insured driver was extremely apologetic and admitted they did not check their blind spot properly before maneuvering across the lane.

It was raining quite hard, and the streets were slick. As I entered the intersection, a vehicle coming from my right didn't stop at the sign and collided with my front corner. The impact was quite loud. My front lamp is broken and there is a deep dent on the fender. I've lived in this neighborhood for forty years, and I've never had an accident like this before. I was just coming back from the market with my groceries, and now I'm here dealing with this mess instead of being home for dinner.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the bus when I saw the whole thing. The gray car definitely rolled through the stop sign without checking properly. The Mercedes was proceeding through the intersection legally when it was struck. It was a very unfortunate incident, especially given the bad weather we are having today. I saw the broken parts fly off onto the pavement after the impact.

I was navigating through the narrow cobblestone streets near the plaza. I was trying to turn around, and I accidentally misjudged the position of a stone bollard. I reversed slowly, but I still made contact. It left a clear dent on my rear bumper. I feel very embarrassed because I consider myself a careful driver. I am going to contact my insurance company immediately to see how to proceed with the repairs. It's a busy area and I just got a bit confused by the traffic flow and the tight space.

I was driving through the city center on my way to pick up my daughter from school. Another car was trying to park and swung out too wide into my lane while I was passing. We collided, and there is some damage to my side. I have a scratch and a damage to the passenger door. I am quite worried about how this will impact my commute for the next week. I just hope the other driver has all their documentation in order so we can resolve this matter quickly.

I admit I was trying to maneuver into a parking space and it slipped my attention the car coming down the street. It was a lapse in judgment on my part. The second vehicle stopped immediately, and we discussed the situation calmly. My vehicle also has some minor damage. We are both cooperating fully to get the insurance paperwork submitted correctly.

Driving along the coastal road, the sun was hitting the windshield at a very sharp angle, and I was momentarily blinded. A cyclist veered suddenly into the road to avoid a puddle, and I swerved to avoid them. I hit a road sign instead. The glass of my side mirror shattered, and it left a major dent in the fender. I am so relieved I didn't hit the cyclist, but my car is in a bad state. It was a very scary moment for everyone involved, honestly, I am still trying to catch my breath.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, just heading home after a very long day at the office. The traffic was quite heavy as usual, and suddenly the car ahead of me braked very hard for a pedestrian. I tried my best to stop, but I just couldn't slow down enough in time and tapped the back of their bumper. I feel terrible about the whole situation. There is a noticeable dent and a long scratch on my front bumper now, and I am really worried about the repair costs.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio during the morning rush. I was in the outer lane when a vehicle attempting to exit the roundabout from the inner lane cut directly across my path. I had absolutely no time to react and we collided. The impact resulted in my right side lamp broken and a significant scratch along the passenger door. The situation involved a very stressful morning and I am just trying to get all the documentation sorted out properly for the claim.

I admit I made a mistake while exiting the roundabout. I was trying to reach the exit quickly and didn't check my side mirror thoroughly before changing lanes. I hit the oncoming driver's car on the side. I am prepared to accept full responsibility for the damages, including the broken lamp and the scratch on the side of their vehicle.

I am so incredibly sorry about what happened today. I was attempting to parallel park on Avenida dos Aliados, which is always so tight, you know? I misjudged the distance to the car parked behind me while I was reversing, and I heard a scraping sound. I panicked for a second, honestly. I got out and saw it left a deep mark on the rear bumper of the parked car. It was purely an accident, and I really want to make sure it gets fixed properly for the owner.

I was driving slowly along Rua da Prata at about 20 km/h. A van tried to squeeze through a very narrow gap next to me while I was turning, and they ended up swiping the entire side of my car. It was quite a shock. My front lamp is broken now, and it left a massive dent and several deep scratch marks along the side panel. It’s all very confusing, but I have already exchanged details with the driver so we can proceed with the insurance formalities.

I was walking down the street when I saw the van attempt to pass the Renault. The van driver clearly underestimated how narrow the street was. I watched them collide, causing clear damage to the Renault's lamp and door. It was an unfortunate incident but I am happy to provide my statement for the report.

It was a lovely sunny afternoon in the Algarve, and I was driving home on the EN125 when traffic came to an unexpected standstill. My brakes were fine, but the driver behind me clearly wasn't paying enough attention. They struck my rear bumper quite hard. I stepped out to find a large dent right in the center. I am quite an experienced driver, so this was definitely not my fault. The other party was very apologetic and cooperative throughout the entire exchange of information.

I entered the intersection at Avenida da República with the green light. Another vehicle came from the cross street and failed to stop at their red signal. They impacted my front passenger door. It was terrifying; the window suffered glass shatter, and there is a significant dent in the door frame. I am still quite shaken up by the event, but I am very thankful that it wasn't any worse than it turned out to be.

I made a terrible error of judgment. I thought I could clear the intersection before the lights changed, but I was clearly wrong. I hit the second vehicle's side door. I acknowledge the damage I caused, including the shattered glass and the door dent. I am fully prepared to cover the insurance excess for the victim.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Porto

statements.text: I was cruising along at about 50 km/h in the middle lane. I checked my mirrors before signaling to move to the left lane, but as I started my maneuver, a small city car was already in my blind spot. We made contact, resulting in a series of paint scratch marks along my rear quarter panel. The situation involved a lapse in my concentration, and I feel quite bad about it. The weather was a bit misty, which might have affected visibility, but I take full responsibility.

Well, I was parking near the center to do some shopping, and it was quite crowded, as it often is. I was turning into a spot and miscalculated the turn, hitting the side of a stationary vehicle parked there. I felt awful immediately. It resulted in a scratch and a small dent on the panel now. I waited for the owner to return, and we exchanged details quite peacefully. These things happen, I suppose, when one is having an off-day and perhaps not as attentive as usual.

I was stopped at a red light on Avenida da França when I was hit from behind by a large delivery truck. The impact was quite forceful, causing the rear glass shatter and the tail lamp broken. My passengers and I were quite shocked. The driver of the truck was very professional and stayed until the police arrived to ensure all documentation was correct. It's quite a headache, but the insurance claim process seems straightforward so far.

I was on my way the delivery truck and unfortunately, I slipped on the pedals in the wet conditions. I slid into the Volvo at the red light. I caused significant damage to their rear, including the lamp and the glass. I have apologized to the driver and am filing this report to get their repairs covered as quickly as possible.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM, the traffic was quite heavy as usual. I was keeping a safe distance, but the car in front suddenly braked hard because of a cyclist. I tried to react quickly, but I couldn't stop in time. My front bumper hit the rear of the other vehicle. I am honestly quite shaken up by this; it's the first time I've ever had an accident and I'm really worried about my insurance premium going up. You can see a noticeable dent on my front bumper.

I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio, planning to take the second exit toward the airport. I was in the inner lane when the car next to me tried to move across without checking their blind spot. I swerved slightly to avoid a full collision, but we still ended up scraping each other on the side. I am just really annoyed because I was heading to a meeting and now I have this scratch on my passenger door to deal with. It all happened so fast, honestly.

I was on the roundabout and I thought I had enough room to shift into the outer lane to exit. Clearly, I misjudged the speed of the other car. You can see a light scratch on my rear door panel, but fortunately, no one was hurt in the incident. I accept responsibility for not checking my side mirror carefully enough before moving over.

I was driving along the Marginal road towards Cascais, enjoying the coastal view, and I decided to move to the right lane to exit. The sun was quite bright, and I suppose I missed the car coming up on my side. I heard a loud noise and pulled over right away. My indicator lamp is broken, and I noticed a deep scratch along the side panel. I am just really stressed about the repair process, man, I hope the insurance covers most of it.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the two cars collide. The Nissan began to change lanes while the other car was already in its blind spot. It didn't look intentional, just a simple mistake due to the glare from the sun. I saw the lamp shatter and heard the metal scraping before both vehicles pulled over to the shoulder.

I was pulling out of a parking garage on Avenida dos Aliados. I was looking left to check for oncoming trams and pedestrians, and when I started to move, I didn't see the bollard that was slightly obscured by the shadow of the building. I ended up reversing directly into it at a very low speed. It was so stupid of me, I am quite embarrassed. The force was enough to cause the glass shatter on my rear light cluster. I hope this won't take too long to fix.

I was driving slowly through the narrow streets of downtown Lisbon. It was a busy Saturday afternoon with many tourists walking about. A van coming in the opposite direction was taking the corner too wide, and I didn't have enough space to pull over further to the right. We swiped mirrors and panels. I noticed a dent and a long scratch down the side of my driver-side door. The other driver stopped, and we exchanged insurance info right there on the spot.

The streets here are very narrow for a commercial van. I did my best to be careful, but I think I clipped the Citroën while navigating the bend. I stopped immediately to ensure the other driver was okay. We both have some surface damage, specifically a dent and scrape along the side panels. It was an unfortunate accident caused by the limited road width.

Well, you see, I was heading to the market on this lovely morning in Viseu, just minding my own business. Suddenly, the gentleman in front of me slammed on his brakes because a cat ran across the road. I pressed my brake, but with the road being a bit damp from the morning mist, my car just didn't stop in time. I bumped into his rear bumper. I feel quite shaken, being 72 years old, these things rattle you. I have a dent and a broken lamp on the front.

I was traveling on the IP3 motorway towards Coimbra at about 90 km/h. I signaled to move to the left lane to overtake a slow-moving truck. I checked my mirrors, but I believe the vehicle in the other lane accelerated unexpectedly as I was already moving over. We made contact side-to-side. It resulted in a long scratch along the side of my car. I am reporting this formally as per the insurance requirements. It was a high-traffic situation and visibility was somewhat limited by the heavy rain.

Dude, I am so stressed out right now. I was trying to park near the Matosinhos beach and I misjudged the height of a concrete barrier. I thought I had more space before the back of the car hit the wall. It happened at like 2 km/h, but it was enough to put a nasty dent in my rear tailgate. I'm just really worried about how much this is going to cost to repair. It's my first car and I feel super guilty about being so careless.

I was proceeding through the green light at the intersection of Avenida da Liberdade. Another car coming from the cross-street failed to stop at their red light. I did my best to brake, but we still collided at the corner of the intersection. My front corner hit their side. I have a broken lamp and several deep scratches on the bumper. I am just thankful that nobody was injured in the collision, although my car is definitely going to need professional repairs.

I admit I was distracted by my GPS for a split second and I completely missed the red light at the intersection. I realize now that I entered the junction when I shouldn't have. I am very sorry for the trouble I've caused. I saw the damage to the other vehicle's lamp and bumper. I am ready to cooperate with the insurance companies to resolve this matter quickly.

I was navigating slowly down Rua de Santa Catarina around 6 PM when the traffic ahead suddenly stopped. I hit the brakes, but I didn't stop in time and tapped the car in front of me at about 10 km/h. It was completely my fault, I was distracted for a second by my GPS. It resulted in a noticeable dent on my front bumper. I feel terrible about the whole situation because the individual driving the other car was very polite despite the inconvenience. I just want to get this sorted out quickly.

I was navigating the Rotunda da Boavista, trying to exit towards Avenida da Boavista. A van pulled into my lane abruptly as I was turning. I swerved to avoid a major hit, but the side of my car still grazed their rear panel. I noticed a long, deep scratch running along my driver-side door. I’m honestly so stressed out right now, man, because this car is basically brand new and I have no idea how much the repair is going to cost me or the other guy.

I was already in the lane when the driver in the Peugeot tried to cut across to take the exit. I didn't see them coming until the last second. They swerved, but we still made contact on the side. We stopped immediately to exchange details. It was just a minor scratch on both our vehicles.

I was attempting to reverse into a tight parking space near the market on Avenida 24 de Julho. I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar behind me. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had backed into it. Now I noticed a dent and some scratches on the rear bumper. I've been driving for years and I'm quite embarrassed, to be honest. I am reporting this because I need to make sure my insurance covers the repair work at the shop.

It was raining quite heavily on the Estrada Monumental. I put on my turn signal to change into the right lane. I checked my mirror, but I suppose the other driver was in my blind spot. As I moved over, we clipped each other. My rear passenger-side lamp is completely broken now. I am very worried about the safety of driving it like this. I was being careful, but the weather really made visibility poor today, and I just didn't see them there.

I was driving straight in the right lane when the Nissan started moving into my lane without enough space. I tried to brake, but the rain was slick. We made contact, and their light broke on impact. It was just a simple case of a miscalculation in the bad weather.

I was going through a green light at the intersection near the luxury boutiques. A delivery scooter came out of nowhere from the side street, trying to beat the red light. I slammed on the brakes but still collided with the side of their bike. My passenger side window suffered from glass shatter when they fell against it. I am shaken up, but thankfully everyone seems to be okay. It happened so fast that I barely had time to process what was going on.

I was standing on the corner waiting for the light to change. The car clearly had the green light. The scooter driver tried to cut through the intersection far too quickly. There was definitely glass shatter from the car window when the scooter leaned into it during the fall.

I was on my way to visit my daughter in Setúbal. I was slowing down because of the heavy traffic on Avenida Luísa Todi, just observing the lovely view of the river, when the car behind me didn't stop in time. They hit me quite hard. My rear bumper has a large dent and my left brake lamp is broken into pieces. I am a bit confused by the paperwork, but I just want to ensure my little car gets back to the condition it was in yesterday.

I was distracted by the sun glare coming off the water. I didn't see that the traffic in front had come to a complete halt until it was too late. I hit the back of the Fiat, causing damage to their lamp and bumper. I apologized to the lady immediately; it was entirely my error.

I was driving down a narrow street in Braga. An elderly pedestrian stepped out unexpectedly. I swerved to avoid them and clipped a bollard on the side of the road. It left a long, ugly scratch down my front passenger side door panel. I am just relieved I didn't hit the person, but I definitely need to get the paintwork fixed. It's a busy part of the city and there are always tourists walking around, so I have to be extra careful next time.

I was going around the roundabout near the airport. It was super busy, as usual. The taxi in the inner lane tried to exit suddenly and crossed right over my path. I couldn't move out of the way. They hit the front of my car, and it caused a hairline crack in my plastic bumper casing. I am really worried, man, because I need this car for my job tomorrow. I don't know why they didn't check their mirrors before turning like that.

I parked my car on the street while I went to buy some books. When I came back, I noticed someone had scraped the rear corner of my bumper while trying to park behind me. I noticed a clear dent and a deep scratch where they must have pushed into my car. It is frustrating that they didn't leave a note, but I have the time of the incident from my dashcam. I just need to get it back to its original state.

I was sitting at the café across the street. I saw a large silver sedan hit the parked Mini while trying to reverse. They hit it hard enough to cause a dent and scratch the paint. The driver looked out the window, hesitated, but then drove away without leaving any contact information.

location: Rotunda do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout at Marquês de Pombal around 5:30 PM, just trying to merge toward Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo. Honestly, I think I was a bit stressed with the heavy evening traffic, you know? I checked my mirrors, but I guess I missed seeing the silver car in my blind spot. I pulled over to the side and saw a noticeable scratch on my rear door. I am just so worried about my insurance premium going up now; I feel like a total idiot for not being more careful.

I was maintaining my lane inside the roundabout when the driver in the Polo attempted to merge without checking. I did my best to brake, but they grazed the side of my vehicle. There is a long scratch along my passenger side door where we made contact at a very low speed. It was an honest mistake, but it is quite frustrating.

It was pouring rain in Porto this morning while I was trying to park near the market. I misjudged the distance to the bollard while reversing, even though I was moving at less than 5 km/h. I heard a dull thud and immediately stopped. When I got out to check, I saw a dent right on the corner of my rear bumper. I feel terrible about this because I have been driving for years without a single incident, but the visibility was just so poor.

I was heading down Avenida dos Aliados when the traffic suddenly stopped. The car in front braked much harder than I expected. I did my best to hit the brakes, but I just couldn't stop in time on the slick road surface. I hit the back of his vehicle with enough force to cause a dent and break my front passenger-side lamp. I am honestly shaken up; my hands were literally trembling when I got out to talk to the oncoming driver.

I came to a complete stop for a pedestrian crossing the road. The car behind me didn't stop in time and hit my rear bumper. I noticed that their headlight was broken and their hood had a significant dent from the impact. I just want to get this sorted through the proper insurance channels.

I was driving along the EN125 towards Faro when a truck pulled out of a side street without looking. I swerved to avoid a head-on collision, but I clipped the side of his trailer. I ended up with a dent on my front fender and a deep scratch running down the side of the door. I am just really shaken by the whole event, man. It happened so fast that I barely had time to react before the contact occurred.

I was waiting at the junction on my bike when I saw the truck pull out into the path of the oncoming Megane. The driver of the car swerved to avoid the impact, but they still scraped the side of the truck. It was clear the car driver was doing about 40 km/h and had no time to stop.

I was proceeding through the green light at the junction near the park, and everything seemed fine. Suddenly, another car clipped my side as they were trying to turn across my path. The impact was loud, and I was shocked to see my driver-side window glass shatter instantly. I’ve lived in this neighborhood for forty years and have never seen such a messy situation at this intersection; it really is quite a dangerous spot when the sun hits the traffic lights just right.

I was backing out of a tight parking spot in Coimbra. I thought I had plenty of clearance, but the narrow streets here are really deceiving. I must have miscalculated the turn, and I backed right into a street lamp post. The impact was very minor, but it was enough to break the rear lamp cover completely. I feel so bad because it's such a silly mistake to make, but I guess I was just a bit distracted by the kids in the back seat.

Traffic on Avenida Luísa Todi was crawling along, and I was checking my navigation system for a second. When I looked up, the car in front was stopped. I pressed the pedal, but I hit them anyway at low speed. There is a small dent and some light scratching on their bumper. I feel really terrible about this; I was not being careful enough, and now I have to deal with all this paperwork, which is quite stressful for me right now.

I was stationary in heavy traffic when I felt a jolt from behind. I checked my rear bumper and saw a dent and a scratch where the Corsa had hit me. It was a minor incident, but it is certainly an inconvenience to have to take the car to the repair shop next week.

I was moving from the left lane to the middle lane on Avenida 24 de Julho. I turned on my signal, but I didn't notice the motorcycle coming up alongside me. We made contact, and there is a visible mark on the side of my door. I am just really concerned about the well-being of the motorcyclist; I hate that this happened and I hope they are alright, as that is much more important than the paint on my car.

I was riding in the middle lane when the Qashqai suddenly shifted into my lane without checking the blind spot. They side-swiped me, causing a scratch along my fairing. I managed to stay upright, thank goodness, but it was a close call that left me quite shaken up on the road.

I was exiting the roundabout at Boavista and thought the lane beside me was clear. As I began to turn, I realized a van was still alongside me, and we collided. My front bumper has a dent and the headlight assembly has a broken lamp housing. I've been driving in Porto for over twenty years, and this is the first time I've ever had such an incident; it's quite a shame, really, as I try to be very careful.

I was continuing around the roundabout while the BMW was attempting to exit. The driver of the BMW did not see me and clipped my rear panel, which resulted in damage to their lamp and bumper. It was a simple case of not checking the blind spot properly, but no one was injured, which is the main thing.

I was navigating the roundabout near the Casa da Música, trying to exit towards Avenida da Boavista, when traffic suddenly stopped. It was raining and the road was quite slippery, you know? I hit the brakes, but I just couldn't stop in time and tapped the back of the car ahead of me. I am so worried because this is my first car and I honestly didn't mean to cause any trouble. You can see a visible dent on my front bumper and some nasty scratches on the hood where it hit his trunk, man.

I was navigating home from work along the Avenida 24 de Julho around 6 PM, just trying to merge into the middle lane. I checked my mirror, but I suppose I didn't see the other vehicle coming up fast in my blind spot. I moved over slightly and felt a distinct graze against the side of my door. I immediately pulled over to apologize. I noticed a long, deep scratch running along my passenger side door panel that I am really upset about.

I was maintaining my lane on the Avenida 24 de Julho when the driver in the Volkswagen suddenly swerved into my lane without signaling properly. I attempted to steer away, but there was a light contact between our side panels. I pulled over with him to inspect the damage, and he was very apologetic. My car has a long scratch on the rear quarter panel.

It was a busy afternoon near the city center, and I was distracted for just a split second by my phone GPS. The car in front had stopped for a pedestrian crossing, and I just couldn't stop in time. I am so terribly sorry about this. My front lamp is completely broken, and there is glass shattered all over the road from the headlight assembly. I am really stressed about the repair costs because the car is relatively new and I take very good care of it.

I stopped my vehicle safely at the pedestrian crossing as required by the law. Without any warning, I felt a hard jolt from behind. When I got out, I saw that the driver behind me had crashed into my rear. His headlight was broken and there was glass on the ground. It was quite an alarming experience, to be honest.

I was heading towards Cascais along the coast on the Estrada Marginal. The traffic was quite heavy with many tourists. As I did my best to change lanes to avoid a slowing bus, a vehicle in the next lane moved at the same time. We collided side-by-side at a low speed. It was a simple miscommunication, really. My car sustained a dent and a scratch on the driver's side door, which is quite annoying given the car was in perfect condition until today.

I was walking along the path near the beach when I saw two cars trying to merge into the same lane. Both drivers seemed to be unaware of each other's presence. There was a low-speed impact, resulting in some clear damage to the doors of the Toyota. It appeared to be an honest accident caused by poor visibility in the heavy traffic.

I was sitting at a red light in Vila Nova de Gaia. The driver behind me didn't seem to notice the light was still red and just rolled forward into my bumper. It wasn't a high-speed collision, but the impact was enough to break my rear lamp and push the bumper into a dented shape. I am really stressed about the repair time, man, because I need this car to get to my university classes every day. Do you think it will be fixed quickly?

I simply took my foot off the brake too early while looking at my navigation screen. I rolled forward into the car in front of me at the red light. I feel terrible about it. I have already inspected the damage and accepted full responsibility for the broken lamp and the dent I caused to the second vehicle's bumper.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: It was during the morning rush hour here in Lisbon. I was driving straight on the Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo when a delivery van to my left attempted to merge into my lane without checking. It scraped along my left door and fender. The driver was very cooperative and we exchanged details immediately. It resulted in a long, ugly scratch along the side of the car now. It is quite disappointing because I just had the car polished last week, but these things happen in city traffic.

I was approaching the crossing on the Circunvalação when a driver coming from the opposite direction made a sudden left turn right in front of me. I had absolutely no time to react and hit them on the side. The impact was quite significant. My headlight is shattered, the lamp is broken, and there is a massive dent on my hood where it crumpled. It was a very loud crash and quite a traumatic moment for me, to be honest.

I was standing at the bus stop and witnessed the whole thing. The Skoda was going straight with a green light, but the other car turned directly into its path without waiting. It was unavoidable for the Skoda driver. There was glass shattered everywhere from the lamp and a clear dent on the front of the vehicle. I felt I had to provide my contact details.

I was driving around the roundabout near the Casa da Música when another vehicle suddenly moved into my lane. I slammed on the brakes but could not avoid the impact at low speed. The individual driving the other car clipped my rear left panel. It was quite stressful, and I’m honestly worried about the repair costs because the car is my only way to get to work. I clearly see a visible dent on the wheel arch and a long scratch along the side paintwork. I was just trying to navigate the traffic flow carefully when this happened.

I was trying to exit the roundabout and I think I misjudged the distance of the car in the outer lane. I turned the steering wheel too early and ended up hitting the side of the other car. I apologize for the mistake, I was just a bit distracted by the GPS navigation instructions.

Traffic was incredibly heavy near the Cais do Sodré area this afternoon. I was stopped in a line of cars when the vehicle behind me failed to stop in time and hit me from behind. The impact was quite jarring, and I felt a bit shaken up. When I got out to check the car, I saw that my rear lamp is broken and there is a significant crack in the plastic bumper casing. Everything happened so fast, and I am just hoping the insurance process goes smoothly for everyone involved.

I was trying to park my car in a tight spot near the shopping center. It happened to be a very narrow street, and I miscalculated the angle while reversing. I ended up scraping the side of a parked vehicle. I feel terrible about it because I was being extra cautious, but it was just a lapse in judgment on my part. There is a visible mark on the side door panel. I am waiting for the owner to return so we can exchange insurance information properly.

I was sitting at a cafe table right next to the parking spot when I saw the driver trying to reverse. They were moving very slowly, but they just misjudged the space and scraped the side of the stationary car. It was clearly an honest mistake while trying to park.

I was navigating home after visiting my daughter, the traffic was moving quite slowly as it usually does on this avenue. I signaled to change lanes to the right, checking my mirrors as I always do, but I clearly missed the other car that was already there. We ended up colliding on the side. My front lamp is broken, and I noticed a deep dent and a scratch along the passenger door. I am feeling quite embarrassed, as I pride myself on being a safe driver for over forty years.

It was pouring rain earlier today, man, and the visibility was just super poor. I was slowing down because the car in front of me braked hard, but the road was so slick that my tires didn't grip well enough. I rear-ended the car ahead of me, which honestly sucks. I am super worried about the repair costs, dude. It left a noticeable dent on the middle of the trunk lid now. I hope my insurance covers this because I really didn't mean for this to happen at all.

I was navigating ahead and had to stop suddenly due to a pedestrian crossing the road. The car behind me couldn't stop in time on the wet asphalt and hit my rear bumper. We both got out and agreed that the weather made it really difficult to brake safely.

Driving across the bridge is always a nightmare with the dense traffic. I was in the middle lane when the driver to my right tried to cut in. I could not spot them until it was too late. You can see a long scratch along my passenger side door. I am really annoyed, to be honest, because I try to be so careful with my car. The other driver apologized and admitted they were in a rush, but that doesn't really fix the paintwork, does it?

I was attempting to merge into the middle lane because my lane was ending soon. I didn't check my blind spot properly and bumped into the side of the BMW. I take full responsibility for the scratch on their door, it was completely my error.

I was pulling out of a parking space in the city center. I did not realize there was a pole behind me as I turned the wheel. It happened to be a very silly mistake, and I am quite upset with myself. The impact resulted in a dent in the rear quarter panel and my tail lamp is now broken. I have been driving for many years, but today I was just distracted by my phone ringing. It’s an expensive lesson, but I am glad no one else was hurt.

I was delivery driving in the old town area, and the streets are just so incredibly tight. I made an effort to squeeze past a delivery truck that was double-parked, but I miscalculated the clearance. My side mirror clipped the truck and the glass shattered completely. I feel really bad about it, man. It's a small car, but I guess I underestimated the width of the gap. I just need to get this sorted out quickly so I can get back to my delivery route.

I was walking down the street and saw the small car trying to pass the parked truck. The driver was moving slowly, but the road is simply too narrow there. I heard the glass shatter when the mirror hit the truck's metal side. It was just a tight space accident.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: The morning commute was absolutely packed today. I was on my way towards the roundabout and the car ahead of me braked suddenly to let a bus pass. I hit the brakes, but I was maybe a bit too close and tapped their rear bumper. It was quite a loud noise, which worried me. Looking at the car, there is a minor dent and some surface scratches on my hood. I am quite frustrated because I am always careful about keeping a safe distance, but it just happened so fast.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, driving at about 20 km/h, when the car to my right tried to exit and didn't see me. I attempted to brake, but we ended up making contact. It happened so fast, and I was just trying to get to a work meeting. My passenger side door took the brunt of the impact, and now there is a visible dent and a long scratch along the panel. I am really stressed about how I am going to get to work tomorrow without my car, honestly.

I was in the roundabout and misjudged the distance while changing lanes to take the exit. I feel terrible about it. I hit the side of the second vehicle's car. I can see a clear dent and some paint scratches on their passenger door where my bumper made contact.

I was trying to parallel park in a very tight spot on Rua de Santa Catarina late in the afternoon. I thought I had enough clearance, but as I was reversing, I miscalculated the angle of the car parked behind me. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had caught the corner of their bumper. It is just a surface scratch, but I feel like an absolute idiot for doing this. I have always been careful, but this street is just so narrow and busy.

Traffic on Avenida da Boavista was incredibly heavy, just stop-and-go. I was following the car in front at a very slow pace, maybe 10 km/h, but I got distracted for a split second by a pedestrian on the sidewalk. When I looked back, the car in front had stopped dead. I slammed on the brakes, but I still bumped into them. It left a nasty dent on my hood and my front left lamp is broken. I am so worried about the repair costs, this is just a nightmare.

I was stopped at the red light when I felt a sudden jolt from behind. I checked my mirror, and the driver behind me had clearly misjudged the stop. My rear bumper is affected, but their car clearly has a dented hood and a broken headlight lamp.

It was raining, and the traffic was really dense on the bridge heading toward Almada. I was in the middle lane, moving at about 40 km/h, when the vehicle in the left lane suddenly tried to merge into my space. I had nowhere to go because of the median. They sideswiped my car, causing a dent on the rear quarter panel and a deep scratch along the side. It was such a scary moment, and the rain made it hard to even see properly what was happening.

I was driving home from my granddaughter's house on the Estrada Monumental. I recall it happened to be a bit breezy, the palm trees were swaying, and I was going quite slowly as I always do. At the intersection, a delivery van just didn't see me and clipped my front corner. The impact caused my side lamp to shatter completely and some glass from the housing to break onto the road. It was quite a shock, I must say, as I've been driving for forty years and rarely see such things.

I was waiting at the pedestrian crossing nearby. I saw the Fiat entering the intersection properly. The delivery van driver clearly didn't notice the Fiat and turned into the side of it. I heard the glass shatter when the lamp broke upon impact.

I was driving along the avenue when the car ahead braked very abruptly for a cyclist. I reacted, but because the road was a bit slick, I couldn't stop in time and tapped their bumper. It was only a low-speed impact, but it left a visible dent on the rear of their vehicle and my own front grille. I am feeling quite anxious about the whole insurance procedure, as I have never had to file a claim before and I really hope everything goes smoothly.

I was driving down Rua da Prata. The street is quite narrow due to some roadworks. A large delivery truck was trying to pass, and it seems the driver miscalculated the width of the gap. They sideswiped my car as they moved past. It left a significant dent and a large scratch on my front fender. The truck driver stopped, and we exchanged details, but I am still very worried about the damage and what it will cost to fix it properly.

I was maneuvering the truck through the construction area. I thought I had cleared the other vehicle, but I heard a scraping sound. When I checked, I saw a dent and a scratch on the side of the passenger door of the car I was passing.

I was traveling on the EN125 when a vehicle stopped suddenly in the middle of the road. I was keeping a safe distance, but it wasn't enough. I hit them from behind at about 30 km/h. It was a mess. My front lamp is broken, and it resulted in a deep impact depression on the hood. I am just really shaken up by the whole experience. The sun was also very low in the sky, which made it hard to see the brake lights of the car ahead.

location: Avenida Fontes Pereira de Melo, Lisbon

statements.text: The traffic was moving at a moderate speed of 50 km/h. I was in the right lane intending to turn into the side street. Another vehicle in the lane to my left attempted to move into my lane at the same time. We both made contact while trying to merge. It resulted in a scratch along my rear door panel. I am quite professional about these things, so I made sure to gather the driver's info immediately after we pulled over to a safe area.
I was checking my blind spot but clearly missed the BMW. I moved into their lane and we made contact. It caused a minor scratch on their vehicle. I admit my fault in this lane-change maneuver.

I was navigating the roundabout near the airport, heading toward the A1 highway. The traffic was extremely dense as usual at 9 AM. I was in the middle lane, and as I went to exit, another vehicle came alongside me. I didn't see him in my blind spot, man. We made contact, and now you can see a noticeable dent and a deep scratch on my rear wing. I'm really stressed about the repair costs, honestly, but I just want to get this sorted out properly.

I was travelling my Seat through the roundabout, following the flow of traffic. I noticed the Peugeot driver moving toward the exit, but it seemed like they didn't check their mirrors before shifting lanes. We bumped into each other at a low speed. It resulted in a dent and some scratches on their vehicle's bodywork. It was a simple case of poor visibility in the heavy morning traffic.

I was navigating home from the pharmacy, and as I approached the traffic lights on Boavista, the vehicle in front of me stopped very suddenly. It was raining quite hard, and the road surface was slick. I stepped on my brakes, but I just couldn't stop in time and tapped their bumper. My front lamp is broken now and it left a dent on my hood. I feel quite shaken by the whole incident, to be perfectly honest, as I have been driving for years.

I was travelling along the main road toward the hotel zone when I decided to shift into the left lane to prepare for a turn. I checked my mirror, but I suppose I didn't hold the gap long enough. The car behind me accelerated, and we scraped the sides of our vehicles. I stopped immediately to exchange information. There is a visible scratch running along the side of my door. I really should have been more patient with the lane change.

I was walking on the sidewalk near the hotel entrance when I observed the two vehicles. The Ford was moving into the left lane quite suddenly. The other driver didn't have much room to react. They collided, resulting in a scratch on the side of the Ford. Neither vehicle was going fast, and they both pulled over to the side of the road immediately afterward to handle the situation.

I had parked my car near the port for lunch. When I returned, I noticed that the vehicle that had been parked behind me must have hit my rear bumper while backing out. I saw a clear dent on the bumper. I waited around for a bit to see if anyone would return, but nobody appeared. It’s very frustrating to find your car damaged when you were nowhere near it, but I suppose that is just the reality of parking in such a crowded city center.

location: Praça do Marquês de Pombal, Lisbon

statements.text: I was entering the intersection near the square, and I thought I had the right of way. I was looking at the traffic light, which was turning yellow. The other driver entered from the side street at the same moment. It was a low-speed impact, but the force was enough to shatter the glass on my side mirror and break the indicator lamp on the front bumper. I am quite worried about the repair, as this car is my only way to get to work.

I was proceeding through the intersection when the Fiat pulled out. I think they might have been distracted by the light changing. My car hit their side, breaking their lamp and shattering the glass on their mirror. It happened so quickly, but we were both driving at perhaps 20 km/h. It was a genuine mistake by both of us regarding the timing of the lights at such a busy crossing.

I was driving in the right lane, and a large truck was in the lane to my left. As we were moving, the truck started to drift into my lane. I swerved to the right to avoid a major collision, but I still clipped the side barrier. This resulted in a long scratch along my passenger side doors. It was quite a stressful experience, and my hands were shaking for a while afterward, but I managed to keep the car under control.

I was standing near the metro exit when I saw the truck drift into the lane of the BMW. The BMW driver reacted well by moving to the right, but they were forced against the guardrail. I saw the side of the BMW get scratched by the barrier. It was clearly the truck's fault for drifting, but thankfully it was only a scratch and not a more serious accident.

My grandson and I were driving down the avenue, just enjoying the afternoon, when the car in front of us braked suddenly for a pedestrian. I pressed the brakes as hard as I could, but my foot slipped a bit, and I hit them. My car sustained a impact depression on the grille and some glass shattered from the headlight. It was a very upsetting moment for me, especially with my grandson in the car, but we are all safe and the other driver was very kind.

I stopped for a pedestrian crossing the street in front of the city hall. The Audi behind me wasn't able to stop in time and hit my bumper. It wasn't a massive impact, but it caused some damage to their headlight glass and a dent on their bumper. I checked on the driver and their grandson immediately, and we exchanged details once we were sure that everyone was feeling okay.

I was driving home from work around 6:30 PM, and traffic on Avenida da Liberdade was quite dense as usual. Suddenly, the car ahead of me braked very abruptly because a tourist stepped off the curb. I slammed on my brakes, but the road was a bit damp and I could not stop in time, so I tapped his bumper. The situation involved a stupid mistake and I feel terrible about it. There is a small dent and a long scratch on my hood where I hit the rear of his car.

I was navigating the roundabout at Boavista in the outer lane when a van suddenly cut across me from the inside lane to exit toward the highway. I did my best to swerve, but there was nowhere to go. We collided at a very low speed. I was honestly so shaken up, like, my hands were literally shaking. I'm worried about the repair costs, dude. The front left lamp is broken and there are several deep scratches along the side panel from the van's bumper.

I was heading home to Gaia and realized I had nearly missed my exit. I moved into the lane quickly but didn't notice the car in my blind spot. I hit the back of his front fender. It was entirely my fault as I was maneuvering too aggressively in the heavy afternoon traffic.

I was trying to parallel park my Fiat near the center of Braga this morning. The spot was quite narrow, and as I was reversing, I misjudged the distance to the concrete pillar behind me. I heard a scraping sound, and I immediately knew I had hit it. I feel quite embarrassed about the whole incident, but I am reporting it immediately for insurance purposes. I noticed a significant, visible scratch across the rear bumper where it scraped against the stone edge of the pillar.

While driving on the N125 near Faro, the lane markings were a bit faded due to the bright sun glare. I signaled to change to the right lane, but another driver was moving up alongside me at the same time. We both tried to adjust, but our side doors made contact. I am a very careful driver, so this is quite frustrating. The door has a noticeable dent and a scratch running horizontally along the handle area where we made contact.

The sunlight was blinding me coming out of the tunnel. I saw a BMW changing lanes, but I was already positioned in the lane. We bumped sides. It was a minor incident, but we both sustained damage to our bodywork. I apologize for not checking my mirror more carefully.

It was quite early, around 8:00 AM, and traffic was crawling across the bridge. A vehicle three cars ahead stopped dead. Everyone jammed their brakes on. The lady behind me stopped, but then a delivery truck hit her, which pushed her into me. I heard the glass shatter immediately.
