My trunk has a huge dent, and the rear window glass shattered from the impact force. It has been a long morning and I just want to get my car to the shop.

I was in the car behind the delivery truck. I saw the whole sequence. The traffic came to a halt on the bridge, and the truck couldn't stop in time. It was a classic chain reaction due to the congestion on the bridge. The driver in the middle really didn't have a chance to avoid hitting the Seat.

Well, you see, I was just coming back from visiting my granddaughter in Benfica. It was a lovely day, but the traffic was simply horrendous. I was turning slowly into a parking spot and there was this young man on a bicycle who suddenly swerved toward my car to avoid a pothole. I stopped, but he clipped the passenger side door. It resulted in a nasty scratch there, poor thing. It's not a large incident, but I felt I must report it correctly as the rules state.

I was cycling and didn't see the Mini pulling in because I was distracted by a pothole in the road. I swerved into the car and my handlebars caused a mark on the side of the door. The driver was very kind and helped me up.

I was driving along the Avenida da Boavista at approximately 40 km/h. A car in the lane to my left started drifting into my lane while the driver was clearly distracted by his mobile phone. I honked, but he still grazed my side. The car has a series of scratches and a small impact depression on the rear passenger door. It's very frustrating because the car is practically new and I always park in a garage to avoid these things.

I admit I was looking at a notification on my phone. I drifted slightly out of my lane on the avenue. I felt a bump and realized I had sideswiped the Mercedes. I am fully responsible for the damage to the side of his vehicle.

I was stopped at a pedestrian crossing in Cascais waiting for a group of tourists to pass. I was just sitting there, calm, listening to the radio, when suddenly the car behind me failed to stop and hit my rear bumper. The force was quite significant. My rear hatch has a very large dent, and the rear window glass shattered completely across the road. It was quite a shock, but at least the pedestrians were safe and nobody was walking behind me at that exact moment.

I was heading along Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM yesterday when traffic suddenly came to a complete standstill. I tried to brake, but I wasn't fast enough and tapped the back of the car in front of me at about 10 km/h. It was completely my fault, man, I was just distracted for a second by the GPS. My bumper has a clear dent and some deep scratches on the right side. I feel terrible about this whole situation, you know, it's just my luck to have this happen during rush hour.

I was waiting in the traffic line heading toward the city center when I suddenly felt a jolt from behind. The driver behind me didn't stop in time. When I checked my car, I saw a impact depression on the lower part of my trunk and some light scratches from the impact. The oncoming driver apologized immediately and was very cooperative.

location: Roundabout near Marina de Cascais, Cascais

statements.text: I was navigating the roundabout near the Cascais marina, trying to exit toward the beach, when I misjudged the distance of the vehicle in the inner lane. As I moved over, I brushed against the side of the other car. It was just a low-speed contact, maybe 15 km/h. There are some long white scratches along my passenger door. I am honestly quite anxious about the insurance claim process because I really need my car for work tomorrow morning. I hope this can be sorted out quickly and without too much hassle.

I was trying to park in a very tight spot on Rua Augusta this morning. I thought I had enough room, but as I was reversing at walking speed, I bumped into the parked van behind me. I didn't see it until it was too late. There is a visible dent on my rear bumper. I am so worried about the repair costs, dude. It was such a silly mistake to make on a Tuesday, and now I have to deal with all this paperwork for the insurance company.

I was sitting at a nearby café terrace when I saw the white Fiat attempting to park. It was moving quite slowly, but the driver clearly miscalculated the proximity to the delivery van. There was a low-speed impact, resulting in a noticeable dent on the Fiat's rear bumper. No one was injured, and the driver stopped immediately.

I was travelling home from the office around 7:00 PM. It was getting dark and the lights were already on. I signaled to change lanes on Avenida 24 de Julho, but I didn't see the motorcycle coming up in my blind spot. I clipped his handlebars, which caused him to wobble, and then he grazed my rear quarter panel. My tail lamp is broken and there are several scratches on the fender. I am so shaken up, honestly, I didn't mean to cut him off, I just truly didn't see him there.

location: Praça de Mouzinho de Albuquerque, Porto

statements.text: It was raining this morning in Porto, and the streets were quite slippery. As I approached the intersection at the Rotunda da Boavista, the lights turned yellow. I tried to stop, but my tires lost grip on the wet pavement. I skidded forward and collided with the back of a stationary taxi at roughly 20 km/h. The impact caused a deep dent on my hood and shattered my front headlight glass. I feel terrible for the taxi driver, as he was just doing his job and waiting for the signal.

I was stopped at the traffic light on the roundabout. I checked my mirror and saw the car behind me sliding on the wet road. He hit my rear bumper. My car has some cosmetic damage, but thankfully, nobody was hurt. It was clearly a result of the sudden rainfall making the road surface very dangerous for braking.

I was heading down the Estrada Monumental toward the city center. I had been driving for about twenty minutes, and I must admit I was a bit tired after my long shift at the hotel. The car in front of me slowed down abruptly for a bus that was pulling away from a stop, and I just didn't react quickly enough. I hit him at very low speed, but there is a clear dent on my front grille. I am very sorry about this, it was just a moment of poor judgment.

I had just finished my weekly grocery shopping. The situation involved a very busy morning at the parking lot on Avenida da República. As I was pulling out of my space, I miscalculated the swing of my front bumper while turning, and I grazed the side of the parked SUV next to me. It created a long, unsightly scratch along my door. I immediately left a note with my contact details on the other windshield, as I believe that is the right thing to do in such an unfortunate situation.

I returned to my car after running errands and found a note on my windshield. The other driver admitted to scraping my side door while pulling out of their parking spot. There are visible white scratches on my passenger side door panel. I appreciate the honesty of the driver, as they provided all their insurance details right away.

Well, you see, I was travelling down the Avenida dos Aliados, which is always so full of tourists and busy traffic. I was looking for a spot to drop off my granddaughter at the museum, and while I was turning, I didn't see the bollard on the edge of the pedestrian area. I bumped into it at about 5 km/h, very slowly really. It broke my rear tail lamp. I have been driving for over forty years, and I must say I feel quite embarrassed by this little mishap.

It happened to be a narrow street in the Cedofeita neighborhood. I was trying to pass a delivery truck that was partially parked on the side of the road. I thought I had enough clearance, but there was a car coming in the opposite direction. I tried to pull back to my side, but I didn't have enough room and side-swiped the parked car. It resulted in a dent on my front fender and some nasty scratches along the trim. Man, I am so stressed, I really need this car for my commute every single day.

I was entering the roundabout near the airport, and honestly, the traffic was moving quite erratically. I was changing lanes to take the exit when I collided with a car that was accelerating hard from behind. The impact caused a dent on my rear quarter panel and broke my side-mounted indicator lamp. It happened so fast, like, I checked my mirrors, but they were in my blind spot. I am definitely going to be more careful at roundabouts from now on, it was a very scary experience.

I was driving around the roundabout toward the airport terminal. The car in front of me attempted to cut across lanes without signaling clearly. I tried to brake, but we made contact. My front bumper has a dent from the collision. It was a very confusing situation given how busy the roundabout was at that time of day.

I was driving home from work along Avenida da Boavista when traffic suddenly slowed down near the park. I braked, but the driver behind me didn't react in time. My car was pushed forward, and I felt the impact clearly. I got out and saw a crush on the rear bumper and some white paint scratches across the plastic trim. I am quite worried about the repair costs, as I have always tried to keep my car in perfect condition. The other driver was cooperative and we immediately filled out the European Accident Report.

I was navigating the roundabout at Entrecampos during the morning rush. As I was exiting towards the main avenue, a van coming from my left failed to yield and struck my passenger side. The impact was loud, and I realized my turn signal lamp broken and the passenger side window glass shatter immediately. I am truly shaken up by the whole experience. It happened so fast, and honestly, I just want to make sure the process is handled correctly because I need the car for my daily commute.

I was merging into the roundabout and simply did not see the Peugeot in my blind spot. I take full responsibility for the collision. When I hit the vehicle, I heard the glass break and saw the side light unit shatter on the ground. I have already provided my insurance details to the driver so we can process the claim as quickly as possible.

It happened to be a busy Saturday afternoon in Setúbal. I was trying to park in a tight spot along Avenida Luísa Todi. I misjudged the distance while reversing into the space next to a parked sedan and ended up dragging my rear quarter panel against their bumper. I feel terrible about the mistake. There is a deep scratch along the side of my car. I waited for the other owner to return to the vehicle so we could exchange information properly. It was an honest error of judgment on my part.

I was moving slowly in heavy traffic near Avenida dos Aliados. The driver in the adjacent lane tried to squeeze into my gap without checking the mirrors properly. He swiped the side of my vehicle while merging. I have a long dent along the door and several deep scratches where the paint was removed. My main concern is getting this sorted out quickly, as this is a company car and I need to report this to my fleet manager without delay. It was a very frustrating afternoon in the city center.

I was walking along the sidewalk and saw the whole thing. The white car tried to change lanes too abruptly. There was no way the BMW could have avoided it. I saw the metal denting as they scraped together. I left my contact details because it was clear the driver of the BMW wasn't at fault.

I was pulling out of a parking spot in downtown Lisbon. I was being careful, but as I turned the wheel to exit, I clipped a bollard that I hadn't noticed. It happened to be a very low-speed impact, maybe 5 km/h, but it was enough to cause my front lamp broken. I feel quite silly for missing that pole, honestly. It's just one of those days where everything feels a bit off. I'm reporting this to get the light replaced as soon as possible because I don't want to drive with a broken light at night.

It was a lovely day for a drive, and I was heading towards Cascais along the Marginal. Traffic came to a sudden halt near the beach parking areas. The vehicle behind me, a large delivery truck, bumped into my rear. It left a significant impact depression on the trunk door. I have been driving for over forty years, and this is the first time I have been involved in such an incident. My grandchildren were in the car, and we were all just startled by the sudden jolt of the collision, truly an unexpected afternoon.

The sun was quite bright, and when the traffic stopped, I was momentarily distracted by the glare. I hit the back of the Mercedes at a low speed. I apologize for the incident; I caused a dent to the trunk of the car. We have filled out the papers, and I am ready to cooperate with the insurance claim process.

I was traveling north on Avenida da República in the middle lane. The car to my right suddenly accelerated and swerved into my lane without signaling. I attempted to steer left, but we made contact. It resulted in a noticeable dent on my front fender and a long scratch along the wheel arch. I'm just so stressed about this, you know? I have an important meeting later, and now I have to deal with this mess. The other driver and I are currently waiting for the police to clear the scene.

I was crossing the intersection at Rua de Cedofeita when a taxi came through a red light. It hit my side door. I was quite scared because the impact shattered the glass of my rear window and my turn signal lamp broken. There is also a large dent in the door panel. I’ve never been in a crash before, and my heart is still pounding. I am just really hoping the insurance covers the repairs properly, as this is my only car and I rely on it for everything.

I was rushing to pick up a passenger and misread the traffic lights at the intersection. I am at fault for the collision. The impact damaged the door of the other vehicle, breaking the glass and the indicator light. I am very sorry for the inconvenience and have admitted my error to the individual driving the other car.

I was parking near Praça do Comércio, trying to find a spot. While I was maneuvering into a tight space between two cars, I accidentally misjudged the turn and scraped my bumper against a concrete pillar in the underground lot. It’s just a superficial scratch, but I wanted to report it immediately to maintain my insurance standing. I’ve been driving in these tight city streets for years, so it's frustrating to make such a basic mistake today. I will be bringing the car to the shop later this week to get it polished and repaired.

Driving along Avenida 24 de Julho is always chaotic, but today was worse than usual. I was keeping in my lane when the vehicle to my left suddenly swerved to avoid a cyclist. He clipped the side of my car, causing a dent and multiple scratches on the driver's side door. It happened so quickly that I didn't even have time to honk. I'm just thankful no one was hurt. I need to get an estimate for these bodywork repairs as soon as possible, as the damage is quite visible.

I saw the whole incident while waiting for the bus. The driver of the gray car swerved suddenly to miss a bicycle in the road, which pushed him into the Seat. It was definitely a side-swipe, and I saw the paint scratch and the metal dent immediately upon impact.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:30 PM when the traffic suddenly stopped. It was quite heavy due to the rush hour, and I attempted to brake, but I wasn't fast enough and hit the rear of the car in front of me. I am so incredibly stressed about this, like, I have never been in an accident before and I am really worried about how much this is going to cost to repair. I noticed a noticeable dent on my hood where I made contact with their bumper.

I was completely stopped in traffic when I suddenly felt a significant jolt from behind. When I got out to check the damage, the individual driving the other car seemed very anxious and upset. My rear bumper definitely has a dent, but fortunately, nothing else seems broken on my car.

I was navigating the roundabout near Casa da Música when another driver merged into my lane too quickly. I tried to steer away, but we made contact on the side. I am quite a cautious driver usually, so this is very frustrating. It was raining slightly, making the roads slick. The impact caused a long scratch along my passenger side door. I hope the insurance company understands that I really didn't have much room to maneuver away from the other vehicle in that moment.

I was attempting to parallel park on Avenida da Liberdade this morning. The spot was quite tight, and I misjudged the distance between my car and the concrete bollard on the sidewalk. I heard a scraping sound and realized I had made contact. I checked the area and saw both a scratch and a dent on my front right fender. It happened to be a stupid mistake on my part, and I feel terrible about it, but I just want to get it fixed properly through the insurance process.

I was crossing the intersection at Rua Augusta when the other car didn't stop at the red light. I hit them on the side at low speed, maybe 15 km/h. I am still shaking from the impact, to be honest. My front lamp is completely broken and there is glass shatter all over the pavement. It all happened so fast, and I am worried that I'll be held responsible even though I had the green light. It’s just a really overwhelming situation for me right now.

I was standing on the corner waiting to cross when I saw the silver Toyota enter the intersection on a green light. The black sedan ignored the signal and drove right into the path of the Toyota. The situation involved a clear collision; the front lamp of the Toyota shattered instantly on impact.

The traffic was moving slowly in the center lane of Avenida dos Aliados. I checked my mirrors before switching to the left lane, but I must have missed the other driver who was in my blind spot. We side-swiped each other at very low speed. There is a visible scratch on my rear quarter panel. I am a professional driver and I usually pride myself on my awareness, so this is quite embarrassing to report. I have provided the necessary details for our mutual insurance declaration.

I have been driving in this city for over forty years, and I usually take great care. I was driving down Rua do Ouro, going to visit my grandson for his birthday, when the car in front of me suddenly braked for a pedestrian. I pressed the brake pedal firmly, but I still tapped his bumper. It is a dent and a broken lamp on my side. I am quite shaken by this incident as I have not had a claim in a very long time, and I am anxious about the repair.

I stopped for a pedestrian crossing the street. The gentleman behind me clearly didn't stop in time. He was very apologetic and visibly nervous. My car sustained some damage, but he was helpful and we exchanged all insurance details immediately at the scene.

Traffic was dense on the bridge this afternoon. I was maintaining my lane when a heavy vehicle moved into my space, pushing me slightly toward the barrier. I tried to steer away but my side caught the metal guardrail, resulting in a deep scratch. It was a very claustrophobic situation and I am just glad there was no multi-car pileup. I have photographic evidence of the scratch and the location where it happened. I would appreciate it if the insurance claim could be processed efficiently.

location: Avenida Marechal Gomes da Costa, Lisbon

statements.text: I was proceeding through the intersection at around 30 km/h when another vehicle approached from the right and failed to yield at the stop sign. I hit their rear side. It was a loud impact, and my front lamp is broken and I noticed a significant dent on my bumper. I am trying to stay calm about this whole process, but it is such a nuisance to deal with paperwork while I have so much work waiting for me. I just want this resolved as quickly as possible.

I was leaving a parking garage in Rua de Santa Catarina. The exit is very narrow and poorly lit. As I turned the corner, I miscalculated the swing of my car and scraped the side against a concrete pillar. It left a long scratch along the side panel. It is just a minor incident, but it is frustrating given that I only bought this car recently. I am reporting it honestly as it happened, and I hope the coverage will allow for a repair soon.

I was stopped in the middle lane on Avenida da República due to heavy traffic. I was looking at the traffic lights when I was hit from behind by a van. The force was enough to cause a dent in my rear and some glass shatter from the taillight. It was a very jarring experience, and I am still trying to process what happened. I’ve already taken down the details of the individual driving the other car, and we both agreed to file our respective reports immediately to avoid any further trouble.

I was distracted for a split second and failed to notice the traffic had come to a standstill. I hit the back of the Audi in front of me at low speed. The driver of the Audi was composed, and we exchanged details. My vehicle did not suffer major damage, but the Audi has a dent and broken rear glass.

I was travelling around the roundabout at Boavista, trying to head towards the bridge, when things got a bit chaotic. I was in the outer lane, and I think I misjudged the distance of the car next to me. I was going really slow, maybe 20 km/h, because of the traffic density. Suddenly, I heard this grinding noise against the passenger side door. I am honestly so stressed about this, like, I have never had an accident before. There is just a long, visible scratch along the metal, but thank goodness it didn't dent anything.

I was attempting to parallel park near the main square in the city center. It was a tight space, and I was being super careful, checking my mirrors constantly. I thought I had enough clearance from the car parked in front of me, but I clearly miscalculated my distance by a few centimeters. As I reversed slowly, I felt a slight jolt. Upon inspection, I realized I had left a noticeable dent on my rear bumper. It was an honest mistake and I am feeling quite embarrassed about the whole situation.

I was sitting at the outdoor cafe nearby watching the street. The driver of the Peugeot was clearly trying to park carefully. The maneuver was very slow, but he just misjudged the distance to the stationary vehicle and tapped the bumper. I saw the dent occur immediately upon impact. It was just an unfortunate, low-speed parking error.

It was pouring rain this afternoon, and the visibility near the Baixa area was quite poor. I was moving at a very low speed because of the heavy pedestrian traffic. As I pulled forward, a delivery van suddenly stopped in front of me. I braked hard, but my car slid slightly on the wet cobblestones, and I hit the back of the van. The impact was really minor, but my front lamp is broken. I am worried about the repair costs, man, this car is my only way to get to university.

I stopped my van to check a delivery address. The Fiat behind me couldn't stop in time due to the slick road conditions. It was a very gentle tap, but their front lamp shattered upon contact with my rear step. We were both going very slowly.

I was heading home on the N125 after running errands in Faro. The traffic was bumper-to-bumper, as it often is during the late afternoon. I glanced at my GPS for a split second, and when I looked back, the car in front of me had stopped abruptly. I slammed on the brakes, but I still rear-ended them. I am very upset with myself for being distracted. There is a dent and a deep scratch on my hood, and I honestly just want to get this sorted as quickly as possible.

I was driving along the avenue when I decided to change lanes to turn right. I checked my side mirror, but I suppose the other vehicle was in my blind spot. As I shifted, I felt a slight scrape against the side of my car. I pulled over immediately to talk to the individual driving the other car. It left a long scratch running across the passenger door. I really pride myself on being a safe driver, so this is quite distressing for me to report to the insurance company today.

I was maintaining my lane when the driver in the BMW moved into my path without seeing me. I tried to swerve, but they still scraped the side of my vehicle. The contact resulted in a significant scratch on their door panel. We both stopped right away to exchange details.

Well, you see, I was trying to pull into this parking spot, and I have been driving for over forty years, but the sun was hitting my windshield at just the right angle to blind me momentarily. I turned the wheel a bit too early, I suppose, and the front corner of my car caught the side of the vehicle parked next to me. It created a dent and a rather nasty scratch on my bumper. My grandson always tells me to be more careful, and I really should have listened to him today.

I was waiting at a red light on the avenue, and I was completely stationary. Suddenly, I felt a hard jolt from behind. The vehicle behind me failed to stop in time, likely due to a moment of inattention. The impact was quite strong, and it caused the glass to shatter on my rear light assembly. I am feeling a bit shaken up, to be honest. I was just sitting there, waiting for the light to turn green so I could get to my meeting on time.

I am terribly sorry about this. I was looking down at my radio for just a second, and when I looked up, the traffic had stopped. I attempted to brake, but I hit the Volvo in front of me. I heard the glass shatter immediately. I am fully prepared to take responsibility for this accident.

Everything happened so fast. I was circling the square to exit towards the river, and another car was coming in too quickly from the side. We both tried to merge, and we clipped each other. My front lamp is broken, and there is a damage to the fender. I am just really worried because this is my main car for work and I need it fixed. The individual driving the other car and I agreed that it was just a simple misunderstanding of the right-of-way in the roundabout.

I was entering the roundabout and thought I had the space to pull in. The Opel was also entering at the same time. We bumped into each other. I am sorry for the damage to the lamp and the dent on their car. It was just a mistake on both our parts.

It happened to be a busy Saturday morning, and I was navigating the narrow streets of the city. I was trying to squeeze past a delivery truck that was double-parked. I was going very slowly, maybe 10 km/h, but I miscalculated how close the truck's side panel was. I heard a scraping sound against my side mirror and door. You can see a long scratch along the side of my car now. It's so frustrating because the street is just too narrow for two vehicles to pass at the same time.

I was driving home from work during the peak rush hour on the Avenida da Republica. The car in front of me stopped suddenly, and despite my best efforts to brake firmly, I couldn't stop in time on the asphalt. I hit the rear of their vehicle, causing a dent on their bumper and some glass to shatter from their rear light. I feel terrible about the accident; I was paying attention, but the traffic flow was just incredibly erratic and stopped dead.

I was walking on the sidewalk near the crosswalk. I saw the traffic jam build up quickly. The Audi driver was traveling at a reasonable speed, but the car ahead stopped without warning. The impact was unavoidable. I saw the dent and the glass shatter on the ground immediately afterward.

I was driving down Avenida da Boavista around 5:00 PM in heavy traffic. The car in front of me suddenly braked hard because a pedestrian started crossing outside the crosswalk. I made an effort to press my brakes immediately, but I didn't have enough distance, and I ended up bumping into his rear bumper at a low speed. I am honestly quite worried about my insurance premiums now, I hope this doesn't cost me too much. It left a noticeable dent on my hood where I hit him, but thankfully nobody was hurt in the process.

It was raining this morning near the airport and everything was a bit chaotic with the traffic. As I was navigating the Rotunda do Relógio to exit towards the highway, a white van merged into my lane too quickly. I swerved to the left to avoid a full impact, but I still grazed the side of his vehicle. I stopped immediately to check the damage, and I can see a long scratch along my passenger-side door. I am feeling quite stressed about the repair process, dude, this is my first time dealing with this.

I was entering the roundabout and moved to the outer lane. I didn't see the Seat Ibiza coming from behind as I made the turn. We made contact, and my side panel now has a clear scratch. It happened to be a simple mistake due to the heavy rain and poor visibility, and we both pulled over safely to exchange our insurance details.

I was trying to park in a very narrow spot in Coimbra city center yesterday afternoon. I misjudged the distance from the stone pillar on my left while reversing. I heard a scraping sound and stopped right away. When I got out, I realized I had scraped against the pillar, causing a dent and a deep scratch on my rear bumper. I feel so embarrassed about it, honestly. I've been driving for years and I should have been much more careful with such a tight maneuver, but the street was quite dark.

I was cruising along Avenida 24 de Julho near the docks. The traffic was moving slowly, maybe at 30 km/h. A delivery scooter tried to squeeze between my car and the lane divider, but he hit my side mirror and the front bumper. It caused a broken lamp on the side and a series of scratches. I'm really frustrated because I was just driving normally and he appeared out of nowhere. I hope the repair is covered by my policy, as the damage looks quite bad when you see it up close.

I was walking my dog on the sidewalk when I saw the whole thing. The BMW was staying in its lane, but the scooter driver was driving aggressively between lanes. The scooter clipped the side of the car, causing the light to break and leaving visible marks on the car's paint. The BMW driver reacted correctly by braking immediately.

I was coming home from the grocery store in Funchal when a car suddenly pulled out from a side street without stopping at the intersection. I had the right of way, but I couldn't stop in time. We collided, and the impact shattered my side mirror glass and caused a dent in the driver's side door. It was such a shock, I am still shaking a bit, you know? It's just really overwhelming to deal with a broken car when you have to get back to work tomorrow morning.

I apologize, I was distracted by my GPS for a split second and didn't notice the stop sign until it was too late. I hit the side of the Toyota as I entered the junction. I accept full responsibility for the accident and the resulting damage to their vehicle, including the shattered glass and door dent.

I was heading to the beach in Faro, and I signaled to change into the left lane to turn. I checked my mirrors, but I must have missed the other driver who was speeding up. We scraped each other's paint at low speed. It resulted in a long scratch on my rear door. It was honestly a lapse in my judgment, and I feel terrible about it. I am very concerned about the cost of the bodywork, as the car is fairly new and I have always kept it in perfect condition.

I was stopped at a red light on the main avenue in Braga. I was waiting quite a while, thinking about my afternoon appointments, when suddenly I felt a jolt from behind. Another driver had rear-ended me. The impact was quite strong, enough to break my rear tail lamp and push the bumper in, causing a significant dent. I am an elderly driver, and this whole situation has been quite a bother for me, especially having to wait for the police report in this heat with my health conditions.

While navigating the narrow streets near Aliados, I accidentally backed into a concrete post. I was moving at maybe 5 km/h, but the bumper hit the edge of the post. It resulted in a visible crack in the plastic molding of the bumper. It's so frustrating because I'm usually very careful in city driving. I will need to get this repaired as soon as possible because I don't want the damage to spread further. Man, I really wish I had paid more attention to the proximity sensors.

The traffic on the EN125 was moving, then suddenly stopped. I shifted my vehicle slightly to the right to see around a large truck, but I failed to notice the cyclist lane merging. I grazed a stationary car in the process. It left a scratch and a small dent on the wheel arch. I am very apologetic, as I should have checked my blind spot more thoroughly. I am worried about how the insurance company will assess the damage, but I want to make sure the oncoming driver is taken care of.

I was stopped in traffic when the Ford decided to change lanes without checking his surroundings. He side-swiped my rear left panel. I have a scratch and a small dent on my door. We exchanged details on the side of the road safely. It was an honest mistake, I believe, but the damage is certainly there.

I was heading around the roundabout near the city park. The driver in the inner lane tried to exit the roundabout from the wrong lane, crossing right into my path. I had to brake hard, but he still hit my front corner. The impact broke my front indicator lamp. I am very stressed because this is a new vehicle and I have a strict schedule today. The other driver seemed very confused about the roundabout rules, which caused a lot of unnecessary chaos during the morning commute for everyone else.
